chapters.title: Chapter 4851: The old Divine Beast
paragraphs: Though the situation in the outside world was unclear, there was a very wide gap in the flow of time between the two sides. Ling Han decided to first go and see that old Divine Beast.
Ling Han had long heard of its viciousness, but had never seen it before. Ling Han was still slightly expectant.
—Even if they were enemies.
Meanwhile, the Battle Saint Emperor told him to wait, and they would go together.
Fine then.
Ling Han could use the chance to to stabilize his cultivation level. Thirteen days later, the Battle Saint Emperor came out, his wounds recovered.
"Let’s go." The old Saint Emperor picked up his staff and headed towards the cave entrance.
Ling Han followed behind him. After walking out of the Cave of Life, the two of them walked side by side.
They weren’t heading toward the pillar of light at the center of the island. Instead, they were heading towards a considerably veered off angle.
The speed of a Great Emperor was too fast. Not too long after, images of an intense battle appeared ahead of them.
Roughly speaking, it was a group of people ganging up on a single person.
Yi, was this the old Divine Beast?
Ling Han was surprised. The 36 Divine Beasts had all appeared in the form of beasts, but the old Divine Beast had actually taken human form?

If it was not for the fact that he was already certain that it was definitely the old Divine Beast that was being ganged up on, he would definitely have guessed that the old Divine Beast had a human assistant.
However, though they were being ganged up on, it was actually the old Divine Beast that was beating up the others.
He was too strong.
He threw a punch, and all the Great Emperors were sent flying. They were no match for him at all.
Fourth tier Great Emperors were completely no match for a second tier Great Emperor.
But the old Divine Beast did not give chase. His focus was on excavating an enclosed cave. He had already dug out a very deep section, but had not reached the bottom yet.

Ling Han knew that this was the Cave of Death. Once the old Divine Beast dug through the cave, the old Divine Beast would be able to see the key to death. After mastering it, he would truly be invincible in the world.
—Even if one possessed the element of Life, he could still kill any Great Emperor that he wanted, and there would be no way to save him.
"Old Sun is here!" The moment the Battle Saint Emperor arrived, he couldn’t help but roar in excitement. Brandishing his metal staff, he charged forward.
Peng!
The old Divine Beast Beast its hand again, and instantly, the Battle Saint Emperor and the others were sent flying.

However, the other Great Emperors all went with the flow to disperse the momentum, but the Battle Saint Emperor forcibly dispersed it. He was the first to charge back, and brandished his staff to attack again.
However, how could a measly Great Emperor possibly block the old Divine Beast?
Peng, the old Divine Beast sent out another palm strike. This time, it was the Battle Saint Emperor facing it head-on alone. One strike was enough to make him throw up blood endlessly.
Ling Han placed his hand on his forehead. This was the line of the Battle Saint Emperor, so how could he stop his progress on the path of complaining?
"Ling Han!" Buddha Doga’s voice rang out. This veteran Pseudo-Emperor, and now Great Emperor, also appeared in front of Ling Han.
"Senior." Ling Han nodded.
"Haha, since you’ve already proven your Dao, there’s no need for you to address me as Senior." Buddha Doga smiled. He looked at Ling Han with emotion and gratitude in his eyes.
He was able to attain Dao because of his comprehension ability and talent, but most importantly, it was Ling Han who had brought him to this place.
Otherwise, there was no need to mention anything else.
Ling Han thought for a moment, then smiled naturally.
Since these seniors were so open-minded, what need was there for him to be so rigid?
"Then let’s go too," Ling Han said with a smile.
"All right!" Buddha Doga nodded.
The two of them also soared into the skies, and charged towards the old Divine Beast.
This... was very different from the final great battle that Ling Han had imagined.
This was a group of Great Emperors. They had been fighting to the death for billions of years, and all of this was for the sake of a coal mine.
Who would believe this?
This level was really too low.
Just look, just how great was the scheme of the Lords of Death? They would destroy the universe at the drop of a hat.
Here... er, for the sake of a mine?
This was practically incomparable!
However, it just so happened that the battle here would decide the fate of the whole universe.
Ling Han sighed. Was the path of his complaining a path of no return?
"You!" The old Divine Beast suddenly set its eyes on Ling Han. Boom, it delivered a palm strike.
’What? Do you have some kind of grudge against me?’
This palm strike was indescribably fast.
Ling Han could only take it head-on. Peng, he was instantly sent flying, feeling as if all his organs had shifted.
Peng! He crashed into the ground, and it was as if his entire body had turned into mud. He couldn’t move at all.
"Brat, you have a shred of my bearing." The Battle Saint Emperor leaped over and grabbed Ling Han, saying, "I’ll help you heal your injuries."
Ling Han gritted his teeth. It had only been a single strike, and he was already severely injured?
Was the gap really that wide?

However, upon further thought, he had only cultivated two Nine Star Regulations, and in terms of the element of Life, he had only just begun. Thus, on the surface, he looked to be in the fourth tier, but in truth, he should be in the fifth tier, and could only be ranked very, very far ahead in the fifth tier.
It was nothing strange that he would be severely wounded by the old Divine Beast with this strike.
"You’ll get used to it. Fighting with that old beast, who hasn’t been heavily injured, or evendied before?" the Battle Saint Emperor said casually.
By the looks of it, the Great Emperors were already accustomed to being pummeled.
Ling Han could also tell that the Great Emperors were all at the fourth tier. Compared to the old Divine Beast, they were two tiers weaker. Even if they teamed up, they were still no match.
Thus, the Great Emperors could only detain the old Divine Beast. They were still at a disadvantage.
After returning to the Pool of Life, Ling Han began to heal his injuries. On the other side, he was also comprehending the secrets of life, deepening his grasp of the essence of life.
Seventeen days later, he recovered from his injuries.
He decided to leave. He would first deal with the Lords of Death and the 36 Divine Beasts in the outside world.
He would first eliminate the external problem, and then deal with his internal worries.

Buddha Doga didn’t follow him. Since Ling Han had succeeded Dao, he was completely capable of sweeping aside all opposition with his strength. Thus, Buddha Doga wanted to stay here and continue fighting to buy as much time as possible.
Ling Han returned. This time, when he crossed the Sea of Death again, he had shortened the time to seven years.
That was because he was now a true Great Emperor.

Furthermore, he was already using Destructive Energy to temper himself, and would also welcome a burst of power from his physique and Body Art, and added with the fact that he could continue to comprehend the other nine-star Regulations in the outside world, it could be imagined just how massively his battle prowess would be boosted
After crossing the great sea, Ling Han did not stop in the slightest. He passed by the Divine Beast cities, and arrived at the entrance of the passageway of the two realms.
’Hmm?’
He shockingly discovered that the 36 Divine Beasts had actually joined forces to block him again.
True Phoenix Emperor had indeed come back to life.
The Lords of Death weren’t among them. Their alliance with the Divine Beasts was extremely fragile.
The problem was, when had these Divine Beast Great Emperors come here?
If they had been standing guard here all this while, that would be understandable, but if they had suddenly come here, that would be strange.
Could it be that the old Divine Beast had informed them?
But the old Divine Beast was clearly on Imperial Island, so how had he sent out the news?
"Ling Han, you had best stay here obediently," Qiong Qi Emperor said calmly.
"As long as you stay here, we won’t make a move on you either," Ying Yu Emperor continued.

Their goal was very simple, and that was to have the Lords of Death destroy the wider world, and then the destructive power created by the collision of heaven and earth could even affect the Imperial Island, and from there, open the Cave of Death.
Under such conditions, killing Ling Han or not also became secondary.

chapters.title: Chapter 4852: Emperors dying like rain
paragraphs: Ling Han smiled, "You guys came just in time, just in time to fill my stomach!"
"How dare you!" the Divine Beast Great Emperors rebuked.
There were as many as thirty-six of them!
"No matter how many chickens there are, they’re still trash!" Ling Han said with a smile. Xiu! He took the initiative to attack, throwing a punch at the True Phoenix Great Emperor.
This Great Emperor was the fastest, so he had to be the first to dealt with.
"Humph!" The True Phoenix Emperor flapped his wings, and countless flaming arrows shot towards Ling Han.
Ling Han summoned the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower and used it as a shield. He didn’t even stop his punches.
Peng, peng, peng! The flaming feather arrows shot over. To say nothing of breaking through the defenses of the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, it couldn’t even slow it down slightly.
It should be known that the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower was in the fifth tier, and its battle prowess was even superior to the True Phoenix Great Emperor.
Boom! Ling Han threw a punch. This was also the might of the fifth tier, which was infinitesimally close to the fourth tier.
This might was too strong.
Peng!
The True Phoenix Great Emperor received only a single strike, and his colossal body was sent flying. He was no match for Ling Han at all.
This was just like how Ling Han was completely no match for the old Divine Beast, and the True Phoenix Great Emperor was completely no match for him either.
However, it was as if the Divine Beasts had gone mad, pouncing forward one after another.
Yi, do you all know that you can be revived, so you are fighting with your lives on the line, and actually want to die together?
The Great Emperor was originally invincible in the world, and now, the 36 Divine Beast Great Emperors were fighting Ling Han with their lives on the line. This pressure was naturally terrifying.
Thankfully, in terms of battle prowess, Ling Han had surpassed the Divine Beast Great Emperors by more than a tier, and added with his astonishing physique, Ling Han still had the upper hand.

The 36 Divine Beast Great Emperors charged forward bravely, yet Ling Han sent them flying back like they were mere straws. The scene was very similar to how the Great Emperors ganged up on the old Divine Beast.
However, while there was the element of Life on the Imperial Island, there was none here.
Thus, when the Divine Beast Great Emperor was injured, it could not immediately recover, and if it was severely injured, it would be even more impossible to heal.

But these Great Emperors had already gone mad. Whether they had suffered light injuries or severe injuries, they did not care at all. They were just endlessly attacking Ling Han, looking like they were determined to make Ling Han stay no matter what price they had to pay.
Ling Han was astounded. Even if the old Divine Beast could revive these Divine Beast Great Emperors, was there any need to work so hard?
’You’ve already become Emperors, so don’t you have any opinions?’
Why did they have to keep hanging themselves on the same tree?
He could not tell at all what benefits the old Divine Beast would bring to these Divine Beast Great Emperors once he became the strongest.
Heaven and earth no longer existed, so what could you do even if you were strong enough to insta-kill heaven and earth?
However, he immediately cast this doubt aside. It was up to the Divine Beast Great Emperors to make their own choices.
Since they had already chosen their side, the only thing left was to battle.
Ling Han released a battle cry, and unleashed his full battle prowess, holding nothing back.
Logically speaking, as long as the Great Emperors wanted to flee, it was practically impossible for them to be killed, what more when these were 36 Great Emperors.
However, they couldn’t hold up to the fact that they were all putting their lives on the line, only wanting to delay Ling Han, and not caring about their own lives at all.

The battle situation was tragic. Very soon, some Divine Beasts were severely injured, and were forced to retreat to the side, recovering their injuries first. Otherwise, it would be meaningless to force their way in.
Ling Han wanted to follow up with another strike, but was stopped by the other Great Emperors.
How could that be allowed?
He used the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower as protection, forcibly carving out a path of blood.
Peng, peng, peng! Countless attacks shot over, and the other Divine Beasts all tried to stop Ling Han.
However, Ling Han was also determined. Severing one finger was better than merely injuring five.
’Die!’
He aggressively charged in front of that Divine Beast, and shot out a punch.
Peng!
That Divine Beast was instantly destroyed by him, but Ling Han was also hit by a great many attacks, causing him to throw up a mouthful of blood.
How could one kill his enemy in the midst of this "army" without paying any price?
Those were 35 Divine Beasts, and not just any random person.
Ling Han withdrew his fist, and his fighting spirit solidified, soaring sky-high.
Now, his killing intent had also completely burst forth.
"Die!" he roared as he continued to charge forward. With his battle prowess at the peak stage of the fifth tier, which Divine Beast could block him?
At the cost of having a bloody hole blasted into his left shoulder, he killed another Divine Beast.
Bai Ze Emperor.
This did not have the slightest effect of making an example of him. The remaining 34 Divine Beast Great Emperors ignored his death completely, and continued to charge forwards.
Hiss, even if they were completely annihilated, they would still kill him here, or severely injure him?

Ling Han’s battle prowess was indeed superior, but his opponents were thirty-six Divine Beast Great Emperors, which was enough to erase his advantage in battle prowess. Otherwise, he would not have paid such a heavy price just to kill two of them.

For Ling Han, the best strategy was to retreat. He could recover from his injuries first, and then start all over again. In a battle of one against thirty-four, the situation would definitely be better than now.
This was called defeating them one by one.

However, Ling Han felt that the fact that the Divine Beast Great Emperors were attacking so madly meant that the situation outside had also reached a critical moment. Thus, they were willing to die to detain Ling Han.
The time now was indescribably precious.
Since you are prepared to put your lives on the line, how could I not be?

Ling Han’s fighting spirit soared. He channelled the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower. Both were fifth-tier battle prowess, and when the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower exploded, it could even deliver a fourth-tier ultimate attack.
He aggressively pounced. The Destructive Energy and light of great dao channelled, and he had transformed into a god of death. So what if they were Great Emperors?
Anyone who stood in his way would be killed without mercy!
There were more and more injuries on his body, and they were getting heavier and heavier. However, the number of Divine Beast Great Emperors was also decreasing, from double digits to single digits.
This was a battle that was destined to be recorded in history. Emperors died like rain!
Finally, there were only the three Great Emperors that were still standing in front of Ling Han.
True Dragon, Black Tortoise, White Tiger.
Meanwhile, Ling Han was on the verge of collapse. There was practically no part of his body that was not bleeding. His life force was already very bleak, and he could die at any moment.
He had killed 33 Divine Beast Great Emperors with his own power. What kind of battle merit was this?
However, he could not collapse yet, and could not rest.
There were still three Great Emperors that he had yet to kill. In fact, it was possible that the situation outside would be even worse, and he would have to rush to pacify it.
—If he had known this earlier, he would have asked Buddha Doga to come with him.
Ling Han thought to himself, but immediately strengthened his resolve.
He could deal with it, he definitely could.
He channeled the element of Life, and his body was brimming with life and vitality, but how could it be so easy to heal his injuries?
These were all blasted out by Great Emperors, leaving behind the martial intent of every Divine Beast Great Emperor.
"Ling Han, today will be the day of your death!" The True Dragon Emperor and the other Divine Beasts all pounced over.
Ling Han was already severely wounded, so this was the best time to kill him.
"I won’t die, nor can I die!" Ling Han mustered up his remaining strength, and clashed head-on with the True Dragon Emperor and the others.
Boom!
In this tough battle, Ling Han had expended too much of his power. Under this attack, he actually only managed to tie with the three Divine Beasts.
However, with a wave of Ling Han’s hand, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower was summoned and charged towards the three Divine Beasts.
He had completely given up on defense.
In the matter of being prepared to face death, how could it be that he did not have that?

The time now was indescribably precious.
Since you are prepared to put your lives on the line, how could I not be?
Ling Han’s fighting spirit soared.
He channelled the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower.
Both were fifth-tier battle prowess, and when the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower exploded, it could even deliver a fourth-tier ultimate attack.
He aggressively pounced.
The Destructive Energy and light of great dao channelled, and he had transformed into a god of death.
So what if they were Great Emperors?
Anyone who stood in his way would be killed without mercy!
There were more and more injuries on his body, and they were getting heavier and heavier.
However, the number of Divine Beast Great Emperors was also decreasing, from double digits to single digits.
This was a battle that was destined to be recorded in history.
Emperors died like rain!
Finally, there were only the three Great Emperors that were still standing in front of Ling Han.
True Dragon, Black Tortoise, White Tiger.
Meanwhile, Ling Han was on the verge of collapse.
There was practically no part of his body that was not bleeding.
His life force was already very bleak, and he could die at any moment.
He had killed 33 Divine Beast Great Emperors with his own power.
What kind of battle merit was this?
However, he could not collapse yet, and could not rest.
There were still three Great Emperors that he had yet to kill.
In fact, it was possible that the situation outside would be even worse, and he would have to rush to pacify it.
—If he had known this earlier, he would have asked Buddha Doga to come with him.
Ling Han thought to himself, but immediately strengthened his resolve.
He could deal with it, he definitely could.
He channeled the element of Life, and his body was brimming with life and vitality, but how could it be so easy to heal his injuries?
These were all blasted out by Great Emperors, leaving behind the martial intent of every Divine Beast Great Emperor.
"Ling Han, today will be the day of your death!" The True Dragon Emperor and the other Divine Beasts all pounced over.
Ling Han was already severely wounded, so this was the best time to kill him.
"I won’t die, nor can I die!" Ling Han mustered up his remaining strength, and clashed head-on with the True Dragon Emperor and the others.
Boom!
In this tough battle, Ling Han had expended too much of his power.
Under this attack, he actually only managed to tie with the three Divine Beasts.
However, with a wave of Ling Han’s hand, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower was summoned and charged towards the three Divine Beasts.
He had completely given up on defense.
In the matter of being prepared to face death, how could it be that he did not have that?

chapters.title: Chapter 4853: Exterminated
paragraphs: Ling Han and the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower teamed up, completely abandoning their defenses as they unleashed their full power.
Peng! Peng! Peng!
This was really exchanging blood for blood, using one’s life to exchange for another’s.
Great Emperors were hard to kill, but if a Great Emperor went all out, the battle could also be decided instantly, and the victor or loser, life or death would be determined.
After a few strikes, one of Ling Han’s arms was completely smashed into smithereens. However, the True Dragon Emperor was also smashed to bits.
Ling Han looked up at the sky and roared, his fighting spirit solidifying. Bathing in the blood of the Divine Beast, it was as if he had transformed into a God of Slaughter.
Only the Black Tortoise and White Tiger Emperors remained.
"Ang!" The two Great Emperors both released a deafening roar. Then, they controlled their Emperor Tier power, and attacked Ling Han together.
They were completely unconcerned about their own lives, and only hoped that they could kill Ling Han.
Thankfully, the battlefield was here. Otherwise, it was probable that half the galaxy would have been destroyed.

Ling Han and the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower each faced off against a Divine Beast. Destructive Energy surged, and the light of great dao shone. Not long after, the White Tiger Great Emperor also released a terrible scream, and was killed.
However, Ling Han had also paid an exorbitant price. Both his legs had been forcefully destroyed, and only half of his body was left.
It was fine. As long as there was enough time, regrowing a severed limb was no big deal.
The Black Tortoise Great Emperor wanted to charge over and follow up with another attack at Ling Han, but it was blocked by the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower.
It should be known that the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower was fifth tier!

Of course, the battle was too long, and the intensity was too great. The Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower had also expended a lot of energy, and now, it was only capable of matching the Black Tortoise Great Emperor, and had completely lost its advantage.

However, if it was just blocking the Black Tortoise Great Emperor’s attack, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower could still do it. After all, it was the Black Tortoise Great Emperor’s defense that was truly unsolvable. Taking the Black Tortoise Great Emperor’s attack head-on was completely fine.
Ling Han didn’t attack again. Instead, he stopped to make adjustments.
His injuries were too severe.
He channeled the Ten Cultivation Technique. His purpose wasn’t to heal his injuries, but to stabilize them.

The Black Tortoise Great Emperor wanted to break out of the siege time and time again, aiming to give Ling Han another blow. However, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower channelled dutifully, blocking the Black Tortoise Great Emperor every time.

Slightly less than half a day later, Ling Han delivered a palm strike with one hand, and his body borrowed the momentum to rise. He descended towards the Black Tortoise Great Emperor. He threw a punch, and his fist shone, condensing endless divine light.

Although the Black Tortoise Great Emperor was known for his powerful defense, he wasn’t the first generation Black Tortoise Great Emperor. Moreover, Ling Han’s destructive power far surpassed that of ordinary Great Emperors.
He didn’t dare to face it head-on.
His only option was to retreat.
Though Ling Han had lost both his legs, he could still fly with the wings of fire spread out on his back. Soaring and shifting positions couldn’t be too easy.
He joined forces with the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower to attack the Black Tortoise together.
In a one-on-one battle, even the Black Tortoise Great Emperor might not be able to block it, what more in a one-on-two battle.
He was continuously hit, and was bleeding profusely.
"Ah!" He released a terrible scream. The Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower and Ling Han each pierced through his chest and head one after the other, and he immediately died.
However, the fatal strike before his death also left a massive wound on Ling Han’s lower abdomen. Blood gushed out like a fountain, and it couldn’t be stopped at all.
Ling Han’s body swayed, and he flopped onto the ground. In an instant, he had lost all his strength.
This was an incredibly intense battle, but Ling Han felt as if these Great Emperors had all gone crazy.
Otherwise, if any one of them wanted to flee, he would have to expend an extremely great amount of effort to be able to kill them.
What kind of Demonic Power did the old Divine Beast possess that could make the Divine Beast Great Emperors put their lives on the line like this?
It should be known that the True Dragon Emperor and True Phoenix Emperor had died more than once!
When had the grade of Great Emperors become so low? They had actually become hired thugs, death warriors?
This was practically an insult to the words ’Great Emperor’!
Ling Han sat down cross-leggedly, and began to heal his injuries.
If he were to leave just like that, there would be absolutely no way for him to stop the Lords of Death.
His injuries were too severe. Even if Ling Han had grasped the essence of life, it was still difficult for him to recover.
—If he was in the Cave of Life, it would be great. He was sure that he would be able to recover in ten days, at most.
However, with his present damaged battle prowess, it was absolutely impossible for him to cross the Sea of Death. He would only die on the way.
Thus, there was no need to consider this.
Ling Han started his long period of recovery.

Ten years, a hundred years, a thousand years, his legs and arm slowly regrew, mainly because they had been wounded by Great Emperors. His body was filled with the martial intents of the various Great Emperors. If he wanted to heal his injuries, he would first have to expel these martial intents.

To Ling Han, it was equivalent to him having another battle with the 36 Divine Beasts. However, this time, the battlefield had become the inside of his body, so it was even more dangerous. The slightest move could take his life.

The good news was that it was precisely his body that was the battlefield. He had the absolute initiative, and the martial intent of the Divine Beasts were like duckweed without roots, unable to continue.
Thus, after battling for three thousand years, Ling Han finally expelled all the foreign martial intents in his body.
He stood up. The newly grown legs were bare, and only the ends of his legs had torn fabric. At first glance, he was no different from a beggar.

"Is there any Great Emperor in history that has a worse image than me?" He laughed at himself. Then, he took a step, and the great path of black and white spread out. His speed was extraordinarily fast.
He exited the Primitive Abyss, and instantly, the Dao of Heaven and Earth that he had missed reappeared.
Boom! The great dao instantly suppressed Ling Han, exerting a powerful pressure on him.
This was the land of Regulations, which included the channelling of heaven and earth, and cultivation of martial arts. They were all controlled by the Dao of Heaven and Earth.
However, Ling Han had cultivated to the level of Great Emperor, and was self-contained. He had transcended beyond the Dao of Heaven and Earth, and was no longer under control.
This naturally would incite the fury of heaven and earth, which would bombard Ling Han.
In other words, this was the Great Emperor Tribulation.
After enduring this heaven’s calamity, Ling Han would gain the approval of the heaven and earth, and thought that he was qualified to stay in this world.
Ling Han laughed, and greeted the heaven’s calamity.
Come, let’s see how he would settle it easily.
However, thunderclouds rolled out, blasting out bolts of lightning, but not one of them was aimed directly at him.
What was he doing?
Ling Han soon found out why. That was because the lightning had taken form, and turned into multiple cultivators. Every single one of them was exuding an endless imperial might.
Great Emperor!
Nine Great Emperors!

This was practically a lineup that would drive anyone to despair. He had just become a Great Emperor, and nine Great Emperors were summoned by heaven and earth to snipe him, so how was one supposed to survive?
Yet Ling Han merely smiled.
What a joke. Previously, he had already killed thirty-six Divine Beast Great Emperors, so what did he care about these mere nine?
Moreover, he had just become Emperor, so even if heaven and earth sent down a test, how could these Great Emperors formed of lightning be fifth tier?
At most, it would only be in the eighth and seventh tiers. Otherwise, it would be deliberate murder.
The heaven and earth was merciless, but it would definitely leave behind a sliver of hope.
Ling Han didn’t even use the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, and simply charged over.
Peng! Peng! Peng!
He threw a punch, and as the Destructive Energy surged, so what if they were Great Emperors formed of lightning? They would be severely injured after taking a single blow.
Ling Han destroyed everything in his way, and the nine Great Emperors of lightning were all blasted off their feet, unable to form any decent attacks at all.
After experiencing the battle of the 36 Divine Beasts, Ling Han’s battle prowess had been proven, and his confidence was even higher.
He was truly powerful!

chapters.title: Chapter 4854: New Emperor
paragraphs: In less than half a day’s time, the lightning Great Emperors’ energy had all been exhausted by Ling Han, and they no longer had any might.
They couldn’t be killed, because they weren’t living beings in the first place. However, their energy had been annihilated by the Destructive Energy, so they naturally were not a threat anymore.
Ling Han didn’t immediately move. Instead, he sat down in a cross-legged position and floated in the galaxy.
He had survived the heaven’s calamity, and the Dao of Heaven and Earth had already acknowledged him. Thus, Ling Han was able to come into contact with the Nine Star Regulations.
Originally, when he had become a Great Emperor, he should have comprehended the Nine Star Regulations, and when he reached the pinnacle, that would be the strongest level of fifth tier.
Thus, it was very normal for him to be able to comprehend Nine Star Regulations.
And his situation was special.
After he had cultivated two Nine Star Regulations, he skipped over the fifth tier, and directly advanced into the fourth tier.
Thus, theoretically speaking, Ling Han had already surpassed the level of Regulations.
Standing at a higher position, it would naturally be easy for him to grasp the "low level" Regulations.
All of a sudden, enlightenment dawned on Ling Han.
In his mind, eight thin threads quietly appeared.
These were the other eight Nine Star Regulations — the Regulations of Death did not belong to this heaven and earth.

As Ling Han’s comprehension of the Nine Star Regulations continued to deepen, these eight thin threads also became thicker and thicker. However, it was also impossible to grasp all eight Nine Star Regulations in a short period of time.
Seven days later, Ling Han finally stopped.
A faint smile appeared at the corners of his lips. Without too much time, he would be able to grasp all the Nine Star Regulations.
In fact, he had even grasped an additional Regulation, which belonged to the Netherworld.
Thus, even if he did not take into account the element of Life that he had grasped, he would definitely still be slightly stronger than any ordinary Great Emperor.
It was time to leave.
Ling Han searched for the location of the Four Origin Planet. Then, he took a step, and the great path of black and white spread out. In an instant, he had arrived on the Four Origin Planet.
He released the empress and the others, and the large black dog and the others also came upon hearing the news. They were all excited and happy.
"Little Han, have you attained Dao?" they all asked.
Ling Han nodded earnestly, "That’s right."

Everyone breathed a sigh of relief upon hearing this. Ling Han was far too powerful. Once he became Emperor, he would definitely be able to crush all of the current Great Emperors. He would undoubtedly become the most powerful being.
Ling Han also found out about the current situation, but it was not optimistic.

The Yin souls of the Netherworld had mostly been destroyed by Ling Han. However, the Lords of Death were Yin souls in the first place, and at this time, they had no choice but to step forward personally, inhaling and exhaling large amounts of Yin Qi, continuing to corrode the Living Realm.

By now, about half of the universe was still in a state of transforming into the Netherworld, and the Lords of Death seemed to have limited power. They did not take another step further, and merely defended this area of land.
In this way, when heaven and earth collapsed, the two Realms would still clash greatly, but the might would defintiely be much weaker.
Would it affect the Primitive Abyss’s side?

Ling Han didn’t know. If the effects weren’t so great, he wouldn’t even be in a hurry to make a move, because though the collision of heaven and earth would cause great damage, there were no longer any living beings in the center of the universe. If it was destroyed, so be it.
However, if this could still affect the Imperial Island’s side, Ling Han would have to make a move to prevent this from happening.
He wasn’t confident at all, so for safety’s sake, it was best to make a move as soon as possible.
Just as he was about to move out, he suddenly discovered that a strange phenomenon had appeared in the sky.
Endless golden lotuses appeared in the Void, and a celestial voice rang out from the heaven and earth. Everyone was filled with joy, as well as endless reverence.
It was as if a supreme existence had been born in the heaven and earth. Thus, the heaven and earth had bestowed this blessing, and everyone was filled with admiration.
Ling Han and the others paused for a moment before exclaiming, "New Emperor!"
At this point in time, there was actually a new Emperor that had succeeded Dao!
Who was it?
An Imperial Son from the Lands of Death? Or the son of a Great Emperor from some Imperial Clan?
Not many days later, the news spread out.
The one who became Emperor was... Pu Jingtian.
Great Emperor Jingtian!
Ling Han faltered for a moment before shaking his head with a smile.

At first, he had thought that in this era, the "curse" that the Imperial Clans would never produce a second Great Emperor would be broken, because Ling Han had deliberately gone to the Primitive Abyss to prove his Dao, so that another Great Emperor would appear in the great world.
But what was the result?
There were so many descendants of Great Emperors, yet none of them could compete with Pu Jingtian.
He wasn’t a member of the Imperial Clans, but someone that had cultivated to become a Pseudo-Emperor hundreds of millions of years ago.
It could only be said that the blessing of heaven and earth allowed Pu Jingtian to witness the Nine Star Regulations, and complete this step.
’That’s good.’
Ling Han nodded in understanding. In any case, it was fine as long as the new Emperor did not appear from the Lands of Death.
To say the least, even if it really was a fallen Imperial Son that had succeeded Dao, Ling Han would not mind. It was just killing one more Emperor.

Right now, he was already the most powerful battle prowess of the fifth tier, so how could the new Emperor compare to him? Moreover, how long could the Lords of Death maintain their battle prowess at the peak stage of the fifth tier?
Now, if he joined forces with the new Emperor, it would definitely be even easier to sweep through the Lords of Death.
Ling Han was just about to contact Pu Jingtian when he suddenly received an invitation from the Mysterious Spirit Planet.
—Pu Jingtian had become a Great Emperor himself, so it was natural that the whole world would be celebrating.
Having proven his status as a Great Emperor, he was equivalent to ruling over this era. If he did not celebrate and show off a little, wouldn’t that be wearing embroidered clothes at night?
Fine, then let’s host the ceremony.
Logically speaking, he had become a Great Emperor, so it was indeed worth celebrating.
"All right, I will be there on time." Ling Han accepted the invitation.
"Then we shall respectfully await your arrival, Lord," the envoy said. Then, he turned around and left, his arrogance apparent in his words.
Right now, he was a genuine member of an Imperial Clan. Moreover, their Great Emperor was still alive. What kind of concept was this?
The whole world revered them, and they were the strongest clan, and there was no other that could match them!
Thus, even if Ling Han was a Pseudo-Emperor, he could only swallow his pride and obediently bow his head.
This was what it meant to use one’s powerful connections as an intimidation tactic.
"A dog uses its master’s power," the little azure dragon scoffed.
"Four-Legged Snake, I’ll give you a chance to rephrase your words!" the large black dog said coldly.
"What is it? Grandpa Dragon is afraid of you?" The little azure dragon naturally wouldn’t cower.
"Looks like this Great Emperor Jingtian wants to establish his might," Chi Menghan said. "Husband, you’ll definitely bear the brunt."

When a new Emperor achieved dao, they would definitely establish their might and establish a symbol of invincibility. Thus, a Pseudo-Emperor like Ling Han was the best target for the Great Emperor Jingtian to make an example of.
"Definitely. Little Han, you won’t be able to escape." The large black dog patted Ling Han’s shoulder.
Ling Han stroked his chin. Was his halo of hatred really that strong?
"Sigh! I’m too outstanding," he said.
Everyone rolled their eyes. Though you are very outstanding, aren’t you a little too shameless to say it out loud yourself?

Though the universe was still the same size, and had not shrunk, there were only a few planets that had life now. Aside from the Four Origin Planet, it was the ancestral stars where the Imperial Clans were located.
Hence, when a new Emperor had attained Dao, they all rushed over to offer their congratulations. It really did not need too much time.
Merely seven days later, a great celebration to celebrate the new Emperor having attained Dao began on Mysterious Spirit Planet.
Ling Han brought the empress, Brother Monkey and the others with him, and arrived at the Mysterious Spirit Planet a day earlier.
That night, the old Saint from Donglin Planet found him.

"Little Han, have you attained Dao?" they all asked.
Ling Han nodded earnestly, "That’s right."
Everyone breathed a sigh of relief upon hearing this.
Ling Han was far too powerful.
Once he became Emperor, he would definitely be able to crush all of the current Great Emperors.
He would undoubtedly become the most powerful being.
Ling Han also found out about the current situation, but it was not optimistic.
The Yin souls of the Netherworld had mostly been destroyed by Ling Han.

However, the Lords of Death were Yin souls in the first place, and at this time, they had no choice but to step forward personally, inhaling and exhaling large amounts of Yin Qi, continuing to corrode the Living Realm.
By now, about half of the universe was still in a state of transforming into the Netherworld, and the Lords of Death seemed to have limited power.
They did not take another step further, and merely defended this area of land.
In this way, when heaven and earth collapsed, the two Realms would still clash greatly, but the might would defintiely be much weaker.
Would it affect the Primitive Abyss’s side?
Ling Han didn’t know.

If the effects weren’t so great, he wouldn’t even be in a hurry to make a move, because though the collision of heaven and earth would cause great damage, there were no longer any living beings in the center of the universe.
If it was destroyed, so be it.
However, if this could still affect the Imperial Island’s side, Ling Han would have to make a move to prevent this from happening.
He wasn’t confident at all, so for safety’s sake, it was best to make a move as soon as possible.
Just as he was about to move out, he suddenly discovered that a strange phenomenon had appeared in the sky.
Endless golden lotuses appeared in the Void, and a celestial voice rang out from the heaven and earth.
Everyone was filled with joy, as well as endless reverence.
It was as if a supreme existence had been born in the heaven and earth.
Thus, the heaven and earth had bestowed this blessing, and everyone was filled with admiration.
Ling Han and the others paused for a moment before exclaiming, "New Emperor!"
At this point in time, there was actually a new Emperor that had succeeded Dao!
Who was it?
An Imperial Son from the Lands of Death?
Or the son of a Great Emperor from some Imperial Clan?
Not many days later, the news spread out.
The one who became Emperor was...
Pu Jingtian.
Great Emperor Jingtian!
Ling Han faltered for a moment before shaking his head with a smile.

At first, he had thought that in this era, the "curse" that the Imperial Clans would never produce a second Great Emperor would be broken, because Ling Han had deliberately gone to the Primitive Abyss to prove his Dao, so that another Great Emperor would appear in the great world.
But what was the result?
There were so many descendants of Great Emperors, yet none of them could compete with Pu Jingtian.
He wasn’t a member of the Imperial Clans, but someone that had cultivated to become a Pseudo-Emperor hundreds of millions of years ago.
It could only be said that the blessing of heaven and earth allowed Pu Jingtian to witness the Nine Star Regulations, and complete this step.
’That’s good.’
Ling Han nodded in understanding.
In any case, it was fine as long as the new Emperor did not appear from the Lands of Death.
To say the least, even if it really was a fallen Imperial Son that had succeeded Dao, Ling Han would not mind.
It was just killing one more Emperor.
Right now, he was already the most powerful battle prowess of the fifth tier, so how could the new Emperor compare to him?
Moreover, how long could the Lords of Death maintain their battle prowess at the peak stage of the fifth tier?
Now, if he joined forces with the new Emperor, it would definitely be even easier to sweep through the Lords of Death.
Ling Han was just about to contact Pu Jingtian when he suddenly received an invitation from the Mysterious Spirit Planet.
—Pu Jingtian had become a Great Emperor himself, so it was natural that the whole world would be celebrating.
Having proven his status as a Great Emperor, he was equivalent to ruling over this era.
If he did not celebrate and show off a little, wouldn’t that be wearing embroidered clothes at night?
Fine, then let’s host the ceremony.
Logically speaking, he had become a Great Emperor, so it was indeed worth celebrating.
"All right, I will be there on time." Ling Han accepted the invitation.
"Then we shall respectfully await your arrival, Lord," the envoy said.
Then, he turned around and left, his arrogance apparent in his words.
Right now, he was a genuine member of an Imperial Clan.
Moreover, their Great Emperor was still alive.
What kind of concept was this?
The whole world revered them, and they were the strongest clan, and there was no other that could match them!
Thus, even if Ling Han was a Pseudo-Emperor, he could only swallow his pride and obediently bow his head.
This was what it meant to use one’s powerful connections as an intimidation tactic.
"A dog uses its master’s power," the little azure dragon scoffed.
"Four-Legged Snake, I’ll give you a chance to rephrase your words!" the large black dog said coldly.
"What is it?
Grandpa Dragon is afraid of you?" The little azure dragon naturally wouldn’t cower.
"Looks like this Great Emperor Jingtian wants to establish his might," Chi Menghan said.
"Husband, you’ll definitely bear the brunt."
When a new Emperor achieved dao, they would definitely establish their might and establish a symbol of invincibility.
Thus, a Pseudo-Emperor like Ling Han was the best target for the Great Emperor Jingtian to make an example of.
"Definitely.
Little Han, you won’t be able to escape." The large black dog patted Ling Han’s shoulder.
Ling Han stroked his chin.
Was his halo of hatred really that strong?
"Sigh!
I’m too outstanding," he said.
Everyone rolled their eyes.
Though you are very outstanding, aren’t you a little too shameless to say it out loud yourself?
Though the universe was still the same size, and had not shrunk, there were only a few planets that had life now.
Aside from the Four Origin Planet, it was the ancestral stars where the Imperial Clans were located.
Hence, when a new Emperor had attained Dao, they all rushed over to offer their congratulations.
It really did not need too much time.
Merely seven days later, a great celebration to celebrate the new Emperor having attained Dao began on Mysterious Spirit Planet.
Ling Han brought the empress, Brother Monkey and the others with him, and arrived at the Mysterious Spirit Planet a day earlier.
That night, the old Saint from Donglin Planet found him.

chapters.title: Chapter 4855: The world is cruel and cold
paragraphs: Chi Taiming’s expression didn’t look too good.
As he saw it, Ling Han should be the person who had the highest chance of becoming Emperor.

And along the way, Ling Han’s journey was also smooth sailing, crushing all the prodigies of the past and present. The Golden Generation, the sons of the Great Emperors, and so on could only become his stepping stones.
When Ling Han became a Pseudo-Emperor Chi Taiming was even more certain that Ling Han could become Emperor.
Furthermore, when Ling Han was a Pseudo-Emperor, he was already capable of matching a Great Emperor. If he became a Great Emperor, just how strong would his battle prowess be?

This should also be the common thought of all the Imperial Clans. Precisely because of this, these Imperial Clans were also very envious and jealous of the Donglin Imperial Clan. This was because the son-in-law of the Donglin Imperial Clan would clearly become the most powerful Great Emperor in history.
Even this old Saint couldn’t help but spew vulgarities. Midway, a Pu Jingtian actually charged out.
The one who had become Emperor was actually not Ling Han!

It should be known that only one Great Emperor could appear in an era. Even if Pu Jingtian and the Lords of Death would soon die together, it was still impossible for a new Great Emperor to emerge in this era. They would have to wait for millions more years.
Then, unless Ling Han sealed himself in the Primordial Source Clay, he would only die of old age, and would not be able to cross traverse as many as ten million years.
It should be known that ten million years was only the most conservative estimate. Sometimes, it was not uncommon for two Emperors to be separated by tens of millions of years.
Thus, Donglin Imperial Clan’s attempt to borrow Ling Han’s power was naturally an empty dream.

When the news that Pu Jingtian had become Emperor spread out, the members of the Imperial Clans all felt slight regret. A new Emperor had finally appeared, but it was a pity that it was not their own Imperial Son. However, they were more of delighting at the misfortune of others.
After all, in the past, the most popular person to become Emperor was Ling Han.
Now, Ling Han’s hopes of achieving Dao had come to nothing, and the Donglin Imperial Clan had also become a joke. Wasn’t this amusing?

"Son-in-law, your current situation is not too optimistic," the old Saint said. "You attract too much attention. Furthermore, you have once offended Great Emperor Jingtian. In the celebration that will begin tomorrow, it is possible that you would be targeted."
Chi Taiming’s eyes were still very sharp. With a single word, he had revealed Ling Han’s situation.
"Thus, you had best leave quickly."
"You are a Pseudo-Emperor, and have the strength to match a Great Emperor, so you are completely capable of leaving."
"Avoid this era of Great Emperor Jingtian, and choose another opportunity!"
He persuaded Ling Han to give up this era and return in the next era, just like Pu Jingtian. He wasn’t from this era, yet he had attained Dao in this era.
Ling Han smiled, "It’s fine."
Chi Taiming couldn’t help but grimace. He had said so much, and it was all in exchange for these words?

"Son-in-law, you are indeed freakish, but you have to know that the true Great Emperor is indescribably strong," the old Saint advised again. Though the Lords of Death were awesome, they were Great Emperors that had passed their prime, after all. Even if they recovered to their prime condition, the time that their could maintain this state was still limited.
"That’s why we have to battle," Ling Han said with a smile.
Chi Taiming grimaced upon hearing this. If it weren’t for the fact that he was no match for Ling Han, he would definitely have slapped him already.
See if I won’t be able to wake you up with a beating!
No matter how Chi Taiming tried to persuade him, Ling Han completely ignored him. This angered the old Saint so much that he finally left angrily.
"Little Han, why didn’t you tell him that you have already become Emperor?" The large black dog walked out.
"If I tell him, do you think he’ll believe me?" Ling Han countered.

"That’s true." The large black dog nodded. These old Saints came from the Imperial Clans, so they knew very well just how strong a Great Emperor would be, but on the other hand, their outlook was even more conservative, making them believe that it was possible for two or even more Great Emperors to prove their Dao in a single era, so how could it be possible?
"Then we can show off again tomorrow?" The large black dog was in high spirits.

F***, everyone thought that Pu Jingtian was a Great Emperor, while Ling Han was only a Pseudo-Emperor. Then, just when Pu Jingtian thought so highly of himself, planning to humiliate Ling Han, Ling Han turned the tables on him. Just how astonished would everyone be?
"Ao, ao, ao!" The large black dog couldn’t help but howl at the sky. He was too excited, and filled with anticipation.
"Tomorrow is the day the Show-off King proves his Dao," the little azure dragon said from the sidelines.
Stepping on the face of a Great Emperor to show off, this was undoubtedly the king of show-offs.

"Haha, others use martial arts to prove their Dao, but out Little Han, use posturing to prove his Dao!" The large black dog laughed loudly. It was filled with anticipation. It was definitely going to be fun.
Ling Han pursed his lips, and said, "I truly have no intention of showing off."
"We believe you!" The large black dog and little azure dragon both nodded.
"Motherf*cker, can’t you guys be a little more serious when you say you believe me?" Ling Han was almost rendered speechless. They clearly didn’t believe him.
"Heehee!"
The night passed very quickly.
Starting from the morning of the second day, the entire Mysterious Spirit Planet was bustling with activity.

The Great Emperor had proven his Dao and invited the whole world for a celebration. This was the most glorious moment for Mysterious Spirit Planet, and it would become the most powerful force in the world.
Hence, while he had the abilities, he also had to have enough momentum.
The number one in the world, the Great Emperor, naturally had to be matched with the greatest extravagance in the world.
Ling Han and the others were all invited to the ceremony area. Among them, there were Pseudo-Emperors, as well as a large number of Saints. They were naturally VIPs among VIPs.

The grandstand was 300 meters tall, and for elites like them, this couldn’t be considered tall. However, underneath the grandstand, there was a vast and boundless plaza that surrounded the grandstand, highlighting its unique status.
It was as if they were saying that the Great Emperor was the center of the world, and others could only guard and serve him.
Ling Han and the others were arranged in the first row closest to the grandstand. Even so, they were still 300 meters away from the grandstand.
This was done on purpose, so as to highlight the status of Great Emperor Jingtian.
They could only kneel from afar.
"What arrogance!" Ling Han said calmly.
"The higher you’re raised, the harder you fall," the large black dog said in a strange voice.

There were still a lot of seats in the first row. Ling Han and the others took some, and the rest were arranged for Ding Shu, Jing Haoran, Shui Qingchang, the three other Pseudo-Emperors. This was the strongest level below Great Emperor. Naturally, they would occupy the seats of the first row.
As for the second row, it was allocated to the Saints of the Imperial Clans.

And from the third row onwards, it would be very casual. There were people from the Imperial Clans, and there were also people from Mysterious Spirit Planet. They were just there to make up the numbers.
He was sure that Pu Jingtian would also be very depressed. The living beings of this era were wilting, so he could not show off his extravagance.
However, four Pseudo-Emperors had come to attent, and this had surpassed any other era.
Overall, the status of guests was still very high.
Most importantly, there was a true Great Emperor among the guests. This was something that had never happened in all of history.
Very soon, guests arrived, one after another, and sat down according to the rules.
Pu Jingtian didn’t appear. It was unknown whether he had been delayed by something or was deliberately putting on airs.
Because the main banquet had not begun for a long time, it was inevitable that everyone would start chatting.

All the Imperial Clans pointed fingers at Ling Han. Some felt that it was a pity that Ling Han, who had such strong talent, had not become Emperor. If they only relied on Pu Jingtian, it would be too difficult to pacify the darkness.

Some of them were rejoicing in Ling Han’s misfortune, thinking that Ling Han had done too many "bad deeds". He had been abandoned by the heaven and earth, and that was why he had not been able to take that last step.
Because Ling Han was destined to only be a Pseudo-Emperor, some people did not even bother to hide their words, and were not afraid that Ling Han would hear them at all.
How could it be that on the Mysterious Spirit Planet, Ling Han actually dared to use force?

chapters.title: Chapter 4856: The might of a tiger still exists
paragraphs: Pu Jingtian was different from the Lords of Death and the Divine Beast Great Emperors.

The Lands of Death and the Primitive Abyss were all standing on the opposing side of living beings. However, Pu Jingtian was a newly promoted Great Emperor, and had gained the approval of heaven and earth.
Thus, he definitely had to fight to maintain the balance of heaven and earth.
Thus, Pu Jingtian represented the benefits of heaven and earth, and was on the same side as all life in the world.
A Great Emperor was present, and others were all mediocre. They could only adhere to his wishes, which was very logical.
In the territory of this Great Emperor, you, Ling Han, dare to mess around?
Was he seeking death!
These Imperial Clans let themselves loose, and mocked him to their heart’s content.

There was no lack of people trying to curry favor with the new Emperor. Who didn’t know that Pu Jingtian had once had a conflict with Ling Han? Now that Pu Jingtian had attained Dao, would he not settle the score?
Even if he didn’t kill him, Ling Han would definitely suffer greatly.
Thus, now that they were clearly expressing that they were siding with Great Emperor, that naturally could add a lot of points to them.
Ling Han sighed. Why was there always someone who was asking to be beaten?
He stood up, and looked towards those Imperial Clans that had mocked him.

There were not many clans, and they were all Imperial Clans that did not have any child of the Great Emperor. That was why they had lost the demeanor that Imperial Clans should have, and actually began to curry the favour of a new Emperor.
Just look, as long as they had the son of a Great Emperor, which Imperial Clan wasn’t calm and composed?
That’s right. At present, the Mysterious Spirit Planet had indeed produced a Great Emperor that was invincible in the current era, but that was only for this era.
Since they were Imperial Clans, which one of them had not been invincible before?
Thus, under the wheel of history, any kind of glory would wilt.
After another ten million years, twenty million years, you see, wouldn’t the Pu Clan be no different from the other Imperial Clans?
Thus, Imperial Clans didn’t need to flatter anyone at all. They were transcendent in the first place.
"What is it? Ling Han, do you have any objections?" the Imperial Son of the Thousand Spirit Clan asked.
"Heh, how can you be so rude to a Pseudo-Emperor?" The old Saint beside him rebuked, but his tone was even, without the slightest intent of rebuke.
They... had the support of a Great Emperor!
Ling Han stared at the two of them, and asked calmly, "Who moved your ancestral star here?"
The old Saint and Imperial Son were both rendered speechless upon hearing this.
Of course, it was Ling Han.
Otherwise, they might have already been exterminated by now. Even if they hadn’t, they would still be fleeing in panic, like stray dogs.
"What I hate the most are people who don’t know how to be grateful." Ling Han continued, "However, if it is only being ungrateful and not doing evil, then I can also ignore it."
"However, repaying kindness with ingratitude... hoho."
Ling Han flicked his finger, and said, "If I see one person like that, I will kill one. If there are two people, then I’ll kill a pair!"
His last words were bone-chilling.
The two Saints from the Thousand Spirit Imperial Clan were both trembling. It should be known that they were facing a Pseudo-Emperor!
With the word "Emperor", it had already surpassed the range of Saints. Even the Imperial Weapon and the Imperial Formation couldn’t protect them forever.
Moreover, Ling Han was freakishly talented, and his battle prowess far surpassed an ordinary Pseudo-Emperor.
In a head-on confrontation, would they dare to speak tough even if they were given ten thousand guts?
At this time, someone stepped out to play mediator.
"Lord Ling Han, today is a celebratory day for the Great Emperor. Please appease your anger, and do not come to blows," Gong Yeliang said.
He was clearly trying to smooth things over, but his tone was incredibly arrogant.
’Lord, Ling Han!’
He had placed himself on the same level as Ling Han.
However, how could a mere Saint be qualified to be on equal footing with a Pseudo-Emperor?

Additionally, he was clearly warning them — this was the celebration of the Great Emperor’s attaining Dao. If they dared to act recklessly, and angered the Great Emperor, they would naturally be punished.
As everyone listened, they all sighed internally.
He had become Emperor, and was indeed very awesome. Even a Saint dared to threaten a Pseudo-Emperor.
However, there was nothing that could be done. Ling Han still had to swallow this humiliation.
Could it be that he... was going to clash head-on with the Great Emperor?
Gong Yeliang was different from the two members of the Thousand Spirit Clan. He had a Great Emperor behind him!
"You dare to stop me?" Ling Han smiled faintly, and moved directly, pressing down on the two Saints form the Thousand Spirit Imperial Clan.
Hiss!
All the Imperial Clans inhaled sharply upon seeing this. F***, he really dared.
"Who is Ling Han?"

This guy seemed to have never been afraid of anyone. When he was very weak, he dared to be forceful with the Imperial Clans, and afterwards, he was forceful with the Lords of Death and Divine Beasts from the Primitive Abyss.
Pa! Pa!
Emperor Tier power descended, and the two Saints from the Thousand Spirit Clan didn’t even have the chance to unleash their Imperial Weapon before being crushed to death.
Ling Han smiled, and clapped his hands, as if he had swatted two flies to death, "Anyone else has any complaints about me?"
There was dead silence.
He had killed Saints just like that, so who would dare to have any objections?
"You, you, you—" Gong Yeliang pointed at Ling Han, his body trembling slightly.
He was not afraid, but rather furious.
This was the Mysterious Spirit Planet, and Pu Jingtian was the Great Emperor!
A new Emperor had attained Dao, and you actually still dare to make a move?
Did he even take the new Emperor seriously?
This was a blatant provocation.
Ling Han showed a hint of displeasure, "I very much dislike being pointed at. If you don’t want to die, you had best withdraw your hand quickly!"
This was what a threat was like!
Gong Yeliang’s heart shuddered, and he hurriedly lowered his hand, taking three steps back.
He had threatened Ling Han using his powerful connections as an intimidation tactic, but Ling Han’s threat was completely based on his own abilities.
It would be a piece of cake for a Pseudo-Emperor to kill a Saint.

Now that a new Emperor had appeared, he could also bask in the glory. He could be called the second strongest in this universe. But if things continued, he might die before he could even show off his might.
That would really not be worth it.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and sat back down.
This time, no one dared to point at him anymore.
Even though a new Emperor had appeared, the only person who could suppress Ling Han was the new Emperor.
As for the others?
They didn’t even have the right to speak as equals in front of Ling Han.
However, those dissatisfied Imperial Clans were all sneering internally. ’You may be awesome now, but when Pu Jingtian appears, let’s see if you’ll kneel or not!’
Moreover, Ling Han had already offended Pu Jingtian before, so how could Pu Jingtian tolerate Ling Han killing someone at his celebration?
So what if he was a Pseudo-Emperor? Pei!
These Imperial Clans all hoped that Ling Han would be humiliated, or even killed, but the majority of Imperial Clans were still on Ling Han’s side. When they saw this, they were all slightly anxious.
’How can you still remain calm?’
Only Ling Han and the others remained seated, neither happy nor sad.
Time passed slowly, and everyone had their own thoughts, waiting for the situation to develop further.
However, right at this moment, all kinds of strange phenomena suddenly appeared in the skies.
The Yin River poured down, the sea of blood was boiling, and fog was thick... the Lords of Death finally arrived.
What!
The Lords of Death would actually arrive at such an important time?
Hiss, what were they trying to do?
How the Lords of Death had found their way here was no longer a problem. That was because the new Emperor had attained Dao, and the commotion caused was known to the entire universe.
Xiu, xiu, xiu! One after another, figures descended. They were all Imperial Sons of the Lands of Death, and one was the Natural-born Gold Spirit, exuding the might of a Pseudo-Emperor.
"How dare you come uninvited!" Gong Yeliang hurriedly stepped out.
He was the supervisor of the Mysterious Spirit Planet. As long as a Great Emperor did not appear, he would be the representative.
"Mere Saint, scram aside!" The Imperial Sons of the Lands of Death all swept a cold glance over Gong Yeliang.
A Saint actually dared to ask about the Pseudo-Emperor’s personal matters? Humph!

The Lands of Death and the Primitive Abyss were all standing on the opposing side of living beings.
However, Pu Jingtian was a newly promoted Great Emperor, and had gained the approval of heaven and earth.
Thus, he definitely had to fight to maintain the balance of heaven and earth.
Thus, Pu Jingtian represented the benefits of heaven and earth, and was on the same side as all life in the world.
A Great Emperor was present, and others were all mediocre.
They could only adhere to his wishes, which was very logical.
In the territory of this Great Emperor, you, Ling Han, dare to mess around?
Was he seeking death!
These Imperial Clans let themselves loose, and mocked him to their heart’s content.
There was no lack of people trying to curry favor with the new Emperor.
Who didn’t know that Pu Jingtian had once had a conflict with Ling Han?
Now that Pu Jingtian had attained Dao, would he not settle the score?
Even if he didn’t kill him, Ling Han would definitely suffer greatly.
Thus, now that they were clearly expressing that they were siding with Great Emperor, that naturally could add a lot of points to them.
Ling Han sighed.
Why was there always someone who was asking to be beaten?
He stood up, and looked towards those Imperial Clans that had mocked him.
There were not many clans, and they were all Imperial Clans that did not have any child of the Great Emperor.
That was why they had lost the demeanor that Imperial Clans should have, and actually began to curry the favour of a new Emperor.
Just look, as long as they had the son of a Great Emperor, which Imperial Clan wasn’t calm and composed?
That’s right.
At present, the Mysterious Spirit Planet had indeed produced a Great Emperor that was invincible in the current era, but that was only for this era.
Since they were Imperial Clans, which one of them had not been invincible before?
Thus, under the wheel of history, any kind of glory would wilt.
After another ten million years, twenty million years, you see, wouldn’t the Pu Clan be no different from the other Imperial Clans?
Thus, Imperial Clans didn’t need to flatter anyone at all.
They were transcendent in the first place.
"What is it?
Ling Han, do you have any objections?" the Imperial Son of the Thousand Spirit Clan asked.
"Heh, how can you be so rude to a Pseudo-Emperor?" The old Saint beside him rebuked, but his tone was even, without the slightest intent of rebuke.
They... had the support of a Great Emperor!
Ling Han stared at the two of them, and asked calmly, "Who moved your ancestral star here?"
The old Saint and Imperial Son were both rendered speechless upon hearing this.
Of course, it was Ling Han.
Otherwise, they might have already been exterminated by now.
Even if they hadn’t, they would still be fleeing in panic, like stray dogs.
"What I hate the most are people who don’t know how to be grateful." Ling Han continued, "However, if it is only being ungrateful and not doing evil, then I can also ignore it."
"However, repaying kindness with ingratitude... hoho."
Ling Han flicked his finger, and said, "If I see one person like that, I will kill one.
If there are two people, then I’ll kill a pair!"
His last words were bone-chilling.
The two Saints from the Thousand Spirit Imperial Clan were both trembling.
It should be known that they were facing a Pseudo-Emperor!
With the word "Emperor", it had already surpassed the range of Saints.
Even the Imperial Weapon and the Imperial Formation couldn’t protect them forever.
Moreover, Ling Han was freakishly talented, and his battle prowess far surpassed an ordinary Pseudo-Emperor.
In a head-on confrontation, would they dare to speak tough even if they were given ten thousand guts?

"Lord Ling Han, today is a celebratory day for the Great Emperor.

’Lord, Ling Han!’

However, how could a mere Saint be qualified to be on equal footing with a Pseudo-Emperor?
Additionally, he was clearly warning them — this was the celebration of the Great Emperor’s attaining Dao.
If they dared to act recklessly, and angered the Great Emperor, they would naturally be punished.

Hiss!

F***, he really dared.
"Who is Ling Han?"
This guy seemed to have never been afraid of anyone.

Pa!
Pa!

chapters.title: Chapter 4857: Pseudo-Emperors Battle
paragraphs: When a new Emperor had succeeded Dao, and the whole world was celebrating, the Lords of Death had all arrived. What was the reason for this?

However, the Lords of Death were notorious for their viciousness, and they were also Great Emperors who had ruled over an era in the ancient times. They had come together, so which Imperial Clan wouldn’t feel uneasy?
—How could it be that there were not many members of the Imperial Clasns that had been killed at the hands of the Lands of Death?
Gong Yeliang’s aura couldn’t help but weaken. Those standing in front of him were all Pseudo-Emperors.
Though a Saint was already close to the peak stage of cultivation, compared with the Pseudo-Emperor, he was still trash among trash.
However, he still had a true Great Emperor behind him, so he definitely could not cower.
Otherwise, it was not just him that would be losing face, but also Pu Jingtian.
"A new Emperor has appeared, and you people dare to be impudent?" he shouted loudly.
"Hehe." Yang Yihuan and the others all sneered.
A new emperor?
Putting aside the issue of age, when a new Emperor attained dao, he would only be able to grasp a nine-star Regulation, at most. Could he compare to the Lords of Death?
Moreover, how many Lords of Death were there?
"Get lost!" Li Dangping shouted coldly. "Go and invite the Great Emperor Jingtian out. Our fathers have some matters to discuss with the Great Emperor Jingtian."
He fully expressed his contempt for Gong Yeliang, but at the same time, he also appropriately expressed his respect for the Great Emperor Jingtian.

It could not be helped. Even if the other had only been a Pseudo-Emperor a few days ago, which was a status equal to his, now that he had already achieved Dao, he had become the "only" Great Emperor, and was about to rule over an era.
Towards a Great Emperor, everyone had to show the respect that they deserved.
Gong Yeliang’s aura was completely stolen, and he did not dare to say anything at all.
—If the new Emperor was Ling Han, it would be completely different when he encountered this kind of situation.
As long as the rock golem was summoned, would Li Dangping and the others dare to be so arrogant?
It could not be helped. This was called background.
However, the Mysterious Spirit Planet didn’t have a Great Emperor previously, so wouldn’t having a Pseudo-Emperor and Saints in their ranks be astonishing enough?
It could only be said that the side of the Lands of Death was too strong, with twelve Great Emperors gathered. What force could compare to that?

Seeing how the people of the Lands of Death were so arrogant, all the Imperial Clans were furious, and there was actually not a single person on the side of Mysterious Spirit Planet that could resist, which caused everyone’s hearts to be filled with anger.
The Lands of Death had already forced them to leave their homes, and now, they were acting as if there was no one else around them. They were incredibly arrogant, so how could they not be furious?
But the problem was, faced with so many Pseudo-Emperors, who could stand against them?
"Are you guys done yet?" Shui Qingchang asked calmly.
She stood up, and a gentle breeze blew over, outlining her shapely and enchanting figure. She was indescribably perfect.
However, everyone was more intimidated by the aura she displayed.
To dare to step out at this moment, how could they not be impressed?
No woman was inferior to a man!
"When the Lands of Death are executing business, those who are unrelated should not interrupt," Feng Miaoling interrupted.
Shui Qingchang took a step and entered the galaxy. "Do you dare battle me?"
"Do you think I’m afraid of you!" Feng Miaoling immediately entered the galaxy as well, and began a fierce battle with Shui Qingchang.
This was a Pseudo-Emperor battle, and could only be carried out in the distant galaxy. Otherwise, it would be able to crush the Mysterious Spirit Planet in a matter of minutes.
"Haha, my hands are also itching. Who wants to fight me?" Ding Shu laughed loudly, and similarly stepped into the galaxy.
Lin Dong stepped out to meet him, and another Pseudo-Emperor battle was begun.
"Hehe, everyone’s already made a move, so I can’t stay idle either." Jing Haoran winked at Wu Xingtong in a showy manner, and said, "Beauty, are you interested in sparring with me in bed?"
Wu Xingtong was furious. "I’ll chop off your dog’s head!"
Boom!

The two of them stepped into the galaxy at the same time, and began a fierce battle. From this aspect, the side of the Lands of Death still used civility before resorting to force. They did not start a battle on the Mysterious Spirit Planet, which was very much giving face to Great Emperor Jingtian.
Meanwhile, the large black dog was puzzled. "Grandpa Dog didn’t steal that woman’s undergarment, so why does she want to behead Grandpa Dog?"
"It means that your notoriety has spread all over the world, and everyone has the right to kill you," the little azure dragon said happily.

The three Pseudo-Emperor battles began, but even at such a far distance, those Saints could still clearly see that Jing Haoran, Shui Qingchang, and Ding Shu all had the upper hand, and their advantage was very obvious.
That’s right. These three people weren’t as lucky as Ling Han and obtained great fortune from the Primitive Abyss. However, as the Genesis World’s Masters, they naturally weren’t ordinary either.
To say nothing else, merely grasping the Destructive Energy allowed them to possess battle prowess that was superior to ordinary Pseudo-Emperors.
Moreover, Ling Han didn’t keep secrets, and he even passed on the True Dragon Body Art, which naturally raised Ding Shu and the others’ battle prowess to another level.
Hence, this was a one-sided thrashing.
He Luo, Yang Yihuan and the others couldn’t sit still any longer, and hurriedly went to provide reinforcements.
But even if it was a battle of two against one, they did not have the slightest advantage, and were still being suppressed.
The might of Genesis World’s Masters were fully unleashed.
Li Dangping didn’t attack. Instead, his eyes were locked on Ling Han.
This was the key person. With Ling Han’s battle prowess, he could suppress all the Pseudo-Emperors with a single hand.
However, this was the era of the Great Emperor, so no matter how strong a Pseudo-Emperor was, he was still only a Pseudo-Emperor.
Weng!
Right at this moment, the Natural-born Gold Spirit moved, and joined the battle.
The effects were immediately apparent.

From birth, the Natural-born Gold Spirit had already stood at the peak stage of Pseudo-Emperor Tier, and added with the divine sense of the Lords of Death, its battle prowess could sweep aside all Pseudo-Emperor Tier opponents.
—Of course, aside from Ling Han, because Ling Han’s strength had long since surpassed the level of Pseudo-Emperor.

Although Ding Shu and the others were strong, they were only Five Stars and Six Stars Pseudo-Emperors, after all. They were suppressed in terms of minor level, and added with the Natural-born Gold Spirit being extremely powerful in attack, they were outnumbered, and their advantageous situation was instantly turned into a disadvantageous situation.
After battling for a few more rounds, Ding Shu and the others retreated from the battle and returned to the Mysterious Spirit Planet.
"Ling Han, it will still have to depend on you," the three of them said.
The Natural-born Gold Spirit was too strong.
Everyone gritted their teeth. The side of the Lands of Death was really too strong. The Lords of Death hadn’t even made a move, and their trump card was already close to being forced out.
—Fortunately, a new Emperor had attained Dao.
Ling Han smiled, "No need."
He waved his hand, and in the distant galaxy, the rock golem immediately cried out and charged towards the Natural-born Gold Spirit.
Boom!
Instantly, an intense battle broke out in the galaxy.
The rock golem was a nine-star Pseudo-Emperor. Though it was not on the level of a Natural Spirit, it was nurtured by heaven and earth, so it could be said that there was not much difference.
One of them had invincible defense, while the other had heaven-defying attack power. This was the battle between the strongest spear and shield.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
At this moment, the battle was incredibly intense, yet it was difficult to determine who was stronger.
What!
Everyone was numb with shock. Ling Han actually summoned a Pseudo-Emperor-level Natural-born Stone Spirit with a wave of his hand?
What kind of great fortune was this? He was really too blessed by heaven and earth, wasn’t he?
However, it was a shame that he hadn’t become the Emperor.

Thinking of this, everyone shook their heads slightly. In front of a Great Emperor, so what if it was a Pseudo-Emperor-level Natural-born Stone Spirit? It was no different from a toy, and would only be the matter of a minor skirmish.

"I am honored by your presence. I have not come out to receive you, so please forgive my lack of manners!" Right at this moment, a voice filled with authority rang out, as if it could shake the heavens and earth.
