chapters.title: Chapter 4858: Request of the Lords of Death
paragraphs: The new Emperor, Pu Jingtian.
Boundless might surged, and a man was slowly walking over from the distance.
His steps were clearly light, yet gave off an incredibly heavy feeling. It was as if even the heavens would not be able to hold up under his foot, and would be forcefully crushed.
Great Emperor Jingtian!
"Greetings, Great Emperor!" Li Dangping and the other Imperial Sons bowed, paying their respects to the Great Emperor Jingtian.
Seeing the rebellious Imperial Sons from the Lands of Death pay their respects to the Great Emperor Jingtian, everyone felt a sense of pride and confidence rise up from the bottom of their hearts.
Having or not having a Great Emperor was a completely different matter.
Though Ling Han looked freakish, no matter how strong his battle prowess was, he was still only a Pseudo-Emperor.
With the word ’Pseudo’, how could it compare to the Great Emperor?
Thus, every battle with the Lords of Death would end with Ling Han fleeing.
But now? The battle had not even begun, and the Imperial Sons of the Lands of Death were already so respectful. This was proof of the might of the Great Emperor.
This was the weight of the Great Emperor.

The Great Emperor Jingtian was unmoved. He merely looked at the various Lands of Death in the sky, a murderous aura in his eyes, "I haven’t even gone to look for you guys, and you guys have already delivered yourselves to my doorstep?"
To dare cause trouble at his celebration of attaining Dao, this naturally enraged him.

"Jingtian, we have only come to offer our congratulations." A female voice rang out from within the sea of blood. She was clearly incredibly cold, yet gave off a wonderful feeling of beauty, which was incredibly contradicting.
"Tell me your name!" the Great Emperor Jingtian said in a domineering voice.
All the Imperial Clans felt their blood boil with excitement upon seeing this. They finally had a pillar of support.
This boosted their morale too much!
"I am the Ancestor Blood Demon," the Master of the Blood Sea said.
"I am the Sea Emperor."
"I am Void."
"Ah Han."
"Four Directions Great Emperor."
"Wolf Tribe, Di Shitian."
"Ancestral King Fire Clouds."
"Golden Crow Emperor."
"The Three Purity Great Emperor."
"Great Emperor Senluo."
"Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperor."
"Dark Sunflower Demon Emperor."

The leaders of the Twelve Lands of Death reported their titles one after another. These were all overlords who had ruled over an era all those years ago. Some of them were familiar, but there were also some rumored Great Emperors whose records had been lost in the long passage of history.
Even in the face of twelve Great Emperors, Pu Jingtian was still incredibly calm, "If you have only come to offer congratulations, it is not that I have no tolerance for others. Please take a seat."

"Hehe, it’s fine for us to observe the ceremony here," the Four Directions Great Emperor said. "Jingtian, we’ve come here firstly to offer our congratulations, as we’ve gained another member in the ranks of Great Emperors. Secondly, we also want to ask for a favor from you, friend."
"What favor?" the Great Emperor Jingtian asked calmly.
"Please do not move for the next thousand years, friend!" the Golden Crow Emperor continued.

"Hahahaha!" The Great Emperor Jingtian laughed loudly, and said, "I’m the Great Emperor Jingtian, and I’ve grasped the willpower of heaven and earth. I can come and go as I please, yet you people actually want to restrict my movements?"
When he said the last words, his fighting spirit was already soaring.
Which Emperor was not incredibly proud?
Who would dare to restrict the Great Emperor?
Ancestral King Ancestral Fire Clouds spoke up, and said calmly, "Friend, bear with it for a while, and only then will you be able to live forever."

"More than ten million years ago, there was also a new Emperor who had succeeded Dao, but he did not appreciate our kindness. In the end, he died not long after becoming Emperor," the Sea Emperor said.
Of course, he was talking about Xuan Taiyu.
The Sea Emperor’s tone was very calm, but when everyone heard it, they couldn’t help but feel a cold chill rise up in their hearts.
A new Emperor... had been killed by these Great Emperors.
Similarly, you, Pu Jingtian, are also a new Emperor. Of course, you could also be killed, and there would be no accidents.
These words were filled with threat, and also fully displayed the pride of the Great Emperor.
’I’m not trying to persuade you. Instead, I’m blatantly threatening you.’
Those who did not heed his advice would be directly killed!
The Great Emperor Jingtian scoffed, and said, "You people should have disappeared in the passage of time long ago. Acting against the will of heaven will only lead to your own destruction!"
"What a joke!" the Great Emperor Senluo said. "Cultivating is something that defies the heavens to begin with. If we don’t defy the heavens, how can we open up a new world?"

"Jingtian, you’ve just achieved dao, so it’s understandable that you’re full of vigor," Ah Han said. "However, since ancient times, among those who can become Emperors, who would be inferior to another?"
"Firstly, you have just entered into Great Emperor Tier, and have also grasped a nine-star Regulation, and we are all consummate level beings that have grasped nine Regulations!"
"Secondly, there are a total of 12 Great Emperors here, and if we join forces against you, as long as your dao foundations are damaged, you would naturally die very quickly."
"Thirdly, our request is also very simple, and that is you do not enter into our territory within a thousand years."
"This request is not too much, is it? We are also Great Emperors, and charging into our territory can be considered a challenge to us!"
This made a lot of sense. How could the territory of a Great Emperor be allowed to be invaded? That would be equivalent to causing trouble!
However, a Great Emperor ruled over an era, yet now the rule of this era had to be shared among thirteen of them. With the pride of a Great Emperor, who could tolerate this?
However, the Great Emperor Jingtian fell into deep thought.
He had the pride of a Great Emperor, but he was no fool either.
Just like what the Lords of Death said, in terms of battle prowess alone, he was now the weakest Great Emperor.

—In the past, when Xuan Taiyu had died, though he had not heard or witnessed it, when he had been cultivating to attain Dao, he had caught bits and pieces of it from the flow of time, and knew that the words of the Lords of Death were not false.
Who would be weaker than the other among those who could become Emperor?
He had just advanced into Emperor Tier, and there was only one of him. If he went head-on with the Lords of Death, then Xuan Taiyu’s fate was a clear example for him.
Thus, he definitely could not make the same mistake.
Then... he quickly made his judgement.

As long as he stabilized his cultivation level, and possessed the strength to face the Lords of Death head-on, then even if he was still all alone, the Lords of Death weren’t the complete form of Great Emperors, and he could completely exhaust them to death.
This was the correct course of action.
With this in mind, the Great Emperor Jingtian finally came to a decision.
"A thousand years." He nodded, "I will give you a thousand years’ time."
He was clearly the one who wanted to hide for a thousand years, yet he spoke as if he was letting the Lords of Death off the hook.
It could not be helped. Did the Great Emperor not care about his pride?
The Lords of Death didn’t refute this. They were already on the upper hand, so they would let Pu Jingtian save some face.
And once they had dealt with the hidden danger, and even improved further in fact, wouldn’t it be a piece of cake for them to destroy Pu Jingtian?

"Since we’ve come to an agreement, you can all leave now!" the Great Emperor Jingtian said calmly. This was his celebration of proving Dao, so if there were still 12 Great Emperors beside him, where would he get his sense of superiority from?
Hearing this, the Imperial Clans all felt a strong sense of disappointment.
Was he going to cower just like that? Compromise?

Though they all knew that logically speaking, this was the best choice that the Great Emperor Jingtian had made. If he was to clash head-on with the Lords of Death now, he may be able to kill one or two of them, but the Great Emperor Jingtian would definitely die as well.
However, they had waited for so long, anticipating the emergence of a new Emperor. Wasn’t it all for the sake of suppressing the Lords of Death and eradicating the darkness?
However... Pu Jingtian’s performance was far too disappointing.
They couldn’t help but think that if it was Ling Han who had attained Dao, then this guy’s performance would definitely be different.
Why wasn’t it Ling Han who was attaining Dao?

He would definitely not compromise. His battle prowess was incredibly freakish, and at this time, he would just simply charge full speed ahead. Who knows, he may even be able to completely defeat the Lords of Death, and make them flee in a sorry state.
All of a sudden, everyone felt rueful.

chapters.title: Chapter 4859: You disappoint me
paragraphs: However, why was Ling Han keeping such a low profile today?
Was he afraid now?
How was this possible!
Previously, he was also a Pseudo-Emperor, but hadn’t he still fought fiercely with the Lords of Death?
Could it be that he was giving face to the Great Emperor Jingtian?
Yes, that must be the case.
You see, even the Great Emperor had cowered, but Ling Han, a Pseudo-Emperor was charging, wasn’t that equivalent to mocking the Great Emperor Jingtian?

Since Pu Jingtian had already succeeded Dao, there would not be a second Great Emperor in this era. Thus, in order to pacify the unrest, Ling Han had to cooperate with Pu Jingtian. The relations between the two of them naturally could not become strained.
After all, the Great Emperor was the main force, and no matter how freakish Ling Han was, he could only be a support.
Everyone nodded internally. Ling Han had really changed his personality, choosing to endure for the sake of the greater picture.
Thus, the gazes directed at Ling Han were filled with admiration.
Yi?
Ling Han was baffled. He was only showing off as per usual, so how had he suddenly gained the admiration of others for no reason?
En... could it be that the halo above his head had changed its attributes?
The Wolf Tribe Demon Emperor, Di Shitian opened his mouth and said, "We still have to take another person away."
Finally, his eyes landed on Ling Han.

Though a new Emperor had appeared now, and it was impossible for Ling Han to attain Dao, this guy still posed a considerable threat. Additionally, the Mark of Destiny was still in Ling Han’s body, and he had to be killed to release it.

This was supposed to be used in conjunction when Little Ye attained Dao, but Little Ye was already dead, and a new Emperor had also appeared, so the significance was much smaller. However, they had to try again no matter what. It wouldn’t hurt to make more preparations.
"Ling Han!" The Lords of Death looked at Ling Han at the same time, their killing intent blazing like the waves.
These were all Great Emperors, and the killing intent that they exuded at the same time was too terrifying. A great many Saints were directly suffocated, their faces as pale as paper.
The Great Emperor Jingtian frowned, and said, "Haven’t you guys gone too far?"
This was his Dao Ceremony, and if they came over to threaten him, he could still find a reason to convince himself, that this was for the sake of the greater picture, and he could temporarily endure.
But you guys still want to take away one of his guests. That would be going too far.
Did he not care about his pride?
"This boy must die!" the Black Sunflower Demon Emperor declared balefully. His son had died by Ling Han’s hand, and this was a great enmity.
The Lords of Death all exuded killing intent, their attitudes incredibly resolute.

The Great Emperor Jingtian sighed internally. Great Emperors naturally understood Great Emperors. He knew that the Lords of Death had already made up their minds, and it was impossible for him to change their minds.
Or he could choose the course of battle.

However, the consequences of this battle was something that he could not bear. Furthermore, a delay was beneficial to him. He had just attained Dao, so how could it be that he was willing to die with the Lords of Death just like that?
Sacrificing Ling Han alone could save all life in the world, so it was not a loss in terms of the overall situation!
The Great Emperor Jingtian had already taken a step back. Now that he had already started, it would be much easier for him to make any further concessions.
"You can only take one person," he said, his eyes cold.
They actually dared to threaten him? Humph! When he reached the consummate level of the Emperor Tier, he would definitely make these Lords of Death pay a bloody price.
"It’s just one person!" The Lords of Death all nodded. They too had their own plans.
The Great Emperor Jingtian nodded, looked at Ling Han, and said, "For the sake of all life in the world, you can only suffer."
His words implied that he should sacrifice himself first. This was for the sake of all life in the world, to buy time for him. At that time, he would definitely avenge you.
Sigh, after talking for so long, it was finally his turn to take the field.
"Tsk, why are you sacrificing Little Han?" the large black dog immediately shouted.
Yi, are you trying to steal the show?
Ling Han rubbed his nose. Since the large black dog had replied, he would just wait for now.
The Great Emperor Jingtian wore an expression of displeasure. He had just spoken, so how could he allow others to interrupt?

"Why don’t you make some sacrifices?" the large black dog said. "You’ve already lived for so long, and Little Han is still in his prime. It’s clear that you’re the one who should make sacrifices for the sake of the world!"

"You see, my Little Han is so strong. As long as you die bravely, you would definitely be able to severely injure those Lords of Death. At that time, my Little Han would be able to clean up the mess and calm the darkness."
"Don’t worry, your merits will definitely be recorded in history."
"Go on!"
The large black dog waved his paws, looking like he was chasing someone away.
This!
The Great Emperor Jingtian’s mouth twitched slightly. ’This despicable dog, are you even speaking human language?’
However, he naturally would not argue with a Saint, or a despicable dog. That would be too demeaning.
Ignorant pest.
"Ling Han, you killed my descendant, so you need to give me an explanation!" he said calmly.

Previously, he had already wanted to kill Ling Han, but because he was no match for him, he could only stop. But now, he had already attained Dao as a Great Emperor, so was there still a Pseudo-Emperor that he could not suppress?
Since Ling Han was unwilling to submit, he would find an excuse to suppress Ling Han.
Ling Han smiled calmly, "Pu Jingtian, you have disappointed me."
What? He actually dared to speak to the Great Emperor in this manner?
Everyone shook their heads. Looks like Ling Han knew that he would not be able to escape, so he threw caution to the wind as well.
However, they didn’t know that Ling Han’s words were truly filled with emotion.
He deliberately went to the Primitive Abyss to prove his Dao, all for the sake of having another Great Emperor.
But what was the result?
Such a person had appeared.
However, his words could not be understood by outsiders.
"If you had known, you might as well have shot it at the wall," the large black dog said from the sidelines.
"Sigh, what an unfilial son!" The little azure dragon also shook its head.
Without Ling Han’s concession, there would have been no way for Pu Jingtian to attain Dao. Thus, from this aspect, Pu Jingtian was completely repaying kindness with ingratitude.
However, Pu Jingtian didn’t know, and the others didn’t know either.
As they saw it, Ling Han, and the others were completely spouting nonsense.
The Great Emperor Jingtian couldn’t help but sneer, saying, "Ling Han, are you worthy of speaking to me like this?"
He was a Great Emperor!
Ling Han shook his head, and stood up, "After watching the show for so long, it’s time to end it."
"That’s right, with your death!" Wu Xingtong interrupted.
Ling Han cracked a smile, "I’m afraid I’ll have to disappoint all of you."
He looked at the Great Emperor Jingtian and said, "A man knows when to yield and when not to yield. However, in the face of right and wrong, you need to have a bottom line. Unfortunately, you don’t."
The Great Emperor Jingtian couldn’t help but laugh. "Are you even worthy of teaching me a lesson?"
"Of course, he is, just like how a father can beat his own son," the large black dog interrupted.
The Great Emperor Jingtian’s mouth twitched again, and he couldn’t help but turn to look at the large black dog. This despicable dog!
When a Great Emperor moved, what need was there for him to have any reservations?
His killing intent rose, and he stretched out a hand to swat at the large black dog.
"Little Han, save me!" the large black dog hurriedly shouted. Even at this moment, he didn’t forget to show off.
Ling Han naturally wouldn’t sit by and watch. He raised a hand to parry, and the Great Emperor Jingtian’s attack was instantly dispersed..
Boom! Even though the Great Emperor Jingtian had held back, the Emperor Tier power still swept over them, causing the Saints to stumble.
The Great Emperor Jingtian and people of the Mysterious Spirit Planet were both astonished.
Ling Han... was actually capable of contending against Emperor Tier power?
How was this possible?
Could it be that the legends were true?

As they saw it, Ling Han, and the others were completely spouting nonsense.
The Great Emperor Jingtian couldn’t help but sneer, saying, "Ling Han, are you worthy of speaking to me like this?"
He was a Great Emperor!
Ling Han shook his head, and stood up, "After watching the show for so long, it’s time to end it."
"That’s right, with your death!" Wu Xingtong interrupted.
Ling Han cracked a smile, "I’m afraid I’ll have to disappoint all of you."
He looked at the Great Emperor Jingtian and said, "A man knows when to yield and when not to yield.
However, in the face of right and wrong, you need to have a bottom line.
Unfortunately, you don’t."
The Great Emperor Jingtian couldn’t help but laugh.
"Are you even worthy of teaching me a lesson?"
"Of course, he is, just like how a father can beat his own son," the large black dog interrupted.
The Great Emperor Jingtian’s mouth twitched again, and he couldn’t help but turn to look at the large black dog.
This despicable dog!
When a Great Emperor moved, what need was there for him to have any reservations?
His killing intent rose, and he stretched out a hand to swat at the large black dog.
"Little Han, save me!" the large black dog hurriedly shouted.
Even at this moment, he didn’t forget to show off.
Ling Han naturally wouldn’t sit by and watch.
He raised a hand to parry, and the Great Emperor Jingtian’s attack was instantly dispersed..
Boom!
Even though the Great Emperor Jingtian had held back, the Emperor Tier power still swept over them, causing the Saints to stumble.
The Great Emperor Jingtian and people of the Mysterious Spirit Planet were both astonished.
Ling Han... was actually capable of contending against Emperor Tier power?
How was this possible?
Could it be that the legends were true?

chapters.title: Chapter 4860: Attack!
paragraphs: According to legends, Ling Han was able to stand against the Lords of Death and the Divine Beast Great Emperors.
However, this had always been regarded as a joke by the people of the Mysterious Spirit Planet.
How was this possible? A Pseudo-Emperor could match Great Emperors, do you think the Great Emperor being capable of ruling over his era was just a joke?
However, after this attack, no one thought that this was a joke.
There really was such a freakish person in this world!

The Great Emperor Jingtian also raised a brow. He knew that Ling Han was very strong. In the previous battle, Ling Han gave him a feeling of unfathomable depths, and he had not used up all his power. However, no matter how strong a Pseudo-Emperor was, could he compare to a Great Emperor?
He hadn’t used his full power at all—how much power did he need to use to kill a Saint? Moreover, this was the Mysterious Spirit Planet, so he also had reservations.
"You do have some abilities. No wonder you’re so arrogant!" the Great Emperor Jingtian said calmly.
Ling Han smiled, and his eyes swept over the Lords of Death. "Just in time. Since you’ve all come today, there’s no need for me to make an extra trip. I’ll deal with you all together."
These words were very domineering!
All of a sudden, it was as if everyone’s emotions had been ignited, filled with excitement.
This was the tone of the strongest person in the world. Who cares if you are the Lords of Death or the Divine Beast Great Emperors? You are all past your prime. I am the true ruler of this era!
However, everyone immediately sighed. Too bad, Ling Han didn’t attain Dao.
Even if Ling Han was freakishly powerful, and could just barely match a Great Emperor, there was absolutely no way he could suppress him. At most, he could only defend himself.
"Even if we’re on different sides, killing you still feels like burning a qin to boil a crane," Ah Han said1[. This is a Chinese proverb that means ’this is a waste of valuable resources’.].
This time, they had already set up the Inescapable Net, and would definitely not give Ling Han another chance to escape.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and slowly stepped into the galaxy, "Then let us battle!"

"Ling Han!" the Great Emperor Jingtian roared. He also stepped into the galaxy, and said, "You killed my descendant first, and you disrespected me later. Moreover, you’re also unwilling to sacrifice yourself for the sake of all life in the world. I can’t tolerate this!"
Boom!
He immediately lashed out, grabbing at Ling Han.
The elites were all stunned.
Great enemies were in front of them, yet the Great Emperor Jingtian was actually still concerned about an internal conflict?
He was really too petty, wasn’t he?

Meanwhile, the Lords of Death and the others smirked coldly. In terms of conventional battle prowess, they were no longer a match for Ling Han. If they wanted to suppress Ling Han, they had to return to their strongest state. Now that someone was taking the vanguard for them, they were naturally happy to save some energy.
Ling Han casually swung his fists, blocking the Great Emperor Jingtian’s attacks with ease.
So... powerful!

All the Imperial Clans were watching dumbfounded. They knew that Ling Han was strong, but they had never imagined that a Pseudo-Emperor could actually be strong to this extent, and be on equal footing with a Great Emperor that had just attained Dao.
In fact, in fact, Ling Han appeared to be too relaxed, as if he still had energy left.
Gods, there was actually such a Pseudo-Emperor!
Meanwhile, the Mysterious Spirit Planet cultivators all gaped in shock, unable to believe their eyes.
Had their Great Emperor been born in the wrong era?
Throughout history, which Great Emperor hadn’t suppressed heaven and earth and become invincible as soon as they achieved dao?
But now?
Not only did the older generation of Great Emperors climb out of their graves, but even a Pseudo-Emperor was overwhelmingly powerful, possessing the might to match a Great Emperor.
Just what kind of great luck was this!
If Ling Han could become Emperor... hiss!
No one dared to imagine how strong that would be.
All of a sudden, the Great Emperor Jingtian felt extremely complicated.
He had become the strongest in the world, yet his battle prowess was actually not the strongest. How could he accept this?
If it was the Lords of Death, that was still fine. After all, these were the Great Emperors of past eras, and they were all on the same level, but Ling Han... f***, this was a Pseudo-Emperor!
How could a Pseudo-Emperor be so powerful?
He gave a loud shout, and the Nine Star Regulations channelled.

Previously, he had only grasped a portion of the Nine Star Regulations, which allowed his battle prowess to overwhelm all Saints, and be called Pseudo-Emperor. Now, he had finally grasped a complete Nine Star Regulation, and his battle prowess had increased by who knew how many times.
Without the word ’Pseudo’, it was a completely different story.

Boom! His palm pressed down on the sky, and the true Imperial Might blazed. Even at such a far distance, the Saints on Mysterious Spirit Planet couldn’t help but tremble uncontrollably, almost passing out.
Ling Han shook his head, and also sent out a palm strike.
Peng!
The Great Emperor Jingtian was instantly sent flying.
W-what!
Seeing this scene, whether it was the Lords of Death, the various Imperial Clans, or the people of the Mysterious Spirit Planet, they all showed expressions of disbelief.
The Great Emperor... was sent flying with a single slap?
Heavens!
This, this, this, what Pseudo-Emperor could accomplish this in history?
Previously, those Imperial Clans that had deliberately curried the favour of Pu Jingtian, and made cynical remarks about Ling Han, were really numb with shock now.
Ling Han was actually this strong!
How could a Pseudo-Emperor be so strong?
What justice was there left in this world?
Was there any law?
All of a sudden, the entire Mysterious Spirit Planet was dead silent. No one could say a single word.
Except—
"You have attained Dao and become Emperor!" the Blood Demon Ancestor said, her killing intent surging.
Ling Han smiled faintly, "I said that I would slaughter you all, and pacify the world. Did you think I was showing off?"
Everyone was in deep agreement. This was really too much of a show-off.
He had shown off by stepping on the face of the Great Emperor!

Xiu, the great golden path spread out. The Great Emperor Jingtian had already appeared in front of Ling Han. He roared loudly, and endless Imperial Might surged out. His fighting spirit and killing intent had already been ignited to the extreme.
Was he the most tragic Great Emperor in history?
He had just attained Dao, when he was sent flying with a slap.
He would definitely go down in history, but in the most humiliating way.
"Ling, Han!" he called out word by word, wanting nothing more than to grind his teeth into pieces.
Ling Han looked at him calmly, and said calmly, "Cowardice and fear of trouble does not affect others. However, one must have a bottom line. Unfortunately, you do not!"

"What do you know!" The Great Emperor Jingtian charged over, "What I need is only time. As long as I cultivate to the consummate level of Emperor Tier, I will definitely be able to quell the turmoil! Who do you think you are? The heaven and earth no longer allows you to attain Dao. This era belongs to me!"
Peng!
Ling Han didn’t say anything, and the response he received was an iron fist.
This punch was earth-shattering.
So what if he was the Great Emperor? After sustaining such a blow, the Great Emperor Jingtian was once again sent flying, blood gushing from all over his body.
It should be known that his present battle prowess was only in the sixth tier, and furthermore, did not belong to the strongest category. He was slightly inferior to the Divine Beast Great Emperors.
And what about Ling Han?
He alone could match 36 of them, and he had killed all the Divine Beast Great Emperors.
Moreover, Ling Han’s current strength had improved further than before.
How could the Great Emperor Jingtian be a match for him?
If he put his life on the line, he naturally wouldn’t be able to withstand a single blow.
Ling Han caught up to him, throwing punch after punch.
Peng, peng, peng! The dignified Great Emperor was being beaten like a punching bag by Ling Han.
Everyone’s mouths were wide open, but they could not make the slightest bit of sound.
Was this the most tragic Great Emperor in history?
He must be.
He should have suppressed the world and been invincible for an era, but what happened in the end?
Being thrashed in front of everyone in the universe!
Crap, he was really in such a sorry state.

chapters.title: Chapter 4861: Courting Death
paragraphs: The Great Emperor Jingtian released a furious roar. The soundwaves were like a tidal wave, and solidified. Peng, peng, peng! The waves crashed over, and even space was forcibly torn apart.
If they hadn’t been battling in the depths of the universe, this roar alone would have been enough to obliterate all of the nearby planets.
The strength of a Great Emperor was not something that could be imagined by ordinary people.
However, such a powerful Great Emperor was being pummeled by Ling Han!
Heavens!
Everyone was dumbfounded, feeling their scalps go numb, while their bodies continued to feel cold.
They... had witnessed a miracle.
The strongest Pseudo-Emperor in history!
A Pseudo-Emperor was beating down on a Great Emperor. Though it was only a Great Emperor that had just proved his Dao, this had still broken the records thoughout the passage of history.
Hold on, someone seemed to have just said that Ling Han had already attained Dao?
That was impossible.
A new Emperor had just attained Dao, so it was definitely impossible for another Great Emperor to emerge.
And if it was claimed that Ling Han had attained Dao long before the Great Emperor Jingtian, it was even more impossible.
Only one Great Emperor could appear in an era. Furthermore, there had been no phenomenon of heaven and earth previously.
But whether it was the Pseudo-Emperor beating up the Great Emperor, or the birth of two Great Emperors in the same era, this had broken the iron rule of heaven and earth.
What kind of crazy era was this?
Boom! The Great Emperor Jingtian mustered up his remaining strength and forcibly charged forward.
He was covered with injuries, and one of his eyes was swollen. He looked as disheveled as could be.
He stared fixedly at Ling Han, his eyes filled with killing intent.
This was too humiliating.
He was a Great Emperor, a Great Emperor!

"You are definitely not a Pseudo-Emperor!" The Great Emperor Jingtian said through gritted teeth. There was no such powerful Pseudo-Emperor in this world, but to say that Ling Han had become a Grand Emperor... he too could not accept it.
Ling Han smiled faintly, his eyes sweeping over the Lords of Death, "That’s right. I have already attained Dao, and that is before you at that."
What!
Everyone gritted their teeth. Even the Saints from the Imperial Clans were shaking their heads.

This was an impossible feat. A Great Emperor would never see another Great Emperor. This was an iron-clad rule of heaven and earth. Throughout these countless years, this iron-clad rule had also been enforced, and there had never been an exception.
For example, the Lords of Death were buried in the passage of time. Furthermore, they could no longer be considered true Great Emperors.
Ling Han... on what basis was he different from the rest?
"Impossible! Impossible!" the Great Emperor Jingtian roared.
He was the true Great Emperor, the only Great Emperor!
Ling Han shook his head, "Frog at the bottom of a well!"
A Great Emperor that had never even gone to the Primitive Abyss still dared to boast shamelessly that it was impossible?
Anything was possible.
However, the Great Emperor Jingtian didn’t dare to attack again. He had just succeeded Dao, so he didn’t even have the Imperial Weapon. It could be said that he had no trump cards.
Faced with a powerful and unfathomable guy like Ling Han, he really didn’t have the slightest bit of confidence.
However, his heart was filled with great hatred.
He was a Great Emperor, and he had actually been trampled on in public. He had completely lost all face. He naturally wanted to crush Ling Han’s bones and scatter his ashes.
"Friend, how about we work together to capture this brat?" the Three Purity Great Emperor asked calmly.
The Great Emperor Jingtian couldn’t help but be tempted.
In a one-on-one battle, even if he was proud and arrogant, he had to admit that he was inferior to Ling Han. In fact, he wasn’t even qualified to make Ling Han go all out.

However, if he teamed up with the Lords of Death... there were 12 of them, and they could even unleash the strength of the consummate level of Great Emperors. Just like tens of millions of years ago, they had even killed an actual Great Emperor.
Furthermore!

Killing intent flashed through his mind. There was a limit to the explosive power of the Lords of Death. If they used their full strength to kill Ling Han, it was possible that they would also be in danger. Then, he only had to exert a little more strength, and he would be able to completely destroy the Lords of Death.
At that time, he would be the only one to end the turmoil of the ages, and his reputation would definitely last forever.
Very good, very good!
"All right!" The Great Emperor Jingtian nodded. As a Great Emperor, his willpower was definitely resolute.
Instantly, the thirteen Emperors, both new and old, joined forces.
It could be said that no one could have foreseen that things would develop in this manner.
The Great Emperor Jingtian, who should have been the hope of the new era, had actually joined forces with the culprits behind the darkness, fighting against the side of light.
This... was ridiculous.
At the same time, it was also very tragic.
Ling Han shook his head, and said, "Jingtian, I can understand that you’re jealous. However, as a Great Emperor, you don’t even have this bit of tolerance. This truly disappoints me!"
"What do you know!" the Great Emperor Jingtian said calmly. He had already made up his mind. This was called enduring humiliation.
Ling Han sneered, "Don’t think that I don’t know what you’re planning, but to make a deal with a tiger, you will ultimately suffer the consequences of your own actions!"
"You speak too much nonsense!" the Great Emperor Jingtian shouted. He was afraid that Ling Han would expose his scheme.
However, which one of them wasn’t an old fox?
Those who could become Great Emperors were all extraordinarily smart.
They knew, but did not point it out.
"Die!" The Blood Demon Ancestor walked out of the sea of blood. Her shrivelled body did not have the sligthest bit of beauty, and no one could tell that she had once been a supreme Empress.
The price of such longevity was too great.
And precisely because they had already sacrificed so many years, every Lord of Death was yearning to obtain the true art of immortality. For this, they were willing to destroy this universe.
A black Demonic Sunflower suddenly bloomed in the galaxy. One petal was even larger than the galaxy itself, and it was indescribably majestic.
Inside the Demonic Sunflower stood a Great Emperor.
The Black Sunflower Demon Emperor also stepped forward.
The Sea Emperor, Golden Crow Emperor, Void Emperor and so on all entered into battle mode.
The thirteen Emperors battled Ling Han.
Ling Han was extremely calm. With a casual wave of his hand, nine-star Regulations appeared. One, two, three, four... nine, ten!
Though only two were complete, the number had reached ten.
"What?!" The Lords of Death were all stunned. Ling Han had actually grasped 10 Nine Star Regulations!
How was this possible?

The Regulation of Death belonged to the Netherworld. Even for them, they could only grasp and use it after transforming into Yin souls. However, as a price, they had also lost the ability to use the Regulation of Life.
It could not be helped. To them, the Regulation of Life was like poison, and to allow it to enter their bodies was an action of courting death.
But Ling Han... he was clearly a living being, so how could he possibly absorb the Regulation of Death?
This was practically, practically...!
All the Great Emperors wanted to curse. How could such a monster appear?
The Great Emperor Jingtian felt even more inferior. He had only grasped a nine-star Regulation, but what about Ling Han?
Ten flashes!
—Though there were only two that were complete.
No wonder he had been suppressed. This was because he was overwhelmed in terms of the number of Regulations.

But it was all right. As long as he was given enough time, he would similarly be able to grasp all the Nine Star Regulations. Even if he was still inferior to Ling Han, the gap would be very, very small.
"Charge!" he roared loudly, and was the first to charge out.
—The new Emperor was actually playing the role of the vanguard in killing Ling Han. This was really an incomparably ironic matter.
Ling Han’s eyes finally lit up with killing intent.

He was quite tolerant of Great Emperor Jingtian. Although Pu Jingtian definitely wouldn’t admit this, Ling Han believed that this was a Great Emperor that he had nurtured. Thus, he treasured his talent.
Unfortunately, Pu Jingtian had courted death.

"Friend, how about we work together to capture this brat?" the Three Purity Great Emperor asked calmly.
The Great Emperor Jingtian couldn’t help but be tempted.
In a one-on-one battle, even if he was proud and arrogant, he had to admit that he was inferior to Ling Han.
In fact, he wasn’t even qualified to make Ling Han go all out.
However, if he teamed up with the Lords of Death... there were 12 of them, and they could even unleash the strength of the consummate level of Great Emperors.
Just like tens of millions of years ago, they had even killed an actual Great Emperor.
Furthermore!
Killing intent flashed through his mind.
There was a limit to the explosive power of the Lords of Death.
If they used their full strength to kill Ling Han, it was possible that they would also be in danger.
Then, he only had to exert a little more strength, and he would be able to completely destroy the Lords of Death.
At that time, he would be the only one to end the turmoil of the ages, and his reputation would definitely last forever.
Very good, very good!
"All right!" The Great Emperor Jingtian nodded.
As a Great Emperor, his willpower was definitely resolute.
Instantly, the thirteen Emperors, both new and old, joined forces.
It could be said that no one could have foreseen that things would develop in this manner.
The Great Emperor Jingtian, who should have been the hope of the new era, had actually joined forces with the culprits behind the darkness, fighting against the side of light.
This... was ridiculous.
At the same time, it was also very tragic.
Ling Han shook his head, and said, "Jingtian, I can understand that you’re jealous.
However, as a Great Emperor, you don’t even have this bit of tolerance.
This truly disappoints me!"
"What do you know!" the Great Emperor Jingtian said calmly.
He had already made up his mind.
This was called enduring humiliation.
Ling Han sneered, "Don’t think that I don’t know what you’re planning, but to make a deal with a tiger, you will ultimately suffer the consequences of your own actions!"
"You speak too much nonsense!" the Great Emperor Jingtian shouted.
He was afraid that Ling Han would expose his scheme.
However, which one of them wasn’t an old fox?
Those who could become Great Emperors were all extraordinarily smart.
They knew, but did not point it out.
"Die!" The Blood Demon Ancestor walked out of the sea of blood.
Her shrivelled body did not have the sligthest bit of beauty, and no one could tell that she had once been a supreme Empress.
The price of such longevity was too great.
And precisely because they had already sacrificed so many years, every Lord of Death was yearning to obtain the true art of immortality.
For this, they were willing to destroy this universe.
A black Demonic Sunflower suddenly bloomed in the galaxy.
One petal was even larger than the galaxy itself, and it was indescribably majestic.
Inside the Demonic Sunflower stood a Great Emperor.
The Black Sunflower Demon Emperor also stepped forward.
The Sea Emperor, Golden Crow Emperor, Void Emperor and so on all entered into battle mode.
The thirteen Emperors battled Ling Han.
Ling Han was extremely calm.
With a casual wave of his hand, nine-star Regulations appeared.
One, two, three, four... nine, ten!
Though only two were complete, the number had reached ten.
"What?!" The Lords of Death were all stunned.
Ling Han had actually grasped 10 Nine Star Regulations!
How was this possible?
The Regulation of Death belonged to the Netherworld.
Even for them, they could only grasp and use it after transforming into Yin souls.
However, as a price, they had also lost the ability to use the Regulation of Life.
It could not be helped.
To them, the Regulation of Life was like poison, and to allow it to enter their bodies was an action of courting death.
But Ling Han... he was clearly a living being, so how could he possibly absorb the Regulation of Death?
This was practically, practically...!
All the Great Emperors wanted to curse.
How could such a monster appear?
The Great Emperor Jingtian felt even more inferior.
He had only grasped a nine-star Regulation, but what about Ling Han?
Ten flashes!
—Though there were only two that were complete.
No wonder he had been suppressed.
This was because he was overwhelmed in terms of the number of Regulations.
But it was all right.
As long as he was given enough time, he would similarly be able to grasp all the Nine Star Regulations.
Even if he was still inferior to Ling Han, the gap would be very, very small.
"Charge!" he roared loudly, and was the first to charge out.
—The new Emperor was actually playing the role of the vanguard in killing Ling Han.
This was really an incomparably ironic matter.
Ling Han’s eyes finally lit up with killing intent.
He was quite tolerant of Great Emperor Jingtian.
Although Pu Jingtian definitely wouldn’t admit this, Ling Han believed that this was a Great Emperor that he had nurtured.
Thus, he treasured his talent.
Unfortunately, Pu Jingtian had courted death.

chapters.title: Chapter 4862: War of Great Emperors
paragraphs: Ling Han dashed toward the Great Emperor Jingtian.
This time, he didn’t hold back anymore. As he threw a punch, a terrifying power surged, and his killing intent was already surging.
"Humph!" The Lords of Death naturally wouldn’t sit by and watch. They all moved to intercept Ling Han.
"Scram!" Ling Han shouted lightly, his other hand throwing heavy punches. Peng, peng, peng! The Lords of Death instantly turned into straws, scattering madly in the galaxy.
With his present battle prowess that was infinitesimally close to the fourth tier, how could mere seventh tier Emperor Tier battle prowess match him?
One-on-one wasn’t enough, and even if the 12 of them teamed up, it wouldn’t be enough either.
The gap was really too wide.
Just like in the Primitive Abyss, the Great Emperors had joined forces, but could only detain the old Divine Beast, and were not qualified to stop him at all.
Wasn’t there only a difference of two tiers as well?
Ling Han was practically unaffected. He had already rushed right in front of the Great Emperor Jingtian, and his iron fists continued to pummel him.
Peng!
The Great Emperor Jingtian blocked the attack, yet he was instantly sent flying by the devastating power of the attack.
My gods!
Seeing this scene, everyone was numb with shock.
This, this, this, one against thirteen, they were all Great Emperors.
Just how powerful was Ling Han?
Everyone looked towards the Great Emperor Jingtian again, their eyes filled with sympathy.
If, if Great Emperor Jingtian had decided to be slightly more forceful, and if he hadn’t chosen to compromise, then he should have teamed up with Ling Han to fight against the Lords of Death.
With how powerful Ling Han was, perhaps they could pacify the darkness with this battle.
Then, as one of the two main forces, the Great Emperor Jingtian could similarly be known for all eternity, and his name would never be destroyed!
Now, however... er, it was extremely likely that he would become a footnote, a negative example, and be nailed onto the pillar of shame in history.
This was a wrong decision made in a moment of weakness with serious consequences.
"Brat!" the Black Sunflower Demon Emperor roared in fury. Boom! He was the first to recover, and Demonic Qi instantly surged into the surroundings.
At this moment, he was at the peak stage of Emperor Tier.
Of course, this was the pinnacle of the outside world. In fact, this was the pinnacle of the fifth tier.
This Demon Emperor rode over with supreme might, and a massive Black Sunflower bloomed behind him, wrapping around Ling Han.
This black sunflower was too big, and "swallowed" Ling Han in a single move.
Hiss, a Great Emperor at his prime was so terrifying.
Everyone was dazzled.
Ling Han died just like that?
He was beaten to death the moment he flipped out?

This guy must be too proud. Previously, he had been incomparably domineering, causing him to misjudge his own strength. He thought that after recovering his battle prowess, the Lord of Death was only so-so, and that was why he had been easily killed.
All the Imperial Clans looked extremely dejected. Now that Ling Han was dead, how was the darkness going to be pacified?
Relying on the Great Emperor Jingtian?
This result was something that even the Lords of Death and the others hadn’t foreseen. They had already prepared many counterattacks, yet none of them had been used.
"Not good!" Right at this moment, they heard the Black Sunflower Demon Emperor exclaim in shock.
Peng!

In the galaxy, that Demonic Sunflower suddenly exploded, and endless waves of energy surged out in all directions. And in the same spot, Ling Han stood proudly in midair. He was clearly the height of an ordinary person, yet gave off the feeling of an indomitable spirit.
’He’s not dead!’
Instantly, all the Imperial Clans breathed a sigh of relief.
However, all the Lords of Death frowned.

They naturally knew just how terrifying this strike from the Black Sunflower Demon Emperor was. However, Ling Han was completely unscathed even though he had taken it head-on. This showed just how terrifying his strength was.
However, the Black Sunflower Demon Emperor was clearly at the peak stage of the Emperor Tier, so how could Ling Han remain unscathed after taking this attack head-on?
Though he had grasped ten Regulations, there were clearly only two that had reached the complete state.
Thus, they could not accept this at all.
"Die!" Great Emperor Senluo attacked. With a wave of his hand, endless black clouds moved, turning into a massive palm that was entwined with Nine Stars Regulations.
At this moment, he also recovered all of his battle prowess.
Peng!
However, Ling Han merely threw a punch, and this large hand was shattered.
"Impossible! Impossible!" All the Lords of Death murmured, completely unable to believe this.

They were all at the peak stage of the Emperor Tier. Unless they obtained the great opportunity that had arisen from the clash between the two Realms, there was no way for them to advance any further.
Then how were they supposed to suppress this freak?
Being able to become Emperors, who would be weaker than the other? Why was the gap between them so wide?
This caused these Great Emperors to start doubting their own lives. They were really unable to accept the stark difference in battle prowess.

Ling Han charged over. He suddenly took a deep breath, and his figure instantly enlarged endlessly. Then, he threw a punch. His fist was countless times larger than the sun. With this strike, the Lords of Death were completely enshrouded.
He was too powerful!
Left with no choice, all the Lords of Death were forced to enter their strongest states to disperse this terrifying attack.
Peng!
Finally, the Lords of Death joined forces and blocked Ling Han’s attack. In fact, they even had a slight advantage.
However, this result caused the Lords of Death and the others to pale in shock, and even despair.
This!

Though they did indeed have the upper hand, it was only a slight upper hand. They did not have an overwhelming advantage at all, and how long could they maintain this kind of battle prowess in front of Ling Han?
After all, they could no longer be considered true Great Emperors.
Why was it like this?
None of them could accept this.
Ling Han didn’t care. This was a path that they themselves had chosen, and since the Lords of Death had embarked on this path, there was no turning back. They could only go all the way to the end.
’Die!’
Ling Han unleashed his full battle prowess, Destructive Energy and light of great dao channeled at the same time. This was a terrifying destructive power that surpassed fifth tier.
The Lords of Death and the others couldn’t resist at all, and they all dodged.
"It’s this energy again!" Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperor exclaimed through gritted teeth.
Fire Clouds nodded, and said, "Xuan Taiyu also mastered this energy in the past, causing great trouble for us!"

Otherwise, Xuan Taiyu hadn’t actually ascended Dao for too long. At most, he had only grasped five to six nine-star Regulations. However, because of Destructive Energy, they were forced to unleash their full power, and just barely managed to destroy his dao foundations.
And in Ling Han’s hands, this kind of energy was even more terrifying.
Meanwhile, the Great Emperor Jingtian’s expression was ashen.
As it turned out, the gap between him and Ling Han was actually as wide as this.
Was this really a Great Emperor that had just attained Dao, and had not come from the Timestream?
Even if he had reached peak stage Emperor Tier, what right did he have to resist?
There was none!
An Emperor was invincible in the world and filled with confidence, but now, the Great Emperor Jingtian’s Dao Heart was unstable, and he had lost his confidence in being invincible.
"Ah!" The Four Directions Great Emperor let out a roar, and charged over with the Eternal Dragon Hammer.
"A contest of Imperial Weapon?" Ling Han smiled faintly, and unleashed the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower.
Peng!
The Transcendent Weapon unleashed its might, and without even needing Ling Han to command it, it easily blocked the Eternal Dragon Hammer.
This stunned the Lords of Death and the others again. Because there was no Great Emperor channeling the Imperial Weapon, that was the weakest level of power in Emperor Tier.
And now, the weakest Emperor Tier power had actually withstood an attack from the Four Directions Great Emperor?
Heavens, why was everything that had any relation to Ling Han so illogically powerful?

chapters.title: Chapter 4863: Heavenly Emperor Han
paragraphs: Ling Han held the Transcendent Weapon in his hand, and he used it like a heavy weapon as he swung it at the Lords of Death.

It should be known that the Great Emperor wielding the Imperial Weapon, could allow the Imperial Weapon to burst out with battle prowess that surpassed its own abilities. Then, how terrifying would the combination of Ling Han and the Transcendent Weapon be?
Peng!
With a single strike, the Lords of Death couldn’t block it even if they joined forces, and were forced to retreat.

—Ling Han possessed battle prowess that was infinitesimally close to fourth tier, and the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower was the same. In fact, it itself could unleash the might of fourth tier, but it could only be once every ten days.
This kind of powerful alliance could really be called fourth tier battle prowess.

Ling Han was like a tiger that had entered a flock of sheep. The Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower was brandished, unleashing a barrage of blazing white lightning. Coupled with the Destructive Energy, no one could resist Ling Han at all. The Lords of Death could only be blasted here and there.
This caused the Lords of Death and the others to feel despair. They were no match for him!
They couldn’t even defeat Ling Han now, so when they exited their strongest state, how would they resist Ling Han?
Let’s go!
The Great Emperors exchanged a glance before turning around to flee at the same time.
Saints were difficult to kill, because as long as the Saint wanted to flee, it would be very difficult for the other Saint, or even a group of Saints to catch up to him, what more surround him.
Even Saints were like this, what more Great Emperors. Only one could appear in each era.
The Lords of Death fled in different directions, not fighting at all.
Heavens!
On the Mysterious Spirit Planet, when they saw this scene, all the members of the Imperial Clans were so excited that they were on the verge of tears.
The Lords of Death had been chased off!
After teaming up and recovering to their strongest state, they were still chased off.
This was an undisputed great victory!
Though the Lords of Death hadn’t died yet, everyone knew that pacifying the darkness was not just empty words. It was about to be realized.
"Ling Han!"
"Great Emperor Ling Han!"
"He has surpassed all previous Great Emperors, and can be called Heavenly Emperor!"
"That’s right, Heavenly Emperor Han!"
"Heavenly Emperor Han! Heavenly Emperor Han!"
Everyone raised their arms and cheered loudly, cheering Ling Han on.
Lin Dong and Li Dangping also wanted to flee. However, Ding Shu, Shui Qingchang, and Jing Haoran all walked over and surrounded them.
"Why are you in such a rush to leave?"
Ling Han did not pursue, but rather stared at Pu Jingtian.

The Lords of Death were no longer a problem. Their power decreased with each use. Of course, on the other hand, it was also because these Lords of Death ran fast enough and went in separate directions. At most, he would only be able to stop one of them.
In comparison, Ling Han felt that Pu Jingtian was even more detestable.
The Lords of Death were already on the opposite side to begin with, so it was only natural that they were hostile. However, Pu Jingtian was far too disappointing.
Pu Jingtian felt as if he was being watched by a Primordial Beast, and he didn’t dare to make any sudden movements. Otherwise, he would definitely be struck at the speed and power of lightning.
This kind of understanding made him feel very sullen.
He was the Great Emperor, an existence that was unparalleled in this era.
Why?
Why had the heavens allowed him to attain Dao in this era? In the end, he encountered a freak like Ling Han, which caused him to lose all his confidence, and be completely battered.
"Commit suicide," Ling Han said calmly. "To save your last bit of face."
"Haha!" Pu Jingtian chuckled coldly, and said, "I’m the Great Emperor, approved by heaven and earth. You dare to make me commit suicide?"
"Then you can only die with shame!" Ling Han didn’t waste any words, and shot forwards like an arrow, brandishing his fists in a punch.
Peng!
Pu Jingtian parried, but he couldn’t block it at all. He was sent flying by Ling Han’s punch, and bounced through the galaxy, hundreds of times faster than even a streak of light.
However, Ling Han merely flapped his flaming wings, and he caught up to him, throwing another punch.
Peng! Peng! Peng!
Pu Jingtian became a punching bag again, and was thrashed by Ling Han.
However, this time, Ling Han continued to push Pu Jingtian farther and farther away. No one could see him anymore.
Chase after them to watch?
What a joke. Even if it was a Pseudo-Emperor, how could they possibly catch up to Great Emperors?
After a while, everyone suddenly discovered that a rain of blood had begun to fall from the skies. An indescribable grief overflowed their bodies, causing everyone to involuntarily shed tears.
There was no need for anyone to tell them. Everyone knew that the Great Emperor had died.
The Emperor had died, and the heavens grieved.
In just a short while, Ling Han had killed a Great Emperor!
Powerful, this was truly unreasonably powerful.
Meanwhile, it was as if doomsday had arrived for the people of Mysterious Spirit Planet. This was originally a celebration for their Great Emperor, yet what had happened?
On the day of the celebration, the Great Emperor died.
Such a strange thing had never happened before, and it was definitely impossible that it would happen again in the future.
Shua, the great path of black and white spread out, and Ling Han had already advanced towards them in a single step.
"Greetings, Heavenly Emperor Han!" Everyone half-knelt, including the Saints from the Imperial Clans.
In front of the Great Emperor, even the Saints of the Imperial Clans were mere ants, what more when Ling Han was still an existence that could kill a Great Emperor.
Ling Han raised his hand, indicating for everyone to stand up.
What he disliked the most was this kind of red tape.
Though Wu Xingtong, Yang Yihuan and the others were all Pseudo-Emperors, they were all trembling at this moment.

This young man that they had once looked down on had now grown to a level that even they could only look up to. With his own strength, he had sent their fathers fleeing, so strong that words could not describe him.
Why were they born in this era?
Couldn’t they simply avoid this freak?
Ling Han smiled faintly and said, "We’re on different sides, so there’s nothing much to say. You guys can commit suicide."
’Commit suicide?’
Yang Yihuan and the others were all defiant. They were the sons of Great Emperors, and now that they had cultivated to the level of Pseudo-Emperor, they were to commit suicide?
They still wanted to follow their fathers and create greater glory together, so how could they be willing?
Ling Han shook his head, and swiped with his hand.
Pa, pa, pa, pa! Yang Yihuan and the others exploded, turning into a rain of blood.
This was the might of a Great Emperor. In front of him, Pseudo-Emperor was practically trash.
Everyone couldn’t help but feel even more reverence, and lowered their heads even further.
Ling Han tapped a finger at the galaxy again. Pa, the Natural-born Gold Spirit that was still fighting intensely with the rock golem immediately exploded. So what if it was so far away?
Right now, Ling Han wanted to kill, so even if there was a galaxy separating them, he could still kill a Pseudo-Emperor with a single thought.
The rock golem rubbed its head with a dumbfounded expression. "..."
"Let us proclaim ’Invincible’ three times for the sake of the new Heavenly Emperor!" someone boot-licked loudly.
"Invincible!"
"Invincible!"
"Invincible!"
No one shouted ’long live’. Wasn’t this cursing that Ling Han could only live for 10,000 <anno data-annotation-id="6f83ce25-bbc0-4856-a27b-86d7b169f4a5" data-title="years">years1</anno>?
The people of Mysterious Spirit Planet wanted to cry but had no tears. This was the celebration of their new Emperor, so why had Ling Han become the main lead instead?
They had worked so hard, yet it was all for the benefit of another?
However, how could they dare to say no? They had to pretend to be elated.

"This guy, he’s obviously so powerful, yet he still wants to hide it from me. He really doesn’t let me rest easy!" Chi Taiming scolded jokingly. Although he was scolding, the expression on his face was really extremely proud.
That’s right. They had not managed to become a clan with two Emperors either, yet had taken in an invincible Great Emperor as their son-in-law. Merely this fact was impressive enough.
See, he was deliberately scolding, as if he was reminding the surrounding Imperial Clans that he was Ling Han’s in-law!
Do you all dare to scold?
<annotations style="display: none;">In Chinese, ’Long live’ is literally ’10,000 years’.</annotations>

The Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower was brandished, unleashing a barrage of blazing white lightning.
Coupled with the Destructive Energy, no one could resist Ling Han at all.
The Lords of Death could only be blasted here and there.
This caused the Lords of Death and the others to feel despair.
They were no match for him!
They couldn’t even defeat Ling Han now, so when they exited their strongest state, how would they resist Ling Han?
Let’s go!
The Great Emperors exchanged a glance before turning around to flee at the same time.
Saints were difficult to kill, because as long as the Saint wanted to flee, it would be very difficult for the other Saint, or even a group of Saints to catch up to him, what more surround him.
Even Saints were like this, what more Great Emperors.
Only one could appear in each era.
The Lords of Death fled in different directions, not fighting at all.
Heavens!
On the Mysterious Spirit Planet, when they saw this scene, all the members of the Imperial Clans were so excited that they were on the verge of tears.
The Lords of Death had been chased off!
After teaming up and recovering to their strongest state, they were still chased off.
This was an undisputed great victory!
Though the Lords of Death hadn’t died yet, everyone knew that pacifying the darkness was not just empty words.
It was about to be realized.
"Ling Han!"
"Great Emperor Ling Han!"
"He has surpassed all previous Great Emperors, and can be called Heavenly Emperor!"
"That’s right, Heavenly Emperor Han!"
"Heavenly Emperor Han!
Heavenly Emperor Han!"
Everyone raised their arms and cheered loudly, cheering Ling Han on.
Lin Dong and Li Dangping also wanted to flee.
However, Ding Shu, Shui Qingchang, and Jing Haoran all walked over and surrounded them.
"Why are you in such a rush to leave?"
Ling Han did not pursue, but rather stared at Pu Jingtian.
The Lords of Death were no longer a problem.
Their power decreased with each use.
Of course, on the other hand, it was also because these Lords of Death ran fast enough and went in separate directions.
At most, he would only be able to stop one of them.
In comparison, Ling Han felt that Pu Jingtian was even more detestable.
The Lords of Death were already on the opposite side to begin with, so it was only natural that they were hostile.
However, Pu Jingtian was far too disappointing.
Pu Jingtian felt as if he was being watched by a Primordial Beast, and he didn’t dare to make any sudden movements.
Otherwise, he would definitely be struck at the speed and power of lightning.
This kind of understanding made him feel very sullen.
He was the Great Emperor, an existence that was unparalleled in this era.
Why?
Why had the heavens allowed him to attain Dao in this era?
In the end, he encountered a freak like Ling Han, which caused him to lose all his confidence, and be completely battered.
"Commit suicide," Ling Han said calmly.
"To save your last bit of face."
"Haha!" Pu Jingtian chuckled coldly, and said, "I’m the Great Emperor, approved by heaven and earth.
You dare to make me commit suicide?"
"Then you can only die with shame!" Ling Han didn’t waste any words, and shot forwards like an arrow, brandishing his fists in a punch.
Peng!
Pu Jingtian parried, but he couldn’t block it at all.
He was sent flying by Ling Han’s punch, and bounced through the galaxy, hundreds of times faster than even a streak of light.
However, Ling Han merely flapped his flaming wings, and he caught up to him, throwing another punch.
Peng!
Peng!
Peng!
Pu Jingtian became a punching bag again, and was thrashed by Ling Han.
However, this time, Ling Han continued to push Pu Jingtian farther and farther away.
No one could see him anymore.
Chase after them to watch?
What a joke.
Even if it was a Pseudo-Emperor, how could they possibly catch up to Great Emperors?
After a while, everyone suddenly discovered that a rain of blood had begun to fall from the skies.
An indescribable grief overflowed their bodies, causing everyone to involuntarily shed tears.
There was no need for anyone to tell them.
Everyone knew that the Great Emperor had died.
The Emperor had died, and the heavens grieved.
In just a short while, Ling Han had killed a Great Emperor!
Powerful, this was truly unreasonably powerful.
Meanwhile, it was as if doomsday had arrived for the people of Mysterious Spirit Planet.
This was originally a celebration for their Great Emperor, yet what had happened?
On the day of the celebration, the Great Emperor died.
Such a strange thing had never happened before, and it was definitely impossible that it would happen again in the future.
Shua, the great path of black and white spread out, and Ling Han had already advanced towards them in a single step.
"Greetings, Heavenly Emperor Han!" Everyone half-knelt, including the Saints from the Imperial Clans.
In front of the Great Emperor, even the Saints of the Imperial Clans were mere ants, what more when Ling Han was still an existence that could kill a Great Emperor.
Ling Han raised his hand, indicating for everyone to stand up.
What he disliked the most was this kind of red tape.
Though Wu Xingtong, Yang Yihuan and the others were all Pseudo-Emperors, they were all trembling at this moment.
This young man that they had once looked down on had now grown to a level that even they could only look up to.
With his own strength, he had sent their fathers fleeing, so strong that words could not describe him.
Why were they born in this era?
Couldn’t they simply avoid this freak?
Ling Han smiled faintly and said, "We’re on different sides, so there’s nothing much to say.
You guys can commit suicide."
’Commit suicide?’
Yang Yihuan and the others were all defiant.
They were the sons of Great Emperors, and now that they had cultivated to the level of Pseudo-Emperor, they were to commit suicide?
They still wanted to follow their fathers and create greater glory together, so how could they be willing?
Ling Han shook his head, and swiped with his hand.
Pa, pa, pa, pa!
Yang Yihuan and the others exploded, turning into a rain of blood.
This was the might of a Great Emperor.
In front of him, Pseudo-Emperor was practically trash.
Everyone couldn’t help but feel even more reverence, and lowered their heads even further.
Ling Han tapped a finger at the galaxy again.
Pa, the Natural-born Gold Spirit that was still fighting intensely with the rock golem immediately exploded.
So what if it was so far away?
Right now, Ling Han wanted to kill, so even if there was a galaxy separating them, he could still kill a Pseudo-Emperor with a single thought.
The rock golem rubbed its head with a dumbfounded expression.
"Let us proclaim ’Invincible’ three times for the sake of the new Heavenly Emperor!" someone boot-licked loudly.
"Invincible!"
"Invincible!"
"Invincible!"
No one shouted ’long live’.
Wasn’t this cursing that Ling Han could only live for 10,000 <anno data-annotation-id="6f83ce25-bbc0-4856-a27b-86d7b169f4a5" data-title="years">years1</anno>?
The people of Mysterious Spirit Planet wanted to cry but had no tears.
This was the celebration of their new Emperor, so why had Ling Han become the main lead instead?
They had worked so hard, yet it was all for the benefit of another?
However, how could they dare to say no?
They had to pretend to be elated.
"This guy, he’s obviously so powerful, yet he still wants to hide it from me.
He really doesn’t let me rest easy!" Chi Taiming scolded jokingly.
Although he was scolding, the expression on his face was really extremely proud.
That’s right.
They had not managed to become a clan with two Emperors either, yet had taken in an invincible Great Emperor as their son-in-law.
Merely this fact was impressive enough.
See, he was deliberately scolding, as if he was reminding the surrounding Imperial Clans that he was Ling Han’s in-law!
Do you all dare to scold?
<annotations style="display: none;">In Chinese, ’Long live’ is literally ’10,000 years’.</annotations>

chapters.title: Chapter 4864: Start of Collapse
paragraphs: Ling Han was completely uninterested.

In the past, he had been filled with anticipation for the Great Emperor Jingtian. He had promised him that they would fight side by side, but in the end, the latter had betrayed him without the slightest hesitation.
He was very displeased.
Ling Han nodded at the empress and the others. They set out and left, returning to Four Origin Planet.
Ling Han made some arrangements, then began to search for the Lords of Death.
However, after searching for a very, very long time, he still couldn’t find the whereabouts of the Lords of Death. It was as if they had disappeared from the face of the universe.
Unless!
With a thought, Ling Han arrived at the Primitive Abyss.
He entered, searching for any clues, and then confirmed it.
The Lords of Death had entered this place.

Previously, the Lords of Death were definitely curious about the changes in the Primitive Abyss. At least, they would have felt it was strange that the thirty-six Divine Beasts had appeared for no reason. However, because they still had their own goals, they did not have the time to come here to take a look.
However, things were different now.
They definitely couldn’t stay outside; how could Ling Han spare them?
Moreover, with Ling Han around, their plan definitely wouldn’t succeed.
Thus, they chose to enter the Primitive Abyss.
With how smart a Great Emperor was, how could it be that they wouldn’t be able to guess that the reason why Ling Han was so powerful was because it had something to do with the Primitive Abyss?
Since ancient times, among Great Emperors, who would lose to the other?
Thus, the Lords of Death placed their hopes on the Primitive Abyss, wanting to become even stronger.
Of course, they weren’t confident at all. This was a gamble. If they failed, their life force would be exhausted, and they would die in the abyss.
After all, the Primitive Abyss was full of dangers, and even if they entered at their peak, it was still possible that they would die.
The advantage now was that there were 12 of them.
A team of 12 Great Emperors charging into the Primitive Abyss was something that had never happened before.
Ling Han wasn’t in a hurry to give chase. He had to first deal with the hidden dangers outside.
He entered into the territory ruled by the Lords of Death, and began to recover the lost territory, star by star.
This time, there were no more Lords of Death making a comeback.
Ling Han, Ding Shu, Jing Haoran and Shui Qingchang all attacked, reviving the Living Realm and expelling evil.
More than a hundred years later, the entire Living Realm had already returned to how it had once been. Of course, the number of living creatures was still too far from what had once been.

It didn’t matter. Ling Han and the others were all Genesis World’s rulers, and there were a large number of living beings in the dimensions that could fill in the empty spaces, rapidly replenishing this world.
It was as if there was an invisible hand controlling the heaven and earth, maintaining the balance of this world.
Ling Han arrived at the edge of the Primitive Abyss. He observed the nine-star Regulations outside, and then comprehended them in the Primitive Abyss, saving as much time as he could.
He wanted to cultivate the Nine Star Regulations to consummate level outside, and once his cultivation level was complete, he would go to the Imperial Island to further improve his cultivation level.
On the other hand, he was also standing guard here to prevent the Lords of Death from suddenly coming out and causing trouble.
Of course, this possibility was very small.

More than a hundred years had passed in the outside world, and over ten thousand years had passed in the Primitive Abyss. He was sure that those Lords of Death would have already arrived at the Imperial Island — if they hadn’t, they would definitely have died on their way there.
It was best if they had died on their jouney there, to avoid any side issues.
Everyone was making the best use of their time to cultivate, because after Ling Han entered the Primitive Abyss again, he would be staying inside for a very, very long time.
Thus, everyone wanted to become a Pseudo-Emperor, and take that last step on the Imperial Island.
As it turned out, everyone could become Emperor, and the majestic scene of the many Divine Beasts of the ancient era would reappear.
In theory, that was indeed the case, but in truth... how could it be so easy to become a Pseudo-Emperor?
Difficult, as difficult as ascending the heavens.

For example, the empress, Hu Niu, and the others. After arriving at the level of Nine-Star Saint, their cultivation level had stagnated. No matter what, they were unable to awaken their bodies, and step into Pseudo-Emperor Tier.
Not only them, but even the large black dog, the little azure dragon, and Brother Monkey were the same.

For more than a hundred years, only Ding Shu and the other Genesis World’s rulers were Pseudo-Emperors. Furthermore, they improved very quickly. They would occasionally enter into the Primitive Abyss to comprehend, and were getting closer and closer to the level of Nine Star Pseudo-Emperor.
Ling Han also frowned. Was it so difficult to become a Pseudo-Emperor?
However, Lu Xun, Yang Yihuan, and the others were only the sons of Great Emperors, so how could they all become Pseudo-Emperors?
Had they obtained some kind of treasure?
While Ling Han was cultivating, he also began to ponder.

On the Imperial Island, one’s lifespan was unlimited. Thus, Ling Han had to think of a way. Otherwise, in at most a million years, the empress and the others would die from having their lifespans exhausted.
This was something that he could not accept.
As a Great Emperor, could it be that he was destined to endure loneliness and solitude?
Another 600 years later, a boom suddenly rang out in the galaxy, and the whole firmament was trembling.
Ling Han was sitting at the entrance to the Primitive Abyss. He immediately stood up and looked into the distance.
The Primitive Abyss was indeed at the edge of the universe. However, this wasn’t the absolute end; it was a bit further ahead.
That was because the universe was constantly expanding outwards, and the Primitive Abyss was also slowly moving outwards.
However, at this moment, this expansion suddenly stopped.
The collapse of the universe was about to begin.
Ling Han could clearly see that the edges of the universe were no longer extending outwards, but had rather stopped. That massive boom previously was precisely the movement that had stopped here.
For who knew how many years, the universe had been slowly expanding, as if there would never be an end to it.
But now, the expansion had ended, and the collapse was about to begin.

In just a short while, Ling Han saw that the edge of the universe was beginning to shrink back at a slow speed. Just like how this heaven and earth had spent hundreds of billions of years to reach this step, even if it ultimately had to retreat to a point, it would still need a long time.
’Hmm?’
Ling Han was astonished. He saw that as heaven and earth shrank, the Regulations were also being compressed.
These Regulations were preventing the heaven and earth from shrinking, but Regulations were only manifestations of heaven and earth, so how could they possibly resist this kind of great power?
Peng! Peng! Peng!
The Regulations had shattered, and were incredibly fragile.
However, after the Regulations shattered, they reformed and continued to resist, repeating the same cycle.
The Regulations existed to balance the heaven and earth, and stabilize the heaven and earth. Thus, now that the heaven and earth was shrinking, the Regulations would bear the brunt.

Ling Han was pleasantly surprised to discover that the Regulations were destroying and condensing in front of him like this. It was like they were showing him the core secrets, and it was done over and over again, as if they were afraid that he would not be able to see or understand them.
In this way, the time for him to fully grasp the Nine Stars Regulations would be greatly shortened.
Unfortunately, only he could enjoy this kind of benefit. Even Pseudo-Emperors could not. They could only observe the Nine Star Regulations at the moment their bodies were reviving.
Ling Han’s strength began to rapidly increase. His grasp of Regulations improved by leaps and bounds.
Three hundred years later, Ling Han had more or less mastered the Nine Star Regulations. At most, in another ten years, he would be able to reach consummate level.
Now, his battle prowess had definitely advanced into the fourth tier.
And on the matter of the empress and the others, he had also come up with an idea, but whether it could be realized or not, he would only know after trying.
