chapters.title: Chapter 4865: Creating Pseudo-Emperors
paragraphs: "Old Black, do you want to become a Pseudo-Emperor?" Ling Han asked the large black dog.
"Of course!" the large black dog blurted out. However, a guarded expression immediately appeared on his face, and he said, "Little Han, you definitely didn’t hide any good medicine!"
Tsk!
Ling Han smiled, "Look at what you’re saying. Am I that kind of person?"
"Don’t you think about how many years we’ve known each other? With a turn of your eyes, Grandpa Dog will know what you’re pulling—"
"Stop, stop, stop!"

Ling Han hurriedly pressed down on the large black dog, "I have thought of a method that may allow you to advance into the level of Pseudo-Emperor, but because you are the first, I do not have much confidence."

"F***, are you treating Grandpa Dog like a lab rat?" The large black dog immediately spat. He turned around and ran, "Grandpa Dog will help you find an experimental subject. When you succeed, you can do it on Grandpa Dog."
It ran off happily, and soon found the little azure dragon.
"Four-Legged Snake, do you want to become a Pseudo-Emperor?" the large black dog asked with a smile.
"Get lost!" The little azure dragon was in seclusion, and ignored him completely.

"Really, Grandpa Dog and Little Han have thought of a way that can help you break through to the level of Pseudo-Emperor." The large black dog also mentioned Ling Han, because he knew that if it was only him, the little azure dragon would definitely not believe him.

"You’re a Saint yourself, yet you didn’t try it out. Thus, this must be a method that Little Han Han just came up with. You’re afraid of death and pain, so you’ve come to look for Grandpa Dragon." The little azure dragon scoffed, and said, "How can you fool Grandpa Dragon with your little tricks?"
F***, was it that obvious?
The large black dog rubbed his nose. The little azure dragon was too familiar with it, so it wasn’t easy to deceive it.
"Let’s go, we’ll trick others."
"All right."
The two depraved characters ran out side by side just like that, looking for other lab rats.
However, the two of them were too notorious, especially the large black dog. That was the number one despicable Saint in the world. Who would dare believe the words of a despicable dog?
When Ling Han found out, he shook his head and broke into laughter.
He also sent out a notice, saying that he was thinking of a way to help a Saint advance into the level of Pseudo-Emperor, and needed an experimental subject.
When the news spread out, all the Imperial Clans were in an uproar.
Becoming Emperor!

Though it was only becoming a Pseudo-Pseudo-Emperor, everyone knew that as long as one had become a Pseudo-Emperor, there was a slight chance that he could become a real Great Emperor in the Primitive Abyss.
This temptation was too great.
As long as one was a cultivator, who didn’t want to become Emperor?
Just like how a soldier that didn’t want to become a general wasn’t a good soldier, cultivators who didn’t want to become a Great Emperor also didn’t have any ambitions.
Ling Han only wanted one person.
This caused all the Imperial Clans to fight tooth and nail for it.
If Ling Han succeeded, how could it be that he would do a great deed, and help every Saint become a Pseudo-Emperor?
Impossible!
This kind of "technique", or "secret technique", was too crucial. Ling Han would only do this experiment once, at most. In future, he would definitely only use it on his own people.
Thus, if outsiders wanted to become Pseudo-Emperors, or even Great Emperors, they had to take this gamble.

The senior Saints from the various clans all ran over. Though Ling Han had asked for a nine-star Saint, there were still a considerable number of eight-star Saints and even seven-star Saints that had arrived, wanting to test their luck.

Ling Han chose the best. Not only did he have to be a nine-star Saint, but his life force had to be as vigorous as possible. Otherwise, it was extremely likely that his life force would be exhausted when he broke through to the next cultivation level, and he would directly die.
Finally, the Heavenly Sorrow Imperial Clan’s old Saint, Lian Haiyun, was chosen.

Ling Han brought him to a desolate planet in the distance. Whether it was a success or a failure, the shockwave from breaking through to Pseudo-Emperor was too great, and could easily destroy a galaxy.
Ling Han first had Lian Haiyun make proper adjustments, whether it was in terms of physical condition or psychological condition.
Ten days later, he began.

According to Ling Han’s line of thought, the cultivation of Pseudo-Emperor was a process of reviving one’s body from Silent Destruction Tier, and in Ling Han’s case, he had grasped the essence of life, so could he use it to help the Saint complete this step?

The Regulations of Life could not do so, because the Nine-Star Saint was already very close to the highest level Regulations. However, the essence of life was superior, and was the source of all life and matter. In fact, even a Great Emperor could be revived.
Thus, Ling Han was still quite confident.
However, he hadn’t tried it before, after all, so he didn’t dare to use the empress and the others as an "experiment".
He tapped out a finger, and pressed it on Lian Haiyun’s back. He first explored the latter’s body.

Since he wanted to revive his body, he had to first find out how Lian Haiyun had gradually experienced Silent Destruction. Otherwise, if he acted recklessly, reviving two or even in fact three regions at once, how could he possibly succeed?

After a while, Ling Han finally understood the situation. Lian Haiyun’s body had been divided into nine parts, and it was precisely these parts of Lian Haiyun’s body that experienced Silent Destruction.

The sequence of revival need not be the same as the sequence of the Silent Destruction. Thus, Ling Han did not ask Lian Haiyun how he had progressed step by step. He stimulated the essence of life, and began to revive the latter’s body.
It was naturally impossible to succeed in a single attempt. In fact, Ling Han didn’t even know if he could succeed in reality. That was why he needed to experiment.
Once, twice, thrice, ten days, a hundred days, a thousand days.

Time passed very quickly. Ling Han tried many, many times, and Lian Haiyun was endlessly baring his teeth. In the process of this kind of experiment, he was continuously being adjusted by Ling Han’s power. That was definitely not a wonderful experience.
And there was not the slightest sign of improvement even after so long, which caused him to begin to doubt.
—Are you f playing around with me on purpose?
Yet Ling Han’s mind seemed to be wandering. Though he was still trying time and time again, his main focus was on his comprehension of the fundamentals of life.
Using it in this manner, he discovered that his understanding of the fundamentals of life was deepening.
"Let’s go."
Ling Han grabbed Lian Haiyun and entered the Primitive Abyss.
Time passed quickly here. If he wanted to appreciate something, he naturally had to come here.
Though Lian Haiyun was a Nine-Star Saint, he could not bear the gravity here at all. Thankfully, Ling Han had already put the Silver Battle Armor on him, which naturally could ensure his safety.
Ling Han continued to make attempts, summarizing his experiences in the midst of failure.
His grasp of the essence of life improved by leaps and bounds.
30,000 years later, Ling Han breathed a long sigh of relief. He had finally made a breakthrough.

Actually, he had spent more of these 30,000 years cultivating. By now, he had more or less cultivated the fourth tier to consummate level, which was comparable to the Battle Saint Emperor and other Great Emperors of the past eras.
But on the sidelines, Lian Haiyun was about to cry.
He was an old Saint, and he was truly very old. His remaining lifespan was only around 50,000 years, and he had wasted 30,000 years here. He really wanted to cry himself to death.
However, in front of Ling Han, would he dare to complain?
Complain to the Great Emperor?
Hehe.
Right at this moment, Ling Han pointed at him again, saying, "Concentrate and calm your mind. Follow my will!"
Boom, an indescribably powerful vitality surged into his body. Lian Haiyun was shocked to discover that his body that had experienced Silent Destruction was also exuding slivers of vitality.
Heavens! Heavens! Heavens!

"Of course!" the large black dog blurted out.
However, a guarded expression immediately appeared on his face, and he said, "Little Han, you definitely didn’t hide any good medicine!"
Tsk!
Ling Han smiled, "Look at what you’re saying.
Am I that kind of person?"
"Don’t you think about how many years we’ve known each other?
With a turn of your eyes, Grandpa Dog will know what you’re pulling—"
"Stop, stop, stop!"

Ling Han hurriedly pressed down on the large black dog, "I have thought of a method that may allow you to advance into the level of Pseudo-Emperor, but because you are the first, I do not have much confidence."
"F***, are you treating Grandpa Dog like a lab rat?" The large black dog immediately spat.
He turned around and ran, "Grandpa Dog will help you find an experimental subject.
When you succeed, you can do it on Grandpa Dog."
It ran off happily, and soon found the little azure dragon.
"Four-Legged Snake, do you want to become a Pseudo-Emperor?" the large black dog asked with a smile.
"Get lost!" The little azure dragon was in seclusion, and ignored him completely.

"Really, Grandpa Dog and Little Han have thought of a way that can help you break through to the level of Pseudo-Emperor." The large black dog also mentioned Ling Han, because he knew that if it was only him, the little azure dragon would definitely not believe him.
"You’re a Saint yourself, yet you didn’t try it out.
Thus, this must be a method that Little Han Han just came up with.
You’re afraid of death and pain, so you’ve come to look for Grandpa Dragon." The little azure dragon scoffed, and said, "How can you fool Grandpa Dragon with your little tricks?"
F***, was it that obvious?
The large black dog rubbed his nose.
The little azure dragon was too familiar with it, so it wasn’t easy to deceive it.
"Let’s go, we’ll trick others."
"All right."
The two depraved characters ran out side by side just like that, looking for other lab rats.
However, the two of them were too notorious, especially the large black dog.
That was the number one despicable Saint in the world.
Who would dare believe the words of a despicable dog?
When Ling Han found out, he shook his head and broke into laughter.
He also sent out a notice, saying that he was thinking of a way to help a Saint advance into the level of Pseudo-Emperor, and needed an experimental subject.
When the news spread out, all the Imperial Clans were in an uproar.
Becoming Emperor!

Though it was only becoming a Pseudo-Pseudo-Emperor, everyone knew that as long as one had become a Pseudo-Emperor, there was a slight chance that he could become a real Great Emperor in the Primitive Abyss.
This temptation was too great.
As long as one was a cultivator, who didn’t want to become Emperor?
Just like how a soldier that didn’t want to become a general wasn’t a good soldier, cultivators who didn’t want to become a Great Emperor also didn’t have any ambitions.
Ling Han only wanted one person.
This caused all the Imperial Clans to fight tooth and nail for it.
If Ling Han succeeded, how could it be that he would do a great deed, and help every Saint become a Pseudo-Emperor?
Impossible!
This kind of "technique", or "secret technique", was too crucial.
Ling Han would only do this experiment once, at most.
In future, he would definitely only use it on his own people.
Thus, if outsiders wanted to become Pseudo-Emperors, or even Great Emperors, they had to take this gamble.
The senior Saints from the various clans all ran over.
Though Ling Han had asked for a nine-star Saint, there were still a considerable number of eight-star Saints and even seven-star Saints that had arrived, wanting to test their luck.
Ling Han chose the best.
Not only did he have to be a nine-star Saint, but his life force had to be as vigorous as possible.
Otherwise, it was extremely likely that his life force would be exhausted when he broke through to the next cultivation level, and he would directly die.
Finally, the Heavenly Sorrow Imperial Clan’s old Saint, Lian Haiyun, was chosen.
Ling Han brought him to a desolate planet in the distance.
Whether it was a success or a failure, the shockwave from breaking through to Pseudo-Emperor was too great, and could easily destroy a galaxy.
Ling Han first had Lian Haiyun make proper adjustments, whether it was in terms of physical condition or psychological condition.
Ten days later, he began.

The Regulations of Life could not do so, because the Nine-Star Saint was already very close to the highest level Regulations.
However, the essence of life was superior, and was the source of all life and matter.
In fact, even a Great Emperor could be revived.
Thus, Ling Han was still quite confident.
However, he hadn’t tried it before, after all, so he didn’t dare to use the empress and the others as an "experiment".
He tapped out a finger, and pressed it on Lian Haiyun’s back.
He first explored the latter’s body.
Since he wanted to revive his body, he had to first find out how Lian Haiyun had gradually experienced Silent Destruction.
Otherwise, if he acted recklessly, reviving two or even in fact three regions at once, how could he possibly succeed?

It was naturally impossible to succeed in a single attempt.
In fact, Ling Han didn’t even know if he could succeed in reality.
That was why he needed to experiment.
Once, twice, thrice, ten days, a hundred days, a thousand days.
Time passed very quickly.

chapters.title: Chapter 4866: The Last Battlefield
paragraphs: Aside from a freak like Ling Han, whether it was breaking through or improving on the level of Pseudo-Emperor, it was the recovery of the body that would take place first, and then a response from the heaven and earth would be stimulated, so that Pseudo-Emperor could glimpse the Nine Star Regulations, and take advantage of this chance to study it a bit.

Thus, while both may be Five Star Pseudo-Emperors, some could grasp one third of a Nine Star Regulation, but others could not even grasp a sliver. Thus, the gap in battle prowess would naturally be huge.
It was also because of this that Ling Han was confident that he could help a Saint become a Pseudo-Emperor.
It was not difficult to revive one’s body with the essence of Life.

Of course, this was something that could only be done by a fourth tier Great Emperor. Furthermore, all the Great Emperors that have reached this level since ancient times had all entered into the Primitive Abyss. They had long since exhausted all their lifespans, so it was absolutely impossible for them to leave. If they left, they would definitely die.
On the other side, Saints were completely unqualified to reach the Imperial Island.
Hence, this became a problem that could not be solved.
Right until Ling Han appeared.
Hong, he turned the element of Life into the most fundamental life force, to revive Lian Haiyun’s body.
This was truly heaven-defying. It was extremely difficult to do so.
Even if Ling Han was a fourth tier Great Emperor, he could only focus his "firepower" to revive a portion of Lian Haiyun’s body at a time.
Lian Haiyun finally saw some hope. He hurriedly cooperated, and it was inevitable that he would feel excited and emotional.
"Calm down!" Ling Han shouted using the Six Characters Bright King Curse.
If he couldn’t control his emotions at this moment, he would eventually go mad.

Lian Haiyun shuddered, and hurriedly composed himself. Being able to become a Saint, he was naturally not one without self-control. It was just that he had been stuck at the Saint Tier for too long, and now that there was finally hope of breaking through to the level of Pseudo-Emperor, it was inevitable that his heart would be in turmoil.

The two of them continued. Though Ling Han still took the wrong path because of his lack of experience, and it only caused Lian Haiyun to scream repeatedly in pain, but in terms of overall progress, he was steadily advancing.
10 years, 50 years!
Weng, Lian Haiyun’s body began to glow with vitality. Even if Ling Han withdrew his fingers, this vitality was still exuberant, and showed no signs of weakening or disappearing.
Ling Han nodded. Lian Haiyun had already walked on the right path. At most, he would be able to successfully break through in a month’s time.
He watched from the sidelines. If anything happened to Lian Haiyun, he would be able to interfere in time.
Thankfully, Lian Haiyun’s vitality was only becoming more and more vigorous.
More than twenty days later, Lian Haiyun’s vitality had reached the pinnacle. Boom, all of a sudden, a shocking might burst out from his body, as if he was a Great Emperor.
He had broken through.
Pseudo-Emperor!

Lian Haiyun couldn’t help but feel extremely excited. He had finally broken through. He had been trapped in the Saint Tier for close to a million years, and he had finally broken through to Pseudo-Emperor Tier.
Not only did this allow him to possess the strength to look down on all Saints, but it also allowed his lifespan to soar to five million years.
In other words, he still had a long lifespan of four million years.
"Thank you, Heavenly Emperor Han!" He stood up and bowed respectfully.
Though Ling Han was only using him as an experiment, he had indeed broken through to Pseudo-Emperor. This was a kindness that he would never be able to repay in this lifetime.
Ling Han nodded, "Let’s go back."
He grabbed Lian Haiyun and returned to Four Origin Planet.

Strictly speaking, Lian Haiyun was not a complete Pseudo-Emperor. He had only awakened his body once, and had not grasped the slightest bit of the Nine Star Regulations — in the Primitive Abyss, there was no Nine Star Regulations for him to comprehend.
It was fine. He could still continue to awaken his body, and there was still a chance that he could see the Nine Star Regulations.
When the news of Lian Haiyun breaking through to Pseudo-Emperor broke out, the whole world was in an uproar.
Gods, Ling Han could actually help a Saint break through to Pseudo-Emperor Tier!
This was something that had never happened before.
No wonder he was qualified to be called the Heavenly Emperor. Indeed, this was an ability that no Great Emperor was equipped with.
All of a sudden, the veteran Saints were all trying their best to get close to Ling Han.

If he couldn’t get a connection with Ling Han, then he would first get a connection with the large black dog, the little azure dragon, and the others who were close to Ling Han. In short, everyone wanted to become Pseudo-Emperor, and advance further into Great Emperor Tier.
However, how could Ling Han have the time?
Just how many people were by his side?
The empress, Hu Niu, the large black dog, and the others slowly cultivated to Nine Star Saint Tier. Ling Han began to revive their bodies, so that they could break through to Pseudo-Emperor Tier.
With the experience of succeeding once, Ling Han naturally became more and more proficient.

Furthermore, because they were people close to him, Ling Han helped them to break through to Pseudo-Emperor in the outside world. They could have one more chance to observe the Nine Star Regulations, and lay the foundations for becoming an Emperor in future.
Those like the empress and the others were definitely lucky people.

Because at this time, the Regulations were resisting the collapse of heaven and earth, continuously shattering and recovering. They could glimpse the essence, and it would be ten times or even a hundred times easier to grasp.
And after a while, the universe would also adapt to this kind of change. If one wanted to see Regulations clash head-on with the collapse again, that would be a completely impossible thing.
Thus, Ling Han was also racing against time, trying as much as possible to push everyone to Pseudo-Emperor Tier in the shortest time possible.

The empress, the large black dog, Brother Monkey, and so on all became Pseudo-Emperors. Furthermore, with Ling Han’s continuous assistance, they soared high all the way, and very soon, they broke through once more into the level of Two Stars and Three Stars Pseudo-Emperor Tier.
Ling Han was very pleased. When he reached the Imperial Island again, he should be able to bring a bunch of nine-star Pseudo-Emperors with him.
When time had come to the 9400th year after the beginning of the collapse, Regulations finally stopped forcibly collapsing.
The period of benefits had ended.

Thankfully, whether it was the large black dog, the empress and the others, they had all reached the level of Nine Star Pseudo-Emperor. However, they were not freaks like Ling Han, after all. Even if the Nine Star Regulations were so clearly displayed in front of their eyes, and were still continuously playing out their essence, there was still no one that could successfully grasp a whole Nine Star Regulation.

Ding Shu, Shui Qingchang, and Jing Haoran were the exceptions. They had all grasped a complete Nine Star Regulation, and possessed the battle prowess of a Great Emperor. However, they could only be ranked in the eighth tier.
Compared to Ling Han, they were still far inferior, but compared with other Pseudo-Emperors, they had surpassed the latter countless times over.
Being nurtured from the Stone of Life, they were indeed extraordinary.
It was too bad that Origin and the others had died. Otherwise, if the seven Genesis World’s Masters joined forces, they would definitely be able to pose a huge threat to the old Divine Beast.
It was about time. It was time to leave.

Ling Han examined this universe. The Yin souls had been completely swept clean, and the passageway of the two realms had also been closed up. The greatest hidden danger, the Lords of Death, had entered into the Primitive Abyss, and had either reached the Imperial Island or died.

And as for the 36 Divine Beasts, even if they were reborn and revived, they would still be in the Primitive Abyss. Ling Han was constantly standing guard nearby, and it was impossible for anyone to escape.
All right, the external worries were settled. It was time to resolve the internal strife.
Ling Han brought all the Pseudo-Emperors and entered into the Primitive Abyss.
It could be imagined that this would be a very long journey. Without dealing with the old Divine Beast, it would be impossible for Ling Han to come out again.
—What was the point of coming out? The outside world was no longer of the slightest help to his cultivation.
Fine, let’s go!

chapters.title: Chapter 4867: Bad News
paragraphs: Ling Han began his final journey.

He entered the Primitive Abyss and took the lead. Behind him was the empress, the large black dog, Ding Shu and so on. All of them were Pseudo-Emperors, and there was no shortage of Great Emperor-level battle prowess among them.
This kind of lineup could no longer be described as luxurious. It was practically extravagant.
As they journeyed, they naturally passed by the Dragon Head City and the like.
However, there was no sign of the Divine Beast Great Emperors.
Were they all hiding somewhere, or had they not been revived?

Ling Han was unconcerned. His cultivation level was already close to the peak stage of the fourth tier. The Divine Beast Great Emperor might not be like an ant in front of him, but they really could not be considered a match for him.
They continued to advance, and there was no need for them to hide their tracks at all. They travelled openly and aboveboard.

With Ling Han’s current strength, even if he encountered certain storms of heaven and earth, he would still be able to face them head-on, fully demonstrating what it meant to be heaven-defyingly strong.
Eleven years later, they arrived at the sea of death.
The moment he arrived, Ling Han felt a sliver of enlightenment.
He had grasped the Regulations of Death, and the Sea of Death corresponded to the essence of death, so it naturally resonated with him, making him feel quite rueful.
Of course, it was impossible to comprehend the essence of Death here. Otherwise, why would the old Divine Beast abandon what was near only to seek an option that was further?

At this moment, Ling Han no longer acted arrogantly. Instead, he drew everyone into his body. Those who should wear armor would wear armor. Only Ding Shu, Jing Haoran, and Shui Qingchang were an exception, because they already had Emperor Tier battle prowess.
Ling Han headed to the Imperial Island.
After advancing into the fourth tier, his speed became slightly faster, but faced with the Sea of Death, Ling Han still did not dare to relax in the slightest.
Even if he had grasped the essence of life, the Sea of Death was capable of extinguishing this kind of vitality. If he sustained a few more blows, he would still die.
Thus, after spending seven years, he finally arrived at the Imperial Island.
After reaching the island, Ling Han let everyone out. All of a sudden, there was a sea of people.
Everyone was very curious. This was the Imperial Island, which could be considered the core of the universe.

Ling Han led them to the Cave of Life. For a Pseudo-Emperor to break through to become a Great Emperor, this was the best place. It was full of vitality, and no matter how serious one’s injuries, they could still be healed in this space.
"Brother Monkey, you have to be mentally prepared," Ling Han said.
Brother Monkey was speechless. Wasn’t it just that his ancestor was often injured? Why did he sound like the latter was going to die soon?
They entered into the cave, and when they reached the end, sure enough, there was a person presently bathing in the Pool of Life.
"Yi, Buddha Doga!" Ling Han was startled. He had not thought that what he was seeing this time was not the Battle Saint Emperor, but rather Buddha Doga.
"You’re here!" Buddha Doga nodded, his face filled with shock. That was because those people by Ling Han’s side were actually all Pseudo-Emperors.
F***, when did Pseudo-Emperors become so cheap?
However, he was also filled with joy. These were all fresh troops. As long as they broke through to Emperor Tier, they would definitely be a powerful force of power.

Of course, it was too difficult to advance from Pseudo-Emperor to Great Emperor. Even if there were endless opportunities here, only half the people here, at most, or even fewer in fact, that would be able to break through to Great Emperor.
He would definitely not speak up to rebuke them, but rather give them a word of encouragement.
"Doga, are you done yet? It’s my turn now!" The Battle Saint Emperor’s voice rang out. This old Saint Emperor slowly walked out of a cave, his body covered with injuries.
As expected, he had overestimated this person!
Ling Han sighed. At first, he had thought that the Battle Saint Emperor hadn’t been injured this time, but in the end, he had merely not been immersed in the Pool of Life.
"This pool is big enough to accommodate two people," Buddha Doga said expressionlessly.
"Pei, I don’t like the look of you, so I’m not going with you." The Battle Saint Emperor refused decisively.
"Ancestor!" Brother Monkey called out excitedly.
"Huh? So you’re my great-grandson?" The Battle Saint Emperor looked at Brother Monkey with surprise and delight.
Brother Monkey was once again struck speechless. Was there anyone that spoke of their descendant like this?
But in terms of seniority, wasn’t he the other party’s grandson?
"I... am." Brother Monkey nodded, his face ashen.

It was really too rare to see Brother Monkey like this.
"Don’t hold it in anymore. If you want to laugh, just laugh," Brother Monkey said to Ling Han. There was a kind of peace that came from the grief of one’s heart dying.
Pu!

Buddha Doga was rendered speechless. In front of the Battle Saint Emperor, he was a junior.
It was really rare to see a Great Emperor with such a personality, with the feeling of distance being dismissed in an instant.

"Everyone, make the most of your time." Ling Han nodded as well. The old Divine Beast was unstoppable, and who knew when it would be able to open the Cave of Death and witness the element of Death. Thus, if more Great Emperors appeared, they would be able to make even greater contributions to impeding the old Divine Beast.
Becoming Emperor was a huge temptation to everyone, so they all went into seclusion.

Ling Han was also cultivating by the side of the Pool of Life. He was about to reach peak stage of the fourth tier, but he was still a little bit away from grasping the essence of life, and had not reached consummate level of grasping the element of Life.
A dozen over days later, the Battle Saint Emperor and Buddha Doga both recovered from their injuries.
"Come, let’s battle that old Divine Beast again." The Battle Saint Emperor carried the Imperial Weapon on his shoulders, and light shot out from his Fiery Golden Eyes.
"All right!" Ling Han said heroically.

Previously, he had been severely injured with a single strike from the old Divine Beast, and this had become motivation for him to advance further, and he also wanted to know how far he was now from the old Divine Beast.
"Oh, that’s right. Those so-called Lords of Death are also here," the Battle Saint Emperor added.
’Hmm?’
Though Ling Han had long since expected this, he was still slightly shocked upon hearing this.

Buddha Doga continued, "The moment they arrived, they became the target of scorn, and were targeted by us. However, that old Divine Beast moved, and saved those Great Emperors. Now, they have also been nurtured by the essence of life, and obtained a new life. A few of them have already grasped the essence of life."
The old Divine Beast made a move. Though it was a little unexpected, it was within reason.
The enemy of an enemy was a friend.
And those ancient Great Emperors had really lived up to their reputation. Quite a number of them had already broken through, and advanced into the fourth tier.
The ancient Great Emperors were all the strongest of their generation, so they really couldn’t be underestimated.
As long as they were given a sliver of hope, they would be able to create endless possibilities.

Ling Han’s battle prowess could be so strong, far surpassing his peers, because he had grasped some of the might of the four elements ahead of time, but if both of them had grasped the four elements, who would be weaker than the other?

His uniqueness lay in the fact that he had cultivated every cultivation level to the limit. This was an advantage that would not disappear. In a battle of equal cultivation levels, this would greatly increase his score.
"Then this time, let them rest in complete peace!" Ling Han clenched his fists.
The three of them walked side by side, and soon arrived at the battlefield.
Ling Han gazed into the distance, and sure enough, he saw the figures of the Lords of Death.

Behind him was the empress, the large black dog, Ding Shu and so on.

This kind of lineup could no longer be described as luxurious.

Were they all hiding somewhere, or had they not been revived?
Ling Han was unconcerned.

chapters.title: Chapter 4868: Dilemma
paragraphs: Calculating the time, it had been tens of thousands of years since the Lords of Death had entered the Primitive Abyss. With the talent of a Great Emperor, coupled with the vitality of this place, they naturally became human again.
There were a total of seven Great Emperors that had appeared on the battlefield at this moment, and they had all advanced further, advancing into the fourth tier.
After advancing to the fourth tier, it was as if these Great Emperors had been reborn. Their battle prowess was not much weaker than veteran Great Emperors like the Battle Saint Emperor.
Thus, with these seven Great Emperors holding the main force back, the old Divine Beast would be able to spare even more energy to break through the Cave of Death.
"So far, why has only the old Divine Beast grasped three elements, while the other Great Emperors only have one element?" Ling Han asked curiously.
Theoretically speaking, the Battle Saint Emperor and the others had already been here for hundreds of billions of years, so they should have long since grasped all three of the fundamental elements.
The Battle Saint Emperor shook his head, and said, "The four elements are one and the same, and they repel each other. It’s impossible to grasp two or more at the same time."
"But how could the old Divine Beast do that?" Ling Han asked.

"This is also what I want to know," the Battle Saint Emperor said. "Later, when we found out about you, we asked around, and thought that this was also the key to the old Divine Beast being able to create the 36 Divine Beasts."
The old Divine Beast was so capable, that it could suppress all the Great Emperors?
Those who could become Emperor were the most outstanding existences. Whether it was willpower, toughness, or comprehension ability, all of them were top-notch. Only one could appear in a single era.
And now, there was an old Divine Beast that had completely crushed all the other Great Emperors, leaving them in the dust.
Ling Han found this inconceivable.
What secrets were the old Divine Beast hiding?
In the past, this old Divine Beast had even barged into the Divine Beast Graveyard. After that, the corpses of the Divine Beasts had disappeared, so why did he want those corpses?
This was something that only the old Divine Beast knew, and he obviously could not possibly tell this to a wide audience.
"Don’t worry about this. Let’s fight first," the Battle Saint Emperor roared, and was the first to charge into the battle.
Buddha Doga laughed loudly, and also charged over.
Ling Han’s fighting spirit was ignited. With a battle cry, he charged towards the Blood Demon Ancestor.
"It’s you!" When the Blood Demon Ancestor saw Ling Han, her killing intent immediately blazed.
Ling Han smiled calmly, and said, "Now you all know that I have not deceived you. On the contrary, the one who has deceived you is that old Divine Beast!"
The Blood Demon Ancestor did not speak. After coming to the Imperial Island, they naturally knew that they had been deceived for a long time.
However, now that things had come to this, there was no way back for them. They could only follow the old Divine Beast all the way to the end.
According to the words of the old Divine Beast, after opening the Cave of Death, the four elements would cause a great collision, and it would be easy to grasp them again.
Thus, when the time came, the Great Emperors would be able to grasp all four of the key elements, and even manifest the key elements.
What did this signify?
Every Great Emperor could transform into a universe that could accommodate all things in the world, and become a true ruler, indestructible for all eternity.

"Ling Han, now that we have dealt with the hidden danger, and grasped the essence of life, let us battle again, and see if I will kill you!" The Blood Demon Ancestor ignored his words, and directly charged over.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
She was now in the fourth tier, and even if she hadn’t grasped the essence of life to the extreme, her battle prowess was much stronger than before.
More importantly, she no longer had any worries, and could attack to her heart’s content.

Ling Han merely smiled. In truth, he had advanced into fourth tier earlier than the other. Furthermore, he had grasped another nine-star Regulation, so his comprehension of the element of life was even deeper.
Moreover, Ling Han had cultivated to the pinnacle level of every major tier before, so what Great Emperor could compare to him?
Who was afraid of whom?
Ling Han shot out a punch. Peng, the Blood Demon Ancestor couldn’t block it at all, and her whole body was sent flying backwards.
Right now, he already possessed the strength to crush those at the early stage of the fourth tier.
"Ling Han!" More Lords of Death flew over, launching attacks at him.

"Defeated opponents!" Ling Han said calmly. He swung his fists repeatedly. Peng, peng, peng! Even if the seven Lords of Death joined forces, so what? They could only be sent flying everywhere by his attacks.

However, this place was filled with vitality, and these Great Emperors had also grasped the foundations of this universe. They only had to extract a bit of it to heal themselves, and they would naturally recover immediately.
—Otherwise, the Battle Saint Emperor and the others would have long since been eliminated by the old Divine Beast.
There were only two ways to completely kill these Great Emperors that had grasped the essence of life.
Firstly, he had to cultivate the essence of death.
The second option was for them to leave this island.
At present, the Great Emperors could only use the essence of life, and once they left this island, without a large amount of essence of life, they would not be able to revive themselves either.
Thus, Ling Han faced the attacks of the seven Lords of Death. Though he had an advantage in terms of battle prowess, he was still unable to eliminate them.

Previously, it was the old Divine Beast’s battle prowess that was overwhelming, and the Great Emperors could only drag things out. Now, it was the other way round. Wanting to destroy the Lords of Death?
It would be difficult!
After Ling Han battled for several days, he withdrew from the battle.
A battle like this was too meaningless. Furthermore, even if he killed all the Lords of Death, so what? Would he be able to stop the old Divine Beast?
Only by grasping more key elements could he truly stand against the old Divine Beast.

Ling Han was definitely not the only one who had thought of this. However, just as the Battle Saint Emperor had said, the four fundamentals were the foundations that formed heaven and earth. No Great Emperor could cultivate two or more.
Aside from the old Divine Beast.
With Ling Han’s personality, he naturally had to give it a try.
He was still in the Cave of Life, and first raised his grasp of the essence of life to the extreme.
This took him 700,000 years, and he finally reached the consummate level of the fourth tier.
At this time, Ding Shu and the other Genesis World Masters successfully broke through to Emperor Tier.
Very good, they finally had strong reinforcements on their side.
It could be imagined that even more Great Emperors would appear in the future, joining the team that was fighting against the old Divine Beast.
Ling Han left the Cave of Life. This time, he went to the Cave of Destruction.
He had grasped Destructive Energy, so the second type of foundation stone of heaven and earth that he wanted to grasp was naturally the element of destruction.
Sitting down on his knees, Ling Han began to appreciate the element of destruction.

However, there was already one Element of Life in his body, and this was filled with repulsion towards the other three Elements. Thus, Ling Han had just come into contact with the Element of Destruction, when he was barraged by the Element of Life, and was completely unable to comprehend.

The essence of destruction was no weaker than the essence of life, but now, the power of the essence of life was endless, while the essence of destruction had to start from zero, so how could it resist the essence of life?
Thus, the Battle Saint Emperor said that any Great Emperor would only be able to grasp one key element, and could not cultivate two or more at the same time.
After hundreds of millions of years, all the Great Emperors were only in the fourth tier, and this was clear proof.
Ling Han suddenly stopped, a deep frown on his face.
Could it be that it was really impossible?
Although the old Divine Beast’s progress was slow, there would eventually come a day when he would open the Cave of Death and grasp the key element of death, achieving his goal.
Thus, even if the empress and the others had all become Emperors, that would only push back the day that this day would come slightly. It was still impossible to stop it entirely.
Ling Han was definitely unwilling to wait for death.
He possessed Destructive Energy, soâ¦ he should have a chance!

chapters.title: Chapter 4869: Clash of Elements
paragraphs: Ling Han went into seclusion as per usual.
He was comprehending the element of destruction, and would occasionally participate in battle to become more proficient in his comprehension.
All the Great Emperors saw this, but did not say anything.
Which of them hadn’t been brimming with confidence when they had come here? Hadn’t they thought that they would be able to comprehend all three elements, and become an equal of the old Divine Beast?
However, aside from the mysterious existence of the old Divine Beast, no one else could grasp two or more elements of heaven and earth.
As time passed, even with their pride, they had to admit that this was indeed an impossible mission.
Ling Han had just arrived, so it was understandable that he was so arrogant. However, after a while, he would accept the truth.
Then, what right did they have to stop the old Divine Beast?
There were many people.

In the eyes of the Great Emperors, as long as there were enough fourth tier elites, even if they could not kill the old Divine Beast, they could still suppress him, and from there, resolve the crisis of the universe.
Of course, they also wanted to solve the root of the problem, but that was impossible.
Ling Han went into seclusion more and more times, and the time he spent in seclusion every time was also longer and longer.
Another two million years passed, and the empress, Brother Monkey, the large black dog, and the others all became Emperors.

They were very fortunate. When they had been in the level of Pseudo-Emperor, they had been able to see the practical essense of the evolution of the Nine Star Regulations. This was really too helpful for them to break through to the Great Emperor Tier in future.
This was also the greatest opportunity in history, because this would only happen once in millions and millions of years, from the expansion of heaven and earth to its collapse.
However, no one would have imagined that a freak like Ling Han would actually appear, and actually be able to help so many Saints advance into Pseudo-Emperor Tier.
Now, through the accumulation of millions of years, they had welcomed a powerful burst of power.
There were actually as many as over a dozen newly advanced Great Emperors!
However, there were still some people who had not managed to break through to Great Emperor Tier, and Ling Han had taken them into his body.

As long as they were inside his body, it was like they were living beneath a different set of Regulations of heaven and earth. As long as he had reached the level of Celestial King Tier in the Genesis World, he would be able to live forever.

Of course, Ling Han couldn’t possibly absorb everyone into his body. This would damage the Regulations of heaven and earth, and birth, old age, illness, and death were also the Dao of heaven and earth.
Ling Han didn’t interfere too much, but those he valued definitely wouldn’t die in front of him.
Now, the empress, Hu Niu, the large black dog, and the others had also joined the battle. They had become Emperors, so they had definitely grasped the fundamental element of life.
Why did they all start from the fundamental element of life?
Because without grasping the essence of life, even if they stayed on the Imperial Island, they would only be able to live a few times longer, and it was still inevitable that they would die.
Thus, there was no other option.
However, Ling Han was still in seclusion. This time, he went into a long period of seclusion that lasted as long as four million years.
He had been deducing the Destructive Energy all this while. This was a branch of the element of Destruction, so he could definitely trace it back to its source.

—He could not directly comprehend the element of Destruction, because the Elements would repel each other. However, he had already grasped the Destructive Energy, and it was impossible that the Element of Life could erase this.
Thus, this gave him a loophole to exploit.
However, the element of destruction was one of the cornerstones that formed heaven and earth. It was indescribably complicated, so how could it be easy to trace it back to its source?
Thankfully, he was in the Cave of Destruction. There was the most fundamental element of destruction here, so Ling Han could use it as reference.
It could only be used for reference, and could not be directly comprehended, so it was incredibly time-consuming.

But in the Imperial Island, the least valuable thing was time. Aside from the threat posed by the old Divine Beast, time was meaningless. The Great Emperors here did not age, and their environment would never change in any way.

Although the old Divine Beast was getting closer and closer to opening the Cave of Death, he had spent hundreds of billions of years in the outside world to reach this step. If he wanted to completely open it, he might still need tens of billions of years.
Thus, Ling Han’s extravagance of these million years was really nothing.
His contribution was already enough.
—To provide so many newly advanced Great Emperors for the Imperial Island, who could compare?
Four million years passed, and a smile appeared on Ling Han’s face. He had finally reaped some rewards.
Deducing Destructive Energy in reverse and pursuit of the element; success was close at hand.
But even so, another eight million years quietly passed, and only then did Ling Han make substantial progress.
He stretched out a hand. Boom, Destructive Energy pulsated in his palm, but an instant later, Destructive Energy disappeared. It was clearly invisible, yet gave off an even more dangerous feeling.
Destructive Energy... had become the element of destruction!
Boom!
A terrifying conflict instantly formed in Ling Han’s body. That was the clash of the elements of life and destruction.

Though the four elements were the cornerstones that formed the heaven and earth, it was also precisely because they were cornerstones, pure to the extreme, that there was absolutely no possibility of merging them.
Now, these two elements were coexisting in Ling Han’s body. They both wanted to destroy each other and monopolize Ling Han’s body.
When the two Elements battled, that was a collision that was superior to all else, surpassing the level of energy and Regulations, but rather the conflict of the most fundamental force.
Ling Han felt like he was about to explode.
He had misjudged the incompatibility between the two elements. Even as a Great Emperor, he would still be tortured to death.
No, definitely not!

Ling Han’s eyes suddenly snapped open. One eye was exuberantly green, while the other was indescribably dark. It was as if with a single glance from him, any existence would be destroyed, and would no longer exist in this world.
"Suppress!" he shouted loudly.
However, it could not be suppressed.
The four fundamental factors were the foundation stones of heaven and earth, and were transcendent above all else. How could they be suppressed?
Since that was the case... Ling Han gritted his teeth. Then, he would transform into the embodiment of heaven and earth.
He would become the bearer of heaven and earth, and the four elements could coexist to serve him.
It was impossible for other Great Emperors to do so. Great Emperors could become self-contained, and becoming heaven and earth was a completely different matter.
However, Ling Han had already possessed the Genesis World since a very long time ago. This was a representation of heaven and earth.
He began to expand his heaven and earth, and the motivation was the two elements of life and destruction.
At present, he was still lacking a bit, but as long as Ling Han could further obtain the two elements of creation and death, his heaven and earth would become complete.

"Ah—" Ling Han released a roar. The process of transforming himself into heaven and earth was really too painful. Furthermore, the element of destruction was surging violently, wanting to erase him by force.
Thankfully, the essence of life had boosted his exuberant vitality, allowing him to grow endlessly.
If he had known this earlier, he would have gone to comprehend the fundamental element of creation first.
These were just empty words. In terms of the element of Creation, Ling Han couldn’t directly comprehend it, nor could he reverse-deduce it. It was impossible for him to get started.

If this were the outside world, Ling Han wouldn’t be able to construct his own heaven and earth, even if he reverse-deduced the element of destruction. After all, where would the elements of heaven and earth come from?
All the Great Emperors and the old Divine Beast could only use the main elements, but there were no main elements in their bodies.

Otherwise, they could completely walk out of the Imperial Island. As long as there was the element of Life in their bodies, they could grow endlessly, and there was no need for them to be imprisoned here.
It was only here that the four fundamental elements could be reached. He would not be afraid even of death, as the fundamenta element of life could easily revive him.

A feeling of appreciation rose up in Ling Han. If he could really construct a new heaven and earth, then the four elements would be endless. Even if his lifespan dried up, he would still be able to walk out of the Imperial Island.
That was because he had become a new heaven and earth, and possessed his own Regulations.

chapters.title: Chapter 4870: Third Tier!
paragraphs: However, now was not the time to think about this.
Ling Han was still constructing his own heaven and earth. There were only two elements, and he could only construct a framework, but could not create anything.
That was because he had not grasped the fundamental element of creation.
Without the ability of creation, his heaven and earth was naturally empty. There was not even life.
—Life could not be bestowed out of thin air. It had to have a physical body first.
Thus, if he wanted to create something, he still had to grasp the key element of creation.
He constructed his own heaven and earth with great difficulty. This was not difficult, and the Genesis World was the best reference.

It was too painful. The element of destruction and the element of life clashed, wanting to tear his body apart at any moment. If it was not for the fact that Ling Han had long since toughened his willpower along the way, it was believed that he would have long since given up.
Even death would not be so unbearable.
But in this kind of agony, Ling Han managed to hold on for a whole million years.
Finally, his construction of heaven and earth was complete.
Instantly, the pain was gone.
The two elements of life and destruction obediently entrenched themselves in his body, and were even slowly accumulating.
This was too shocking.
It should be known that even a fourth tier Great Emperor could only use key elements, and could not accumulate any key elements.
But what about Ling Han?
His hypothesis was not wrong. After constructing the heaven and earth, he would be able to evolve into a new heaven and earth.
However, this heaven and earth was riddled with holes now, because it lacked the two elements of death and creation. It was not complete.

If Ling Han left the Imperial Island, then because the heaven and earth was incomplete, whether it was the element of life or the element of destruction, they would be rapidly lost, and he had lived for more than ten million years, so his lifespan had already dried up. If he left the island, he would definitely die.
Ling Han stood up, a smile at the corners of his lips.
At this moment, he was filled with confidence.
Because it was only now that he truly knew his own path.
’Fine, I’ll go and kill first!’
Xiu, Ling Han’s figure moved, and rushed towards the battlefield.

The battle here was still the same as before. All the Great Emperors were ganging up on the old Divine Beast, delaying its progress in digging out the Cave of Death, while the Lords of Death were helping the old Divine Beast. The battle between the two sides was incredibly intense, but it was all pointless effort.
No one would die here. No matter how serious their injuries were, they would be able to recover very quickly.
The Great Emperor Senluo was the first to stop, and he said coldly, "Ling Han!"
At this time, the Lords of Death appeared.
As expected of a Great Emperor. As long as they were given a sliver of hope, they would be able to create endless possibilities.
See, after more than ten million years, they had already advanced into the fourth tier.
Ling Han smiled calmly, "A defeated opponent, are you here to seek your own humiliation again?"
The Great Emperor Senluo was enraged. "Brat, it was only that I couldn’t unleash my full abilities just then. Killing you now will be as easy as the turn of a palm!"
The other eleven Lords of Death also stopped, surrounding Ling Han.
If there was anyone they hated the most, it would definitely be Ling Han, who had ruined the plan that they had planned for countless years.
Of course, this plan was only paving the way for another.
However, it could not be denied that Ling Han was definitely the person that the Lords of Death wanted to kill the most.
Ling Han crooked a finger at them, "Come, this time, I will send you on your way!"

"Arrogant!" The Great Emperor Senluo charged over. Right now, his battle prowess was already at the fourth tier, and he had more so reached the peak stage of the fourth tier. Just how terrifying was this battle prowess?
Boom!
He wielded supreme power and charged over, indescribably terrifying.
Fortunately, this was the Primitive Abyss. If this was not, he could even destroy a Heavenly Realm with such a strike.
Ling Han greeted him with a smile, battling intensely with the Great Emperor Senluo.
What cultivation level was he at now?
Third tier!

In a battle of third tier against fourth tier, it was naturally an all-round suppression. However, it was not as ridiculous as a battle of second tier against fourth tier, where it would be completely one-sided.
Even so, Great Emperor Senluo immediately fell into a disadvantage.
No matter how strong he was, so what? There was a gap of a level between them, and there was absolutely no way to turn the tables.
Ling Han launched a series of powerful punches, forcing the Great Emperor Senluo to continuously retreat.
This!

The Lords of Death were all speechless. They had already cultivated to the fourth tier, and had also reached the peak stage of this cultivation level. If it was not for the fact that the Great Emperor could only grasp one key element, they may already be in the third tier, or second tier.
In other words, they were once again standing at the peak of cultivation.
That was indeed the truth. They were battling with the other Great Emperors, and were not at a disadvantage at all!
For those that could become Emperor, who would be weaker than the other?
However, in front of Ling Han, why was the Great Emperor Senluo completely suppressed?
Though he did not have the incomparable battle prowess of the old Divine Beast, Ling Han was already inconceivably strong!
At this moment, not only the Lords of Death, but even the old Divine Beast and the other Great Emperors looked over in surprise.
Aside from the old Divine Beast, there was another being that could suppress fourth-tier battle prowess?
"F***, could it be that this brat has really succeeded?" The Battle Saint Emperor murmured. He naturally knew that Ling Han had been comprehending the essence of destruction all these years.

In his eyes, this was an impossible task. That was because he had already attempted it millions and millions of years ago, and it had also been confirmed by the other Great Emperors. It was impossible for him to succeed.
However, if that was not the case, how could Ling Han be so powerful?
The old Divine Beast also stared at Ling Han, showing a rare hint of seriousness.
Before this, no matter how much the Great Emperors struggled, he was completely unconcerned.
That was because he could not be stopped. Only he could achieve the impossible, and grasp two, or even three, fundamental elements of heaven and earth at the same time.
However, that young man also seemed to have succeeded.
This caused him to feel a strong sense of danger.
This was an emotion that he had never experienced before, and even he was stunned for a moment.
As the only second tier Great Emperor in the world, he actually felt a sense of danger?
What a big joke!
Boom!

On the other side, Ling Han and the Great Emperor Senluo were still engaged in an intense battle. Strictly speaking, however, this was a one-sided battle. Before Ling Han, the Great Emperor Senluo was almost unable to fight back. He could only take a beating.
If this were the outside world, even if the vitality of a Great Emperor was tenacious, they still wouldn’t be able to withstand such a mad barrage of attacks.
But this place was different.

The element of Life overflowed, and minor injuries would immediately heal, and even if there were severe injuries, they could be set aside. At worst, it would only take a little time, and would not take too many days to heal.
In fact, it didn’t matter even if he died. He could completely revive.
In this place, everyone had an undying body.
Thus, the Great Emperor Senluo was completely fearless. He wasn’t afraid of death, so what did he have to be afraid of?
In such a head-on clash, the outcome of the battle was naturally very easily decided.
It was only a few hundred moves, and Ling Han had already pressed the Great Emperor Senluo onto the ground.
"Haha, you can’t kill me!" the Great Emperor Senluo said with a cold chuckle.

"When has the ambition of a Great Emperor become so low? Does not being killed count as a victory?" Ling Han shook his head, his face filled with disdain, but his expression immediately darkened, "However, who said that I could not kill you?"
He grabbed the Great Emperor Senluo and directly sent him inside his own body.
—Inside the heaven and earth that he had constructed.
Yi?
The Lords of Death were all astonished. Where was the Great Emperor Senluo?
Why had he suddenly disappeared?
It should be known that even if there was a Spatial Tool that could store living things, it would still be unable to store a Great Emperor.
This was because a Great Emperor was far too powerful, so much so that he couldn’t be contained at all.

Where was the Great Emperor Senluo?
Why had he suddenly disappeared?
It should be known that even if there was a Spatial Tool that could store living things, it would still be unable to store a Great Emperor.
This was because a Great Emperor was far too powerful, so much so that he couldn’t be contained at all.

chapters.title: Chapter 4871: Slaughtering Emperor
paragraphs: However, right in front of everyone’s eyes, the Great Emperor Senluo had disappeared.
How was this possible?
For some reason, the Lords of Death all felt a chill.
"Where’s Senluo!" the Sea Emperor shouted at Ling Han.
Ling Han made a silencing motion, and said, "Don’t be noisy. I am currently killing him."
W-what!
The Lords of Death didn’t dare to believe this. What right do you have to kill a fourth tier Great Emperor?
As long as they were on this Imperial Island, they were immortal.
"Shameless boasting!"
"Humph, you want to use this to threaten us?"
"Die!"

The Golden Crow Emperor and the other Lords of Death immediately charged over. They believed that Ling Han had used a special method to temporarily imprison the Great Emperor Senluo. Thus, as long as they exerted enough pressure, Ling Han would definitely no longer be able to imprison the Great Emperor Senluo and would be forced to release him.
Eleven fourth tier Great Emperors charged over, their might truly incredibly terrifying.
Yet Ling Han merely parried carelessly, as if he was slightly distracted.
In truth, that was the case.
Ling Han placed his attention on the heaven and earth inside his body.
The Great Emperor Senluo had been taken in by him, and his soul also took human form, standing in front of the Great Emperor Senluo.
"Where is this?" The Great Emperor Senluo frowned. This feeling of unknownness caused him to feel a sliver of panic.
Ling Han smiled faintly, "Welcome to my world."
"Your world?" the Great Emperor Senluo murmured. His frown became even deeper.
In this place, he could no longer sense the essence of life.
Since he could not sense it, he naturally could not use it.

There were only two ways to kill a fourth tier Great Emperor. The first was to grasp the essence of death, but now, even the old Divine Beast was unable to do so, so this option was naturally eliminated.
There was one more, and that was to leave the Imperial Island.

But in truth, including Ling Han, these people had already stayed on the Imperial Island for more than ten million years. This was the theoretically maximum lifespan of a Great Emperor. Thus, as long as he left the Imperial Island, even Ling Han would die from having exhausted his full lifespan.

Of course, because he had been nurtured by the essence of life, Ling Han’s lifespan should have exceeded ten million years, but in this place, time was too cheap. Ling Han would soon reach the true limit of his lifespan.
Thus, even if Ling Han dragged him out of the Imperial Island, the greatest possibility was that the two of them would die together.
He was sure that Ling Han definitely wouldn’t do something so stupid.
But why couldn’t he sense the essence of life?
Was this really the inside of his body?
But how was this possible?
Ling Han smiled and said, "I’m in charge of my own world, so if I want you to die, you can only die!"
"Haha, in your dreams!" the Great Emperor Senluo sneered. Even if he was unsure, how could he possibly show fear in front of Ling Han?
Ling Han ignored him. With a wave of his hand, the element of Destruction instantly transformed into arrows that shot towards the Great Emperor Senluo.
This was his world, and just like he had said, he was in charge of his world!
There was no way to dodge these arrows at all, because they were shooting out from every angle.
The Great Emperor Senluo could only parry. However, even contact with the element of destruction would cause serious injury.
"Wu!" He continuously released muffled groans, and then shockingly discovered that multiple wounds had appeared on his arms, thighs, and body. There was absolutely no signs of healing.
Without the essence of life, how could it heal?
Furthermore, in front of the element of Destruction, if it was not the element of Life that was its equal, how could merely depending on the recovery ability of the body have any effects?
In just a short while, the Great Emperor Senluo’s body was riddled with wounds. He was in an indescribably miserable state.
However, the Great Emperor Senluo felt even more flustered.
Without any element of Life, if he continued to be injured like this, he would really be killed.
"How is this possible!" He paled in shock, "Just what kind of ability have you grasped!"
"The ability to kill you," Ling Han said calmly. "The ability to pacify the world."
The Great Emperor Senluo was furious. His voice was far too calm, and it was as if he weren’t a Great Emperor at all. It was as if he were just a nobody.

"As a Great Emperor, you should be overseeing the world and pacifying the darkness," Ling Han continued. "However, you people have transformed into darkness and caused chaos in the world. Do you still have the right to be called a Great Emperor?"

"A mere junior dares to order us around?" the Great Emperor Senluo roared in fury. Even if he was no match, he couldn’t lose his pride as a Great Emperor, to lower his head and beg Ling Han for mercy.

"I don’t have that interest. I’ll just kill you," Ling Han said. He didn’t hold back. With a thought, the element of destruction transformed into a long sword that slashed at the Great Emperor Senluo.
With the Great Emperor Senluo’s current strength, he was already unable to block this kind of attack.
Pu! He was instantly sliced into two.

However, the Great Emperor’s vitality was incredibly tenacious, and the Great Emperor Senluo had also grasped the fundamental element of life after all. He forcefully fused the two halves of his body back together, forcefully stabilizing his injuries.
"You can block one, but can you block two?" Ling Han asked calmly. Multiple divine swords appeared continuously, slashing towards the Great Emperor Senluo.
This was his world, and his power was unlimited.

The Great Emperor Senluo was continuously sliced into two halves. Although he continued to reassemble his body, he couldn’t hold on for much longer. Blood continued to gush from his adhering body, and so did blood from his mouth.
He was not far from death.
The Great Emperor Senluo was filled with disbelief. After coming to the Imperial Island and grasping the fundamental element of life, he should have been an indestructible existence.
But now, he felt that he was really not far from death.
How was this possible?

He had lived for a very long time, and had even transformed into a Yin soul in fact. It could be said that he had lived through the experience of life and death, yet he had still walked with his head held high, and become a fourth tier Great Emperor.
But now, he was actually going to die in such a humiliating manner?
He was unwilling to accept this, absolutely unwilling to accept this.
But no matter how unwilling he was, so what?
Ling Han slashed down with divine swords, one after another. His injuries became more and more severe, and the life force was also severely injured, with no possibility of recovery.
Unless, of course, he could immediately return to the Imperial Island, and use the essence of Life to temper himself, so that he could come back to life.
However, would Ling Han give him a chance?
"Brat! Brat! Brat!" the Great Emperor Senluo roared in fury. However, he couldn’t change his fate.
Shua! The divine sword slashed down again, slicing the Great Emperor Senluo into two from top to bottom.
This time, the Great Emperor Senluo was unable to recover his body. The two halves of his body floated in Ling Han’s empty world.
He was dead.
There was no shower of blood, nor was there any grief from heaven and earth. It was completely peaceful, and there was not the slightest ripple.
Because this was Ling Han’s world, whatever rules were up to him to decide.
Weng, his mind returned, and his initially wooden movements immediately became agile. Peng, peng, peng! He threw a punch, and sent the eleven Lords of Death flying.
"Where’s Senluo?" the Lords of Death all shouted.
"He’s dead," Ling Han said calmly.
He was dead?
Everyone was in disbelief. He was on Imperial Island, so how could he possibly die?
"Bullsh*t!" the Lords of Death shouted. Even the Battle Saint Emperor and the others didn’t believe this.
They wouldn’t die here. Otherwise, what basis did they have to waste so much time with the old Divine Beast?
Ling Han cracked a smile. Xiu! The Great Emperor Senluo’s two halves were tossed out.
Stowing this into his body was too disgusting.

Moreover, this was a fourth tier Great Emperor, and it would take a considerable amount of time to completely annihilate it with the element of destruction. Thus, it would be better to directly throw it out.
Heavens!

chapters.title: Chapter 4872: Heaven Devouring Beast
paragraphs: In this instant, the Lords of Death felt goosebumps all over their bodies, and an indescribable emotion rose up in them.
This was called fear, an emotion that had not arisen in them for a very, very long time.
The Great Emperor was invincible in this world, so who would he be afraid of?
However, they were really feeling fear now.
Ling Han... possessed the ability to kill a fourth tier Great Emperor.
The spiritual mark of the Great Emperor Senluo had completely disappeared. Although the corpse was still there, it could no longer be revived.
Hiss, Ling Han actually had the ability to erase the soul mark!
How was this different from the heaven and earth?

Why was it that the Great Emperor could not reincarnate in the outside world? That was because the Heavenly Dao was too strong. Once the Great Emperor died, his spiritual mark would directly fuse with the Heavenly Dao, so how could he reincarnate?
Unless he could obtain the Great Herb in the Primitive Abyss. Only in that manner, would he be able to live a second life.

However, on the Imperial Island, the Heavenly Dao did not exist, and there was also the element of Life. Thus, Great Emperors did not fear even death, as they could immediately come back to life. Even a second tier Great Emperor like the old Divine Beast could not kill a Great Emperor completely.
However, Ling Han had created a miracle.
How could this be! How could this be!

At this moment, even the battle between the Great Emperors and the old Divine Beast also came to a halt. Faced with such a miracle, their minds were all stunned. In fact, a feeling of fear even rose up in their hearts.
This was an existence that possessed the ability to completely kill a Great Emperor.
He was so awesome even without obtaining the key element of death?

"It was a mistake not to try my best to kill you." The old Divine Beast strode over. He presently looked like an elegant middle-aged man, but there were multiple seals on his exposed skin, as if they had been branded onto his skin.
Looking closely, they were clearly Divine Beasts, the True Phoenix, the True Dragon, the Black Tortoise and so on.
Ling Han smiled calmly, "Are you praising me?"

"You are indeed very freakish." The old Divine Beast nodded, "These people have battled with me for hundreds of billions of years, yet were still unable to stop me, and I do not take them seriously either. However, you have only been here for such a short while, and I have already seen you in a new light. In fact, I have even become vigilant."
"Thank you." Ling Han nodded, "However, if you are willing to obediently accept your death, I will be even more grateful to you."
"Hahaha!" The old Divine Beast laughed loudly, "Though you have grasped two elements of heaven and earth, in front of me, it is still not enough!"
He was an existence that had grasped three key elements, and was peerless in the world.

Ling Han also smiled, "Indeed, my present strength is inferior to yours, but you can’t kill me! And after some more time, I will be able to grasp the third key element, and be your equal. At that time, you will be trembling!"
This was not an empty threat, but rather a very realistic threat.
Since Ling Han could grasp two key elements, it meant that he had broken through the restrictions of Great Emperors. Then, it was not impossible that he could grasp another key element.
"So, I can’t allow you to live!" The old Divine Beast’s eyes shone with ferocity.
"Come!" Ling Han crooked a finger at him. Unless he could build a new heaven and earth like he had, he would not die even if they fought on the Imperial Island and he was no match.
However, the actions of the old Divine Beast had exceeded everyone’s expectations.
He actually walked to the side of the Great Emperor Senluo’s corpse, and then stopped.
What, was he still reminiscing in memory of this fallen Great Emperor?
Crocodile’s tears?
However, what happened next stunned every single Great Emperor.
He suddenly opened his mouth, and his chin directly fell onto his feet. With a bite of his ferocious mouth, he had swallowed the two halves of the Great Emperor .
’Holy f*ck!’
Not only was Ling Han and the other Great Emperors stunned, even the Lord of Death and the others found this hard to accept.
’He’s already dead, yet he still wants to eat his corpse?’
Was there something f*cking wrong with you?
Ling Han also felt his blood run cold. A thought suddenly occurred to him, and he said, "Those Divine Beast corpses that have disappeared... have all been eaten by you!"
He finally knew why the Divine Beast’s corpse had mysteriously disappeared.
The old Divine Beast wasn’t going to steal it, but to eat it!
So, was it because of this that he had been able to create those Divine Beasts, the Great Emperor, and the others?

Previously, Ling Han had not been able to figure out how the old Divine Beast could create the Great Emperor’s corpse. Now, it seemed that this was definitely related to him eating the corpses of those Divine Beasts.
All the Great Emperors were also extremely shocked. The old Divine Beast had actually eaten the corpse of a Great Emperor. This practically caused their worldview to explode.
What kind of monster was this?

"Gaga!" The old Divine Beast’s head suddenly turned back into the form of a Divine Beast. He released a strange laugh, and said, "I am the number one Divine Beast in the world, and my name is... Heaven Swallowing Beast!"
No one spoke. Looks like the old Divine Beast was about to reveal some of its own secrets.

"At the beginning, I was only an ordinary Divine Beast, but after devouring the corpses of the Divine Beasts and Divine Beasts, not only did my lifespan increase, I even obtained some of the abilities of those Divine Beasts and Divine Beasts," the old Divine Beast Divine Beast continued as expected.
Ling Han paused for a moment, then said, "The thirty-six Divine Beasts from before weren’t independent beings at all. They were all your doppelgangers, right?"
Otherwise, how could a newly created individual possibly possess the memories of his predecessor?
There was only one possibility, and that was that those were the continuation of the old Divine Beast!

"You’re very smart!" The old Divine Beast didn’t hide anything anymore. He had swallowed the Great Emperor Senluo’s corpse in public, so it was destined that some secrets couldn’t be hidden anymore. "At first, I thought that I could lock the passageway and prevent outsiders from coming to this island again. I didn’t expect..."

He had not thought that the appearance of a freak like Ling Han would cause such a massive impact on his plans. Not only had he failed to stop outsiders from arriving at the Imperial Island, even the arrangements of the Lords of Death had been ruined.
Ling Han smiled and said, "So, your plan is destined to fail!"

"Wrong. Previously, I have never considered you as a rival, and that was my negligence, but now!" The old Divine Beast turned back into a complete human form, "Since I have my eye on you, don’t even think of creating any more waves."
"Oh?" Ling Han shook his head, "Then I’ll wait and see."
Boom!
The old Divine Beast didn’t waste words, and directly charged over.
Ling Han charged forwards, and clashed with the old Divine Beast.
Peng! Peng! Peng!
This was a head-on clash between a second tier and a third tier Great Emperor, but the gap in strength was too wide. Ling Han immediately fell into a complete disadvantage.
He was like a straw, as the old Divine Beast’s attacks caused him to dance madly in the air.

However, he had already constructed his own heaven and earth, and there was the element of Life inside his body. Even if he was injured, the element of Life would immediately fill his body, allowing him to recover to a complete state.
This was a true undying body!
How was this possible?
The old Divine Beast found this hard to accept. How could Ling Han’s recovery ability be so terrifying?
Even for him, after sustaining so many heavy blows, he still had to stop the battle and absorb a large amount of element of Life to recover.
Why was Ling Han so freakish?

According to his plan, he would first severely injure Ling Han. Then, he would sacrifice some spiritual marks, and create the manifestation of a Divine Beast. He would drag Ling Han into the Sea of Death, and take him down with him.
This would greatly decrease his strength, but in order to get rid of a guy like Ling Han who would cause endless trouble in the future, this was completely worth it.
However, the progress of the matter was completely beyond his expectations.
