He had not thought that the appearance of a freak like Ling Han would cause such a massive impact on his plans.
Not only had he failed to stop outsiders from arriving at the Imperial Island, even the arrangements of the Lords of Death had been ruined.
Ling Han smiled and said, "So, your plan is destined to fail!"
"Wrong.

Previously, I have never considered you as a rival, and that was my negligence, but now!" The old Divine Beast turned back into a complete human form, "Since I have my eye on you, don’t even think of creating any more waves."
"Oh?" Ling Han shook his head, "Then I’ll wait and see."
Boom!
The old Divine Beast didn’t waste words, and directly charged over.
Ling Han charged forwards, and clashed with the old Divine Beast.
Peng!
Peng!
Peng!
This was a head-on clash between a second tier and a third tier Great Emperor, but the gap in strength was too wide.
Ling Han immediately fell into a complete disadvantage.
He was like a straw, as the old Divine Beast’s attacks caused him to dance madly in the air.
However, he had already constructed his own heaven and earth, and there was the element of Life inside his body.
Even if he was injured, the element of Life would immediately fill his body, allowing him to recover to a complete state.
This was a true undying body!
How was this possible?
The old Divine Beast found this hard to accept.
How could Ling Han’s recovery ability be so terrifying?
Even for him, after sustaining so many heavy blows, he still had to stop the battle and absorb a large amount of element of Life to recover.
Why was Ling Han so freakish?
According to his plan, he would first severely injure Ling Han.
Then, he would sacrifice some spiritual marks, and create the manifestation of a Divine Beast.
He would drag Ling Han into the Sea of Death, and take him down with him.
This would greatly decrease his strength, but in order to get rid of a guy like Ling Han who would cause endless trouble in the future, this was completely worth it.
However, the progress of the matter was completely beyond his expectations.

chapters.title: Chapter 4873: Helpless against each other
paragraphs: The old Divine Beast attacked repeatedly, using all kinds of powerful moves.
He was really very strong, and had grasped three fundamental elements, which was indescribably terrifying.

It should be known that Ling Han had only grasped the Destructive Energy, and at that time, it was already enough to make the Great Emperors wary, and the old Divine Beast had even grasped the essence of Destruction. The power of his strike was connected with the essence of Destruction.
Hong! Hong! Hong!

The element of destruction took the form of multiple black dragons, black phoenixes, and black tigers. They were all in the form of Divine Beasts. However, they were incredibly dark, and charged towards Ling Han.
Ling Han’s body trembled violently from the impact, and multiple black holes appeared on his body. These parts of his body directly disappeared.
However, in an instant, the element of Life in his body surged out, instantly mending these black holes.
This was a true undying body.

Though those like the Great Emperors had also grasped the essence of life, if they were injured, they would need to extract the essence of life from outside their bodies, and only then could they use it to heal their injuries. If that was not the case, if they were severely injured, they would not need to go to the Cave of Life, because the essence of life there was the densest.
Even for the old Divine Beast, he actually could only use three key elements, and was still unable to take in the key elements himself.
From this aspect, Ling Han was indeed walking at the forefront.
This kind of recovery ability caused even the old Divine Beast to feel fear.

If Ling Han was allowed to grasp the key element of creation, then this young man would be able to be his equal in terms of number of key elements, and in terms of grasp of key elements... he was obviously superior to him.
Thus, Ling Han definitely couldn’t be allowed to grasp the third key element!
The old Divine Beast roared repeatedly, and images of Divine Beasts appeared continuously from his body, boosting him with various mystical powers.
This was a godly technique that he had never used before.
This was because he didn’t need to unleash his full power against the other Great Emperors.
On the other hand, even if he went all out, so what?
In the end, they would still be revived.
Thus, he focused the majority of his energy on excavating the Cave of Death. As long as he could comprehend the essence of death, he would be able to instantly kill all the Great Emperors.
But now, he felt a tremendous pressure.
He could no longer allow Ling Han to continue growing. This brat’s freakishness was practically heaven-defying!
Ling Han was calm and unperturbed. He had long since walked out his own path. Han Fists shot out, each punch domineering.

He also unleashed the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower. This was a Transcendent Weapon, and after fusing with the Metal of Creation, it was equivalent to possessing a portion of the element of creation. Even the element of destruction couldn’t damage it.
The man and the tower worked together. Though they were still at a disadvantage, it was not that they could not put up a fight.
—It could not be helped. Ling Han’s recovery ability was too strong.
Fight, fight, fight!
The two Great Emperors that had surpassed the fourth tier unleashed their full strength. A frightening power surged out, causing the whole Imperial Island to rumble loudly.
"Let’s go!" All the Great Emperors exchanged looks. This was the first time in history that they had seen hope of defeating the old Divine Beast. At the very least, they could fight to a tie.
"Don’t even think about it!" the Lords of Death also shouted as they charged forward.
The Emperor Tier team battle began.
If an outsider came over, it was possible that they would be directly scared to death.
An Emperor Tier team battle, wasn’t this like a dream?

None of the Great Emperors would have any qualms about attacking. In this place, aside from the freakish Ling Han, the other Great Emperors were unable to kill another Great Emperor. Even the old Divine Beast was no exception. Thus, they could attack with ease.

Though this was intense, to the Great Emperors, this was only a microcosm of their millions and millions of years of battle experience. The only difference was that there were just a little more people participating.
For the first time, the old Divine Beast put aside its excavation of the Cave of Death, and focused its full effort on dealing with Ling Han, wanting to get rid of this calamity.
He hadn’t thought of a solution yet, but the first thing he had to do was to at least suppress Ling Han.
He would slowly consider how he was going to kill him.

Previously, he had not taken the Great Emperors to heart. In any case, there was a limit to how much they could impede him. It was just that the Cave of Death was too hard to dig out, so the Great Emperors mistakenly thought that their efforts were effective.
In truth, he had been digging here alone for hundreds of billions of years. It was really very boring.
However, Ling Han’s appearance caused him to feel a sense of danger.
For those like the other Great Emperors, as long as he was willing to pay some price, he could still kill them, but if it was Ling Han, he really felt that this was a problem.

It seemed like... he didn’t need time to communicate with the essence of life, nor did he need a channel, nor was there any limit to the amount. It could even be said that he was the embodiment of the essence of life!
How could such an existence be killed?
In truth, even if Ling Han was really thrown into the Sea of Death, with the element of Life accumulated in his body, he was completely capable of holding on for a while.
Thus, if the old Divine Beast dragged Ling Han into the sea, it was guaranteed that the one who would die would be the old Divine Beast and not Ling Han.

Ten years, a hundred years, a thousand years. On Imperial Island, the least valuable thing was time. This battle lasted as long as thirty thousand years, but the situation was no different from the beginning. Though the old Divine Beast was beating down on Ling Han, it was completely unable to severely injure Ling Han, what more kill him.

—If it could kill Ling Han, then the old Divine Beast would sacrifice a spiritual mark, and have it tangle with Ling Han’s spiritual mark. They would directly enter into the Sea of Death, and completely destroy this freakish being.
People were easy to kill, but the spiritual mark was hard to erase. This was the essence of the Great Emperor, and the key to his revival.
Now, it had become a stalemate.

The old Divine Beast was targeting Ling Han, so Ling Han had no time to comprehend the fundamental element of creation at all. Furthermore, he could no longer excavate the Cave of Death, and the situation had become a dead end.
In any case, time was worthless and meaningless, so they might as well fight.
In the blink of an eye, another seven million years had passed.
The Great Emperors had already been severely wounded and killed several times. However, the battle between Ling Han and the old Divine Beast continued.
This was a battle that no one could afford to lose.

If Ling Han died in battle, then he would definitely be completely killed at all costs by the old Divine Beast, and if the old Divine Beast allowed Ling Han to continue to grow stronger, there would eventually come a day when he too could possibly be killed by Ling Han.
However, after fighting for more than seven million years in one go, even the old Divine Beast was a little numb.
He was facing an opponent all this while, and there was no hope of killing him at all. This greatly affected his fighting spirit.
Finally, the old Divine Beast gave up, and with a furious roar, went back to mining.
Ling Han didn’t give chase, as this was completely meaningless.
Without becoming a second tier, there was no way he could deal with the old Divine Beast.

The other Great Emperors rushed over, wanting to delay the old Divine Beast. However, the old Divine Beast merely launched a single attack, and close to a hundred Divine Beasts appeared at the same time, instantly killing half of the Great Emperors. Those that did not die were also severely injured.
This!
Only now did the Emperors know just how strong the old Divine Beast was.
Previously, he was simply playing around with them, and had not used his full strength at all.
Ling Han moved, and protected all the dead and wounded Great Emperors, bringing them back into the Cave of Life.
They would recover with some nurturing. Those who were injured would recover, and those who were dead would come back to life.
Ling Han set his eyes on the Lords of Death.
The old Divine Beast couldn’t be killed, but for the Lords of Death... there was no problem!

chapters.title: Chapter 4874: Eliminating the Lords of Death
paragraphs: Right now, the old Divine Beast was completely focused on mining.

He had completely no intention of fighting any longer. He was just working hard on mining. With the channelling of the element of destruction, he was excavating the hard rock with great difficulty, his progress slow.
If he could be faster, he would have long since obtained all four elements, and no one would be able to stop him.
Since that was the case, Ling Han would not be reserved either.
Faced with Ling Han, the Lords of Death all felt uneasy.
This was a terrifying opponent, an existence that could kill them.
As Great Emperors, they had never feared anyone in their entire lives. However, in front of Ling Han, they were all filled with fear.
However, with the pride of Great Emperors, they could not reveal that at all.
Which one of them had not been invincible for an era?
Even if they had to die, they would die standing, and battle to the death.
"Do you guys have any regrets?" Ling Han asked.
"If we did, would you let us go?" Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperor said calmly.
"Sorry, I won’t." Ling Han shook his head.
"Even if we have regrets, we have long since destroyed them," the Void Emperor said.
Ling Han nodded. He had seen the memory image of the Blood Demon Ancestor in the Netherworld before, and she had wavered before, but she had forcefully severed it.
Emperors were merciless.
"Since that’s the case, I’ll send you on your way!" he said very calmly.
There was no mockery, nor was there any pride.
No matter what, those who could become Emperos were all worthy of respect, though these Emperors could no longer keep their integrity, and were lured by darkness.
"Ling Han, though you are powerful, it would not be so easy for you to kill us!" the Black Sunflower Demon Emperor declared proudly.
"Bring it on!" The Sea Emperor stood at the entrance of the Cave of Death. Boom, the Imperial Might was completely unleashed.
They had to defend this place, so that the old Divine Beast could fully concentrate on excavating, and release the key element of Death completely.
As long as they could hold on until then, the old Divine Beast would be able to show its might.
This was filled with unknowns, and it was not certain whether the old Divine Beast would turn hostile at that time. However, this was also the only choice they could make now.
Ling Han charged over and raised his fist to attack.
Boom!

He had battle prowess of the third tier, and because of the unique nature of his body, his battle prowess was much stronger than an ordinary third tier. Otherwise, even if he possessed the essence of life, he would not be able to clash so hard with the old Divine Beast.
With a single strike, the Sea Emperor was sent flying, crashing heavily into the cave wall behind him.
However, before Ling Han could follow up with another attack, the other Lords of Death had already surged forwards, stopping Ling Han’s pursuit.
Peng! Peng! Peng!
This was another group battle between Great Emperors. However, this time, it was an eleven-on-one battle.
Even so, Ling Han was still at an absolute advantage. In a battle of third tier against fourth tier, his advantage was indeed too great.
However, just like how the old Divine Beast was unable to kill the Great Emperors, Ling Han was also unable to defeat the Lords of Death, one after another.
Those who could become Great Emperors were all extraordinarily smart.
The 11 Great Emperors teamed up, helping each other and preventing Ling Han from killing them.
But this was only a stalemate for a month, because the other Great Emperors had either recovered from their injuries, or come back to life, and rejoined the battle.
This time was different.
With them holding them back from the sidelines, Ling Han would be able to focus on dealing with a Lord of Death.
The second person that he drew into his heaven and earth was the Three Purity Great Emperor.
The moment he entered, a look of realization appeared on the Three Purity Great Emperor’s face. "So that’s how it is."
With how smart the Great Emperor was, he could immediately guess his current situation through the disappearance of the element of Life.
Without being able to use the essence of life, the moment one died, the spiritual mark would completely disappear.
The Three Purity Great Emperor smiled, and a carefree expression appeared on his face. Then, his fighting spirit blazed, and soared.
A Great Emperor naturally had the magnanimity of a Great Emperor. Even if he had fallen to become a Lord of Death, this was only a change in perspective, and would not affect his magnanimity.
"If I die in battle, please throw my corpse into the Sea of Death," the Three Purity Great Emperor suddenly said.
Ling Han nodded, "All right!"
With the pride of Great Emperors, would they allow their corpses to be swallowed by a Divine Beast after their deaths?
Thus, he would rather bury himself in the Sea of Death.
In truth, even if he did not say, Ling Han had no plans to leave the Great Emperor’s corpse for the old Divine Beast.

Previously, he had not known that the old Divine Beast was actually capable of obtaining the corresponding Mystical Power of the Great Emperor through devouring their corpse. Now that he knew, he naturally would not make another mistake.
The two Great Emperors exchanged blows. This time, there was no doubt. In Ling Han’s heaven and earth, everything was up to him to decide.
So what if the Three Purity Great Emperor fought with his life on the line? He was killed in just a few hundred moves.

Ling Han was neither sad nor happy. Speaking of which, the Lords of Death were also pitiful people who had been bewitched by the old Divine Beast. Otherwise, they might have been companions who would fight side by side.
His soul retreated from the heaven and earth of his body, and returned to his mind. He set his eyes on another Lord of Death.

Sea Emperor, Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperor, Void Emperor, one after another, Lords of Death were killed by Ling Han. However, the old Divine Beast seemed to have made up his mind, and had no intention of making a move at all.
In just a few days, the Lords of Death were completely annihilated.
At this point, the only great villain left was the old Divine Beast.
However, this one character was 10,000 times more troublesome than all the Lords of Death combined.

For the moment, the old Divine Beast was invincible. If he wanted to fight, he could. If he didn’t want to, no one could do anything to him. Even Ling Han was unable to stop him from continuing to dig out the Cave of Death, releasing the essence of death.
Ling Han arrived at the Sea of Death and tossed out the corpses of the Lords of Death.
However, just as these corpses were about to come into contact with the ocean’s surface, a large hand suddenly stretched out of the ocean’s waters, directly capturing all the corpses of the Emperors.
What!
Ling Han was shocked. He focused his gaze, and saw that the old Divine Beast had actually flown out of the great ocean.
How was this possible!
The Sea of Death could kill all Great Emperors, and even the old Divine Beast was no exception. How could he possibly lay in ambush in the Sea of Death?
However, Ling Han immediately came to a realization, because when the old Divine Beast flew up, the sea level actually dropped a bit.
He finally understood. As it turned out, the old Divine Beast, Ling Han, had disguised himself as a great ocean, covering the Sea of Death.

This was really a bold plan, because there would be columns of water rising from the Sea of Death at any moment, soaring straight into the skies. The old Divine Beast was lying in ambush here; just how many times would he have to be attacked?

That’s right. If a fifth tier Great Emperor Tier was touched by a column of water, even if he did not die, he would be severely injured. However, the old Divine Beast was different. He was the only second tier Great Emperor Tier in the world. Even if the deathly column of water had destructive power on him, he would definitely be able to withstand it for a short period of time.
However, since the old Divine Beast was here, then what about the island?
"Gaga, I have manifested millions of times, so how could you possibly know which one is my true self!" the old Divine Beast said proudly.

In fact, this wasn’t his personal Mystical Power, but an ability that he had obtained after engulfing the "Yinyang Beast". It wasn’t as terrifying as manifesting ten million clones. He only had one yin doppelganger and another yang doppelganger.
However, he had suddenly used this Mystical Power, and he had succeeded.

In truth, even if he did not say, Ling Han had no plans to leave the Great Emperor’s corpse for the old Divine Beast.
Previously, he had not known that the old Divine Beast was actually capable of obtaining the corresponding Mystical Power of the Great Emperor through devouring their corpse.
Now that he knew, he naturally would not make another mistake.
The two Great Emperors exchanged blows.
This time, there was no doubt.
In Ling Han’s heaven and earth, everything was up to him to decide.
So what if the Three Purity Great Emperor fought with his life on the line?
He was killed in just a few hundred moves.
Ling Han was neither sad nor happy.
Speaking of which, the Lords of Death were also pitiful people who had been bewitched by the old Divine Beast.
Otherwise, they might have been companions who would fight side by side.
His soul retreated from the heaven and earth of his body, and returned to his mind.
He set his eyes on another Lord of Death.
Sea Emperor, Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperor, Void Emperor, one after another, Lords of Death were killed by Ling Han.
However, the old Divine Beast seemed to have made up his mind, and had no intention of making a move at all.
In just a few days, the Lords of Death were completely annihilated.
At this point, the only great villain left was the old Divine Beast.
However, this one character was 10,000 times more troublesome than all the Lords of Death combined.
For the moment, the old Divine Beast was invincible.
If he wanted to fight, he could.
If he didn’t want to, no one could do anything to him.
Even Ling Han was unable to stop him from continuing to dig out the Cave of Death, releasing the essence of death.
Ling Han arrived at the Sea of Death and tossed out the corpses of the Lords of Death.
However, just as these corpses were about to come into contact with the ocean’s surface, a large hand suddenly stretched out of the ocean’s waters, directly capturing all the corpses of the Emperors.
What!
Ling Han was shocked.
He focused his gaze, and saw that the old Divine Beast had actually flown out of the great ocean.
How was this possible!
The Sea of Death could kill all Great Emperors, and even the old Divine Beast was no exception.
How could he possibly lay in ambush in the Sea of Death?
However, Ling Han immediately came to a realization, because when the old Divine Beast flew up, the sea level actually dropped a bit.
He finally understood.
As it turned out, the old Divine Beast, Ling Han, had disguised himself as a great ocean, covering the Sea of Death.
This was really a bold plan, because there would be columns of water rising from the Sea of Death at any moment, soaring straight into the skies.
The old Divine Beast was lying in ambush here; just how many times would he have to be attacked?
That’s right.
If a fifth tier Great Emperor Tier was touched by a column of water, even if he did not die, he would be severely injured.
However, the old Divine Beast was different.
He was the only second tier Great Emperor Tier in the world.
Even if the deathly column of water had destructive power on him, he would definitely be able to withstand it for a short period of time.
However, since the old Divine Beast was here, then what about the island?
"Gaga, I have manifested millions of times, so how could you possibly know which one is my true self!" the old Divine Beast said proudly.
In fact, this wasn’t his personal Mystical Power, but an ability that he had obtained after engulfing the "Yinyang Beast".
It wasn’t as terrifying as manifesting ten million clones.
He only had one yin doppelganger and another yang doppelganger.
However, he had suddenly used this Mystical Power, and he had succeeded.

chapters.title: Chapter 4875: Obtaining all Mystical Powers
paragraphs: Right in front of Ling Han, the old Divine Beast swallowed the corpses of the eleven Lords of Death.
In this battle, the old Divine Beast had achieved a complete victory.
The old Divine Beast cackled, appearing extremely pleased with itself.

After engulfing the corpses of the Emperors, he would be able to obtain corresponding abilities, thereby increasing his own battle prowess. Unfortunately, he would not be able to obtain the spiritual mark, or he would be even stronger.
"Young man, do you think that I have really allowed you to do as you please because I have no way to deal with you?" The old Divine Beast asked with a mocking smile.
Ling Han sighed internally. This time, he had really broken what he had given his word on.
He had always been the type to keep his promises.
"You used me to kill these Great Emperors to devour them," Ling Han said calmly.

"That’s right." The old Divine Beast nodded, "This kind of battle prowess is really useless to me. However, it would be different if it was swallowed by me. Combined with my battle prowess, I would be able to better display their strengths."
"For example—"
With a flash, he suddenly formed ten million clones of himself.
This was the ultimate move unique to the Ten Thousand Shadows Great Emperor!
It had been grasped so quickly by the old Divine Beast?
Heaven Devouring Beast, Heaven Devouring Beast, could it devour even the heavens?

"Young man, thank you for killing these fools!" The old Divine Beast mocked Ling Han to its heart’s content. In the previous battle, he had not been able to do anything to Ling Han, but in this battle, he had achieved a complete victory.
Though his abilities were stronger, he was unable to kill all the Great Emperors, and had to accomplish their deaths through Ling Han’s hand.
Ling Han looked at the old Divine Beast, and his fighting spirit began to soar.
"What is it? Can’t swallow this anger?" The old Divine Beast provoked, its eyes similarly filled with killing intent.
This area should be the limit of their ability to leave the island. If they went any further, they would really not be able to sense the essence of life.
They had long since exceeded the limit of their lifespans. Thus, if they went any further, they may lose their vitality in an instant, and die directly.
Perhaps, this was a good opportunity to kill Ling Han.

If the Great Emperor wanted to flee, it would really be very difficult to stop him, what more when Ling Han was only slightly weaker than him. Thus, he had to coordinate with the right time and place. Only then would he have the chance to kill Ling Han.
Now... this was really not too bad.
The old Divine Beast transformed into ten million clones that surrounded Ling Han.
"Die!"

This time, the old Divine Beast transformed into a middle-aged man again. Tens of thousands of them attacked at the same time, tapping out a finger at Ling Han. Instantly, tens of thousands of Demonic Sunflowers bloomed beside Ling Han.
This was the Black Sunflower Demon Emperor’s ability!
Ling Han released a battle cry, channelled the element of destruction, and attacked with all his might.
Peng, peng, peng! Images of fists interwove, and the Demonic Sunflowers fell one after another.

"Young man, I really have to thank you," the old Divine Beast said with a smile. "Though I have practically devoured all the Divine Beasts, the Divine Beasts were created by the heaven and earth, so their abilities are not strong. They are not like you Great Emperors that have cultivated, and truly have your own strengths."
"And now, my ability has truly been unleashed!"
Hong! Hong! Hong!

The old Divine Beast attacked continuously, and the ultimate moves of the Lords of Death were launched one after another. Coupled with the three key elements that he had grasped, the might was even more terrifying.
Tens of thousands of old Divine Beasts were chanting the Six Characters Bright King Curse at the same time. What kind of concept was this?
The Sea of Death was also howling, setting off waves that were as tall as 30,000 meters, that surged madly in all directions.
Ling Han had a feeling that he was not fighting with the old Divine Beast, but rather twelve Lords of Death who had obtained the strength of the old Divine Beast!
This was the true trump card that the old Divine Beast had laid out!

—If the Lords of Death successfully caused the two Realms of Yin and Yang to collide, that would be the best result. He would then be able to take advantage of the opening of the Cave of Death to comprehend the essence of death.
However, if the Lords of Death failed, then after retreating here, he would still have a chance to devour these Great Emperors and obtain their abilities.
Of course, the latter was actually very coincidental. Ling Han would have to have the ability to kill these Great Emperors.
However, starting from the fact that Ling Han was able to kill the Lords of Death, the old Divine Beast should be planning for the latter.

He had deliberately battled with Ling Han for seven million years, and then pretended to be helpless, his whole heart intent on digging out the Cave of Death. In the end, he had sold off the remaining Lords of Death, and his purpose was to devour them.
Such deliberate planning!
What an old fox.
Ling Han had to admit that he had underestimated this old Divine Beast.

He was too smooth-sailing, successfully advancing into Emperor Tier. In fact, he had even cultivated two main elements, causing even those ancient Great Emperors to blush with shame at their own inferiority. In the battle with the old Divine Beast, though he was at a disadvantage, the old Divine Beast was also exasperated.
Everything was saying that as long as he grasped another key element, he would be able to deal with the old Divine Beast, and return peace to the world.
He had never imagined that this was actually a trap laid out by the old Divine Beast.
Ling Han had already been careful enough. He had come so far to bury the Lords of Death, yet he had still fallen for the old Divine Beast’s trick.
"You’re actually transformed from a fox, right?" Ling Han asked. Now that things had come to this, regret was useless. He had to face reality.
After a moment of dejection, Ling Han regained his confidence.
The old Divine Beast could become stronger, so could he.

"I am Heaven Devouring, destined to devour the heavens, and become the new heavens!" The old Divine Beast declared proudly. Boom, with a wave of his hand, countless Yin Rivers shot out like silk, striking towards Ling Han.
Ling Han released a battle cry, the element of destruction entwined around his fists, as he charged towards the countless old Divine Beasts.
This element of destruction was much more terrifying than Destructive Energy. This was the cornerstone of heaven and earth, and could destroy anything.
Hong! Hong! Hong!

Ling Han threw punch after punch, and one after another, the old Divine Beasts were destroyed by him. However, if it was just his doppelgangers, they would not be able to block the terrifying element of destruction at all.
However, every time Ling Han killed a doppelganger, a new one would appear, and there was no end to it.

The old Divine Beast laughed proudly. Previously, his offensive methods were at a disadvantage due to the limited variety, but after obtaining the Mystical Powers that belonged to the Lords of Death, his strength was finally completely unleashed.
The power that he had cultivated was completely different from what the heaven and earth had bestowed on him.
"Young man, die!" The old Divine Beast laughed loudly, "You can’t stop me. No one can stop me!"
Ling Han said calmly, "So what if you have grasped all four fundamental elements? Are you planning to destroy the heaven and earth?"

"What do you know!" The old Divine Beast sneered, "I was created by the heaven and earth, so I can peek into destiny! This world will eventually be destroyed, and by then, no matter how strong you are, you will be buried alongside the heaven and earth."

The universe was already beginning to collapse. Though it would take an incredibly long time, there would indeed come a day when this heaven and earth would return to its original state. At that time, all living beings would die.
"Unless!"
The old Divine Beast continued, "Exterminate this heaven and earth, and replace it!"

"So, you want to obtain all four elements and grasp the foundation stones of heaven and earth?" Ling Han shook his head, and said, "In this way, even if you can achieve immortality, what’s the point if it would only be you alone?"
Strength needed to be contrasted by weakness; otherwise, it would be meaningless.
It was the same for eternal life.
If he was all alone, what was the point of living?
"You, don’t, understand!" The old Divine Beast continued to attack, "The path of elites is naturally to rush as far ahead as possible!"

chapters.title: Chapter 4876: Backhand
paragraphs: Ling Han shook his head, and said, "We walk different paths, so we can’t work together!"
He had a different idea. There was absolutely no need for him to destroy this world, and take its place. Instead, he himself would become a new world.

This was just like a willow tree. There was absolutely no need to eradicate it and plant it again. Instead, one could break off one of its branches, and it would be able to root and sprout, turning it into a new tree.
Of course, Ling Han wasn’t sure if he could withstand the terrifying power of this world that had been compressed back to its original point, even if he had formed his own heaven and earth.
However, he would rather give it a try.
This was the difference between him and the Lords of Death, and the old Divine Beast.
The two of them did not speak further, and merely continued their fierce battle.
The old Divine Beast was continuously developing the abilities that he had just obtained, and as his proficiency level increased, his battle prowess was also becoming more and more terrifying.
"Found you!" Ling Han shouted lightly, and charged rapidly towards an old Divine Beast, brandishing his fists repeatedly.
"So what?" The old Divine Beast humphed. His strength was superior to Ling Han, so even if his true self was discovered, so what?

However, in order to familiarize himself with his abilities, he immediately retracted the doppelgangers that filled the sky. As long as he manifested them again, Ling Han would again have to spend a long time to find him.
However, right at this moment, a pair of flaming wings suddenly flapped behind Ling Han’s back.
Phoenix Wings Divine Flight!
His figure suddenly sped up, and grabbed hold of the old Divine Beast in a single move.

"Are you seeking death?" the old Divine Beast asked disdainfully. This was not a street brawl, and you actually dare to engage in close-quarter combat. This was really embarrassing for a Great Emperor.
Ling Han smiled. Boom! His wings flapped again, and he actually dragged the old Divine Beast down into the sea.
This time, even the old Divine Beast’s expression changed drastically.
F***, Ling Han was trying to take him down with him.
However, an instant later, a baleful expression appeared on his face.
’Great!’
It should be known that he had obtained the Mystical Power of the Yinyang Beast. He could split into two bodies, and this was his Yin Body. Even if this body died, he still had his Yang Body.
That’s right. This would definitely affect his strength, but once Ling Han died, who would be able to threaten him?
Moreover, the least valuable thing on the Imperial Island was time. He could completely cultivate another Yin body, and it would only be a few hundred million years.
"I’ll oblige you!" The old Divine Beast also turned around to grab hold of Ling Han. At the same time, he also began to speed up, and took the initiative to fall towards the Sea of Death.
The two Great Emperors both exerted force to descend. This naturally could not be stopped.
Tong!
The two of them fell into the sea at the same time. Furthermore, in order to prevent the other from escaping, they were still holding onto each other.

The endless power of death assaulted, and the old Divine Beast immediately felt its vitality being extinguished. Even if there was still the element of Life here, they were far inferior to the power of death, and the loss of life was far greater than the replenishment.
Death... was coming!
However, he broke into a grin, because Ling Han was also about to die.
Haha, this was a worthwhile price to pay!
His hands gradually became weak, and he was no longer able to grab onto Ling Han. His body continued to sink.
But right at this moment, he suddenly saw Ling Han’s arms suddenly spread out, and he rapidly floated towards the surface of the sea.
F***, what was going on?
’He, he didn’t die?’

The old Divine Beast was stunned at this moment. His eyes widened, and he wanted to grab Ling Han. However, his vitality was about to be exterminated, so what strength did he have left? He could only watch helplessly as Ling Han continued to rise.
Why? Why!

He knew that Ling Han’s vitality was exuberant. Previously, no matter how heavy a blow he sustained, he would always be able to recover very quickly. However, this was the Sea of Death, which was filled with the power of death, and even he would be killed.
How had Ling Han managed to survive? Was he even more powerful than him?
However, he no longer had the strength to figure it out. His body had already sunk into the depths of the Sea of Death.
Peng!
Ling Han came out of the water and immediately returned to the Imperial Island.

In such a short period of time, he had already exhausted all the element of Life in his body. If the main body of the old Divine Beast charged over and forced him into the sea, he would definitely be done for.
After landing on the Imperial Island, the element of Life was immediately replenished.
Ling Han breathed a sigh of relief, a smile appearing at the corners of his lips.
The previous battle could be considered multiple turns of events.

First, he fell for a trick, and "gifted" the corpses of the Lords of Death to the old Divine Beast. However, he immediately counterattacked, putting an act of wanting to die together with the old Divine Beast. He dragged the old Divine Beast into the Sea of Death with him, and successfully destroyed one of his doppelgangers.
This wasn’t the type of doppelgangers that Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperor had. They were the Yin and Yang Bodies, which naturally caused severe damage to the old Divine Beast.
Lose first, then win, and successfully turn the tables.
However, the old Divine Beast was not without gains either. He had obtained all the abilities of the Lords of Death, and even if only the main body was left, it was still unbelievably strong.

Ling Han decided to continue comprehending the fundamental element of creation. Only by grasping the three fundamental elements would he be qualified to truly stand against the old Divine Beast, or even kill this monster.
"Ao!" On the island, the furious roar of the old Divine Beast was heard.
This was understandable. An incredibly important doppelganger had died just like that, so how could the old Divine Beast not be furious?
Ling Han ignored him and continued to study the fundamental element of creation.
This created another dilemma for Ling Han.

Ling Han had only been able to grasp the fundamental element of destruction because he had already learned Destructive Energy. As for the fundamental element of creation... he hadn’t grasped Creative Energy.
The four elements conflicted with each other, and had a strong exclusivity, so they could not be cultivated simultaneously.
However, since Ling Han dared to try, he naturally had some confidence.
What could he do?
Since the elements repelled one another, he would make use of this repulsive force.
Inside Ling Han’s body, the two elements repelled each other. If Ling Han hadn’t created a heaven and earth for them, they would definitely have torn Ling Han’s body apart.
However, precisely because the two elements repelled each other, would it be possible to maintain this situation while comprehending the element of creation?
Ling Han believed that this would instead be easier than other Great Emperors comprehending the second element.

—He had already imparted his experience. The other Great Emperors could not imitate him, but Ding Shu, Jing Haoran and Shui Qingchang should be able to give it a try. After all, they were also the Genesis World’s rulers, and had grasped Destructive Energy, so it was possible that they could structure the heaven and earth.
If Ding Shu and the others could also advance to the third tier, or even the second tier, then if they joined forces, the old Divine Beast would really die.
However, the road was long. They were too difficult to cultivate.
Ling Han didn’t pay any attention to others. He simply immersed himself in his own world, studying the fundamental element of creation.
Creation was the complete opposite of destruction, just like life was the opposite of death.

Ling Han made use of the repulsion of the elements of life and destruction, and took advantage of the opportunity to comprehend the element of cretaion. However, even if the two great elements were competing with each other, a powerful repulsive force was still created, to prevent Ling Han from grasping the element of creation.
Thus, his progress was overwhelmingly slow.
However, it was still the same thing. On the Imperial Island, the least valuable thing was time.

What Ling Han had to do was to compete in speed with the old Divine Beast. If he first grasped the key element to creation, he would possess strength that could completely match the old Divine Beast, and possibly even surpass it.
On the other hand, if the old Divine Beast first grasped the essence of death, then everything would be over.

Tong!
The two of them fell into the sea at the same time.
Furthermore, in order to prevent the other from escaping, they were still holding onto each other.
The endless power of death assaulted, and the old Divine Beast immediately felt its vitality being extinguished.
Even if there was still the element of Life here, they were far inferior to the power of death, and the loss of life was far greater than the replenishment.
Death... was coming!
However, he broke into a grin, because Ling Han was also about to die.
Haha, this was a worthwhile price to pay!
His hands gradually became weak, and he was no longer able to grab onto Ling Han.
His body continued to sink.
But right at this moment, he suddenly saw Ling Han’s arms suddenly spread out, and he rapidly floated towards the surface of the sea.
F***, what was going on?
’He, he didn’t die?’
The old Divine Beast was stunned at this moment.
His eyes widened, and he wanted to grab Ling Han.
However, his vitality was about to be exterminated, so what strength did he have left?
He could only watch helplessly as Ling Han continued to rise.
Why?
Why!
He knew that Ling Han’s vitality was exuberant.
Previously, no matter how heavy a blow he sustained, he would always be able to recover very quickly.
However, this was the Sea of Death, which was filled with the power of death, and even he would be killed.
How had Ling Han managed to survive?
Was he even more powerful than him?
However, he no longer had the strength to figure it out.
His body had already sunk into the depths of the Sea of Death.
Peng!
Ling Han came out of the water and immediately returned to the Imperial Island.
In such a short period of time, he had already exhausted all the element of Life in his body.
If the main body of the old Divine Beast charged over and forced him into the sea, he would definitely be done for.
After landing on the Imperial Island, the element of Life was immediately replenished.
Ling Han breathed a sigh of relief, a smile appearing at the corners of his lips.
The previous battle could be considered multiple turns of events.
First, he fell for a trick, and "gifted" the corpses of the Lords of Death to the old Divine Beast.
However, he immediately counterattacked, putting an act of wanting to die together with the old Divine Beast.
He dragged the old Divine Beast into the Sea of Death with him, and successfully destroyed one of his doppelgangers.
This wasn’t the type of doppelgangers that Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperor had.
They were the Yin and Yang Bodies, which naturally caused severe damage to the old Divine Beast.
Lose first, then win, and successfully turn the tables.
However, the old Divine Beast was not without gains either.
He had obtained all the abilities of the Lords of Death, and even if only the main body was left, it was still unbelievably strong.
Ling Han decided to continue comprehending the fundamental element of creation.
Only by grasping the three fundamental elements would he be qualified to truly stand against the old Divine Beast, or even kill this monster.
"Ao!" On the island, the furious roar of the old Divine Beast was heard.
This was understandable.
An incredibly important doppelganger had died just like that, so how could the old Divine Beast not be furious?
Ling Han ignored him and continued to study the fundamental element of creation.
This created another dilemma for Ling Han.
Ling Han had only been able to grasp the fundamental element of destruction because he had already learned Destructive Energy.
As for the fundamental element of creation... he hadn’t grasped Creative Energy.
The four elements conflicted with each other, and had a strong exclusivity, so they could not be cultivated simultaneously.
However, since Ling Han dared to try, he naturally had some confidence.
What could he do?
Since the elements repelled one another, he would make use of this repulsive force.
Inside Ling Han’s body, the two elements repelled each other.
If Ling Han hadn’t created a heaven and earth for them, they would definitely have torn Ling Han’s body apart.
However, precisely because the two elements repelled each other, would it be possible to maintain this situation while comprehending the element of creation?
Ling Han believed that this would instead be easier than other Great Emperors comprehending the second element.
—He had already imparted his experience.
The other Great Emperors could not imitate him, but Ding Shu, Jing Haoran and Shui Qingchang should be able to give it a try.
After all, they were also the Genesis World’s rulers, and had grasped Destructive Energy, so it was possible that they could structure the heaven and earth.
If Ding Shu and the others could also advance to the third tier, or even the second tier, then if they joined forces, the old Divine Beast would really die.
However, the road was long.
They were too difficult to cultivate.
Ling Han didn’t pay any attention to others.
He simply immersed himself in his own world, studying the fundamental element of creation.
Creation was the complete opposite of destruction, just like life was the opposite of death.
Ling Han made use of the repulsion of the elements of life and destruction, and took advantage of the opportunity to comprehend the element of cretaion.
However, even if the two great elements were competing with each other, a powerful repulsive force was still created, to prevent Ling Han from grasping the element of creation.
Thus, his progress was overwhelmingly slow.
However, it was still the same thing.
On the Imperial Island, the least valuable thing was time.
What Ling Han had to do was to compete in speed with the old Divine Beast.
If he first grasped the key element to creation, he would possess strength that could completely match the old Divine Beast, and possibly even surpass it.
On the other hand, if the old Divine Beast first grasped the essence of death, then everything would be over.

chapters.title: Chapter 4877: Hope
paragraphs: Ling Han continued to comprehend the fundamental element of creation.
This time, he was really trying to seek survival in the crevice. He made use of the mutual repulsion between the two great factors, and from there, comprehended the essence of creation bit by bit.
His speed was overwhelmingly slow.
But no matter how slow it was, it was still improvement.

What Ling Han had to do was to race with the old Divine Beast, and in the case of the old Divine Beast, it would still need a very, very long time to dig out the Cave of Death. He could still afford the time.

One million years, two million years, three million years... On this Imperial Island, it was as if the passing of time had not brought about any change. The cultivation levels of the Great Emperors had long since stopped improving. Their purpose here was to delay the old Divine Beast.
There were only a few exceptions.
Ling Han, Ding Shu, Jing Haoran, Shui Qingchang, and of course, the old Divine Beast, who was slowly approaching the Cave of Death.
This was his goal, and it seemed like it was also his life goal.

The Great Emperors were naturally still stopping the old Divine Beast, but after the old Divine Beast had swallowed the Lords of Death, its battle prowess had increased greatly. However, using the means of the Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperor to manifest millions of doppelgangers was extremely troublesome to the Great Emperors. They couldn’t effectively slow down the old Divine Beast at all.

Now, Ling Han and the old Divine Beast were both racing against time. On the surface, neither of them could do anything to the other, but in truth, as long as one of them could attain a breakthrough, the victor would be decided between them, or even life or death.
Ten million years, twenty million years, time continued to fly by.
Ling Han’s grasp of the fundamental element of creation had improved, but he was still very far from truly grasping it and being able to accommodate it into his body.
Meanwhile, Ding Shu, Shui Qingchang, and Jing Haoran were also cultivating in seclusion.

If they could also absorb the element and advance into the third tier, then even if their battle prowess was inferior to Ling Han’s, it would be four third tiers against a single second tier, which might really be able to stop the old Divine Beast.
A draw was within reach!

Thus, all the Great Emperors felt a strong hope rise up in them. Previously, they had released the Stone of Life in an attempt to break out of this dilemma. After so many years, the plans that they had previously laid out were finally effective.

They were filled with motivation. Even if they were completely no match for the old Divine Beast, so what? Every day, they would charge, be injured, and go to the Cave of Life to experience the power of life; it was an endless cycle.
"Sigh, Saintly Material is also unreliable!" The large black dog said gloomily, "It actually broke Grandpa Dog’s underpants!"
In the battle with the old Divine Beast, even a Great Emperor’s body was damaged, what more Saintly Material.
Thus, the large black dog’s iron underwear was already in tatters.

"Hehe, why don’t you say that the old Divine Beast is interested in your behind?" The little azure dragon snickered. However, after so many years, he finally reached the standard of maturity and became a great azure dragon.
However, his temperament was already deeply ingrained in his bones, and there was not the slightest difference from before.

"Scram!" The large black dog bared his teeth. There were a great many wounds on his body that were deep enough to reach his internal organs. The moment he moved, he would feel pain. Previously, he had only been deliberately diverting his attention.
It was already in such a miserable state, and what about the others?
The lower half of Brother Monkey’s body was directly severed, and the azure dragon also lost two claws. One of the little red bird’s wings was forcefully ripped off.
However, the most miserable was still the Battle Saint Emperor. The upper half of his body had been obliterated, and only his two legs remained.
However, as long as the soul imprint was not destroyed, they would not truly die, and could be nurtured and revived by the essence of life.

"Great-grandson, good job!" Though the Battle Saint Emperor was only left with the lower half of his body, his divine sense had already been nurtured, so it was naturally no problem for him to transmit a message through divine sense.
"Hehe!" Brother Monkey bared his mouth in a grin. "Old Sun can still fight another 300 rounds!"
"Good, as expected of my descendant!" The Battle Saint Emperor laughed loudly.
Everyone gritted their teeth as they watched.
Of the two generations of Monkey Kings, one was only left with the upper half, while the other was only left with the lower half. If the two were put together, they could form one.
’Heh, those who don’t know would think that there’s something wrong with you people. You’re deliberately severing yourselves into two so that you can speak to yourself.’
"I hope Little Han comes out of seclusion as soon as possible," the large black dog said. "Otherwise, I won’t be able to continue living like this."
He would be severely wounded and killed every few days. This was really too f dark.
Just think, damn it, it had always been invincible with its words. When had it ever suffered such injustice?
The little azure dragon nodded as well. At that time, their show-off trio had been glorious and invincible, but now? They were being beaten madly by an old Divine Beast.
Most importantly, it wasn’t strange to lose in a fight; who hadn’t lost before?
However, after tens of millions of years of being beaten by the same character, that would really be very, very vexing.
"We can only wait."
"I hope Little Han Han comes out of seclusion as soon as possible."

However, Ling Han’s progress was clearly far slower than they had imagined. Another 300 million years had passed, and Ling Han still showed no signs of coming out of seclusion, making Brother Monkey and the others anxious.
’It can’t be... that he is unable to break through, right?’
However, the Great Emperors were completely unconcerned.
Just how many years had they battled here for?
Billions and billions of years!
300 million years was only a matter of taking a nap for them, and was not considered much at all, all right?
Peng!
Right at this moment, a loud sound was heard, and the whole Imperial Island trembled slightly.
What was going on?
"Little Han has come out of seclusion!" The large black dog immediately jumped up.
"That’s right. Aside from Little Han coming out of seclusion, it can’t possibly cause such a big commotion," the little azure dragon also said.
Even the empress, Chi Menghan, and the other women looked expectant. Was their freakish husband about to perform another miracle?
However, when they rushed over to take a look, they saw that the person who had come out of seclusion was actually Jing Haoran.
"Yi, you all know that I have broken through, so have come to congratulate me?" Jing Haoran said with a smile, looking like he was asking for a beating.
As one of the seven Genesis World’s rulers, it was truly a miracle that he had survived until now.
Everyone was disappointed. They had initially thought that Ling Han had come out of seclusion.
"Hey, hey, hey, what’s with your expressions!" Jing Haoran bared his teeth, "For better or worse, I have now grasped two key elements, and am an elite among elites."
Boom!
Right at this moment, a loud bang rang out again, and another figure appeared, shapely and beautiful.
Shui Qingchang.
She had also broken through, and become a third tier Great Emperor.
"Are you guys going to let me cultivate properly?" Ding Shu also walked out. The aura he exuded was clearly different, and had become much stronger.
The three Genesis World’s rulers, after experiencing more than 300 million years of seclusion, successfully grasped the elements of destruction, and became the strongest below the old Divine Beast.
This time, the strength of their side had increased greatly.
"If Ling Han comes out of seclusion, we’ll definitely be able to kill the old Divine Beast!" the little red bird said.
"That’s right. Now, all we have to do is wait for Little Han," the large black dog said with a grin. Finally, he didn’t need to be severely wounded and killed every few days.
Invigorating!
"Haha, then let’s go and meet that old Divine Beast first," Ding Shu said heroically.
"Let’s go!" Jing Haoran also looked lazy.
They did not have any pride?
Of course not.
As the Genesis World’s rulers, they were actually extremely proud. How could they be willing to always be under Ling Han’s lead?
This time, Ling Han was in seclusion, so they would be the ones to pacify the situation.

chapters.title: Chapter 4878: Severed Route
paragraphs: Ding Shu and the others led the way, and the Great Emperors charged towards the Cave of Death.
In truth, the battles at the Cave of Death had never stopped. Only the heavily injured and dead Great Emperors would go to the Cave of Life to recover, forming a cycle of battles.
However, when everyone rushed to the Cave of Death, they shockingly discovered that the battles here had actually stopped.
What was going on here?

"A few days ago, the old Divine Beast suddenly sent us flying. Then, it used rocks to block the passageway. We have to first move the rocks away before we can continue our attack," the Great Emperor Wu Ya said.
The heaven and earth structure of the Imperial Island was too sturdy. Even if it was a Great Emperor, it would not be an easy task to break through the pile of rocks.
Furthermore, the old Divine Beast had blasted people out of the cave first, and then began to block the hole. Just how long was this passage?
Thus, cleaning up the rubble was also a difficult task.
"We’ll do it!" Ding Shu and the others stepped out. They had grasped the essence of destruction, so they were very suited to digging pits.
—The reason why the old Divine Beast could advance so rapidly was naturally also because he had grasped the essence of destruction. Otherwise, his progress would be much slower.

Moreover, this was only filled with rocks, and they were not starting from the very beginning. Naturally, the difficulty level would decrease further, and could not be compared to the old Divine Beast.
The three Genesis World’s rulers began to clear the rocks to create a hole.

"Do you feel anything? Ever since we came here, our class has suddenly decreased," the large black dog said. "Not only do we have to be beaten by the same character every day, but we also have to do jobs like mining."

Er, it was clearly a battle between Great Emperors, and for the sake of protecting all life in the world, such a sacred and noble cause, why did has it changed so drastically, coming out of your mouth?
"Only you!" Everyone pointed at the large black dog, looking like they wanted to draw a clear dividing line between them.

In terms of strength, the large black dog definitely wouldn’t be able to become the strongest in this lifetime. However, to be so despicable that even the Great Emperors would reject him, that was the height that the old Divine Beast had reached.
From this aspect, the large black dog had really lived enough in this lifetime.
In any case, they had nothing else to do, so the large black dog continued to chatter and joke around with the others.
This was called being flexible. Obviously, once the passageway was dug out, it would be another arduous battle.
Ten years, a hundred years, a thousand years. This passageway was long in the first place, and even Ding Shu and the others would need some time to destroy the solid matter here.
Thus, even after 1000 years, they still hadn’t dug to the end.
However, going by everyone’s experience, they would be able to dig to the end in another twenty years, at most.
—The old Divine Beast was progressing even slower on his side, so how many feet could he dig in over a thousand years?
Thus, as long as they dug to the end of the tunnel, they would be able to encounter the old Divine Beast.
"However, don’t you guys find it strange?" The large black dog scratched its head, "That old Divine Beast doesn’t take us seriously at all, so why did it suddenly block the path?"
Yes, this was indeed very strange.

Previously, though the Great Emperors had tried their best to stop him, the truth was that the old Divine Beast had not been affected at all. It was just that he had nothing better to do, so he could use the Great Emperors to pass some time. Otherwise, as long as he was willing to pay some price, it was not impossible for him to annihilate all the Great Emperors.
But now, he was actually blocking the way?
The possibility that he had a premonition that Ding Shu and the others would break through was too small.

Furthermore, though Ding Shu and the others had advanced into third tier, their battle prowess was still no match for Ling Han. Thus, there was absolutely no reason for the old Divine Beast to be afraid.
"There must be something fishy about this!" the large black dog concluded.
It was the ancestor of trickery, and immediately felt that something was off.
"Could it be that we should allow that old beast to do as it pleases?" Ancestral King Lingtian frowned.

"Grandpa Dog feels that it would be better to wait for Little Han to come out of seclusion. Our power is still inferior to the old Divine Beast. Don’t let him defeat us one by one, and ruin the good hand of cards that we have been dealt," the large black dog said very seriously.
At this time, it was really very serious — if it had not used its claws to scratch its behind.
All the Emperors were speechless. This despicable dog always managed to ruin the atmosphere. It was clearly a tense time.
Moreover, he even said that the class of events had decreased. With you here, how could the level of class be any higher?

However, what the large black dog said was indeed reasonable. After all, it was the ancestor of being despicable. Its thoughts could be used as reference. Who knows, it may really be able to hit the nail on the old Divine Beast’s idea.
They went to ask Ding Shu and the others, and voiced everyone’s concerns.
"It’s all right. We have already grasped the essence of destruction. If the three of us join forces, even if we are no match for that old beast, the gap would not be too big," Ding Shu said.
"Moreover, this place is filled with the essence of life. As long as the old beast hasn’t grasped the essence of death, it can’t possibly kill us," Jing Haoran said.
"Precisely because of this, we have to find the old Divine Beast as soon as possible to stop him from continuing to dig," Shui Qingchang added.
Er, these words were quite logical.
Though the old Divine Beast was strong, without grasping the essence of death, he had absolutely no ability to kill Great Emperors — it was not like Ling Han, who could absorb Regulations himself.
Thus, even if there was a shock, they wouldn’t be in danger.
The Emperors couldn’t convince Ding Shu and the others, so they could only let them continue.

"Not good!" The large black dog shook his head, and said, "These three people are dissatisfied with being suppressed by Little Han all this while, so they’re trying their best to do something. They’ve already surpassed Little Han, so they’re no longer rational."
"However, they have a point. In this place, aside from Little Han, who can kill Great Emperors, even the old Divine Beast can’t," the little azure dragon said.
"Believe Grandpa Dog, that old b@stard is definitely up to something!" the large black dog said with absolute certainty.

"Then what do you think we should do?" the empress asked. She still trusted the large black dog quite a bit, and when it came to devious ideas, there was no one that was better at it than the large black dog.

The large black dog pondered for a moment, and said, "We’ll observe the situation. If things go awry, we’ll immediately retreat into the Cave of Creation. No matter what, we have to protect Little Han."
Faced with the unknown, it could not think of a way to deal with it.
"En." Everyone nodded.
"But, Old Black, could it be that you can also be serious for once? This is really unexpected!"
The large black dog sneered, "Grandpa Dog has always been very reliable, all right!"
"En." Everyone nodded again, but the expressions on their faces... were saying ’yeah, right’.
Everyone sat down and waited quietly.
At most, the answer would be revealed in twenty to thirty years.
Peng!
37 years later, a muffled sound came from the cave.
It was clear!
All the Great Emperors hurriedly stood up. They were going to battle with the old Divine Beast again.
"My hands are itching to kill!" The Battle Saint Emperor gripped his staff.
"So is Old Sun." Brother Monkey was also rubbing his fists. However, his Saintly Material staff was completely useless here. He had already thrown it away, and now, he could only fight bare-handed.
Thankfully, he was already a fourth tier Great Emperor, so the effects of the Imperial Weapon would also be limited.
Boom!

Amidst a huge commotion, Ding Shu and the others rushed out of the cave, and behind them, the old Divine Beast that had transformed into an elegant scholar slowly walked out, looking calm and composed.
"Kaka, have you all come to seek death?"
