Furthermore, the old Divine Beast had blasted people out of the cave first, and then began to block the hole.
Just how long was this passage?
Thus, cleaning up the rubble was also a difficult task.
"We’ll do it!" Ding Shu and the others stepped out.
They had grasped the essence of destruction, so they were very suited to digging pits.
—The reason why the old Divine Beast could advance so rapidly was naturally also because he had grasped the essence of destruction.
Otherwise, his progress would be much slower.
Moreover, this was only filled with rocks, and they were not starting from the very beginning.
Naturally, the difficulty level would decrease further, and could not be compared to the old Divine Beast.
The three Genesis World’s rulers began to clear the rocks to create a hole.
"Do you feel anything?
Ever since we came here, our class has suddenly decreased," the large black dog said.
"Not only do we have to be beaten by the same character every day, but we also have to do jobs like mining."

Er, it was clearly a battle between Great Emperors, and for the sake of protecting all life in the world, such a sacred and noble cause, why did has it changed so drastically, coming out of your mouth?
"Only you!" Everyone pointed at the large black dog, looking like they wanted to draw a clear dividing line between them.
In terms of strength, the large black dog definitely wouldn’t be able to become the strongest in this lifetime.
However, to be so despicable that even the Great Emperors would reject him, that was the height that the old Divine Beast had reached.
From this aspect, the large black dog had really lived enough in this lifetime.
In any case, they had nothing else to do, so the large black dog continued to chatter and joke around with the others.
This was called being flexible.
Obviously, once the passageway was dug out, it would be another arduous battle.
Ten years, a hundred years, a thousand years.
This passageway was long in the first place, and even Ding Shu and the others would need some time to destroy the solid matter here.
Thus, even after 1000 years, they still hadn’t dug to the end.
However, going by everyone’s experience, they would be able to dig to the end in another twenty years, at most.
—The old Divine Beast was progressing even slower on his side, so how many feet could he dig in over a thousand years?
Thus, as long as they dug to the end of the tunnel, they would be able to encounter the old Divine Beast.
"However, don’t you guys find it strange?" The large black dog scratched its head, "That old Divine Beast doesn’t take us seriously at all, so why did it suddenly block the path?"
Yes, this was indeed very strange.
Previously, though the Great Emperors had tried their best to stop him, the truth was that the old Divine Beast had not been affected at all.
It was just that he had nothing better to do, so he could use the Great Emperors to pass some time.
Otherwise, as long as he was willing to pay some price, it was not impossible for him to annihilate all the Great Emperors.
But now, he was actually blocking the way?
The possibility that he had a premonition that Ding Shu and the others would break through was too small.
Furthermore, though Ding Shu and the others had advanced into third tier, their battle prowess was still no match for Ling Han.
Thus, there was absolutely no reason for the old Divine Beast to be afraid.
"There must be something fishy about this!" the large black dog concluded.
It was the ancestor of trickery, and immediately felt that something was off.
"Could it be that we should allow that old beast to do as it pleases?" Ancestral King Lingtian frowned.
"Grandpa Dog feels that it would be better to wait for Little Han to come out of seclusion.
Our power is still inferior to the old Divine Beast.
Don’t let him defeat us one by one, and ruin the good hand of cards that we have been dealt," the large black dog said very seriously.
At this time, it was really very serious — if it had not used its claws to scratch its behind.
All the Emperors were speechless.
This despicable dog always managed to ruin the atmosphere.
It was clearly a tense time.
Moreover, he even said that the class of events had decreased.
With you here, how could the level of class be any higher?
However, what the large black dog said was indeed reasonable.
After all, it was the ancestor of being despicable.
Its thoughts could be used as reference.
Who knows, it may really be able to hit the nail on the old Divine Beast’s idea.
They went to ask Ding Shu and the others, and voiced everyone’s concerns.
"It’s all right.
We have already grasped the essence of destruction.
If the three of us join forces, even if we are no match for that old beast, the gap would not be too big," Ding Shu said.
"Moreover, this place is filled with the essence of life.
As long as the old beast hasn’t grasped the essence of death, it can’t possibly kill us," Jing Haoran said.
"Precisely because of this, we have to find the old Divine Beast as soon as possible to stop him from continuing to dig," Shui Qingchang added.
Er, these words were quite logical.
Though the old Divine Beast was strong, without grasping the essence of death, he had absolutely no ability to kill Great Emperors — it was not like Ling Han, who could absorb Regulations himself.
Thus, even if there was a shock, they wouldn’t be in danger.
The Emperors couldn’t convince Ding Shu and the others, so they could only let them continue.
"Not good!" The large black dog shook his head, and said, "These three people are dissatisfied with being suppressed by Little Han all this while, so they’re trying their best to do something.
They’ve already surpassed Little Han, so they’re no longer rational."
"However, they have a point.
In this place, aside from Little Han, who can kill Great Emperors, even the old Divine Beast can’t," the little azure dragon said.
"Believe Grandpa Dog, that old b@stard is definitely up to something!" the large black dog said with absolute certainty.
"Then what do you think we should do?" the empress asked.
She still trusted the large black dog quite a bit, and when it came to devious ideas, there was no one that was better at it than the large black dog.
The large black dog pondered for a moment, and said, "We’ll observe the situation.
If things go awry, we’ll immediately retreat into the Cave of Creation.
No matter what, we have to protect Little Han."
Faced with the unknown, it could not think of a way to deal with it.
"En." Everyone nodded.
"But, Old Black, could it be that you can also be serious for once?
This is really unexpected!"
The large black dog sneered, "Grandpa Dog has always been very reliable, all right!"
"En." Everyone nodded again, but the expressions on their faces... were saying ’yeah, right’.
Everyone sat down and waited quietly.
At most, the answer would be revealed in twenty to thirty years.
Peng!
37 years later, a muffled sound came from the cave.
It was clear!
All the Great Emperors hurriedly stood up.
They were going to battle with the old Divine Beast again.
"My hands are itching to kill!" The Battle Saint Emperor gripped his staff.
"So is Old Sun." Brother Monkey was also rubbing his fists.
However, his Saintly Material staff was completely useless here.
He had already thrown it away, and now, he could only fight bare-handed.
Thankfully, he was already a fourth tier Great Emperor, so the effects of the Imperial Weapon would also be limited.
Boom!

Amidst a huge commotion, Ding Shu and the others rushed out of the cave, and behind them, the old Divine Beast that had transformed into an elegant scholar slowly walked out, looking calm and composed.
"Kaka, have you all come to seek death?"

chapters.title: Chapter 4879: Surrounded
paragraphs: The old Divine Beast looked around in the crowd, and couldn’t help but frown slightly, "Where’s Ling Han?"
The person he wanted to kill the most was Ling Han, because only this person could truly pose a threat to him.
Though Ding Shu and the others had also advanced into third tier, they were still negligible in his eyes.
"Old Beast, there is no need for Ling Han to move, and we would be able to suppress you!" Jing Haoran said very flamboyantly.
"Die!" Shui Qingchang was much more decisive, and directly charged over.

The moment she moved, Ding Shu and Jing Haoran could only follow. Even if they had become third tier Great Emperors, there was still a very large gap between them and the old Divine Beast. Thus, if they did not join forces, they would definitely lose.
The three of them attacked together, besieging the old Divine Beast.
"Bunch of brats!" The old Divine Beast was extremely disdainful, and shot out a palm strike, sending Ding Shu and the others flying.
Seeing this scene, the Emperors were instead relieved.
That’s right. The old Divine Beast was still incredibly powerful, but there was not much improvement to its abilities from more than a thousand years ago.
Then... there was no need to worry.
"Old Black, looks like you guessed wrong," the little azure dragon said.
The large black dog shook his head, "Something’s not right, something’s definitely not right!"
"What do you mean?" Brother Monkey asked.

"The moment this old Divine Beast came out, it asked Little Han where he was, and even looked disappointed." The large black dog analyzed the situation, "Thus, Grandpa Dog has no choice but to guess that he has actually been preparing some kind of secret weapon that can restrain Little Han all these years."
"However, this kind of weapon probably couldn’t be used many times. Thus, the old Divine Beast looked disappointed because it didn’t discover Little Han at the first moment."

The little azure dragon was stunned. "Old Black, I really couldn’t tell. You really spoke like it was real. However, you came to this conclusion just from the change in his expression, don’t you think it’s a bit strange?"

"F***, Grandpa Dog has never been so serious before," the large black dog said. "The old geezer disappeared for more than a thousand years, and deliberately blocked the passage at that. That’s because he doesn’t want others to know what he’s doing."
"Amongst us, the person who poses the greatest threat to him, and possibly the only one that poses a threat to him, is Little Han."
"Thus, Grandpa Dog’s guess, no, I am certain. The old b@stard must be thinking of some way to trick Little Han."
Was that really the case?

Everyone did not speak further. Ahead of them, Ding Shu and the others were battling extremely fiercely with the old Divine Beast. The battle prowess of third tier Great Emperors was fully displayed, and was enough to restrain even the old Divine Beast.
All the Great Emperors were excited by this, and they all charged out, unleashing their ultimate moves one after another, blasting towards the old Divine Beast.

The three great third tier Great Emperors were the main generals, and there were as many as twenty over fourth tier Great Emperors as support. This time, they had really managed to stand against the old Divine Beast.
They were not losing, they really were not losing.
Then, when Ling Han came out of seclusion, and another fresh member joined thier forces, it was really possible that they would be able to suppress the old Divine Beast.
Instantly, all the Emperors were incredibly excited. After so many years, they finally had a clear view of hope.
Fight, fight, fight. With their morale greatly boosted, their battle prowess increased slightly, and they actually had a slight upper hand.
This was inconceivable, and also something that had never happened before.
This was the first time that they had gained the upper hand in a battle with the old Divine Beast!
There was hope, there really was hope!

However, the old Divine Beast was too powerful. Even if the Emperors had the upper hand, so what? If they wanted to attain an overwhelming victory, it would at least have to be a matter of a few hundred or a few thousand years later.
Furthermore, so what if he had the upper hand?
The old Divine Beast also had an undying body.

"Huh? Ding Shu, and the others seem to be a little different from Little Han," the large black dog said. He, the little azure dragon, the empress, and the others didn’t participate in the battle. Instead, they focused on watching the battle.
"En." Chi Menghan nodded, "Though their battle prowess is obviously strong, their recovery ability is far inferior to Husband’s."

"Little Han has opened up a new world in his body, which can accommodate the elements," the little azure dragon said. It stared at Ding Shu and the others for a while, then said with a frown, "It’s extremely likely that they didn’t manage to do this, but rather used the Genesis World to hold the elements."
This was completely different.
The Genesis World’s structure was too small. The strongest elite was only Heavenly Venerable Tier-level, and in the outside world, they were no different from ordinary people.
However, Ling Han had created a new heaven and earth. At present, he was using the four fundamental elements as his foundation.
At this point, it could be seen that even if they were all Genesis World’s rulers, there was still a difference.
However, upon further thought, this was normal. Ling Han had cultivated more human limits than Ding Shu and the others, so how could this not have any effect?
On the path of martial arts, even the slightest inadequacy could possibly affect whether one could become a Saint or Emperor, what more when it was their present height.
Thus, though Ding Shu and the others had advanced into third tier, their battle prowess was far inferior to Ling Han’s. In fact, it was possible that they would not be able to advance any further.
This was also the reason why they had insisted on this battle. That was because they could no longer advance. This was their strongest state.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
The fierce battle was still continuing. All the Great Emperors seemed to have gotten a little carried away, and thought that suppressing the old Divine Beast was close at hand.
Three hundred years, seven hundred years, one thousand and five hundred years!
The battle continued for a very long time, and all the Great Emperors were already completely on the upper hand, beating down on the old Divine Beast.
"Old Black, looks like you’re really wrong." The little azure dragon nudged the large black dog.

Yet the large black dog’s expression became even more solemn, "Wrong, this just confirms Grandpa Dog’s thoughts. The old Divine Beast has hidden a powerful weapon, but it can only be used for a limited amount of time or a limited number of times. That is why he is patient."
Chi Menghan frowned slightly, and asked, "Then should we inform the others?"

"No!" The large black dog shook his head without hesitation, and said, "If Grandpa Dog’s prediction is correct, then the old Divine Beast will definitely have the confidence to kill Little Han. We can’t let Little Han take risks!"
Hiss!

The little azure dragon, the little red bird, and the others all looked stunned. The large black dog was planning to use the other Great Emperors as bait to expend the powerful weapon of the old Divine Beast — if there was one.
Wasn’t this too ruthless?
"Let’s do that!" the empress also spoke up, her expression resolute.
Even if there were 10,000 Great Emperors added together, none of them would be as important as her man. Thus, she didn’t hesitate at all.

In her eyes, Ling Han was the most important. Saving all life in the world was only something that she could do in passing. ’If there was a trap ahead of them, then please help Ling Han clean out the traps.’
Hu Niu was naturally the same. What was more important than Niu’s Ling Han?
"Furthermore, even if we go and remind them now, who would listen?" The large black dog pointed at the Great Emperors, who were in the midst of an intense battle.
This was the first time in hundreds of billions of years that they had gained the upper hand. Every single Great Emperor was incredibly excited, and their only thought was to win.
Moreover, it wasn’t like they hadn’t died before. What did they have to fear?
And only the large black dog would conclude that the old Divine Beast was actually enduring, and wanted to use a secret weapon to screw Ling Han over.
In the end... who was right and who was wrong?
After battling for another 30,000 years, the old Divine Beast finally couldn’t bear it any longer.
With how strong he was, when had he ever been forced to this extent?
"Damn it!" he roared loudly. Suddenly, two swords of light that were as dark as ink appeared in his hands, exuding an endless air of death.

chapters.title: Chapter 4880: Sword of Death
paragraphs: Pu!
The old Divine Beast suddenly unleashed its might, instantly unleashing an astonishing battle prowess. He sent the Great Emperors flying with a single strike, arriving directly in front of Ding Shu.
Boom, the black sword of light in his hand stabbed out, as fast as lightning.
However, Ding Shu’s reaction speed wasn’t slow, and he immediately retreated, dodging this strike.
However, the old Divine Beast’s figure flashed, and actually appeared behind Ding Shu, stabbing again.
This was the ultimate technique of the Void Emperor. It was also the predecessor of the Strange Shadow Steps, and was most suited for assassination.
This time, Ding Shu was no longer able to dodge.
Shui Qingchang and Jing Haoran hurriedly rushed over to block this attack for Ding Shu.
However, it was too late.
The sword stabbed down, directly sinking into Ding Shu’s body.
Ding Shu was instantly killed.

"Quick, bring him to the Cave of Life!" the Great Emperors hurriedly said. They had nothing to fear even if they died in battle here. As long as the soul mark was not destroyed, it was only a matter of time before they revived.
However, when the old Divine Beast drew its sword, it opened its massive mouth and directly swallowed Ding Shu.
How was this possible!

Though the old Divine Beast was known as the Heaven Devouring Beast, it could only swallow corpses. Otherwise, if he swallowed every Great Emperor after killing one, how could so many things have happened?
Even if they were killed here, the soul imprint would not be erased. Thus, even if he swallowed the corpse, it would not be destroyed. At most, it would only extend the time of their revival.
However, there was a Great Emperor inside his body. Just how dangerous was this?
Wasn’t he afraid that after Ding Shu revived, he would launch an attack from within?
Even if the old Divine Beast was a second tier Great Emperor, how could the defenses inside its body be the same?
Once he was severely injured, Ling Han could appear again and draw him into the heaven and earth inside his body. At that time, he would be able to easily kill him.
Thus, how could the old Divine Beast take such a risk?
Could it be that it had been infuriated by everyone’s attacks, and was only on the spur of the moment that it wanted to devour the corpse to vent its anger?
"Not good!" Heaven Slashing Demon Emperor exclaimed in shock, "Ding Shu’s spiritual mark has disappeared!"
’What?’
All the Great Emperors could not believe it. The soul imprint had disappeared, which meant that he had really died.
However, how could the old Divine Beast suddenly possess the ability to kill a Great Emperor?
Those two swords!
All the Great Emperors were looking at the two black swords of light in the old Divine Beast’s hands. The one that had pierced into Ding Shu was no longer dark, and was slowly disappearing.
At this time, how could they not guess?
It was this sword that had killed Ding Shu.
It was capable of killing a third tier Great Emperor!

The old Divine Beast directly threw away that sword, looked very cherishingly at the other sword, and said, "This is called the Sword of Death, and is a God Tool that I have used so many years to forge!"

This was formed from the essence of death that had been extracted from the Cave of Death, and could completely cancel out the essence of life. Thus, when this sword pierced into a vital point, the essence of life would not be able to take effect, so naturally, the soul imprint could no longer be preserved.
However, there was too little element of death in this. It would dissipate after being used once.

When he had been digging out the Cave of Death, it was not that the old Divine Beast had not gained anything, but it could only be forged into two Swords of Death. For him, they were too useless, and he could not be bothered to use them to kill those Great Emperors.
—He could kill two of them, and there would still be a group left.
However, following the sudden appearance of Ling Han, the old Divine Beast finally realized that it was time to unleash these two Swords of Death.
Unfortunately, the first one was wasted.
The expressions of all the Great Emperors changed drastically. As it turned out, the old Divine Beast had really hidden a trump card!

Obviously, the reason why the old Divine Beast had created the Sword of Death was so that it could deal with Ling Han. However, Ling Han had not appeared, while Ding Shu and the others had advanced into third tier, and began a great battle that even he had not foreseen.
Left with no choice, he could only draw the Sword of Death. Otherwise, it was really possible that he would encounter trouble.

It could be said that everyone had accidentally uncovered a conspiracy of the old Divine Beast, but the old Divine Beast still had a Sword of Death in its hands, which was still enough to pose a threat to Ling Han.
"Scram!" The old Divine Beast advanced aggressively, "That brat should be in the Cave of Creation, right? Gaga, I’ll go and kill him now!"
"Don’t even think about it!"
Jing Haoran, Shui Qingchang, the Great Emperor Wu Ya, and the others all stepped forward to block the old Divine Beast.
Yi?
The old Divine Beast appeared slightly surprised. He cackled repeatedly, and said, "Don’t you guys forget, I now have the ability to kill you guys!"
"You can only kill one!" All the Great Emperors said calmly.
"However, the person who’s going to die... is very likely you!" The old Divine Beast attacked their mentality. "Who’s willing to die?"

The large black dog strode out, "In order to stop you, Grandpa Dog is willing to step out! Brothers and sisters, we must stop this guy. Even if we die, we must force him to expend this Sword of Death!"
The little azure dragon bared its teeth. "Has this big black guy changed his personality? Why isn’t he afraid of death anymore?"
Meanwhile, the empress smiled and said, "He’s putting on an act. If we really get into a fight, he’ll definitely hide behind us."
However, even though she said this, the empress still strode forward.
In order to stop the old Divine Beast from killing Ling Han, she was willing to battle to the death.
Hu Niu and Chi Menghan also walked out. In this place, anyone could die, but it definitely couldn’t be Ling Han!
"You people!" The old Divine Beast was stunned. He had not thought that killing Ding Shu would actually not intimidate these people. Instead, it made their fighting spirit even more frightening.
What was going on here?
Shouldn’t it be the instinct of life to seek fortune and avoid calamity?
"So, you don’t understand at all!" the large black dog scoffed. "You don’t know what it means to have the love for all life, comradeship, brotherhood, matrimonial love!"
"Thus, you are destined to fail!"

The old Divine Beast felt that this was inconceivable. There were so many Great Emperors here, and they could clearly attain immortality here, yet they were actually willing to sacrifice their lives for the sake of others.
This was something that he could not understand.
"Bunch of ignorant people, you all have absolutely no idea what strength is!" he roared loudly. He withdrew the Sword of Death, and charged towards the Cave of Creation.
All the Great Emperors hurriedly intercepted it, but the old Divine Beast was too strong. It merely sent out a palm strike, and peng, seven Great Emperors were sent flying at the same time.
However, there was still Jing Haoran and Shui Qingchang!
These two people were in the third tier, which was enough to obstruct the old Divine Beast.

"The two of you..." the old Divine Beast roared. "You’ve already grasped two elements, and it won’t be difficult for you to become the strongest in the world one day. Why do you have to die for others?"
"Hahaha, old monster, I already told you, you don’t know what affection is!" Jing Haoran laughed loudly, his fighting spirit blazing.
Half of the reason why he and Shui Qingchang were where they were today was because of their hard work, but half of it was because of Ling Han.
Without Ling Han bringing them here, would they have been able to become Great Emperors?
Without Ling Han teaching them how to grasp the element of destruction, would they be able to advance into third tier?
To say the least, if Ling Han hadn’t rushed over to save them, they would have long since died at the hands of the Lands of Death.
Thus, so what if they fought to the death for Ling Han?
That’s right. They wanted to compete with Ling Han, but that was the pride they had as the rulers of the Genesis World, and not jealousy.
"Don’t even think of passing!" Shui Qingchang charged over.

sentences.text: Pu!
The old Divine Beast suddenly unleashed its might, instantly unleashing an astonishing battle prowess.
He sent the Great Emperors flying with a single strike, arriving directly in front of Ding Shu.
Boom, the black sword of light in his hand stabbed out, as fast as lightning.
However, Ding Shu’s reaction speed wasn’t slow, and he immediately retreated, dodging this strike.
However, the old Divine Beast’s figure flashed, and actually appeared behind Ding Shu, stabbing again.
This was the ultimate technique of the Void Emperor.
It was also the predecessor of the Strange Shadow Steps, and was most suited for assassination.
This time, Ding Shu was no longer able to dodge.
Shui Qingchang and Jing Haoran hurriedly rushed over to block this attack for Ding Shu.
However, it was too late.
The sword stabbed down, directly sinking into Ding Shu’s body.
Ding Shu was instantly killed.
"Quick, bring him to the Cave of Life!" the Great Emperors hurriedly said.
They had nothing to fear even if they died in battle here.
As long as the soul mark was not destroyed, it was only a matter of time before they revived.
However, when the old Divine Beast drew its sword, it opened its massive mouth and directly swallowed Ding Shu.
How was this possible!
Though the old Divine Beast was known as the Heaven Devouring Beast, it could only swallow corpses.
Otherwise, if he swallowed every Great Emperor after killing one, how could so many things have happened?
Even if they were killed here, the soul imprint would not be erased.
Thus, even if he swallowed the corpse, it would not be destroyed.
At most, it would only extend the time of their revival.
However, there was a Great Emperor inside his body.
Just how dangerous was this?
Wasn’t he afraid that after Ding Shu revived, he would launch an attack from within?
Even if the old Divine Beast was a second tier Great Emperor, how could the defenses inside its body be the same?
Once he was severely injured, Ling Han could appear again and draw him into the heaven and earth inside his body.
At that time, he would be able to easily kill him.
Thus, how could the old Divine Beast take such a risk?
Could it be that it had been infuriated by everyone’s attacks, and was only on the spur of the moment that it wanted to devour the corpse to vent its anger?
"Not good!" Heaven Slashing Demon Emperor exclaimed in shock, "Ding Shu’s spiritual mark has disappeared!"
’What?’
All the Great Emperors could not believe it.
The soul imprint had disappeared, which meant that he had really died.
However, how could the old Divine Beast suddenly possess the ability to kill a Great Emperor?
Those two swords!
All the Great Emperors were looking at the two black swords of light in the old Divine Beast’s hands.
The one that had pierced into Ding Shu was no longer dark, and was slowly disappearing.
At this time, how could they not guess?
It was this sword that had killed Ding Shu.
It was capable of killing a third tier Great Emperor!

The old Divine Beast directly threw away that sword, looked very cherishingly at the other sword, and said, "This is called the Sword of Death, and is a God Tool that I have used so many years to forge!"
This was formed from the essence of death that had been extracted from the Cave of Death, and could completely cancel out the essence of life.
Thus, when this sword pierced into a vital point, the essence of life would not be able to take effect, so naturally, the soul imprint could no longer be preserved.
However, there was too little element of death in this.
It would dissipate after being used once.
When he had been digging out the Cave of Death, it was not that the old Divine Beast had not gained anything, but it could only be forged into two Swords of Death.
For him, they were too useless, and he could not be bothered to use them to kill those Great Emperors.
—He could kill two of them, and there would still be a group left.
However, following the sudden appearance of Ling Han, the old Divine Beast finally realized that it was time to unleash these two Swords of Death.
Unfortunately, the first one was wasted.
The expressions of all the Great Emperors changed drastically.
As it turned out, the old Divine Beast had really hidden a trump card!
Obviously, the reason why the old Divine Beast had created the Sword of Death was so that it could deal with Ling Han.
However, Ling Han had not appeared, while Ding Shu and the others had advanced into third tier, and began a great battle that even he had not foreseen.
Left with no choice, he could only draw the Sword of Death.
Otherwise, it was really possible that he would encounter trouble.

It could be said that everyone had accidentally uncovered a conspiracy of the old Divine Beast, but the old Divine Beast still had a Sword of Death in its hands, which was still enough to pose a threat to Ling Han.
"Scram!" The old Divine Beast advanced aggressively, "That brat should be in the Cave of Creation, right?
Gaga, I’ll go and kill him now!"
"Don’t even think about it!"
Jing Haoran, Shui Qingchang, the Great Emperor Wu Ya, and the others all stepped forward to block the old Divine Beast.
Yi?
The old Divine Beast appeared slightly surprised.
He cackled repeatedly, and said, "Don’t you guys forget, I now have the ability to kill you guys!"
"You can only kill one!" All the Great Emperors said calmly.
"However, the person who’s going to die... is very likely you!" The old Divine Beast attacked their mentality.
"Who’s willing to die?"
The large black dog strode out, "In order to stop you, Grandpa Dog is willing to step out!
Brothers and sisters, we must stop this guy.
Even if we die, we must force him to expend this Sword of Death!"
The little azure dragon bared its teeth.
"Has this big black guy changed his personality?
Why isn’t he afraid of death anymore?"
Meanwhile, the empress smiled and said, "He’s putting on an act.
If we really get into a fight, he’ll definitely hide behind us."
However, even though she said this, the empress still strode forward.
In order to stop the old Divine Beast from killing Ling Han, she was willing to battle to the death.
Hu Niu and Chi Menghan also walked out.
In this place, anyone could die, but it definitely couldn’t be Ling Han!
"You people!" The old Divine Beast was stunned.
He had not thought that killing Ding Shu would actually not intimidate these people.
Instead, it made their fighting spirit even more frightening.
What was going on here?
Shouldn’t it be the instinct of life to seek fortune and avoid calamity?
"So, you don’t understand at all!" the large black dog scoffed.
"You don’t know what it means to have the love for all life, comradeship, brotherhood, matrimonial love!"
"Thus, you are destined to fail!"

chapters.title: Chapter 4881: Disregarding one’s own safety
paragraphs: Jing Haoran and Shui Qingchang were both fighting with their lives on the line, trying their best to stop the old Divine Beast from advancing.
They definitely could not allow him to pass, even if it meant sacrificing their own lives.
This was the shared understanding of the two of them.
Boom! More and more Great Emperors charged over, one after another. Not a single one of them showed any sign of fear.
No one would want to die. This was also why so many Great Emperors had come to the Primitive Abyss to seek immortality. However, for the sake of righteousness, they were willing to generously die.
The old Divine Beast was stupefied.
How could this be?
Could it be that these people did not know that he possessed the ability to kill Great Emperors?
Though he could only kill one, it could be any one of them.

In the past, when the Great Emperors had battled fiercely with him, they were unafraid of death. The old Divine Beast could still understand, because everyone could come back to life, but now, what right did you all have to be so fierce?
Did they really think that he did not dare to use the Sword of Death?
In a fit of rage, the old Divine Beast summoned the Sword of Death again.

However, he had never imagined that these Great Emperors would become even more excited. One after another, they actually took the initiative to pounce towards the Sword of Death. They were so crazy that even the old Divine Beast was dumbfounded.
Only at this moment did he confirm that the Great Emperors were not putting on airs. Instead, they were really willing to use themselves to "eliminate" the Sword of Death.
Without the Sword of Death, the old Divine Beast would not be able to threaten Ling Han. Then, as long as Ling Han was given enough time, he would one day be able to kill the old Divine Beast.
The old Divine Beast took a deep breath.
Crazy, they had really gone crazy. How could there be such people? Furthermore, it was a whole group of them!
He frowned deeply. If it was just those Great Emperors from years ago, he would not be concerned at all. He could forcefully blast out a path. After all, he all had the advantage of two levels.
But added with Jing Haoran and Shui Qingchang, it was a different story.
The two of them were in the third tier!
Two third tiers and a group of fourth tiers could have extremely strong obstructive effects. In fact, when there were three third tiers just now, even he had been suppressed.
Unless he really drew out the Sword of Death, and killed another third tier.
The problem was, without the Sword of Death, he couldn’t do anything to Ling Han either, so what was the point of breaking out of the siege?
The old Divine Beast gritted its teeth. For the first time, it felt regret.

In the past, when the Great Emperors had sent out the Stone of Life, he had actually been able to stop them — if he was willing to pay the price of destroying a few soul marks, but as he saw it, even the fourth tier Great Emperors could not withstand a single blow, and were only worthy of becoming his toys, so why would he care about a Stone of Life?
He was very expectant. When he opened the Cave of Death, he anticipated the expressions of despair on the faces of the Great Emperors.
How boring was it to wear embroidered clothes at night? He hoped that when he succeeded, there would be someone who could be spectators on the sidelines, no matter how the spectators felt.
But now, he really regretted it.
If he had known, if he had known!
"Ah!" The old Divine Beast roared furiously, filled with endless emotions.
He pushed forward with great difficulty.

This had become a battlefield. With every step he took, he would have to pay the price of sending a dozen over Great Emperors flying. However, the Great Emperors were advancing one after another, using their bodies to block his path.
In fact, even the old Divine Beast was forced to put away the Sword of Death, because he was afraid that he would be accidentally bumped into by some Great Emperor.
F***, was he really holding a deadly weapon in his hand? Why did it feel like he was holding porcelain!
"You, a bunch of stupid guys!" the old Divine Beast called out. It clapped and waved its palms repeatedly, pushing its own strength to the extreme.
He definitely had to stop Ling Han from continuing his comprehension.

Though he had once been very confident, and thought that no Great Emperor would be able to cultivate two or more elements of heaven and earth, with Ling Han first, followed by Ding Ding Shu and the others, he no longer had such confidence.
Why was it that he could cultivate several elements at the same time?
Because he was a Heaven Devouring Beast, and had devoured countless soul marks before, it could be said that he was actually a fusion of many souls, and could not be considered an individual.
Thus, in his eyes, the exclusion of the four elements did not exist.
However, what basis did Ling Han and the others have?
He couldn’t understand, but it didn’t matter. He would kill them all, kill them all!

The old Divine Beast charged forward aggressively, and no matter how hard the Great Emperors tried, a second tier was really too strong, and could not be stopped. Just like how the old Divine Beast wanted to dig out the Cave of Death, the Great Emperors could only slow it down, and it was only their own self-perception that they were slowing it down.
This battle lasted another 700 years.
The old Divine Beast Beast advanced with great difficulty, but still charged to the front of the Cave of Creation.

"Gaga!" A smile appeared on the old Divine Beast’s face. As long as he was allowed to enter into the cave, he would be able to use rocks to block his path of retreat. In that way, no one would be able to stop him.
Ling Han, ultimately would die!
"You guys can’t stop me!" He laughed loudly. With how terrifying the Sword of Death was, killing Ling Han wouldn’t be difficult.
All the Great Emperors were even more frenzied. However, their battle prowess was far too inferior, so what did it matter even if they put their lives on the line?
Peng!

The old Divine Beast unleashed an absolutely powerful attack, sending all the Great Emperors flying. This was a powerful move of his. Even with his strength, he was panting for breath, and in the next instant, he had stepped into the Cave of Creation.
"Gaga, goodbye!" The old Divine Beast waved its hand, and instantly, rocks fell, locking down the passage.
All the Great Emperors charged back, but it was already too late.
All of a sudden, looks of despair appeared on their faces.
Just like how they had previously opened the Cave of Death, how much time had they spent?
More than a thousand years.
With such a long time, the old Divine Beast would have long since killed Ling Han.
What could they do?
The hope that had just risen was extinguished just like that?
"No, Little Han will definitely survive this!" the large black dog said with absolute confidence.
"That’s right." The empress was the first to rush out, and began to dig out rocks.
"Niu’s Ling Han is the most awesome!" Hu Niu also joined in.
Chi Menghan didn’t say anything, and simply continued to work in silence.
Though they clearly knew that the chances of this were pitifully low, even more Great Emperors joined in, and began to excavate the rocks.
Boom!
Right at this moment, a massive tremor was heard.
Ling Han and the old Divine Beast were fighting!

"Hurry! Hurry! Hurry!" the little azure dragon shouted loudly. He had already taken the form of a True Dragon, using his sharp claws to claw at the stones. After cultivating to the level of Great Emperor, his terrifying physique had also reached the strongest level, and his sharp claws could cut open stones.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
Inside, the commotion caused by the battle was getting louder and louder, yet no one knew how the battle was progressing, causing all the Great Emperors to feel extremely anxious.
The only good news was that the battle was still continuing.
As long as the battle had not stopped, that meant that Ling Han was not dead, and everything was possible.
"Quick, quick, quick!"
They excavated with all their might, and Jing Haoran and Shui Qingchang channeled the element of destruction at all costs.

One had to realize that they hadn’t been able to construct a new heaven and earth inside their bodies like Ling Han had. Instead, they had made use of the Genesis World again. Thus, the amount of destruction that they could contain was much lesser.
For them, this kind of expenditure was too great.
However, they paid no heed to this, and merely continued to dig with all their might.
Closer, closer and closer!
Everyone could feel that the shockwaves from the battle were getting closer and closer to them.
"We got through!"
All the Great Emperors cheered.
Peng, a figure flew out of the gap that they had created.

chapters.title: Chapter 4882: Second tier!
paragraphs: After the old Divine Beast entered the cave, it continued to block the path with rocks as it advanced.
In this way, if the people behind wanted to catch up to him, that would be a matter of one to two thousand years later.
—The Cave of Creation had long since been dug out, so it was much deeper than the Cave of Death.
However, his speed was fast, and it wasn’t long before he arrived at the bottom of the cave.
Ling Han was presently sitting cross-legged in the Pool of Creation.
A smile appeared on the old Divine Beast’s face. He stretched out his right hand, and the Sword of Death had already appeared.
He was going to take advantage of this opportunity to deliver a sword strike to Ling Han, completely eliminating any future trouble.
This was disgraceful?
What a joke. When one had reached a height like he had, would he still care about honour?
Die!
The old Divine Beast charged out, his sword stabbing towards Ling Han.
He used the ultimate move of the Void Emperor. With a flash, he had appeared in front of Ling Han, the blade of his sword exuding an endless air of death.
Logically speaking, it would be best for an assassination to appear behind the target, but how proud was a Great Emperor?
’I can’t kill you with a head-on strike?’
What kind of joke was this!
Moreover, with the movement technique of the Void Emperor, there was no difference whether he appeared in front of or behind him. After all, he would kill with a single strike.
Shua, the sword stabbed down at an incredibly fast speed.
Right at this moment, Ling Han’s eyes suddenly snapped open. There were actually three streaks of light flickering in his eyes.
Peng, Ling Han delivered a palm strike, and it actually struck the old Divine Beast’s wrist.
Even with the old Divine Beast’s physique, it still let out a pained groan. The sword that it had stabbed out was instantly deflected, and almost slipped out of its grip.
’What?’
The old Divine Beast’s mouth gaped open, as it released a soundless exclamation of shock.
F***, he had gotten a scare.
He was a second tier Great Emperor!
Ling Han smiled faintly, and turned his palm into a fist that blasted towards the old Divine Beast. Boundless power surged out.
Peng!
The old Divine Beast took it head-on, yet was directly sent backwards.
So strong?
He was shocked, and exclaimed in shock, "You, you have grasped the essence of creation!"
Otherwise, no matter how freakish Ling Han was, how could he be qualified to match him?
Ling Han smiled faintly, "I just had some ideas."
He spread out his arms. Boom, the element of creation surged endlessly into his body, filling his own heaven and earth.

When the old Divine Beast charged in, he was naturally awakened, but it was the crucial moment of his comprehension, so he did not move. Instead, he continued to comprehend. Only when the old Divine Beast stabbed him with its sword did he react.
The element of creation surged over, and Ling Han’s enlightenment was like the brightness of the stars, three-colored light shining brilliantly in his eyes.
How could it be so coincidental!
The old Divine Beast gritted its teeth. If it wasn’t for those guys dragging things on for several hundred years, Ling Han definitely wouldn’t have grasped the key element of creation.
Damn it! Damn it!
Xiu! Ling Han counterattacked, and the might of his punch became even stronger.
Right now, he was like a resuscitated giant. With each passing second, he would become stronger.
Peng!
The old Divine Beast clashed head-on with him, yet it was no match, and was once again sent backwards.
He was in disbelief. They were both in the third tier, so why was he inferior to Ling Han?

"You were created by heaven and earth, and you can only be limited to the limits of heaven and earth." Ling Han said calmly, "But do you know that every time I break through, I have broken through the limits!"
Hence, as a fellow second tier, he was even stronger, even if he had just advanced into this cultivation level.
The old Divine Beast was rendered speechless. Now that things had come to this, what else could he say?
However, he still had a chance to kill Ling Han, as long as he managed to pierce the latter with his sword.
However, because it could only deliver a single strike, the old Divine Beast was enduring silently. It definitely had to wait for the best opportunity.
Hong! Hong! Hong!

Ling Han unleashed a burst of power, his power boiling. He unleashed his second-tier battle prowess one strike after another, and in this process, he was also familiarizing himself with the key element of creation.

Originally, the heaven and earth inside his body was completely blank, but as the element of creation appeared, he could create things with a single thought. Multiple stars appeared, planets, moons, suns, and stars, and on the planets, countless living creatures appeared out of thin air.
Creation, bestowing life.
In an instant, tens of billions of years had passed in the heaven and earth inside his body. Planets were destroyed, and stars exploded. The end of creation was destruction.

However, there was no life that had died from exhaustion of lifespan, because in this heaven and earth, there was no element of death. Unless life was destroyed by the element of destruction, it could not die, even if it was sliced into a thousand pieces, or ten thousand pieces.
Without death, this was not a normal world.
Ling Han nodded. Death was the replenishment of life, and was also a kind of order.
Hence, all four elements could not be lacking.
Enlightenment dawned on Ling Han, but the fists he shot out became more and more terrifying.
Peng! Peng! Peng!
Not only would the old Divine Beast be sent backwards, it would even be sent flying.

Retreating and being sent flying were two completely different concepts. In the first scenario, it was that his abilities were slightly inferior, while in the other case, he was more or less overwhelmed.
As the heaven and earth in Ling Han’s body was perfected, his battle prowess also increased to a terrifying height.
The old Divine Beast was no longer a match for him.
Boom!
With a violent blast, the old Divine Beast was sent flying, and crashed into the rocks in the passage behind him, causing the old Divine Beast to grit its teeth in pain.
At this moment, he regretted it again.
If he had known earlier, why would he have blocked the passageway?
This would affect his escape.
Peng, peng, peng! Ling Han rushed over and gave him a series of violent punches.
The old Divine Beast could only suffer, feeling extremely sullen.
He, a dignified second tier Great Emperor, the strongest existence in the world, was actually pressed against the wall and thrashed. How could he accept this?
However, no matter how defiant and displeased he was, so what?
Right now, his battle prowess was genuinely no match for Ling Han.
Peng!
When Ling Han’s iron fist smashed down, the rocks behind the old Divine Beast coincidentally loosened, and the old Divine Beast was directly sent flying.
What!
Seeing the old Divine Beast being sent flying backwards, everyone was collectively confused.
In their minds, Ling Han would definitely be at a disadvantage at this moment. He would only be able to barely parry, barely managing to save his life.

Thus, once the passageway opened, they wanted to risk their lives to block the weapon, so that Ling Han could escape. Meanwhile, they would use themselves to block the old Divine Beast, and it would be best if they could directly expend the Sword of Death.
In this way, though Ling Han was still no match for the old Divine Beast, there was no need to worry about his life.
However, the one that had been sent flying was actually the old Divine Beast?
They hurriedly turned around to face the old Divine Beast, but on second thought, they turned around to look at Ling Han who was striding out.
This terrifying guy!
"Ling Han!"
"Little Han!"
Everyone exclaimed in shock. Who would have thought that Ling Han would actually be the victor?
"You’ve grasped the key element of creation?" the large black dog asked in excitement.
"En." Ling Han nodded.
Instantly, everyone cheered.
A second tier Great Emperor, they finally had a second tier Great Emperor.

It was no wonder that even the old Divine Beast was no match for Ling Han. As a second tier Great Emperor, Ling Han, who had cultivated all the way here on his own, was definitely stronger than the Divine Beast that was created by heaven and earth.
In the distance, the old Divine Beast had also recovered. He glanced at Ling Han, then suddenly turned around and left.
He couldn’t win, and he still had to dig out the Cave of Death.
Though he had not been able to dig through it all this while, there was naturally an overflowing element of death in the Cave of Death. He had been in contact with it all this while.
Thus, as long as he unlocked the Cave of Death, he would definitely be able to grasp it before Ling Han did.
—He could condense the Sword of Death; this was clear proof.

chapters.title: Chapter 4883: Cave of Death opens
paragraphs: "Little Han, Ding Shu is dead!" the little azure dragon said.
Ling Han frowned, "How could—"
He immediately thought of the sword that the old Divine Beast had stabbed over with, which exuded a powerful aura of death.

That’s right. The old Divine Beast had been digging out the Cave of Death all this while. Even if he had not dug to the end, his understanding of the fundamental element of death had definitely surpassed any other person.
Ding Shu!
Ling Han couldn’t help but think back to how he had become acquainted with Ding Shu. This was also the only Genesis World ruler that he had ever taken as a lackey.
Though this was more of a joke, it could not be denied that among the rulers of Genesis World, Ling Han and Ding Shu had the best relationship.
He was dead!
Ling Han took a deep breath, and instantly, his killing intent blazed.
Then let the old Divine Beast die in compensation.
"Be careful!" the empress hurriedly said. "His sword can kill you!"
Ling Han nodded, "Don’t worry, I won’t let him stab me."
He did not need anyone’s help. He had already advanced into second tier, which was enough to suppress the old Divine Beast.

The Emperors were all invigorated. They had just struggled free from despair, yet were about to achieve victory in the grand finale. This great rise and fall was really too stimulating, that even their hearts could barely bear it.
Ling Han walked in front, and all the Great Emperors followed behind him.
Here, there was no such thing as seniority. They were all comrades-in-arms.
It wasn’t long before they arrived before the Cave of Death.
Ling Han was the first to enter, and the Great Emperors followed behind him.

After walking for a while, they saw the old Divine Beast digging with all its might ahead of them. Under the bombardment of the element of destruction, the rock layer slowly crumbled, falling at an overwhelmingly slow pace.
This was the Imperial Island, a core of heaven and earth that even a battle between Great Emperors wouldn’t be able to cause much damage to. Thus, it was naturally incredibly sturdy.
"Old b@stard, come and accept your death!" the large black dog called out. He had never minded using his powerful connections as an intimidation tactic.
The old Divine Beast ignored him completely, and merely continued to mine.
"F***, you’re not giving Grandpa Dog any face. Little Han, charge!" The large black dog waved his paw.
Ling Han smiled, "All right!"
He strode forward. Boom! His aura surged, and his battle prowess as a second tier surged.

The old Divine Beast finally had no choice but to turn around. He did not dare to ignore Ling Han, because the latter had the ability to kill a Great Emperor. Furthermore, after he had devoured Ding Shu’s corpse, he more or less knew the reason.
After all, even though Ding Shu had died, someone as powerful as a Great Emperor would still have some memories in his body.
It was a shame that Ding Shu hadn’t been able to create his own heaven and earth. Otherwise, he would have been able to take it for his own without much effort.

Thus, the old Divine Beast definitely didn’t dare to be severely wounded by Ling Han. If it lost the ability to resist, it would be absorbed into the heaven and earth within Ling Han’s body. At that time, it would be up to Ling Han to kill or torture it.
"After this battle, there will be no more you in this world!" Ling Han said calmly. It was only a very ordinary sentence, but it was filled with incomparable confidence.
"Haha!" The old Divine Beast merely responded with a cold smirk, as if he couldn’t care less. However, he had no choice but to admit internally that Ling Han really could do it.
He felt that this would weaken his aura, and immediately summoned the Sword of Death, then withdrew it.
This meant that he too had the ability to kill Ling Han.
But just taking it out and showing it was a kind of intimidation. Don’t think that you can force me too far, because you don’t know when I will draw my sword.
Ling Han didn’t waste any more words as he charged over.
Hong! Hong! Hong!

The two second tier Great Emperors battled fiercely, and Ling Han instantly gained the upper hand. However, the threat of the Sword of Death could not be ignored, causing Ling Han to hold back in his attacks.
Firstly, though the old Divine Beast was at a disadvantage, it would still need a very long time to be defeated, or even severely injured.
Furthermore, even if the old Divine Beast was really severely injured, would he dare to take him into the heaven and earth inside his body?
Wasn’t he afraid that the other party would unleash the Sword of Death?
If he delivered a sword strike inside his body, how could this be a joke?
Endless shockwaves of power surged out, and the two strongest Great Emperors naturally went all out. The three elements surged, forming a terrifying collision.
Visibly, the cave walls were actually slowly falling off. This speed was even faster than the full-power excavation of the old Divine Beast.
This!
The old Divine Beast had not expected that the collision of the three elements would actually have such an effect.
After being stunned for a moment, he was overjoyed.

If they continued to battle like this, it was extremely likely that the Cave of Death would be opened in the next tens of thousands of years. At that time, everyone would be able to come into contact with the essence of death. At that time, he would definitely be the first person to grasp the essence of death.
At that time, what would Ling Han be worth?
He would have grasped four key elements, and that was the number one person in the world!
If the old Divine Beast could think of it, Ling Han naturally could as well.
However, could Ling Han stop his attacks?
If he did not make a move, the old Divine Beast could still dig, though it would be slightly slower.
Though Ling Han had the advantage in strength, he was not strong enough to force the old Divine Beast out of the cave.
Just like when he was in third tier, his abilities were obviously inferior to the old Divine Beast, but the old Divine Beast was still unable to force him to jump into the Sea of Death, right?
Thus, Ling Han still maintained a terrifying offensive.
The opening of the Cave of Death needed time, and wouldn’t it be fine as long as they destroyed the old Divine Beast before that?
To say the least, Ling Han still had his pride.
Both of them would begin to comprehend the essence of death at the same time. He did not believe that he would be slower than the old Divine Beast.
Of course, this was the last resort. It was naturally best to deal with the old Divine Beast in advance.

The two Great Emperors battled fiercely. Though the other Great Emperors also pounced, even third tier Great Emperors like Jing Haoran and Shui Qingchang were unable to be of much help. They were easily sent flying left and right by the terrifying power.
And following their great battle, the Cave of Death also continued to fall, large areas of rock dispersing.

100 years, 500 years, 1000 years, and the battles were still continuing. Though it was still Ling Han who had the upper hand, the old Divine Beast was deliberately guiding Ling Han deeper into the cave.
Ling Han had no option but to face this attack.
He pursued the old Divine Beast, and the battle continued.

There were a few times that the old Divine Beast almost couldn’t hold on any longer. However, he summoned the Sword of Death, and successfully forced Ling Han to retreat, buying him a chance to catch his breath.
It should be known that for this kind of elite, as long as he could catch his breath, it was equivalent to being full of vigor again.
This was a second tier Great Emperor, after all. He was only a single step away from reaching the consummate level.
Five thousand years, ten thousand years, twenty thousand years!

An expression of delight appeared on the old Divine Beast’s face. Now, the element of death that had seeped out was practically increasing by tons. Thus, he was sure that it was definitely not too far away from the Pool of Death.

Haha, though he had been beaten for tens of thousands of years, as long as he grasped the essence of death, he would be the number one person in the world. He would be able to destroy the heavens and earth, and could freely control life and death. He was omnipotent.
From three to four, this was a qualitative change!
At this time, Ling Han also let go of his reservations.
Then let’s have a competition, and see who would be able to grasp the essence of death first!
Hong! Hong! Hong!
The cave wall was on the verge of collapse, and in another terrifying exchange, hong, the last rock also collapsed loudly, revealing a massive cave, with a pool placed in the middle.
The Cave of Death had opened!

chapters.title: Chapter 4884: First Tier?
paragraphs: "Haha, hahahaha!" The old Divine Beast faltered for a moment, then laughed loudly, "Ling Han, I am the Heaven Devouring Beast, and possess more than one soul imprint. Thus, I do not have the worry of the elements rejecting one another at all."
"In terms of grasping the key elements, you can’t compare to me at all!"
"Just you wait. When I have grasped the essence of death, I will kill all of them, one after another!"
"Don’t worry, I will leave you last, and admire your pained expression!"
Ling Han shook his head, "You speak too much nonsense!"
His fists continued to attack, but on the other side, the essence of death surged out, and he was also appreciating.
What they were competing in now was who would be the first to grasp the key element of death.

The old Divine Beast didn’t speak any more nonsense. In fact, he wasn’t a chatterbox either, but who asked him to have been beaten too terribly by Ling Han in the past tens of thousands of years? This was something that had never happened before, making him feel sullen and resentful. No matter what, he had to throw out some mockery.
The two of them were still battling fiercely, but in the midst of the intense battle, they were also distracted, appreciating the key element of death.

This was very strange, because as they fought, their tempo would become slower and slower, but without waiting for them to stop, they would suddenly speed up their tempo, and once again, fight fiercely.

Furthermore, if the old Divine Beast was forced to use the Sword of Death, Ling Han would be able to move without any reservations and suppress the old Divine Beast.
All the Great Emperors surged forwards, unleashing their full battle prowess as they attacked the old Divine Beast.

In this place, everyone had an undying body. As long as he didn’t use a cheat code like the Sword of Death, what was there to be afraid of? Moreover, they were more willing for the old Divine Beast to use the Sword of Death. Then, Ling Han would really be safe.

It was like a fly. Though it would not cause any damage, if it was buzzing around one’s ear, that would really be detestable.
Moreover, this fly was like a cockroach that couldn’t be killed no matter what, so it was naturally even more displeasing.

This greatly affected the old Divine Beast’s comprehension progress. It should be known that this was a race against time with Ling Han. Even if he thought that he had an advantage over Ling Han, he could not hold up to such a massive waste of time.

And because everyone was here, no one discovered that the fundamental elements were surging outwards from the four element caves, converging towards the center of the island.

What was going on?

With how powerful the Great Emperors were, even if these falling rocks were heavier than hundreds of millions of stars added together, they were still unable to wound them.

However, they were stunned. It should be known that the structure of the Primitive Abyss’s heaven and earth was incredibly sturdy, and the Imperial Island was several hundred times more freakish. Even a Great Emperor using his full might could not damage it.
But now?
This place was like an ordinary cave that had encountered an earthquake. Rocks fell, and it looked like it was about to collapse.
What in the world had happened?

However, what exactly was going on outside?
Everyone ran out one after another, and even the old Divine Beast was no exception.
How were they supposed to comprehend if they were struck by these boulders?
It should be known that this rock was equivalent to the weight of several hundred billion stars. Though it would not die if it landed on one’s body, it would definitely hurt.
How was one supposed to comprehend after suffering such a heavy blow?
It was better to come back after the cave collapsed. It would be easier to dig through the rubble, because it had already been shattered.
Thus, the group exited the Cave of Death.
The moment they exited, they saw that pillar of light that had changed colour.
"We still haven’t dealt with the old Divine Beast, that b@stard. Don’t let him cause some trouble again!" Jing Haoran murmured to himself.

Boom, the pillar of light suddenly erupted with a dazzling light. Even if everyone present was a Great Emperor, their eyes still hurt from the blinding light. It was as if this was the light that had appeared when the universe first split apart and exploded, which was incredibly dazzling.
Then, this pillar of light disappeared.
What replaced it was an incredibly powerful aura.
’What?’
All the Great Emperors felt their hearts tremble greatly. Even the old Divine Beast was slightly flustered, because this aura was even stronger than his.
How was this possible? How was this possible!
"You jinx!" The large black dog pointed at Jing Haoran.
Jing Haoran was just about to retort, but when he saw that everyone’s eyes were focused on him, he could only accept his fate and shut his mouth.
Ling Han also frowned. The strength of this aura was above even him.
However, he was already in the second tier, so how could there be an existence that was superior to him?
Unless!
"An existence that has grasped the four fundamental elements!" Ling Han said in a solemn voice.
Hiss!
How was that possible? Now, in terms of grasping the fundamental elements, the two strongest people were Ling Han and the old Divine Beast. However, they had only grasped three.
Where had this invincible elite come from?
Furthermore, where had he been previously?
He had slumbered on the island all this while, and it was only when the four caves of fundamantal element were opened that he was roused?
In front of everyone’s eyes, the place where the pillar of light had shot out had already become a deep pit, and at this moment, a person was slowly rising from the deep pit.
This was a man who looked to be in his thirties. He had a stocky build, and his black hair billowed wildly, exuding a rough aura.
However, that terrifying aura that surpassed second tier... originated from his body.
First tier!
A Great Emperor appeared. That was an existence that was superior to all else, and could easily kill another Great Emperor.
"One is still fine, but two would be terrible," Jing Haoran murmured again.
Boom, another terrifying aura suddenly exploded, and a second person floated up from the deep pit.
This was a woman. Her red robes were as beautiful as blood, and her figure was indescribably perfect. However, she was wearing a black clown mask, which made her look extremely strange.
However, the aura she exuded was definitely not inferior to the sturdy man from before.
"You really are a jinx!" the large black dog said to Jing Haoran.

chapters.title: Chapter 4885: Invincible Great Emperor
paragraphs: The pillar of light that had been standing in the center of Imperial Island for so long had actually collapsed!
How many trillions of years had it existed for?
Even the old Divine Beast didn’t know, because when he came here, this pillar of light was already here.
Perhaps, when the heaven and earth was first created, it had already existed, and had always been here.
Why was there a pillar of light here?

Some Great Emperors had been curious before, but they were unable to make heads or tails of the situation. This was because there was a terrifying amount of energy contained within the pillar of light. It was as if it had solidified, and even the Great Emperors were cut it, and investigate the truth behind the pillar.
And just how hard was the ground of the Imperial Island?
Just look at how the old Divine Beast dug so painstakingly at the Cave of Death. It was incredibly difficult.
—If the old Divine Beast had the energy to dig out the source of the pillar of light, then wouldn’t it be better to directly dig through the Cave of Death?
However, when everyone was already accustomed to the existence of this pillar of light, an accident happened.
The pillar of light crumbled.
If it was just a collapse, so be it. Everyone could accept that, but why had two people appeared?
An existence that surpassed second tier!
Hiss, could it be that at the beginning of the universe, there were already two first tier Great Emperors?
However, they had already reached the first tier, so they were definitely an invincible existence. Why were they suppressed under the pillar of light?
They must have been suppressed. Otherwise, they could not think of any other reason.
However, why had the pillar of light suddenly collapsed?
It had clearly existed for hundreds of millions of years, so how could it collapse just like that?
All of a sudden, everyone’s minds were filled with questions.
However, when the Empress in red appeared, a third person immediately appeared from within the cave.
This was an old man, dressed in a grey robe. He looked sanctimonious and kind, but the aura he exuded was not the slightest bit weak.
This was another invincible Great Emperor!
Heavens, three, three, three!
Everyone was speechless, and felt an indescribable fear.

The old Divine Beast was awesome enough, wasn’t it? With its own power, it had suppressed all the Great Emperors to the point that they did not even have a temper. If it was not for the fact that the Great Emperors had a flash of inspiration, or had carefully considered, and sent out the Stone of Life, which ultimately evolved into Ling Han, Ding Shu and the other Genesis World rulers, they would still be suppressed by the old Divine Beast.
However, three beings that were even more powerful than the old Divine Beast had appeared now.
If they too wanted to commit evil, who would be able to stop them?
"There can’t be a fourth one, right?" Jing Haoran murmured.
The moment these words left his mouth, he immediately encountered everyone’s hostility.
Don’t you know that you are a jinx?
Shut up!
Fortunately, there was no fourth invincible Great Emperor in the end.
"We’ve finally come out!" the Empress in red said in a sweet voice. She even stretched her arms, and her beautiful figure was completely displayed, causing one’s heart to beat wildly.
However, Ling Han could see very clearly that this Empress’s body... was not a physical body!
It was like an image, directly projected.
"Just how many reincarnations has it been?" The gruff and bold Great Emperor also said, "Haha, we’ve come out much earlier than last time. We can have fun for a while."
"Immeasurable Heavenly Venerate," the grey-robed elder mumbled.
The three Great Emperors were extremely arrogant, and it was as if they hadn’t seen Ling Han and the others at all.
"Dare I ask how should I address you three friends?" the Great Emperor Wu Ya asked.
No matter what, he had to find out if these three people were friends or foes.

The Empress in red ignored him. Instead, she stretched out her hand and beckoned, and an astonishing scene appeared. The four elements of heaven and earth materialized, and under her control, they took the form of an exquisite woman. Whether it was her figure or appearance, they were exactly the same as her.
Then, she fused with this elemental form, and instantly became a person.
Ling Han was astonished. This was because the Empress now gave him a feeling of solidity.
The four fundamental elements were the foundations of heaven and earth in the first place, so the body that they were used to construct naturally couldn’t be any more realistic.

"Tsk, it’s been a long time since I’ve experienced this kind of genuine feeling." The Empress in red smiled beautifully, then turned to look at the Great Emperor Wu Ya, and said, "My name is Star Moon. This old Daoist is called Boundless, and as for that gruff man, his name is Mysterious Clouds."
Though she had revealed the identities of the three of them, the Great Emperors did not have the slightest idea. They had never heard of these three beings before.

Meanwhile, Ling Han and the large black dog both started to complain. This Boundless Great Emperor was so narcissistic. The first thing he said was "Boundless Heavenly Venerate". Who would praise themselves like this?
"Shameless," the large black dog said softly.
"Extremely." Ling Han nodded.

However, they could only zone out for a moment. Three Great Emperors that were suspected to be of the first tier appeared out of thin air. This was practically... every single one of them could change the great power structure of the world.
"Dare I ask why my three friends have suddenly appeared?" Ling Han asked directly.

The Boundless Great Emperor and the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor ignored them. Instead, like the Star Moon Empress, they began to use the four elements to reform their bodies. At present, they existed in the form of soul imprints.

Theoretically speaking, soul imprints didn’t possess battle prowess. However, this didn’t apply to them. Their first-tier battle prowess hadn’t decreased in the slightest, and they were as powerful as could be.
Meanwhile, the Star Moon Empress propped up her pink cheeks, and looked like she was in deep thought. After a while, she finally said, "This is a very big problem. Where should I start?"
"Why don’t we start from the beginning?" Ling Han said.
"All right," the Star Moon Empress said. "After being trapped for so long, I can only talk to those two vulgar guys. I’m really about to die of boredom!"
She was incredibly beautiful, and even this complaint was breathtaking and captivating.
Thankfully, the people here were all Great Emperors, and all of them had firm willpower. Otherwise, they would not have been able to hold on for millions and millions of years of hard battle.
"This heaven and earth is beginning to collapse," the Star Moon Empress said first, then nodded, "You all know, right?"

"Yes," Ling Han replied with a nod. The other Great Emperors didn’t say anything either. At this moment, they were all willing to listen for a while. Only then would they decide whether they were friend or foe.
The old Divine Beast did not speak either, revealing a pensive expression.

"When heaven and earth is created and collapses, it is a cycle." The Star Moon Empress was in a good mood, and began to explain to everyone, "However, do you guys know how many times this world has experienced this cycle?"
This?
How could anyone possibly know?
Hold on?
Ling Han was astonished. Judging by the Empress’ words, this wasn’t the first time that heaven and earth had collapsed?
How could it be!
A shocking deduction rose up in his heart, yet he could not quite believe it.
"As far as I know, there should be 34 times," the Star Moon Empress said.
When these words fell, all the Great Emperors inhaled sharply. How did she know?
"Can you count them?" the large black dog mumbled.
"I really counted them," the Star Moon Empress said, smiling as she answered the large black dog’s question.
Er... The large black dog was instantly rendered speechless.
Then—
All the Great Emperors looked at the Star Moon Empress in shock, their eyes almost popping out of their heads.
"That’s right. I am not from this era." Star Moon Empress shook her head with a smile. Then, she pointed at the two Great Emperors, Boundless and Mysterious Clouds, "Neither are they."
Heavens!
