chapters.title: Chapter 4886: The Truth Since the Stacked Era
paragraphs: Though the collapse had not ended, the Great Emperors all knew that once the world returned to a single point, all life would cease to exist.
Even Great Emperors could not withstand that terrifying pressure!
It should be known that the gravity fields of the Primitive Abyss were terrifying enough. Even Saints would be crushed to pieces. Only Pseudo-Emperors were able to resist.
On the Imperial Island, even Pseudo-Emperors could not hold up to it, and would have to wear Battle Armor.
Then, if all of this was compressed into a single point, an endlessly small point, just how terrifying would the pressure be?
Even a Great Emperor wouldn’t be able to withstand it.

Thus, the Lords of Death were so proactive in destroying the two realms. What they sought was immortality, and they also wanted to eliminate any future troubles on their path to immortality. Otherwise, when the heaven and earth returned to its original point, they would be crushed.

Of course, they had fallen for the old Divine Beast’s trick. The clash of the two Realms of Yin and Yang would not allow them to attain immortality, or improve their abilities further. It could only cause a great commotion on the Imperial Island, and cause the Cave of Death to open.
However, the Star Moon Empress actually said that she had experienced the replacement of heaven and earth 34 times. What kind of concept was that?
She had survived!

No wonder she didn’t have a physical body when she appeared previously. Thinking about it, it made sense. The entire heaven and earth had shrunk to the point of its origin, so what kind of body could withstand it?
However, she was able to make her soul mark indestructible and undamaged. It appeared in this era, which showed how terrifying she was.

"Heaven and earth, creation and collapse, a cycle, is called a Stacked Era," the Star Moon Empress continued. Then, she smiled slightly, "Oh, that’s right. I was the one who invented the term Stacked Era."
No matter what it was, it was just a name.

"Grasping the four key elements would allow one to resist the heavy pressure of heaven and earth retracting back to its original point, and ensure that the soul imprint would not be destroyed?" Ling Han asked.
"Not bad, not bad." The Star Moon Empress clapped her hands, "However, counting through thirty-four Stacked Eras, only a mere three people have managed to accomplish this."
It was her, the Boundless Great Emperor, and the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor.
"I’m the first," the Star Moon Empress said with a smile. Her smile was dazzling, and she didn’t possess the austerity of a Great Emperor at all.
However, who dared to underestimate her?
This was a first tier Great Emperor, and the first one in history at that!

"However, even if one has grasped the four fundamental elements, the physical body would still be unable to resist the pressure of the heaven and earth, and would be forcefully shattered at the end of the Stacked Era." The Star Moon Empress sighed, "Furthermore, even if the heaven and earth has just been created, the soul imprint would only be trapped here, and become the slave of the heaven and earth."
Even if one was as strong as a first tier, they would still be unable to truly oppose heaven and earth.
—That was because the power of the Great Emperor originated from the heaven and earth, and the heaven and earth was the source of their power, so how could they resist it?
"Unless—" The Star Moon Empress paused.
The large black dog continued, "Unless the caves of the four elements are all opened?"

"That’s right." This empress began applauding again, "The heaven and earth is made up of four elements. When the caves of the elements are fully opened, it would form a violent collision. Hence, we would be able to come into being."
"You guys are really not bad, opening the Four Elements Caves so quickly."
"Mysterious Clouds, Boundless, can they be ranked first?"
She turned to ask the other two invincible Great Emperors.
"They can’t be ranked first. The seventeenth Stacked Era is even faster. The heaven and earth still haven’t begun to collapse!" the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor said stiffly.
"Oh." The Star Moon Empress nodded, and showed an apologetic expression, "It has been too long, so it is inevitable that my memories would be a little chaotic."
This wasn’t a matter of it being too long. Rather, it had been endlessly long ago.

A normal Great Emperor would only be able to live for ten million years. Even if they obtained the Great Herb from the Primitive Abyss, they could live for a second life, at most, for twenty million years.
All the Great Emperors had battled here for hundreds of millions and millions of years, but at most, it had not even been half a Stacked Era.
But as for the Star Moon Empress... she had lived for 34 Stacked Eras.
This was really indescribably ancient.
As Ling Han listened, he frowned slightly. That was because why did he feel that this method seemed familiar?
’Oh!’
Wasn’t this how the old Divine Beast had deceived the Lords of Death?
The result of the clash between the two Realms would only open the caves of elements of the Imperial Island!
Hold on, now that the caves of elements had been opened, by the looks of it, the people who would benefit the most were these three invincible Great Emperors.
This... was it a coincidence?
At this time, the old Divine Beast also looked confused.
He wasn’t stupid!

"In some Stacked Eras, right until the end of the Stacked Era, the caves of elements have not been completely opened. We can only be trapped for another Stacked Era." The Star Moon Empress shook her head, a desolate expression on her face.
This could be seen as the entire lifespan of heaven and earth, yet they were all trapped in the form of souls. Just how torturous was this?
Even a Great Emperor... would probably go crazy.
A vigilant expression appeared on Ling Han’s face. Who knew what a crazy person would do?
"This old Divine Beast... does it have anything to do with you guys?" he suddenly asked.
The Star Moon Empress glanced at Ling Han, and showed a hint of praise, "Not bad, not bad. You are a smart person!"
She seemed to like saying ’not bad’, was it a catchphrase?
However, her affirmation caused the expressions of the Great Emperors to change drastically.
The Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor frowned, "Why are you speaking nonsense with these people?"
"After being trapped for so long, it’s rare to see something alive, so don’t you want to say a few more words?" the Star Moon Empress countered.
The Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor did not speak further. The Boundless Great Emperor, on the other hand, had a good temper, and merely stood at the sidelines, looking benevolent.

Being called something by her, all the Great Emperors gritted their teeth slightly. However, firstly, she was really strong enough, and secondly, they still wanted to know the answer. Thirdly, if they reasoned with her, wouldn’t it be even worse if she admitted that they were nothing?
"Bullsh*t!" The old Divine Beast was the first to jump up.

The Star Moon Empress ignored him, and said, "In the last two Stacked Eras, we were especially unlucky. No one could open the caves of elements to release us. Thus, when it was this Stacked Era, the three of us finally came up with a solution."
"Taking advantage of the opening of the heaven and earth, when a crack was revealed, we sent out a seed."
"As expected, this seed did not disappoint us. Following the call of our hearts, the seed returned here, and began to excavate the caves of elements."
This!
Hearing this, all the Great Emperors were rendered speechless with shock.
After such a long time, the old Divine Beast was actually paving the way for someone else!
"Grandpa Dog knew it!" The large black dog slapped his thigh, and exclaimed in excitement, "How could a guy that doesn’t even have a name be the final great villain?"
The old Divine Beast’s expression instantly turned dark. Then, he began to reflect deeply on his actions.

It seemed to be true... From the moment he was born, he had a clear goal. He would first lay low, then go and devour the corpses of those old dead Divine Beasts. After he had reached Great Accomplishment level, he came to the Primitive Abyss, where he began his life’s work.
Why did he have to put his life on the line?
All this while, his aim had been to grasp the four key elements, and become the strongest in the world. However, what was the purpose of becoming the strongest?
He had never considered this.
For this one goal, he had worked so hard for so many years?
Now that he thought about it, his beast life was really too tragic.

chapters.title: Chapter 4887: Temporarily at peace
paragraphs: All the Great Emperors couldn’t help but sigh.
They had fought so hard here for so long, and they were actually only fighting a tough battle with the lackey of another?
This, they were really speechless.
But could this be blamed on the Star Moon Empress and the others?
Their purpose was to escape, and had not committed any heinous crime.
To say the least, if it was the Great Emperors that were trapped, would they also think of this method to escape?
The question was, how were the three invincible Great Emperors going to play next?
"I don’t believe it!" The old Divine Beast looked like it was about to collapse.
First, he had lost to Ling Han, and now, he was told that he was actually just a chess piece of someone else. This was a huge blow to him.

For a long time, he had been the number one person in the world — or beast. In any case, it did not matter. Even if he was being ganged up on by the Great Emperors, he was still incredibly carefree, and was completely unafraid.
That was because he was strong!

But now, he was no longer the number one elite. In fact, he couldn’t even be ranked in the top three, and it also proved that he was actually just a puppet. He thought that he was doing something great, but in the end, he was serving someone else. Furthermore, he was so stupid that he thought too highly of himself.
F***, he was a Great Emperor, not a miner!

"The Heaven Devouring Beast has only appeared once in history. Thankfully, I still remember a sliver of its mark of life, which allowed me to create it," the Star Moon Empress said calmly. "This kind of extraordinary beast would cause even heaven and earth to feel wariness."
Indeed, being able to devour the corpses of other Great Emperors and transform them into his own Mystical Powers, this was indeed extraordinary.
Ling Han asked calmly, "Then what are the three Great Emperors planning to do next? Do you want to destroy the world?"
"Destroy the world?" The Star Moon Empress laughed delicately. Her beautiful figure was like a willow in the wind, lightly trembling and swaying, filled with beauty.
She shook her head, "It wasn’t easy for us to escape. If we destroy this heaven and earth, what fun would there be left?"
Hearing these words, all the Great Emperors felt their hearts relax.
If these three Great Emperors committed evil, no one would be able to stop them.
Because they were existences that had cultivated the four elements, and were first tier Great Emperors, even if Ling Han and the old Divine Beast joined forces, they would still be no match.
However, Ling Han frowned.
Because in the words of the empress, destroying the world was only a matter of whether it was fun or not.
Such an important matter was only a matter of fun for her?
This kind of thought was too dangerous.

Ling Han knew that these three invincible Great Emperors had seen many replacements of heaven and earth. Thus, to them, so what if they destroyed the heavens and earth? They would just wait for the next reincarnation.
However, Ling Han was unable to accept this.
This world was too important to him.

His family and friends were all in this heaven and earth. If they died, and Ling Han had successfully cultivated the four elements, being able to continuously experience the change of heaven and earth like the Star Moon Empress and the others, what meaning was there to it?
However, now was definitely not the time to question, and become hostile with the three invincible Great Emperors.
If they became hostile, they would definitely die.
Since these three had no plans to destroy the world at present, Ling Han could also accumulate his abilities first. When he too advanced into the first tier, he would be qualified to match them.

"Then let me first congratulate the three of you on escaping." Ling Han smiled, then pointed, "We still have some debts to settle with this old Divine Beast, and hope that the three of you would not interfere either."
"Brat!" The Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor spoke up, "Are you issuing commands to us?"
Ling Han was neither servile nor overbearing, and said, "This old b@stard killed my friend, I want revenge!"
The old Divine Beast rolled its eyes. Just think, he was once the strongest being in this world, and he was actually called the old b@stard. How could he not be happy?
"This is our pet," the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor said haughtily. "Even if you want to beat a dog, you have to see who is the owner first. Are you planning to become enemies with us?"
Ling Han paused for two seconds before replying, "I wouldn’t dare!"
Although he said he didn’t dare, his eyes were resolute and his brows were raised, exuding an unyielding aura.
The Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor’s killing intent instantly soared. What kind of existence was he?

He was truly the strongest in the world, and had stood for several Stacked Eras. Furthermore, after being trapped for a long time, all his hot-bloodedness and passion had been worn away, leaving behind only violence.
"Hehe, what is there to argue about with a little kid?" The Star Moon Empress stretched out a hand to stop him.
She had the most authority among the three of them. Thus, though the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor humphed coldly, he no longer had the intention to make a move.
The old Divine Beast was extremely defiant. He was a second tier Great Emperor!
"What is it? Are you still not convinced?" The Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor stretched out a hand, and grabbed the old Divine Beast.
Hiss, the old Divine Beast that had once been invincible was actually not even qualified to dodge or parry.
There was a gulf of 10,000 levels between the first tier and the second tier!

Cultivating the four elements to the consummate level was a qualitative change. Even if heaven and earth retreated to the original point, they still could not be killed, which showed how powerful it was.
"Let’s go. We should go and take a look at this beautiful world," the Star Moon Empress said, and was the first to fly out.
The Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor grabbed onto the old Divine Beast, and left quickly without even looking at them.

"Boundless Great Emperor!" The Boundless Great Emperor had clearly left, but after taking a step, he suddenly turned his head, and gave a shout. Instantly, a wave rippled out towards Ling Han and the others.
Pu! Pu! Pu!
Instantly, aside from Ling Han, Jing Haoran, and Shui Qingchang, the other Great Emperors all threw up blood madly, feeling as if all the bones in their bodies had been shattered.
Even Ling Han and the others were pale, feeling indescribably uncomfortable.
Only now did everyone know that even though this Boundless Great Emperor looked benevolent, he was the most temperamental and merciless.

In this attack, the Boundless Great Emperor had used the essence of death. Though it was not a very large amount, it still caused every single Great Emperor to be enshrouded in an air of death, which was enough to torment them for a very, very long time.
With the appearance of such a temperamental Great Emperor, what kind of calamity would be caused?
Most importantly, to say nothing of the fact that Ling Han and the others were unable to leave, even if they could leave, would they be able to stop them?
Now, each of them had surpassed the limit of their lifespans, and had the support of the element of life here, but once they left, they would naturally die immediately.
At this moment, everyone’s eyes were focused on Ling Han.
Only Ling Han would have the chance to cultivate the four elements, and battle those three strongest Great Emperors.
Who would have thought that after battling hundreds of billions of enemies, that was actually just a lackey?
This kind of understanding caused a great blow to the Great Emperors. Just think, which one of them had not ruled over their own era, yet they were actually unable to deal with even someone’s dog?
This was far too displeasing.

Ling Han took a deep breath. Though the Star Moon Empress was the leader of the three of them, she seemed to be the easiest to deal with, and the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor was ruthless, and the Boundless Great Emperor was temperamental. From the attack he delivered just before he left, it was clear that this person’s temperament was extremely sinister.
More importantly, if a great conflict really broke out, the Star Moon Empress may not be able to stop the two of them.
They were all Great Emperors, so who would be weaker than the other?
"I want to cultivate in seclusion!" Ling Han said. He entered the Cave of Death and moved the rocks away. He then sat beside the pond.

Of course, he didn’t dare to enter the pool. That was the Pool of Death, and it was filled with the essence of death. Even if Ling Han’s body had the essence of life, he would still be severely injured by this thing. If he came into contact with it too much, he would die.
After all, the element of life in his body was limited, and he was still unable to grow endlessly.

Instantly, aside from Ling Han, Jing Haoran, and Shui Qingchang, the other Great Emperors all threw up blood madly, feeling as if all the bones in their bodies had been shattered.
Even Ling Han and the others were pale, feeling indescribably uncomfortable.
Only now did everyone know that even though this Boundless Great Emperor looked benevolent, he was the most temperamental and merciless.
In this attack, the Boundless Great Emperor had used the essence of death.
Though it was not a very large amount, it still caused every single Great Emperor to be enshrouded in an air of death, which was enough to torment them for a very, very long time.
With the appearance of such a temperamental Great Emperor, what kind of calamity would be caused?
Most importantly, to say nothing of the fact that Ling Han and the others were unable to leave, even if they could leave, would they be able to stop them?
Now, each of them had surpassed the limit of their lifespans, and had the support of the element of life here, but once they left, they would naturally die immediately.
At this moment, everyone’s eyes were focused on Ling Han.
Only Ling Han would have the chance to cultivate the four elements, and battle those three strongest Great Emperors.
Who would have thought that after battling hundreds of billions of enemies, that was actually just a lackey?
This kind of understanding caused a great blow to the Great Emperors.
Just think, which one of them had not ruled over their own era, yet they were actually unable to deal with even someone’s dog?
This was far too displeasing.
Ling Han took a deep breath.

Though the Star Moon Empress was the leader of the three of them, she seemed to be the easiest to deal with, and the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor was ruthless, and the Boundless Great Emperor was temperamental.
From the attack he delivered just before he left, it was clear that this person’s temperament was extremely sinister.
More importantly, if a great conflict really broke out, the Star Moon Empress may not be able to stop the two of them.
They were all Great Emperors, so who would be weaker than the other?
"I want to cultivate in seclusion!" Ling Han said.
He entered the Cave of Death and moved the rocks away.
He then sat beside the pond.
Of course, he didn’t dare to enter the pool.
That was the Pool of Death, and it was filled with the essence of death.
Even if Ling Han’s body had the essence of life, he would still be severely injured by this thing.
If he came into contact with it too much, he would die.
After all, the element of life in his body was limited, and he was still unable to grow endlessly.

chapters.title: Chapter 4888: Comprehending the essence of death
paragraphs: Ling Han felt a strong sense of urgency.
Who knew what the Star Moon Empress would do? There were three Great Emperors that had been trapped for more than two Stacked Eras, so it was possible that they would go crazy.
Moreover, to such Great Emperors, even if heaven and earth returned to its origin, they would still be unable to die. At that time, they would be trapped again.
Perhaps they could still appear in the next Stacked Era, or perhaps not. Thus, they had even more reason to be crazy.
This world... was only a toy to them, and also a cage for them.
Thus, so what if they damaged this world? After several years, the heaven and earth would regenerate, and everything would only repeat itself.
Would such Great Emperors take pity on the common people?
Wasn’t this a joke?
Thus, Ling Han had to hurry up and stop the three Great Emperors before they destroyed the world.
What he could do was to grasp the essence of death.

The Star Moon Empress and the others had been overconfident. They had only thought that Ling Han had only "simply" grasped the four elements. They would never have imagined that Ling Han had already constructed his own heaven and earth within his body. He was only missing the single element of death.
Once he took this step, Ling Han would be equivalent to a different heaven and earth.
It was never the Great Emperor that could stand against the heaven and earth, but rather another heaven and earth!
From the fact that Ling Han had crushed the old Divine Beast, it could be seen that the true way to go was for him to have such a grasp of the fundamental elements.
If he was given time, he could do it.
However, how was one supposed to grasp the essence of death?
The first key element was relatively easy to grasp, and the subsequent elements would be difficult. With the repulsion of the key elements, the group of Great Emperors were completely at a loss.

Only the old Divine Beast had devoured countless souls, and had more than one spiritual mark in his body, which allowed him to continue comprehending the fundamental elements without being affected. Then, it was Ling Han, Jing Haoran, and the other Genesis World rulers. Because they had long since grasped the fundamental element of destruction, they could achieve success in a roundabout manner.
And when it came to the second tier, only Ling Han had managed to cultivate the element of creation by relying on the repulsion of the elements of life and destruction.
However, how was he supposed to grasp the fourth key element?
Previously, when Ling Han had been battling fiercely with the old Divine Beast, he had been thinking about it. However, he had never had a clue.

From a certain aspect, the appearance of the Star Moon Empress and the others had actually helped Ling Han out of his predicament. Otherwise, it was really possible that the old Divine Beast would be the first to grasp the key element of death.

Of course, Ling Han belonged to the category of characters who had more explosive power the greater the pressure they were under. Perhaps, in that kind of situation, his brain would run wild, and he would come up with a solution.
There was no point talking about this now. Ling Han calmed his mind and continued to comprehend.
Tens of thousands of years had passed, and Ling Han had no clue at all.
He was not in a rush. It was difficult to grasp the fundamental elements in the first place, what more when he now had to reach consummate level.
Another three million years passed, and Ling Han had already tried out all the usual methods.
It did not work.
He came to this conclusion.
He couldn’t help but wonder, ’How did the Star Moon Empress and the others succeed?’
After some thought, he set this question aside.
How others did it was their own business.
And after at least thirty-four Stacked Eras, only three people had managed to grasp all four key elements, which showed how difficult it was.
Since the heaven and earth had birthed an existence like the Divine Beasts, who knows, there may be someone that could have two souls in one body?
Er, he said he didn’t want to, but why was he thinking about it again?
Ling Han forcefully suppressed this thought, and focused his attention on himself.
Ordinary methods were completely impossible.
Then, how should he take the unconventional path?
Ling Han fell into deep thought.
Another million years later, he decided to take the risk.
Since he wanted to grasp the key element, why not just touch it directly?

In the outside world, this could not be done, because the essence of death could not be seen or touched, and could only be sensed. However, in this place, the essence of death had taken solid form, and fused into the pool.
Ling Han walked over and touched it with his hand.
Boom, instantly, endless power of death assaulted, wanting to destroy his vitality.
Thankfully, Ling Han had only come into contact with a little bit of it. Using the three major elements to resist, this was not enough to kill him.
This method was feasible!

Ling Han’s idea was very simple, and that was to use the large amount of element of death here to resist the three elements in his body. Then, when he went to comprehend the element of death, he would not encounter any obstruction.
This was very, very difficult.

He had to maintain an absolute balance. Otherwise, if there was less element of death drawn in, those three elements would still disturb him, and if there was too much, it would directly destroy his vitality.
This was really a situation of neither advancing nor retreating. He had to maintain an incredibly fragile balance.
And just like that, as he walked on the edge of the cliff, Ling Han began to comprehend the essence of death.
Progress was slow.

There were quite a few times that Ling Han made mistakes, and almost led to a great disaster. There was even one time that he was completely disfigured. Thankfully, the empress and Hu Niu discovered it in time and sent him to the Cave of Life, where he lay for a whole thirty thousand years before he finally recovered.
The moment he recovered, Ling Han went to the Cave of Death again.
When the other Great Emperors found out, they decided to take the risk and make an attempt as well.

They had all grasped the essence of life. Thus, they also possessed the ability to resist the essence of death. However, they were extremely fragile, and would be killed if they were the slightest bit careless.
However, none of them were afraid.
Now, they didn’t even have to fight the old Divine Beast anymore. Could it be that they would have to wait here until the day the heaven and earth returned to square one?
What difference did this have to prison?
They would go crazy.
Furthermore, Great Emperors all had great intelligence, great decisiveness, and would definitely not hesitate to take a gamble.
In the past, they had not had the chance, but now, Ling Han had pushed open a door for them.
Time passed, and 70,000 years later, a Great Emperor died.

It was a newly promoted Great Emperor, Luo Yang, the son of the Heavenly Saint Emperor. He had been eroded by the power of death, and had been sent to the Cave of Life. It was useless, as the soul imprint had long since dimmed.
However, this did not affect the Great Emperors in the slightest.
One million years, ten million years, 100 million years!

When time had reached more than 960 million years, Ling Han finally attained a breakthrough, and the other Great Emperors also saw the light of dawn gradually, but they still needed time to truly master it.
Inside Ling Han’s body, the essence of death turned into a trickle that was converging in his small heaven and earth.

However, this was still extremely fragile, and could not resist the three major elements. Thus, Ling Han was still stimulating even more element of death to enter, and continued to resist the three major elements.
Another 100 million years passed, and the inside of Ling Han’s body had changed completely in appearance.
His life force that had been growing madly all this while was now under control, and he was experiencing normal aging and death.
There was life and death, beginning and ending. This was a perfect balance and cycle.
Realization dawned on him. Why could the Genesis World only be called a small world? That was because Celestial Kings and above could attain immortality. This did not align with Dao.
Weng, his eyes suddenly snapped open. Four-coloured light flickered, penetrating through the heaven and earth.
Boom, a powerful aura surged out of his body, indescribably terrifying.
First tier!
After so many years, he had finally successfully grasped the four elements, and became the fourth person in countless Stacked Eras to have grasped the four elements.
Furthermore, unlike the Star Moon Empress and the others, Ling Han had not only grasped the four elements, he had even developed another heaven and earth in his body.

chapters.title: Chapter 4889: Flawless consummate level
paragraphs: After entering the Primitive Abyss for close to a billion years, Ling Han finally reached the limit of martial arts.
Consummate level of the four elements. He had constructed his own heaven and earth, which was perfect and flawless.
He was the embodiment of heaven and earth.
Ling Han had a feeling that if he were to fight with the old Divine Beast now, he would be able to crush it with a single finger.
There were tens of thousands of third tiers separating the first and second tiers.

And what made Ling Han even happier was the fact that there was an endless supply of element of life in his body now, and he could already regenerate them on his own. The collision of the four elements was not destructive, but rather endless.
Having formed his own heaven and earth, he naturally could produce the four main elements on his own.
This meant that not only could he leave the Imperial Island, but others could as well.
What did he have to fear now that his lifespan had dried up?
He was a human-shaped supply station for the element of life!
Ling Han swept an eye over them. Most of the Great Emperors were still cultivating in seclusion, so he did not disturb them either. Instead, he began to stroll by the coast.
In fact, he had even entered into the great ocean. The main element of death was no longer the fatal assassin, and was like an ordinary wave crashing down on him, incredibly gentle.
To him, there were no more dangerous places in this world.
—He was the heaven and earth , and could overwhelm everything else, so what danger would there be?

After cultivating the four fundamental elements, one would possess the ability to transcend the heaven and earth. Thus, the Star Moon Empress and the others could ignore the limits of their lifespans, and traverse one Stacked Era after another. However, they did not have their own heaven and earth, but lived in this heaven and earth, yet were destined to be suppressed again.
The passing of one Stacked Era after another was a torture to their immortality.
Moreover, they couldn’t die even if they wanted to. The heaven and earth couldn’t kill them, and neither could they themselves.
This kind of life... it would be strange if they weren’t crazy.
Ling Han continued to familiarize himself with the use of the four elements. Mastering them was one matter, but how to completely unleash their might was another matter.

The three first tier Great Emperors had been stuck at this cultivation level for far, far too long, so their mastery of the four fundamental elements was definitely far superior to his. Thus, even though he had the advantage of heaven and earth, he still couldn’t be blindly confident.
Of course, the three of them definitely wouldn’t be able to kill him. They had also grasped four key elements, and that meant invincibility.
On the other hand, Ling Han could kill them.
Why?

That was because as long as the three Emperors were dragged into his heaven and earth, this would be another world for the three of them. The four elements they had grasped would slowly be exhausted, and ultimately, they would be killed by him.
After waiting for another seven million years, the Great Emperors gradually came out of seclusion.

A great many Great Emperors had advanced into third tier, but there were also a great many that had not managed to take this step. They were basically Great Emperors that had broken through in the Primitive Abyss, and lacked too much accumulation.
After all, those who could become Great Emperors in the outside world all possessed great fortune.
Ling Han related his thoughts of leaving, and obtained the agreement of a great many Great Emperors.
After having left for so long, they all wanted to return to see what that universe had become.
However, there were still a great many Great Emperors that expressed that they wanted to stay on the Imperial Island. They had not yet comprehended the essence of death, and wanted to continue.
There were also some third tier Great Emperors that were going to stay behind. They were all maniacs of martial arts, and wanted to break through to second tier.
For example, Jing Haoran and Shui Qingchang also decided to stay behind. They were too far behind Ling Han, and wanted to catch up to him.
However, they hadn’t formed their own heaven and earth, so it was almost impossible for them to grasp the third key elemtn.
They had all come from the Stone of Life, yet Ling Han had stolen all of their fortune.
Survival of the fittest; this was also the way of nature.
Everyone set out, leaving the island.
To say nothing of the fact that Ling Han was leading the way, even if he wasn’t, this Sea of Death wasn’t much, because everyone had basically grasped the key element of death.
Of course, even if they had grasped the essence of death, they did not dare to come into direct contact with it for too long. That would still result in death.
Of course, this was unless they could reach Ling Han’s level and reach the consummate level of the four elements.
Ling Han gifted them some element of life, allowing the Great Emperors to maintain their lifespans.
Each portion could allow the Great Emperors to live for as long as 100,000 years. Thus, there was absolutely no need for them to worry.
—Even if they went to the outside world, how long would it take for the Great Emperors to return to the Imperial Island?
After exiting the Sea of Death, the storm of heaven and earth appeared once more.
However, Ling Han merely waved his hand lightly, and the storm of heaven and earth suddenly disappeared.
This was the power of a Great Emperor!
Even the Great Emperors couldn’t help but click their tongues in wonder and admit their inferiority.
Because they were walking straight ahead, their speed was very fast. In less than half a day, they had already exited the Primitive Abyss.
Yi?
Everyone was shocked, because the Primitive Abyss was incredibly close to the borders of heaven and earth, but now?
The surroundings were dotted with stars, as if they had appeared in the centre of the universe.
What the hell!?
"Let’s split up and take a look," the Great Emperors all said. Initially, they had also planned to separate after leaving the Imperial Island.
The Great Emperors all left, while Ling Han nodded. Even if he had left the Imperial Island, he could still grasp the four key elements at any time.
No wonder the Star Moon Empress and the others could leave without any reservations, and need not worry about the problem of their lifespans.
In truth, this kind of connection was active. The four elements surging into his body was like instinct.
Thus, theoretically speaking, even if the Star Moon Empress and the others wanted to commit suicide, they would not be able to do so.
Ling Han casually grabbed a ball of element of life and inserted it into the large black dog’s body.
"Little Han, what are you doing?" the large black dog asked curiously.
"Oh, an experiment," Ling Han said casually.
"Pei, don’t experiment on Grandpa Dog!" the large black dog hurriedly spat.
Ling Han smiled, and stretched out a hand. A small dot of light appeared in the palm of his hand, which then slowly became larger, and actually turned into a piece of metal!
"Origin Gold!" the large black dog immediately exclaimed in astonishment. He recognized what it was.
The empress and the others were also astonished. How had Ling Han suddenly created a piece of Origin Gold?

"I’m my own heaven and earth, so creating Origin Gold is only a matter of thought for me," Ling Han said with a smile. Moreover, his heaven and earth was born from this world, so the two were completely similar.

The large black dog snatched the Origin Gold from him, then immediately stuffed it back, and said, "Little Han, you directly forge it into a tool for Grandpa Dog, and upgrade it to become the Transcendent Weapon!"
Ling Han smiled, "You really have a lot of requests."
"Those who are capable do more work!" The large black dog was extremely shameless.
Ling Han didn’t refuse. With a thought, the grade of the Origin Gold began to increase.
The so-called Metal of Creation was a form of the element of creation, so he naturally had no difficulty at all.

"What form do you want—" Ling Han was just about to ask the large black dog what shape the Transcendent Weapon would be made into, but when he saw the perverted expression on the large black dog’s face, he resolutely didn’t ask further.
A pair of shining golden iron underwear quickly took form.

"Take it!" Ling Han tossed the Transcendent Weapon to the large black dog. He then placed his hand on his forehead. In the future, he definitely wouldn’t admit that this Transcendent Weapon was created by him.
How humiliating!
Meanwhile, the large black dog happily put on his iron underwear. Then, he began to refine it, turning it into the true Transcendent Weapon. Otherwise, it would only be a Spirit Tool.
"You guys have a share too." Ling Han nodded at the empress and the others. They were already eager.

To say nothing of the fact that Ling Han was leading the way, even if he wasn’t, this Sea of Death wasn’t much, because everyone had basically grasped the key element of death.
Of course, even if they had grasped the essence of death, they did not dare to come into direct contact with it for too long.
That would still result in death.
Of course, this was unless they could reach Ling Han’s level and reach the consummate level of the four elements.
Ling Han gifted them some element of life, allowing the Great Emperors to maintain their lifespans.
Each portion could allow the Great Emperors to live for as long as 100,000 years.
Thus, there was absolutely no need for them to worry.
—Even if they went to the outside world, how long would it take for the Great Emperors to return to the Imperial Island?
After exiting the Sea of Death, the storm of heaven and earth appeared once more.
However, Ling Han merely waved his hand lightly, and the storm of heaven and earth suddenly disappeared.
This was the power of a Great Emperor!
Even the Great Emperors couldn’t help but click their tongues in wonder and admit their inferiority.
Because they were walking straight ahead, their speed was very fast.
In less than half a day, they had already exited the Primitive Abyss.
Yi?
Everyone was shocked, because the Primitive Abyss was incredibly close to the borders of heaven and earth, but now?
The surroundings were dotted with stars, as if they had appeared in the centre of the universe.
What the hell!?
"Let’s split up and take a look," the Great Emperors all said.
Initially, they had also planned to separate after leaving the Imperial Island.
The Great Emperors all left, while Ling Han nodded.
Even if he had left the Imperial Island, he could still grasp the four key elements at any time.
No wonder the Star Moon Empress and the others could leave without any reservations, and need not worry about the problem of their lifespans.
In truth, this kind of connection was active.
The four elements surging into his body was like instinct.
Thus, theoretically speaking, even if the Star Moon Empress and the others wanted to commit suicide, they would not be able to do so.
Ling Han casually grabbed a ball of element of life and inserted it into the large black dog’s body.
"Little Han, what are you doing?" the large black dog asked curiously.
"Oh, an experiment," Ling Han said casually.
"Pei, don’t experiment on Grandpa Dog!" the large black dog hurriedly spat.
Ling Han smiled, and stretched out a hand.
A small dot of light appeared in the palm of his hand, which then slowly became larger, and actually turned into a piece of metal!
"Origin Gold!" the large black dog immediately exclaimed in astonishment.
He recognized what it was.
The empress and the others were also astonished.
How had Ling Han suddenly created a piece of Origin Gold?
"I’m my own heaven and earth, so creating Origin Gold is only a matter of thought for me," Ling Han said with a smile.
Moreover, his heaven and earth was born from this world, so the two were completely similar.

The large black dog snatched the Origin Gold from him, then immediately stuffed it back, and said, "Little Han, you directly forge it into a tool for Grandpa Dog, and upgrade it to become the Transcendent Weapon!"
Ling Han smiled, "You really have a lot of requests."
"Those who are capable do more work!" The large black dog was extremely shameless.
Ling Han didn’t refuse.
With a thought, the grade of the Origin Gold began to increase.
The so-called Metal of Creation was a form of the element of creation, so he naturally had no difficulty at all.

"What form do you want—" Ling Han was just about to ask the large black dog what shape the Transcendent Weapon would be made into, but when he saw the perverted expression on the large black dog’s face, he resolutely didn’t ask further.
A pair of shining golden iron underwear quickly took form.
"Take it!" Ling Han tossed the Transcendent Weapon to the large black dog.
He then placed his hand on his forehead.
In the future, he definitely wouldn’t admit that this Transcendent Weapon was created by him.
How humiliating!
Meanwhile, the large black dog happily put on his iron underwear.
Then, he began to refine it, turning it into the true Transcendent Weapon.
Otherwise, it would only be a Spirit Tool.
"You guys have a share too." Ling Han nodded at the empress and the others.
They were already eager.

chapters.title: Chapter 4890: The world has changed
paragraphs: It didn’t take long before everyone possessed a Transcendent Weapon.
For Ling Han, this was only a matter of time.

Unlike the large black dog, the little azure dragon and the others only required the Transcendent Weapon to be practical — of course, the so-called practicality of the large black dog was not recognized by anyone at all, but in the case of the empress and the others, they had many more requests.
Firstly, it had to be aesthetically pleasing!
This was the top priority.

Ling Han simply chose to forge a Battle Armor for each of them. Because he was too familiar with the women, the Battle Armor he forged naturally fit them extremely well, outlining every single curve of their bodies.
Beautiful!
This made the women very happy. Each of them gave Ling Han a sweet kiss.
"Hey, hey, hey. Do you want us to leave first?" the large black dog asked with a smile.
"Is one day enough?" the little azure dragon asked with a smile. He and the large black dog were a perfect team.
The large black dog immediately glared at him, "Are you looking down on Little Han? What need is there for a day? At most, three minutes!"
"Hahaha!" The little azure dragon instantly roared with laughter.
Peng! Peng!
The empress and Hu Niu both lashed out, kicking the large black dog and little azure dragon into oblivion.
Ling Han smiled faintly, "Come, let’s go and take a look too."
When a Great Emperor traveled, crossing the galaxy was only the matter of a single thought. Hence, they had only taken a single step, and landed on a planet.
At this time, the large black dog and little azure dragon had also returned.
Everyone sized up this star, their expressions filled with surprise.
This was definitely a newly born star. It had only existed for eight million years, and everyone was very sure of this fact. However, this star was filled with all kinds of living creatures.

Ordinarily, eight million years of evolution was completely insufficient to create the most primitive life forms, but in this place, there were already cultivators here, and the strongest among them was Saint-level.
Thus, how could this not be shocking?
Was it related to the collapse of the universe?
No, that was definitely impossible.
"It’s those three!" Everyone immediately reached a unanimous conclusion.

It had been about a billion years since those three invincible Great Emperors had left the Primitive Abyss. In this heaven and earth, it would have been about ten million years. Thus, it made sense that they had created the stars here after coming out.

Only those Great Emperors who had grasped the four fundamental elements could create things out of thin air, and only then could they bestow life, and only then could they allow a world to evolve to this extent in such a short period of time.
"Walk slowly, and take a look slowly."
Ling Han said, and took the lead.
They entered into a city. There were many people here, and cultivators ran rampant.

"This is your girl?" They were walking on the streets, and had not thought that a sturdy man would suddenly appear out of nowhere. His eyes were fixed on the empress, but these words were directed at Ling Han.
Ling Han gave the empress a look, telling her to calm down. Then, he smiled and said, "That’s right."
"Let me have her!" the brawny man said, his expression self-righteous, as if he was just saying something very ordinary.
Ling Han shook his head, "Why should I let you have her?"
"If you don’t, I’ll beat you to death!" the brawny man said. True enough, he moved directly, waving his hand at Ling Han.
He was merely a Cauldron Forging Tier.
Since when had Cauldron Forging Tiers become so arrogant?

Though Ling Han and the others had completely returned to simplicity, and their auras were not obvious, even Saints could not possibly tell that they were extraordinary, the problem was that a Cauldron Forging Tier was only a minor character on a planet that had Saints.
A minor character actually dared to commit a crime in public, and snatch someone else’s wife?
What kind of world was this?
Ling Han tapped out a finger, and pa, this sturdy man turned into a shower of blood.
Such a decisive attack instantly intimidated those around them who were also eager to give it a try, and they did not dare to make the slightest move.
They were violent and lawless, but they were not so stupid that they would still attack even if they knew that they would definitely die.

However, after Ling Han and the others had walked for a while, they encountered some idiots who wanted to snatch the empress and the others by force. In fact, even the large black dog was targeted by others, and they wanted to capture him to become their pet beast.
This infuriated the large black dog, and he immediately aimed his butt at him. The Transcendent Weapon unleashed a dazzling glow, causing the person to vanish into thin air.
And along the way, Ling Han saw people openly robbing and killing people, kidnapping women, and even committing rape in public.
There was no order, only chaos, and only elites could do as they liked.
What kind of world was this?

Weng, a powerful aura suddenly appeared. Then, an elder appeared. Peng, peng, peng! The aura swept over, and many people had no time to escape at all. Instantly, they were crushed into pieces, crushed to death on the spot.
This was a Saint.
This Saint stared at the large black dog’s black dog. To be more exact, he was staring at his underpants.

He had been attracted by the light emitted by the Saint Tool, and that was why he had moved. And with his insight, he could tell with a single glance that this pair of iron underwear was extraordinary.
Saint Tool!
He thought, and couldn’t help as his greed blazed.
However, he was also a little conflicted internally. Which b@stard was so reckless to actually forge Saintly Material into underpants?

In the future, when he encountered powerful enemies, he would fight them, and in order to conclude the battle once and for all, he would suddenly summon the Saint Tool. When his opponent saw that it was actually a pair of iron underwear, would he burst out laughing?
However, since he had encountered such a Saint Tool, how could he possibly miss out on it?
"Hand over the Saint Tool, and I can spare your life," the Saint said calmly. It was as if he were doing them a favor.
The large black dog flew into a thunderous rage, "Shameless old b@stard, you actually want to peel Grandpa Dog’s underpants? You old b@stard, old and indecent, old and undying, old and corrupt..."
It was the king of verbal abuse, and it was about to curse in a single breath, causing even that Saint to be dumbfounded.
Heavens, so he could actually curse like this!
As it turned out, insults also had such terrifying might, making him want to throw up blood!

—Ordinary verbal battles naturally did not have such might, but the large black dog was different. It was presently a Great Emperor. Though it was still only in fourth tier, with a word from the Great Emperor, heaven and earth would follow. This was the Regulation of Karma!
Thus, the Saint was naturally feeling terrible. This was the pressure exerted by heaven and earth.

"Enough!" That Saint couldn’t help but roar. He felt like the world was spinning around him. He was really afraid that he would be directly scolded unconscious by the large black dog. If that happened, he would really be leaving his name in history.
"Just because you say enough, it is enough? Who do you think you are? Grandpa Dog doesn’t want face?" the large black dog scoffed.
The Saint was so infuriated that his entire body was trembling. He then launched a palm strike at the large black dog.
To say nothing of the fact that he didn’t know that the large black dog was a Great Emperor, even if he did, he would probably be so furious that he couldn’t care less.
The large black dog chuckled as he pointed his butt at the Saint. Weng! The Transcendent Weapon unleashed its might and shot out a column of light.
Boom! The pillar of light surged past, and that Saint was also turned into dust. Not even ashes could be found.
The large black dog clearly had countless ways to kill Saints, yet he had used the most despicable method.
"The most despicable person in the world!"
"Eternal Despicable Great Emperor!"

The little azure dragon and the little red bird both felt rueful. Even if he had become a Great Emperor, he wouldn’t be able to change his despicable nature. Sure enough, it was easy to change mountains and rivers, but hard to change one’s despicable nature.

chapters.title: Chapter 4891: Settling the Chaos
paragraphs: Joking was one thing, but the scene they saw on this planet made everyone frown.
Though this place was filled with vitality, the overall atmosphere was extraordinarily violent.
In this place, there was no order. Everything was decided through violence.
Thus, all kinds of evil deeds could be seen continuously. Killing, robbing, and humiliation were the main theme of the entire planet.
With such chaos, why could such a large population be maintained? Shouldn’t they have long since sought their own demise?

Ling Han and the others discovered that firstly, the birth rate here was too high. On the one hand, people were being killed, but on the other, new lives were continuously being born. Furthermore, the time of pregnancy had been shortened to a mere month.
Moreover, the growth rate of Spiritual Herbs was also ridiculously fast. Most of them only needed to grow for a few years to have the effects of a hundred years old, or even a thousand years old.
It was as if the entire planet was nurturing the people on it in an overdrafted manner.

This star had clearly only been born for eight million years, and logically speaking, it hadn’t even passed the time of infancy. However, Ling Han observed for a moment, and discovered that more than half of the energy in the core of planet had already been lost.
At this rate, at most, in another eight million years, this planet would be heading towards destruction.
At that time, aside from those above Spirit Transformation True Lords, everyone else would die.

Oh, no, there was no need to wait until that time. When the star dried up, and could no longer nurture these people, it was believed that the majority would have long since starved to death, and no new life would be born. There was absolutely no need to worry about the problem of the star heading towards death.
Ling Han and the others went to another planet, and the scene they saw was almost the same.
Three, four, five, all the stars were the same, barbaric and wild.
Not long after, the Great Emperors all returned.
Everyone shared what they had seen and heard, and the result was the same. The whole galaxy had become a barbaric world, where there was only slaughter, ruled by the most primitive desires.
"It must be the doing of those three!" In the end, all the Great Emperors came to a conclusion.
Those three people had been imprisoned for too long. Even if they had once been the most upright and kindest people, it would not be strange for them to have gone crazy.
Being imprisoned for two Stacked Eras at the drop of a hat, it would be strange if one didn’t go crazy.
Ling Han frowned. He decided to return to the Four Origin Planet first.
However, from the moment he left to the moment he returned, more than a billion years had passed in the Primitive Abyss. In this outside world, more than ten million years had also passed.
After such a long time, even a Great Emperor would have to live a second life to be able to survive. If it was a Saint, they would have long since died over a dozen times.
In other words, the people that Ling Han had known all those years ago had long since died.
Ling Han was extremely rueful. He very much wanted to know how his descendants were doing.
Although he had brought a group of people into the inner world, there were still more people who had stayed outside.
This time, Ling Han only traveled with the empress and the large black dog. There weren’t many of them.
At first, he had still held onto a sliver of hope, but after coming here, he was disappointed.
Four Origin Planet... also became an unreasonable world.
The Nine Suns Holy Landwas still here, and it was still the strongest force of Four Origin Planet. However, it had also become a force that used its power to bully others.
Just ask around, and the evil deeds committed by Nine Suns Holy Land were innumerable.
"What are those three playing at? Even if they have gone mad, there is no need for the whole world to go mad, right?" Even the large black dog could not bear to watch any longer.
In other places, they could still be detached from the outside world as they would be outsiders. However, Four Origin Planet was their ancestral grounds.
It had also become like this!
Ling Han nodded, and said, "Then let’s start correcting the chaos and re-establishing order!"
The Four Origin Planet was of extraordinary significance to him, so he definitely had to take it back and start over again.
Since the Nine Suns Holy Land was Four Origin Planet’s strongest force, Ling Han and the others naturally headed directly to the Nine Suns Holy Land.

When he arrived in front of the mountain gates of the Nine Suns Holy Land, he saw that there was a massive stone statue erected at the entrance. It was thirty thousand meters tall, and had even surpassed the highest mountain peak in the Holy Land.
"Who is this?" the large black dog called out. He couldn’t recognize this stone statue at all.

Theoretically speaking, the first person who was qualified to have a stone statue erected in his memory would naturally be the Founder, the Nine Suns Saint. The second person would be the Nine Mountains Old Man. For the sake of the Nine Mountains Holy Land, he could be said to have done his utmost, right until death.
Of course, Ling Han was also qualified. To say nothing of his identity as a Great Emperor, he had also done an equally great service for the Nine Suns Holy Land.
However, the statue of a stranger had now been erected.

"You’ve come to become disciples?" Someone walked over. It was a young man who looked alright. His eyes swept over the empress, Hu Niu, and Chi Menghan, and he said, "Three beauties, if you follow me, I can guarantee that you’ll become disciples of the Holy Land!"
This was really blatant poaching.
"Scram!" the empress said coldly.
Meanwhile, the young man looked dazed and captivated. He felt that the empress looked beautiful when she was angered, and his heart throbbed wildly.

"Haha, since you’ve delivered yourself to my doorstep, then I won’t be reserved!" the young man said. At first, he had wanted to play soft. If the three women were willing to follow him, that would naturally be best. After all, though the melon that was forcibly plucked had a unique flavor, it was not sweet after all.
However, just the sight of these melons was fragrant. He was definitely going to get hold of them!
He charged over, looking like he was going to grab the empress and the others.
However, as he ran, he realized that his legs had disappeared. Then, his arms had also disappeared, leaving behind only a torso.
He was astounded. More importantly, it was as if his arms and legs were naturally non-existent. Not a single drop of blood dripped from his wounds.
This, this, this, were these people demons?
"Hurry up and return my arms and legs to me!" the young man shouted loudly. "My older brother is Lord Sect Master’s ninth disciple!"

Seeing a conflict arise here, quite a number of people gathered around, but all of them only crossed their arms over their chests, their expressions filled with delight at the misfortune of others. They completely treated themselves as spectators watching the excitement.
This kind of sect did not have the slightest atmosphere of friendliness.
No, there was no longer any element of "love" in the whole world. Everyone was like a beast, preying on the weak.

"Brat, you’re definitely going to die. Why don’t you give the three girls to me, and I’ll take care of them for you? I guarantee that I will feed them to their heart’s content every day," someone said to Ling Han, their words extremely vulgar.

"Junior Brother Xu, with that thin staff of yours, to say nothing of giving you three beauties, even if there was only one, how many minutes would you be able to last?" Immediately, someone undermined him.
"Just give them to me!"
"Give them to me!"
"Give themto me!"
A great many people were calling out, and some were even glaring. They were about to come to blows.
Ling Han shook his head, and with a flick of his finger, everyone in the surroundings instantly disappeared.
It was not death, but rather disappearance.
Element of destruction!
The young man at the beginning naturally saw this, and this time, he finally knew fear.
"You, don’t be rash!" he said in a trembling voice, his two rows of teeth chattering.
Ling Han pointed at the towering stone statue, and asked, "Who is this person?"
"Lord Sect Master, of course," the young man replied.
’F*ck! How shameless!’

In this outside world, more than ten million years had also passed.
After such a long time, even a Great Emperor would have to live a second life to be able to survive.
If it was a Saint, they would have long since died over a dozen times.
In other words, the people that Ling Han had known all those years ago had long since died.
Ling Han was extremely rueful.
He very much wanted to know how his descendants were doing.
Although he had brought a group of people into the inner world, there were still more people who had stayed outside.
This time, Ling Han only traveled with the empress and the large black dog.
There weren’t many of them.
At first, he had still held onto a sliver of hope, but after coming here, he was disappointed.
Four Origin Planet... also became an unreasonable world.
The Nine Suns Holy Landwas still here, and it was still the strongest force of Four Origin Planet.
However, it had also become a force that used its power to bully others.
Just ask around, and the evil deeds committed by Nine Suns Holy Land were innumerable.
"What are those three playing at?
Even if they have gone mad, there is no need for the whole world to go mad, right?" Even the large black dog could not bear to watch any longer.
In other places, they could still be detached from the outside world as they would be outsiders.
However, Four Origin Planet was their ancestral grounds.
It had also become like this!
Ling Han nodded, and said, "Then let’s start correcting the chaos and re-establishing order!"
The Four Origin Planet was of extraordinary significance to him, so he definitely had to take it back and start over again.
Since the Nine Suns Holy Land was Four Origin Planet’s strongest force, Ling Han and the others naturally headed directly to the Nine Suns Holy Land.
When he arrived in front of the mountain gates of the Nine Suns Holy Land, he saw that there was a massive stone statue erected at the entrance.
It was thirty thousand meters tall, and had even surpassed the highest mountain peak in the Holy Land.
"Who is this?" the large black dog called out.
He couldn’t recognize this stone statue at all.
Theoretically speaking, the first person who was qualified to have a stone statue erected in his memory would naturally be the Founder, the Nine Suns Saint.
The second person would be the Nine Mountains Old Man.
For the sake of the Nine Mountains Holy Land, he could be said to have done his utmost, right until death.
Of course, Ling Han was also qualified.
To say nothing of his identity as a Great Emperor, he had also done an equally great service for the Nine Suns Holy Land.
However, the statue of a stranger had now been erected.
"You’ve come to become disciples?" Someone walked over.
It was a young man who looked alright.
His eyes swept over the empress, Hu Niu, and Chi Menghan, and he said, "Three beauties, if you follow me, I can guarantee that you’ll become disciples of the Holy Land!"
This was really blatant poaching.
"Scram!" the empress said coldly.
Meanwhile, the young man looked dazed and captivated.
He felt that the empress looked beautiful when she was angered, and his heart throbbed wildly.
"Haha, since you’ve delivered yourself to my doorstep, then I won’t be reserved!" the young man said.
At first, he had wanted to play soft.
If the three women were willing to follow him, that would naturally be best.
After all, though the melon that was forcibly plucked had a unique flavor, it was not sweet after all.
However, just the sight of these melons was fragrant.
He was definitely going to get hold of them!
He charged over, looking like he was going to grab the empress and the others.
However, as he ran, he realized that his legs had disappeared.
Then, his arms had also disappeared, leaving behind only a torso.
He was astounded.
More importantly, it was as if his arms and legs were naturally non-existent.
Not a single drop of blood dripped from his wounds.
This, this, this, were these people demons?
"Hurry up and return my arms and legs to me!" the young man shouted loudly.
"My older brother is Lord Sect Master’s ninth disciple!"
Seeing a conflict arise here, quite a number of people gathered around, but all of them only crossed their arms over their chests, their expressions filled with delight at the misfortune of others.
They completely treated themselves as spectators watching the excitement.
This kind of sect did not have the slightest atmosphere of friendliness.
No, there was no longer any element of "love" in the whole world.
Everyone was like a beast, preying on the weak.
"Brat, you’re definitely going to die.
Why don’t you give the three girls to me, and I’ll take care of them for you?
I guarantee that I will feed them to their heart’s content every day," someone said to Ling Han, their words extremely vulgar.

"Junior Brother Xu, with that thin staff of yours, to say nothing of giving you three beauties, even if there was only one, how many minutes would you be able to last?" Immediately, someone undermined him.
"Just give them to me!"
"Give them to me!"
"Give themto me!"
A great many people were calling out, and some were even glaring.
They were about to come to blows.
Ling Han shook his head, and with a flick of his finger, everyone in the surroundings instantly disappeared.
It was not death, but rather disappearance.
Element of destruction!
The young man at the beginning naturally saw this, and this time, he finally knew fear.
"You, don’t be rash!" he said in a trembling voice, his two rows of teeth chattering.
Ling Han pointed at the towering stone statue, and asked, "Who is this person?"
"Lord Sect Master, of course," the young man replied.
’F*ck!
How shameless!’

chapters.title: Chapter 4892: Ancestor!
paragraphs: "Which maniac dares to come to our Nine Suns Holy Land, and act wantonly?" With a loud shout, eleven figures flew over from the mountain.
"Brother! Brother!" When the young man saw him, it was as if he had seen his savior.
These were the eleven disciples of Lord Sect Master. The weakest was Spirit Transformation Tier, and the strongest had even advanced into Venerate Tier.
There was hope for him.

When the elder brother of that young man, Huo Ming, saw how his younger brother had lost all four limbs, he couldn’t help but be both shocked and furious. He directly charged towards Ling Han, "Madman, die!"
Boom, he delivered a palm strike, and the strength of a Sect Master completely burst forth.
Ling Han casually snapped his fingers. Pa! Huo Ming instantly transformed into a cloud of blood.
Hiss, he had killed a Sect Master with a snap of his fingers?
All of a sudden, these eleven disciples were all greatly shocked. Only two of them managed to maintain their composure, because they were both Venerate Tiers.

The young man from before was transfixed with shock. This was his older brother, the most prodigious prodigy of the Huo Clan. He had also entered the Nine Suns Holy Land as he had wished, and become a Sect Master of the Nine Suns Holy Land.
But now?
He had been insta-killed with a single snap of his fingers. This was unbelievable.
"Sir, dare I ask how our Nine Suns Holy Land has offended you?" A Venerate Tier clasped his hands and said. He was dressed in blue.
Ling Han’s strength caused these people who only had ruthlessness in their blood to feel wary.
After all, fear of death was also instinctive.
Ling Han ignored him and simply flicked a finger at the stone statue. Pa! The stone statue instantly exploded into pieces.
"How dare you!" the remaining ten disciples all shouted.

This was the stone statue of the Lord Sect Master, and it was a symbol of the Saint’s glorious achievements. Yet, Ling Han had actually destroyed it. The Lord Sect Master would definitely fly into a thunderous rage later.
They could no longer hold back, and they all pounced towards Ling Han.
"Are you people worthy of exchanging blows with Little Han?" The large black dog scoffed, and a pillar of light shot out from his iron underwear, sweeping towards the 10 people.
The pillar of light swept past, and the ten people were instantly annihilated.
’Holy f*ck!’
When the young man saw this, he was almost scared out of his wits.
Insta-killing two Venerate Tiers... Was this a Saint?

"Hehe, how have I, Liu Qinghe, offended you to the point that my friend would fly into such a thunderous rage?" Amidst a long bout of laughter, the current Sect Master of the Nine Suns Holy Land, Liu Qinghe, finally appeared.
He was of medium build, and looked to be in his fifties. However, he looked sage-like.
Ling Han shook his head. Eleven personal disciples had died, yet he didn’t look angry at all. This person’s coldness was clear for all to see.
This wasn’t a matter of him alone. Instead, it was a matter of the entire universe having their side of good suppressed, leaving behind only the evil side.
Ling Han smiled calmly, and said, "I’ll borrow your Nine Suns Holy Land."
Liu Qinghe frowned, and said, "Friend, you’ve gone too far!"
To demand for his position as Sect Master right from the start, you are really too ambitious.
"Er, do you know who this person standing in front of you is?" The large black dog couldn’t help but ask. This was another chance for him to show off.
"Who?" Liu Qinghe asked casually. However, he couldn’t help but glance at the large black dog again.
It was rare to see a dog wearing iron underwear!
Furthermore, why did he feel a sense of deja vu?

"This is Ling Han, the first Sect Master of the Nine Suns Holy Land of the Four Origin Planet!" The large black dog pointed at Ling Han, and said, "Junior, why aren’t you kneeling down to pay your respects after seeing your ancestors?"
Liu Qinghe couldn’t help but feel furious.
’I treat you all as my friends, yet you all want to become my ancestors?’
He had gone too far!
"Humph, you guys have really gone too far. You actually dare to make fun of me!" he declared balefully. Did they really think that he did not dare make a move?
The large black dog chuckled. Boom! Imperial might spread through the air.
’F*ck!’
Liu Qinghe instantly knelt down, "This unworthy disciple pays respects to Ancestor!"
The large black dog faltered upon hearing this. He hadn’t expected this person to be so cowardly.
As long as they were stronger than you, you would acknowledge them as your father?
"Old Black, this guy has your bearing," the little azure dragon teased.
"Scram!" The large black dog immediately rebuked, "Though Grandpa Dog has achieved dao through despicable means, I am definitely not one to be afraid of death!"
It spoke boldly and righteously, and Ling Han and the others also believed it.
Though the large black dog would run when he encountered danger, if Ling Han, the empress, and the others encountered danger, he would definitely step out.
A thought suddenly flashed through Liu Qinghe’s mind. He finally understood why the large black dog looked so familiar.
In the ancient records of the sect, it was recorded that there was a grand elder, and that was a large black dog.
However, according to the records, this grand elder had an upright and righteous image. The only similarity was that in a painting, the large black dog in the portrait was wearing iron underwear.
Er, there should be no other dog in this world with such a wretched image.
According to rumors, this grand elder hadn’t died. Instead, he had entered the Primitive Abyss to search for a path to immortality.
Could it be that it had succeeded?
That’s right. If he had not succeeded, how could that Great Emperor-level aura just now have intimidated him to the point that even his mind had gone blank?
Thinking of this, he no longer felt aggrieved. Instead, he felt extremely proud.
An ancestor that had become a Great Emperor, then wouldn’t he be invincible in this world?
Though he was a Saint, he was only a Two Star Saint. However, with an ancestor that was a Great Emperor, he was the Second in the World!
Wasn’t that awesome enough?

"Ancestor, you have finally returned. Grand-disciple has missed you dearly!" Liu Qinghe was very shameless as he knelt all the way, and when he reached the large black dog’s side, he hugged the large black dog’s leg.
Thankfully, the large black dog was wearing iron underwear. Otherwise, Liu Qinghe’s face would probably be stuck onto his behind.
The large black dog gritted his teeth. He had never seen such a shameless Saint before.
"Get lost, don’t even think about having any ideas about Grandpa Dog’s underwear!"

When Liu Qinghe heard this, he became even more excited, "Ancestor, are you going to pass on this heirloom underwear to your grand-disciple? Don’t worry, grand-disciple will definitely keep it safe for you. I will carefully wipe it every day, and guarantee that there will not be the slightest bit of dust."
As he spoke, he continued to sprawl over it.
"Scram!" The large black dog was enraged, and he kicked Liu Qinghe away.
"Ancestor!" Liu Qinghe was neither angry nor discouraged, and immediately knelt back down.

"Old Black, you really have a successor," Ling Han said with a shake of his head. However, while the large black dog’s despicability was to disgust his enemies, Liu Qinghe’s despicability was to disgust his own people.
Thus, it was best not to be on the same side as him.
"How dare you! You actually dare to speak to Ancestor like this!" Liu Qinghe found a chance to curry favor. He immediately got to his feet, and shouted at Ling Han.

"Hehe." The little azure dragon shook its head and said with a laugh, "Flatterer, you really have a pair of dog’s eyes this <anno data-annotation-id="f33c2def-15b4-46e3-b555-a7fc81691f49" data-title="time!">time!1</anno>"
"Woof!" the large black dog shouted in displeasure.

"I already told you just now. This is the first Sect Master of the Nine Suns Holy Land after the Nine Suns Holy Land moved to the Four Origin Planet. Didn’t you hear me?" the little azure dragon continued.
Liu Qinghe was taken aback. Who was the first Sect Master?
Ling Han!

That was a character whose name would go down in history. His natural talent in martial arts was known as the strongest in all of history. In the Primitive Abyss, he had attained Dao as a Great Emperor, and when he came out, he had killed the Great Emperor of the current era, and had even suppressed the darkness single-handedly.
An incredibly awesome character!
This, this, this, this person was Ling Han?
