chapters.title: Chapter 4893: Creation, Great Emperor!
paragraphs: Liu Qinghe was even more excited. Compared to the large black dog, this was his true backer.
"Ancestor Ling Han!" He pounced over again, kneeling by Ling Han’s feet.
Just as it looked like he was about to grab onto Ling Han’s thigh, Ling Han couldn’t help but kick him.
Peng! Liu Qinghe was kicked into pieces.
"Er... I accidentally used too much force," Ling Han said apologetically.
Pei, what accident? It must have been deliberate.
The others naturally wouldn’t reprimand him. This Liu Qinghe was far too despicable. They were rendered speechless by his actions.
"These people, is there any medicine that can save them?" Ling Han frowned slightly as he looked at the group of shivering people.
He had overwhelming power, but the human heart has never been something that could be changed with mere power.
"Everyone is afraid of death. Let’s control them with strict rules first. After a few more generations, the overall atmosphere should improve," the large black dog said with some experience.
"The Despicable Emperor already said so, so it must be so." The little azure dragon nodded.
"Get lost!"

Ling Han couldn’t massacre the entire planet and galaxy just because these people were bloodthirsty and violent. He entered the Nine Suns Holy Land and issued a strict order for them to abide by the rules, or they would be killed without mercy.
However, these people had never been restrained by the law. Though the decree had been issued, it was practically useless. Everyone would still commit violence and murder without any scruples.
Ling Han was furious, and began the first round of harsh punishment.
In just one day, the population of Four Origin Planet had decreased by a whole tenth.
And after this day, Four Origin Planet had its own rules.
Those who did not want to die would obediently adhere to the rules. Gradually, the word ’discipline’ appeared in everyone’s hearts.
Of course, this was the result of high pressure. Once Ling Han was gone, everything would return to normal.
However, what Ling Han wanted to change was not them, but rather the second and third generation.
The Great Emperors gradually returned. They were also very dissatisfied with the current situation. The entire galaxy was in chaos, which made them feel extremely uncomfortable.
After learning of Ling Han’s thoughts, the Great Emperors were also willing to lend him a helping hand.
Thus, laws gradually appeared on the planets one after another. Massacre and other atrocities were under control. Though they could not be completely eliminated, they were much better than before.
Ling Han felt like there weren’t enough people.
Though this universe was chaotic now, it was too prosperous. There were countless stars and countless people.
He needed more helpers.
Ling Han thought for a moment, then decided to create something.

For example, the old Divine Beast, who had lost a leg and only grasped the three elements, could also create living creatures, and the Star Moon Empress and the others had single-handedly created the extremely prosperous situation now.
Why couldn’t Ling Han do the same?
Not only had he grasped the four key elements, he had also formed his own heaven and earth.
With a thought from Ling Han, a human figure appeared in the heaven and earth of his inner world. It changed according to his thoughts, and then turned into an ordinary-looking young man.
He had bestowed the highest cultivation level on the other.
A Great Emperor!
Ling Han was stunned. He could actually create a Great Emperor, though he was only in the eighth tier.
The old Divine Beast could create Great Emperors, and in fact, it could create a Great Emperor as strong as the sixth tier, but that was different.

That could not be considered to have been created out of thin air. Instead, it was the old Divine Beast that had first devoured the corpse of the corresponding Divine Beast, and added with his own soul, strictly speaking, that was a doppelganger, and not a pure creation.
But he... had actually created a Great Emperor out of thin air!
However, this kind of Great Emperor was also limited to the eighth tier, with no possibility of advancing further.
"Greetings, Milord!" When this man was released, he immediately half-knelt on the ground.
Ling Han nodded, "Do you know why I created you?"
"Yes." The man nodded, "Master wants me to safeguard the laws of this world."

"En." Ling Han smiled, "You are my first Emperor Tier creation, used to maintain order. Your significance is extraordinary, so I bestowed upon you the name... ’Shou <anno data-annotation-id="d7ab3951-92a8-4fdd-b352-07ecc84f17ff" data-title="Ji’.">Ji’.1</anno>"
"Thank you, lord!" Shou Ji bowed in thanks.
Subsequently, Ling Han began to create Emperors again, creating 99 in a single go. Only then did he feel strained, and felt that this was his limit.
If he wanted to create another Great Emperor, he would have to wait until one or several of them died first.
At the beginning of heaven and earth, Divine Beasts appeared one after another, numbering close to a hundred. Was it the same?
Ling Han was still no match for the great heaven and earth, because back then, the Divine Beasts were all in the fifth tier.

"Compared to this heaven and earth, the four elements I possess are still too little," Ling Han thought to himself. Though he had been absorbing the four elements all this while, and was also producing the four elements himself, compared with the accumulation of heaven and earth over several hundred Stacked Eras, that naturally was child’s play.
It was fine. He was becoming stronger at every moment.
With the help of these 99 Great Emperors, the efficiency of Ling Han’s management naturally increased greatly.
And when they found out that Ling Han could actually create a Great Emperor, the Great Emperor Wu Ya and the others were all dumbfounded.

If they wanted to become Great Emperors, not only would they have to go through untold hardships and experience hundreds of deathly dangers, they would also have to compete with prodigies of the same era and different eras. In the end, the heaven and earth would favour them, and only then would they be able to stand out and become the strongest of their era.
But when it came to Ling Han, Great Emperors could actually be mass-produced!
How could they not sigh with emotion?
Thankfully, Ling Han’s creations were only eighth tier, at most, which gave them some comfort. Otherwise, it was hard to guarantee that Great Emperors would also bleed internally from fury.
What they didn’t know was that Ling Han would also be able to create a fifth tier Great Emperor one day.

However, what he had created was ultimately not comparable to a Great Emperor that had cultivated every step of the way. The fifth tier was definitely the limit, and he would never be able to advance into the fourth tier.
However, 99 Great Emperors was already impressive enough.
Aside from the Great Emperors, Ling Han had also created a great many Saints, numbering in the thousands.

With so many elites helping to maintain order, the nearby galaxy soon gained order. Furthermore, it was still spreading out in all directions at an extremely fast speed. In this way, it would probably only need ten thousand years, and the order of the entire universe would be completely renewed.
Ling Han was extremely pleased with this kind of progress.
However, he was also on guard, because those three invincible Great Emperors should not just sit by and watch.
As expected, after several hundred years, someone came to visit.

This was a young man who looked to be around 20 years old. However, he radiated with a powerful saintly might, and there was also a black-robed man following behind him. His entire body was wrapped in black cloth, and he didn’t release a single wisp of his aura.
"Who goes there, to actually dare oppose the three Lords!" This young man smirked coldly. In a few steps, he had arrived in front of the main gate of the Nine Suns Holy Land.
He stood with his hands clasped behind his back, surveying the surroundings, as if there was no one around.
"This is the Nine Suns Holy Land. If you’re here to become a disciple or a visitor, please register here first," a disciple who was on duty immediately walked up and said to the young man.
"Hahaha!" The young man laughed madly, "I am the dignified Xuan Mingyu. Who in this world is worthy of becoming my Master?"
Then are you crazy!
The disciple on duty was neither servile nor overbearing, neither happy nor angry. He continued, "Since you are not a disciple nor a visitor, then please leave. This place is not open to the public!"

sentences.text: Liu Qinghe was even more excited.
Compared to the large black dog, this was his true backer.
"Ancestor Ling Han!" He pounced over again, kneeling by Ling Han’s feet.
Just as it looked like he was about to grab onto Ling Han’s thigh, Ling Han couldn’t help but kick him.
Peng!
Liu Qinghe was kicked into pieces.
I accidentally used too much force," Ling Han said apologetically.
Pei, what accident?
It must have been deliberate.
The others naturally wouldn’t reprimand him.
This Liu Qinghe was far too despicable.
They were rendered speechless by his actions.
"These people, is there any medicine that can save them?" Ling Han frowned slightly as he looked at the group of shivering people.
He had overwhelming power, but the human heart has never been something that could be changed with mere power.
"Everyone is afraid of death.
Let’s control them with strict rules first.
After a few more generations, the overall atmosphere should improve," the large black dog said with some experience.
"The Despicable Emperor already said so, so it must be so." The little azure dragon nodded.
"Get lost!"
Ling Han couldn’t massacre the entire planet and galaxy just because these people were bloodthirsty and violent.
He entered the Nine Suns Holy Land and issued a strict order for them to abide by the rules, or they would be killed without mercy.
However, these people had never been restrained by the law.
Though the decree had been issued, it was practically useless.
Everyone would still commit violence and murder without any scruples.
Ling Han was furious, and began the first round of harsh punishment.
In just one day, the population of Four Origin Planet had decreased by a whole tenth.
And after this day, Four Origin Planet had its own rules.
Those who did not want to die would obediently adhere to the rules.
Gradually, the word ’discipline’ appeared in everyone’s hearts.
Of course, this was the result of high pressure.
Once Ling Han was gone, everything would return to normal.
However, what Ling Han wanted to change was not them, but rather the second and third generation.
The Great Emperors gradually returned.
They were also very dissatisfied with the current situation.
The entire galaxy was in chaos, which made them feel extremely uncomfortable.
After learning of Ling Han’s thoughts, the Great Emperors were also willing to lend him a helping hand.
Thus, laws gradually appeared on the planets one after another.
Massacre and other atrocities were under control.
Though they could not be completely eliminated, they were much better than before.
Ling Han felt like there weren’t enough people.
Though this universe was chaotic now, it was too prosperous.
There were countless stars and countless people.
He needed more helpers.
Ling Han thought for a moment, then decided to create something.

For example, the old Divine Beast, who had lost a leg and only grasped the three elements, could also create living creatures, and the Star Moon Empress and the others had single-handedly created the extremely prosperous situation now.
Why couldn’t Ling Han do the same?
Not only had he grasped the four key elements, he had also formed his own heaven and earth.
With a thought from Ling Han, a human figure appeared in the heaven and earth of his inner world.
It changed according to his thoughts, and then turned into an ordinary-looking young man.
He had bestowed the highest cultivation level on the other.
A Great Emperor!
Ling Han was stunned.
He could actually create a Great Emperor, though he was only in the eighth tier.
The old Divine Beast could create Great Emperors, and in fact, it could create a Great Emperor as strong as the sixth tier, but that was different.
That could not be considered to have been created out of thin air.

Instead, it was the old Divine Beast that had first devoured the corpse of the corresponding Divine Beast, and added with his own soul, strictly speaking, that was a doppelganger, and not a pure creation.
But he... had actually created a Great Emperor out of thin air!
However, this kind of Great Emperor was also limited to the eighth tier, with no possibility of advancing further.
"Greetings, Milord!" When this man was released, he immediately half-knelt on the ground.
Ling Han nodded, "Do you know why I created you?"
"Yes." The man nodded, "Master wants me to safeguard the laws of this world."
"En." Ling Han smiled, "You are my first Emperor Tier creation, used to maintain order.
Your significance is extraordinary, so I bestowed upon you the name... ’Shou <anno data-annotation-id="d7ab3951-92a8-4fdd-b352-07ecc84f17ff" data-title="Ji’.">Ji’.1</anno>"
"Thank you, lord!" Shou Ji bowed in thanks.
Subsequently, Ling Han began to create Emperors again, creating 99 in a single go.
Only then did he feel strained, and felt that this was his limit.
If he wanted to create another Great Emperor, he would have to wait until one or several of them died first.
At the beginning of heaven and earth, Divine Beasts appeared one after another, numbering close to a hundred.
Was it the same?
Ling Han was still no match for the great heaven and earth, because back then, the Divine Beasts were all in the fifth tier.
"Compared to this heaven and earth, the four elements I possess are still too little," Ling Han thought to himself.

Though he had been absorbing the four elements all this while, and was also producing the four elements himself, compared with the accumulation of heaven and earth over several hundred Stacked Eras, that naturally was child’s play.
It was fine.
He was becoming stronger at every moment.
With the help of these 99 Great Emperors, the efficiency of Ling Han’s management naturally increased greatly.
And when they found out that Ling Han could actually create a Great Emperor, the Great Emperor Wu Ya and the others were all dumbfounded.

If they wanted to become Great Emperors, not only would they have to go through untold hardships and experience hundreds of deathly dangers, they would also have to compete with prodigies of the same era and different eras.
In the end, the heaven and earth would favour them, and only then would they be able to stand out and become the strongest of their era.
But when it came to Ling Han, Great Emperors could actually be mass-produced!
How could they not sigh with emotion?
Thankfully, Ling Han’s creations were only eighth tier, at most, which gave them some comfort.
Otherwise, it was hard to guarantee that Great Emperors would also bleed internally from fury.
What they didn’t know was that Ling Han would also be able to create a fifth tier Great Emperor one day.
However, what he had created was ultimately not comparable to a Great Emperor that had cultivated every step of the way.
The fifth tier was definitely the limit, and he would never be able to advance into the fourth tier.
However, 99 Great Emperors was already impressive enough.
Aside from the Great Emperors, Ling Han had also created a great many Saints, numbering in the thousands.
With so many elites helping to maintain order, the nearby galaxy soon gained order.
Furthermore, it was still spreading out in all directions at an extremely fast speed.
In this way, it would probably only need ten thousand years, and the order of the entire universe would be completely renewed.
Ling Han was extremely pleased with this kind of progress.
However, he was also on guard, because those three invincible Great Emperors should not just sit by and watch.
As expected, after several hundred years, someone came to visit.
This was a young man who looked to be around 20 years old.
However, he radiated with a powerful saintly might, and there was also a black-robed man following behind him.
His entire body was wrapped in black cloth, and he didn’t release a single wisp of his aura.
"Who goes there, to actually dare oppose the three Lords!" This young man smirked coldly.
In a few steps, he had arrived in front of the main gate of the Nine Suns Holy Land.
He stood with his hands clasped behind his back, surveying the surroundings, as if there was no one around.
"This is the Nine Suns Holy Land.
If you’re here to become a disciple or a visitor, please register here first," a disciple who was on duty immediately walked up and said to the young man.
"Hahaha!" The young man laughed madly, "I am the dignified Xuan Mingyu.
Who in this world is worthy of becoming my Master?"
Then are you crazy!
The disciple on duty was neither servile nor overbearing, neither happy nor angry.
He continued, "Since you are not a disciple nor a visitor, then please leave.
This place is not open to the public!"

chapters.title: Chapter 4894: Invader
paragraphs: "What a joke, a mere Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator actually dares to control my actions?" Xuan Mingyu sneered. "Kneel!"
The disciple on duty was unmoved, and said, "This is the Heavenly Emperor’s Holy Land, and everyone has to act according to the rules!"
"Heavenly Emperor?" Xuan Mingyu laughed madly again, "What a joke, is Heavenly Emperor a title that any random person can casually call himself?"
"How dare you!" The disciple on duty immediately rebuked.
"Are you seeking death?" Xuan Mingyu suddenly released his own aura. That was Saint-level.
The disciple on duty instantly felt as if there was a huge rock weighing down on his chest. He couldn’t breathe, and his face was as white as a sheet.
"I’ll give you a chance to live. Kneel!" Xuan Mingyu said coldly.
"I’m not going to kneel!" Unexpectedly, this disciple on duty was extremely unyielding, and directly refused.
"Do you think I don’t dare to kill you?" Xuan Mingyu humphed, and the aura he released instantly increased by a hundred times. Pa, the left arm of that disciple on duty instantly exploded.
"Kneel or not?" Xuan Mingyu revealed a cruel smile. He would never get tired of playing this kind of game.
"To dare commit a crime in the Nine Suns Holy Land, you’re dead!" The disciple on duty was still unafraid.
Xuan Mingyu felt extremely displeased. He was obviously just a minor character of Cauldron Forging Tier, so how could he be so unyielding?
"Humph!" He snapped his fingers again. Pa! The other arm of the disciple that was on guard exploded into pieces.

"How about it?" he asked again. "If you don’t kneel down to me, every piece of skin and every bone in your body will explode like this! And I promise you, next, I will be very, very slow. I guarantee that I will have enough time to play with you!"
"Sir, that’s enough!" At this moment, a voice rang out, and a person walked out from the mountain.
"Who are you?" Xuan Mingyu looked towards that person.
"Servant of the Heavenly Emperor, Can Ye," the person replied.
"Can Ye?" Xuan Ming Yu muttered, and couldn’t help but laugh out loud. "You should be called an idiot, to actually dare tell me to stop. Where did you get such courage from?"
"You have already violated the laws enacted by the Heavenly Emperor, and if you surrender now, you can still get a light punishment," Can Ye said calmly.
"Hahaha!" Xuan Mingyu laughed madly again, but there was no hint of a smile on his face, "You guys have really had enough, one by one. What Heavenly Emperor, shameless boasting."

He looked towards that disciple on duty, "I am going to kill this person now. If you have the ability, then come and stop me. That Heavenly Emperor or whatever, if you have the ability, then come and stop me!"
"Stubborn!" Can Ye’s hand shook, and a sword appeared in his hand.

Shua, he attacked Xuan Mingyu, but Xuan Mingyu only sent out a palm strike, and peng, Can Ye was sent flying. Then, Xuan Mingyu sent out another palm strike at the disciple on duty. Pa, that disciple was immediately smashed into a bloody mess.
"Wa!" Can Ye fell onto the ground, throwing up blood madly.
"Pei, what Heavenly Emperor!" Xuan Mingyu spat, his expression filled with disdain.
He, a Saint, was capable of sweeping aside all opposition. Was this even worthy of being called a Heavenly Emperor?

Can Ye struggled to get back to his feet. Today was really too coincidental. Ling Han just happened to be out on a trip, and the various Great Emperors had been establishing order outside all this while. There were no elites keeping watch in the sect.

In truth, the Nine Suns Holy Land was already an overlord-level existence in the universe, and no one dared to trifle with them at all. Who would have thought that a Saint would suddenly barge in today?
"Since even I can’t be stopped, what meaning is there for this place to exist?" Xuan Mingyu sneered, "Let me flatten it!"
With a loud shout, he blasted towards the mountains ahead of him, wanting to destroy them with a single strike.
Boom!
A terrifying power surged past, and then, the mountains were still there, as if they had not suffered any attack at all.
This!
Xuan Mingyu felt a little embarrassed. Just now, he had still been so confident, yet in the end, with a palm strike, not even the slightest bit of damage was caused. How could he endure this?
"So there is the protection of an Imperial Formation!" The corners of his lips quirked up, "However, would this be enough to stop me?"
Weng, right at this moment, a powerful aura surged over.
"Who dares to come to our Nine Suns Holy Land and act wantonly?" Xiu, a figure descended, and saintly might filled the air.
Xuan Mingyu looked towards the other, "And who are you?"
That person humphed, "Heavenly Emperor’s disciple, Ding Ping!"
"Oh?" Xuan Mingyu’s eyes lit up. "I’m very interested in killing you now."
Ding Ping frowned upon hearing this. Was this person crazy?

However, the Heavenly Emperor and the other Great Emperors had already treated the galaxy for many years, so the lunatics in the surroundings should have all been cured by now. Those who hadn’t been cured wouldn’t dare to act recklessly, so why had another come out?
"Die!" Xuan Mingyu charged towards Ding Ping.
Ding Ping was unafraid, and he continued to battle against Xuan Mingyu.
In these few hundred years, Ling Han had also given some guidance to his disciples.

It should be known that Ling Han had already formed his own heaven and earth, capable of creating things with a single thought. Even Origin Gold could be created out of thin air, so what treasured medicine could he not produce?
Thus, his disciples had all improved significantly. In just a few hundred years, they had all advanced into Saint Tier.
However, if they wanted to take another step further, it would be impossible. Limited by their natural talent, they were unable to step into Pseudo-Emperor Tier.
This meant that even if Ling Han possessed an endless supply of element of life, Ding Ping and the others would still die of old age one day.
And this time, Ling Han did not plan to take anyone else into the inner world.
Birth, old age, sickness, and death were natural laws, and he did not want to destroy them.

The two Saints battled fiercely. Though it had caused a shocking wave of battle, this place had been reinforced by Ling Han. Even if Saints battled fiercely, it would only throw around a few rocks, and could not cause much damage.
Slowly, Ding Ping gained the upper hand.
Xuan Mingyu did not dare believe this. With how noble his status was, they were both Nine-Star Saints, so why was he inferior to the other?
However, that was the truth. His disadvantage was getting larger and larger, and he was already teetering on the verge of defeat.
"Fourth!" Xuan Mingyu finally couldn’t help but roar.
Instantly, the mysterious person who was standing motionlessly behind him, his whole body enshrouded in black, finally moved. He stretched out a hand and pressed down on Ding Ping.
With this press, Imperial Might spread out, and it was probably indescribable!
Ding Ping was astonished. This was actually a Great Emperor!
Regardless of how powerful he was, he was still only a Saint. To say nothing of being able to rival a Great Emperor, he wouldn’t be able to block even a wisp of aura from a Great Emperor.
Fortunately, this was the Nine Suns Holy Land.
"Come!" he shouted lightly, and a ray of light immediately flew out of the mountain, turning into a sword of light that slashed out from Ding Ping’s hand.
Peng!
The Sword of Light slashed onto the black-robed man’s wrist, and though it immediately crumbled, it still managed to block the black-robed man.
Ding Ping was filled with disbelief. As a Great Emperor, he was actually following the lead of a Saint?

Furthermore, even in this golden age, when the Great Emperors of the world were standing side by side, the environment of heaven and earth was still unable to allow the appearance of a new Great Emperor.
Was this a new Emperor that had been born in the Primitive Abyss?
But no matter what, why would a Great Emperor be commanded by a Saint?
This was too illogical, and too hard to believe.

chapters.title: Chapter 4895: Invitation
paragraphs: "Destroy this mountain!" Xuan Mingyu was flustered and exasperated.
Since this mountain was protected by an imperial formation, he would destroy this mountain first. Then, he could kill whoever he wanted.
The black-robed Great Emperor lashed out at the imperial formation.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
Massive explosions rang out endlessly. A Great Emperor had moved, and just how terrifying was that? Destroying a planet would only be the matter of snapping his fingers.

However, this was Four Origin Planet, which had been reinforced by Ling Han’s power of elements. Thus, added with the protection of the imperial formation, it couldn’t be said to be impregnable, but even if a fourth tier Great Emperor wanted to damage it, he would still have to expend some effort.
However, this black-robed Great Emperor was only in the eighth tier.
An eighth tier Great Emperor had about the same might as an Imperial Weapon, and about the same might as an Imperial Formation.
Thus, though the black-robed Great Emperor was attacking fiercely, the imperial formation remained unmoved.
"Trash! Trash!" Xuan Mingyu shouted endlessly, but the black-robed Great Emperor turned a deaf ear to him. He merely continued to attack, as if he was a machine or a puppet.
"Are you done yet?"
Right at this moment, a calm voice rang out. Though it was not loud, it was filled with might.
A look of delight instantly appeared on Ding Ping’s face. He half-knelt and said, "Master!"
Ling Han had returned!
Xuan Mingyu was also slightly stunned, but when he recalled his own identity, he couldn’t help but feel extremely proud, and asked, "You are that Heavenly Emperor Han?"

Ling Han appeared. He was dressed in a long green robe, and his attire could be said to be very ordinary-looking. However, he had an intimidating aura that made people involuntarily hold their breaths.
Originally, he had been reconstructing order at a very far location, but sensing that the imperial formation was under attack, he returned in a single step.
His eyes swept over the surroundings, and saw the blood and Qi that was still wafting in the air.
"I am Ling Han," he said calmly.

"Listen, I am the 35,867th son of the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor," Xuan Mingyu said, "Today, under the command of my father, I have deliberately come to command you to stay here obediently. Don’t run around everywhere. Otherwise, my father will break your legs!"
Hehe, the reconstruction of order had finally suffered a backlash from the three great invincible Great Emperors. However, the first person to jump out was the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor.
If these three people didn’t appear, Ling Han wouldn’t be able to find a reason to deal with them.
However, the conflict had come now.
Ling Han ignored him, and stretched out a hand to grab. The blood and Qi that wafted in the skies immediately condensed, and very soon, took the form of a human figure.
As Xuan Mingyu watched, his eyes involuntarily widened.
This was the disciple on duty that he had just killed!
He had already been blasted into so many pieces, yet he could still reform?
What kind of great power was this?
Ling Han tore open the barrier between the two realms again, and directly reached into the Netherworld.
’Holy f*ck!’
Xuan Mingyu almost fainted. He could do that?
That was the Netherworld!
Did he think that the barrier between the two realms was made of paper? He could tear it apart just like that?
When Ling Han withdrew his hand, he also brought out a soul, which he pressed into the body of the disciple on duty.
Instantly, this disciple released a loud roar, and suddenly stood up.
He was alive, he was alive!
He had come back to life.
If it weren’t for the fact that Xuan Mingyu had personally killed this disciple on duty, he really wouldn’t believe that someone could actually revive the dead!
This was too terrifying. This had surpassed the ability of a Great Emperor!
Only then did Ling Han look at Xuan Mingyu, and said, "You have killed someone here."
This was not a question.

Xuan Mingyu was still stubborn, "So what? I am the son of the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor. To say nothing of killing this kind of minor character, even if I killed your son, what could you do to me?"
Ling Han smiled eerily, "Those who commit murder should be killed."
He raised his hand and pressed it down on Xuan Mingyu.
Xuan Mingyu was shocked, and hurriedly exclaimed, "Fourth, save me!"
The black-robed Great Emperor immediately leaped over, greeting Ling Han’s palm strike.
However, when the palm landed, it was like the heavens were collapsing. It was not something that any power could stop at all.
Peng! The black-robed Great Emperor immediately crumbled, transforming into a cloud of blood and flesh. Meanwhile, Ling Han’s palm was completely unaffected, and it continued to slam down.
"No—" Xuan Mingyu released a terrible scream, and still wanted to stretch out his hand to block, but how could a mere Saint be able to block the attack of the Invincible Great Emperor?
With a single palm strike, Xuan Mingyu instantly disappeared from sight.
"Master!" Ding Ping walked over, and said, "You killed the son of the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor, so he definitely won’t let the matter go. It’s possible that a huge battle will break out!"
Ling Han smiled calmly, "It’s fine."

He was also a Great Emperor, so he was naturally unafraid of the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor. However, he definitely had to choose a suitable location for the battle. Otherwise, if the two invincible Great Emperors fought, they could easily destroy half the universe.
He acted as if nothing had happened, and continued to construct order.
However, he couldn’t help but complain. This Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor was really too fertile, wasn’t he?

Even if he had already stayed outside for ten million years, but more than thirty thousand sons? Added with daughters, even if it was just doubling that amount, it would be sixty thousand; what kind of terrifying reproduction ability was that?
Were they actually born, or were they created?
Several months later, Ling Han received an invitation.
It was a message from the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor, telling him to attend the ceremony for his millionth wife.
A million!
When Ling Han saw this, he couldn’t help but grit his teeth. Could you f manage to find the time?
Was this really an invincible Great Emperor?
You haven’t touched a woman in your last life? No, you haven’t touched a woman in hundreds of millions of lifetimes, so you have to make up for it in this lifetime!

Stop, stop, stop. Ling Han sighed. He didn’t want to become a Heavenly Emperor of Mockery.
"Are you going?" the empress asked.
Ling Han cracked a smile, "Let’s go!"
It was impossible for him and the three invincible Great Emperors to get along peacefully. There would eventually be a battle.
Thus, he definitely had to make this trip.

This wasn’t rushed at all. Ling Han was a Great Emperor, and he could traverse the universe in a few steps.
If he went this time, there might be a commotion. Ling Han decided to only bring a few people with him. If a fight really broke out, he would be able to have less worries.

Since this mountain was protected by an imperial formation, he would destroy this mountain first.
Then, he could kill whoever he wanted.
The black-robed Great Emperor lashed out at the imperial formation.
Hong!
Hong!
Hong!
Massive explosions rang out endlessly.
A Great Emperor had moved, and just how terrifying was that?
Destroying a planet would only be the matter of snapping his fingers.
However, this was Four Origin Planet, which had been reinforced by Ling Han’s power of elements.

Thus, added with the protection of the imperial formation, it couldn’t be said to be impregnable, but even if a fourth tier Great Emperor wanted to damage it, he would still have to expend some effort.
However, this black-robed Great Emperor was only in the eighth tier.
An eighth tier Great Emperor had about the same might as an Imperial Weapon, and about the same might as an Imperial Formation.
Thus, though the black-robed Great Emperor was attacking fiercely, the imperial formation remained unmoved.
"Trash!
Trash!" Xuan Mingyu shouted endlessly, but the black-robed Great Emperor turned a deaf ear to him.
He merely continued to attack, as if he was a machine or a puppet.
"Are you done yet?"

Though it was not loud, it was filled with might.
A look of delight instantly appeared on Ding Ping’s face.
He half-knelt and said, "Master!"

However, he had an intimidating aura that made people involuntarily hold their breaths.
Originally, he had been reconstructing order at a very far location, but sensing that the imperial formation was under attack, he returned in a single step.
His eyes swept over the surroundings, and saw the blood and Qi that was still wafting in the air.
"I am Ling Han," he said calmly.
"Listen, I am the 35,867th son of the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor," Xuan Mingyu said, "Today, under the command of my father, I have deliberately come to command you to stay here obediently.
Don’t run around everywhere.
Otherwise, my father will break your legs!"
Hehe, the reconstruction of order had finally suffered a backlash from the three great invincible Great Emperors.
However, the first person to jump out was the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor.
If these three people didn’t appear, Ling Han wouldn’t be able to find a reason to deal with them.
However, the conflict had come now.
Ling Han ignored him, and stretched out a hand to grab.
The blood and Qi that wafted in the skies immediately condensed, and very soon, took the form of a human figure.

This was the disciple on duty that he had just killed!
He had already been blasted into so many pieces, yet he could still reform?
What kind of great power was this?
Ling Han tore open the barrier between the two realms again, and directly reached into the Netherworld.
’Holy f*ck!’

He could do that?
That was the Netherworld!
Did he think that the barrier between the two realms was made of paper?
He could tear it apart just like that?

He was alive, he was alive!
He had come back to life.

This was too terrifying.
This had surpassed the ability of a Great Emperor!

This was not a question.

To say nothing of killing this kind of minor character, even if I killed your son, what could you do to me?"
Ling Han smiled eerily, "Those who commit murder should be killed."

The black-robed Great Emperor immediately leaped over, greeting Ling Han’s palm strike.

Peng!

chapters.title: Chapter 4896: Another Wedding
paragraphs: "Invitation card." There was a guard at the door, and very proficiently, he accepted the invitation card, as if he had already done it a few hundred to over a thousand times.
En, this was definitely not an adjective.
Ling Han handed over his invitation. When that person saw it, he hurriedly said respectfully, "So it’s Heavenly Emperor Han! Please, please!"
He let another person take over, while he personally brought Ling Han and the others into the venue, arranging for Ling Han and the others to sit at a very close position.
After a cordial reception, he finally retreated.
The large black dog stroked his chin, and said, "In Grandpa Dog’s opinion, there will probably be a bloody calamity today."
"Why?" the little azure dragon asked in a timely manner.

"You see, the few weddings that Little Han has attended have basically all ended with snatching the bride, and there is no lack of bloodshed." The large black dog teased, "So, I suspect that after today, this Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor may also be cuckolded."
Ling Han couldn’t help but roll his eyes—you are really mischievous!
Quite a number of people had come, but aside from Ling Han and the other two, the highest cultivation level was only Saint-level.
—Would a Great Emperor come to attend the event where someone would be marrying his 100,000th wife? Though this indeed had the significance of breaking records.
Furthermore, even the Saints all looked calm, without the slightest bit of excitement.

After all, they had participated in this kind of event a lot. On average, it would happen once every ten years. When such events were held closely together, it was possible that there would be two to three such events in a year. How could they still be excited?
"Yi, why can these three sit there?" Someone set their eyes on Ling Han and the others.
That was because Ling Han and the other two were seated in the most prominent positions, and the other seats were like stars surrounding the moon, gathered around with them as the centre.
"That’s right. What right do they have to sit there?"
"Humph, they have indeed sat down, but without abilities, how long can they sit for?"

The people of this world were ruthless by nature, magnifying the negative emotions in human nature to the extreme. Thus, just as someone said a few words, someone directly walked towards Ling Han and the others.
"Your seats are not too bad, I’ll take them!" This was a Saint, and commanded Ling Han and the others.
"Are you sure you want it?" the large black dog asked with a grin.
"Humph! Do you think I’m afraid?" the Saint said in a haughty voice.
"Come, I’ll let you sit." The large black dog walked away obediently.
Yi?
Had Old Black changed his personality?
Of course, this was impossible. Thus, Ling Han and the little azure dragon also stood up and cooperated.
That Saint was very pleased with himself. They were really three cowards. They would retreat with just a scare.
He sat down boldly, but he had just sat down, when he heard a swoosh.
"Pu!"

Everyone spluttered in laughter upon hearing this. As it turned out, the Saint had plonked down onto the ground, yet the fabric on his behind had already been torn apart. A fair bottom was instantly revealed.

Though this Saint was male, he had actually bared his bottom in full public in front of so many people, which still caused his face to flush red in embarrassment. Hurriedly, he darted out, and instantly disappeared without a trace.
The large black dog snickered, "See, this seat is not so easy to sit in. Can’t you see that Grandpa Dog has deliberately worn iron underwear?"

Everyone naturally did not believe this, and thought that it should be the large black dog and the others that were behind this. However, this did not seem to be possible, because to tease a Saint like this, what cultivation level did he have to be at?
There were only two invincible Great Emperors in the world!

—The Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor and Boundless Great Emperor had each established a colossal force, practically splitting the entire universe into two. Meanwhile, the Star Moon Empress seemed to have disappeared without a trace.
Hence, in the territory under the rule of the Boundless Great Emperor and Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor, everyone knew that there were only these two Great Emperors.
Could it be that this was a test set by the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor? Only the strongest person would be qualified to sit in the most noble position?
"I’ll go!" Immediately, another Saint leaped out.
Since this was a test, then there must be a chance of passing. Otherwise, how could it be called a test?
—But he had forgotten another possibility, and that was a certain dog was especially deceitful, so despicable that he did not play by the usual rules!
"Come, come, come. Please take a seat." The large black dog was very cordial, and invited that Saint to sit beside him.
The Saint unleashed his full power before slowly sitting down.
Three inches, two inches, one inch away from the chair, okay, he had sat down solidly!
The corners of the Saint’s lips had just curled up into a smile. However, a cracking sound suddenly traveled over, and his face immediately became as white as a sheet.
He was done for.
"Hahaha!" Laughter instantly erupted, one after another.
A considerable number of Saints had come here. Furthermore, the people here were all fierce and barbaric. Thus, no one would give them any face.
Xiu! The Saint also fled.
"Who else is there?" the large black dog shouted loudly. It was clear that he hadn’t played enough.

Needless to say, there had always been Saints who refused to admit defeat. One after another, they walked over to undergo the "test". In the end, they naturally all bared their bottoms in public, completely embarrassed.

When the master of ceremonies walked onto the stage and was about to announce the start of the wedding, he saw the Saints leaving one after another. Even if he was experienced and knowledgeable, he still couldn’t help but grimace.
Had he come to the wrong place?
Was this a butt-revealing competition for Saints?
"What are you guys doing!" he roared loudly, his voice rolling out, instantly causing everyone to fall silent.
He was a Nine-Star Saint, so the might of his roar was indeed world-shaking.

Only then did the other Saints that were itching to give it a try sit down sheepishly, still feeling slightly defiant. If they could successfully sit down, they may be able to gain the favor of the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor. From then onwards, they would become close subjects of the Great Emperor.
"Old b@stard, do you want to give it a try?" The large black dog made a gesture of invitation.

"Humph, the wedding is about to begin, yet you people are making such a ruckus. Aren’t you afraid that the Great Emperor will be angry?" The Saint who was the master of ceremonies looked coldly at the large black dog. He had finally seen through it. This dog was the only one that was playing tricks, and was extraordinarily lively.
"You don’t understand, do you? This is called lively. Shouldn’t a wedding be lively?" The large black dog looked at everyone and asked, "Don’t you all agree?"
"That’s right!" A great many people agreed.
The ruthless side of people nowadays was completely unleashed, and correspondingly, their intelligence had also become a little limited.
"Look." The large black dog spread out his paws.
"How dare you!" The master of ceremonies Saint was furious, "All of you, get out. You are not welcome here."
At this time, Ling Han finally spoke up, and said, "We are guests invited by Mysterious Clouds. You are not yet qualified to make us leave."

"You actually dare to call the name of the Great Emperor!" The master of ceremonies Saint’s expression changed drastically, and the other Saints also stood up one after another. This was really too audacious. This could practically be considered treason!
Ling Han smiled, "Don’t be rash. Otherwise, if the wedding turns into a funeral, Mysterious Clouds would probably be displeased."
"You!" Everyone was both shocked and furious. Ling Han actually dared to directly address the Great Emperor by name time and time again. Just how outrageously bold was he?
Even if you wanted to seek death, you wouldn’t do such a thing, right?
"Haha! When I capture you, I’ll deliver you to the Great Emperor!" A Saint leaped forward and said.
Weng, right at this moment, an imposing and domineering aura swept out.
The Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor appeared.

chapters.title: Chapter 4897: A game
paragraphs: "Greetings, Great Emperor!" Everyone knelt on the ground.
Emperors were lofty beings who ruled the world.
Of course, this world was a little chaotic. Emperors were no longer unique to an era, and a situation of two Great Emperors standing side by side had appeared.
And if these people could find out more, they would know that there were actually far more than two Great Emperors in this world.
The Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor raised his hand casually, then looked at the Saint that had jumped out, "You want to avenge me?"
"I am willing to serve the Great Emperor!" That Saint was overjoyed.
This was an excellent opportunity to curry favor.
"If you can kill him, I’ll bestow you with a great opportunity," the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor said.
"Thank you, Great Emperor!" the Saint said as he knelt again.
The great opportunity that the Great Emperor spoke of was definitely extremely awesome.
Ling Han and the others were astonished. Others didn’t know that they were Great Emperors, but how could it be that the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor did not know either?
Since he knew, why did he still have to trick his own subordinates?
Was he temperamental? Or did he not take human life seriously at all?
It should be both.

After being trapped for countless years, the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor’s personality must have changed drastically. Thus, after he escaped, he tried his best to marry and have children. To him, subordinates were only toys, so how could he take them to heart?
"Who are you? I allow you to announce yourself, and I can also erect a tombstone for you after death," that Saint said. In front of the Great Emperor, he naturally had to perform well.
Ling Han smiled and said, "Then there’s no need. It’s just a matter of raising my hand."
"What did you say?" The Saint flew into a thunderous rage. Did this mean that he was no match for Ling Han?

"I had initially wanted you to have someone to pay respects to after your death. However, it’s a shame that you insisted on seeking death!" the Saint said in a baleful voice. He then leaped forward and charged at Ling Han.
Ling Han and the others didn’t move. However, the Saint started to crumble on his own when he was only nine meters away from Ling Han.

His arms and legs were the first to disappear, causing him to be greatly shocked. His expression was incredibly terrified, and when he opened his mouth to call for help, he had already disappeared completely.

"Looks like you won’t be able to obtain my good fortune," the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor murmured to himself. However, a smile tugged at the corners of his lips, and it was as if he were enjoying a show.
"Is it interesting?" Ling Han asked.
"It is." The Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor nodded, and said, "In this world now, no matter how I look or play with it, it is all interesting."
"Since that’s the case, why don’t you cherish this world?" Ling Han asked.
"This world would ultimately be destroyed, so why cherish it?" the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor countered.
Ling Han shook his head, and said, "We walk different paths, so we can’t work together!"
Hearing the conversation between the two of them, everyone felt their scalps go numb.
To be able to converse as an equal with the Great Emperor, who was he?
He could only be a Great Emperor!
Heavens, they had actually shouted at a Great Emperor just now?
However, shouldn’t the other Great Emperor be the Boundless Great Emperor?
This person in front of them... didn’t look like him at all.
"I didn’t kill you last time, so why didn’t you stay on that island? Why did you insist on coming to your death?" the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor asked calmly. There was no anger in his voice.
Who was he?
This was a great elite that had traversed many Stacked Eras and was truly invincible in this world. He definitely had an undying body.
Having lived long enough, he was naturally unconcerned about anything.
He had single-handedly directed the present prosperous times, but who knows, with a single thought, he might be able to erase all life in an instant.
In any case, their lives would all end one day.
Everything was just a cycle.
This damn loop!

After all, there were really not many people in this world that were qualified to make him laugh.
Ling Han did not smile, and merely said calmly, "Let’s go to the Primitive Abyss for a battle!"

He merely moved, and guided the attack of the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor into the galaxy. Though it created multiple black holes in space, it did not cause any deaths.

Ling Han was clearly an enemy, yet he was taking their lives into consideration. Meanwhile, the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor didn’t care about their lives at all.
This kind of understanding rendered them speechless.

The Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor laughed loudly, and said, "Alright, since you’re so close to becoming one of us, I’ll grant your request this once."
"Then let’s battle!" Ling Han took a step forwards, heading towards Primitive Abyss.
The Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor shrugged nonchalantly, and followed after him.

Seeing the large black dog and little azure dragon also leave on the golden path, the Imperial Might that diffused from them didn’t dissipate for a long time, and the Saints couldn’t help but be dumbfounded.
"That dog... is actually also a Great Emperor!"
Heavens, how was this possible?
"Even such a despicable dog can become Emperor!"
"Is the heavens blind?"

Their first reaction, as well as the most shocking thing for them was that the large black dog, being so despicable, had still become Emperor, and it was not that there were clearly two Great Emperors standing side by side, so how could a new Emperor be allowed to appear in this world?
From this, it could be seen just how despicable the large black dog was.
No wonder no one had been able to sit down previously, and even their pants had exploded.
With the evil intentions of a Great Emperor, what Saint would be able to withstand it?
’However, you’re a Great Emperor, so is there any need for you to play such tricks?’
Despicable, he was really despicable!
Everyone came to a unified understanding. From today onwards, the name of the Despicable Emperor would also spread throughout the world.
In the Primitive Abyss, Ling Han and the Mysterious Spirit Great Emperor faced off against each other.
"Being able to leave that island means that you’ve also grasped the four key factors," the Celestial Spirit Emperor said. "So, what’s the point of battling me?"
’You can’t kill me, and I can’t kill you either. Even if there’s still some difference in the grasp of the four elements, advantage and disadvantage won’t affect the final outcome at all.’
In any case, both sides were immortal and indestructible.
"Important!" Ling Han said in a solemn voice. "I can’t stand the sight of you!"

"Haha, hahaha!" The Celestial Spirit Emperor couldn’t help but laugh loudly. After laughing for a while, a nostalgic expression appeared on his face, and he said, "A long time ago, so long ago that even I almost forgot about it, I was also as childish as you."

chapters.title: Chapter 4898: Battle of first tiers
paragraphs: "Brat, one day, you will also become as indifferent as me," the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor said. "This isn’t a derogatory term, but rather stating a fact."
"When you’ve seen too many eras pass, your mentality will naturally change."
"We are high and noble, surpassing all else."
Ling Han laughed loudly, "I am the type to deliberately stomp on those who are not convinced. You are high and noble, so I will pull you off your horse, and stomp on you firmly!"
"Junior, you’re far too arrogant!" The Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor shook his head, and said, "No matter what, I’m still your senior. You need to respect your senior as much as possible!"
Boom, he threw a punch.
It was simple and direct, but because there were four elements wrapped around it, this punch was also indescribably violent.
With a single punch, it was guaranteed that even a second tier Great Emperor would be instantly killed!
Merging and connecting the four elements had actually surpassed the level of a Great Emperor, and reached an indescribable height.
Ling Han was unafraid, and faced it head-on with a punch.

Hong long long, the two invincible Great Emperors immediately broke out into an intense battle. With every exchange of blows, the ground around them would be completely destroyed, leaving behind multiple crevasses, like a dried up sea.

It should be known that with the sturdiness of the ground here, even an Imperial Weapon would find it difficult to create a small crater. However, the shockwaves created by the battle between Ling Han and the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor were able to cause such damage, which showed just how strong these two people were.
The simple word ’strong’ could no longer describe how terrifying they were.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
Ling Han no longer had any qualms. He unleashed his full battle prowess, focusing all his anger and emotions on his fists, and smashed them madly at the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor.
However, the older one was, the wiser they were.
How many years earlier had the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor become a first tier Great Emperor before Ling Han?
There were at least a dozen over Stacked Eras, right?
What a long time this was, and it also allowed the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor to reach perfection in the use of the four elements.
The four main elements were not just used for attack.

When Ling Han threw punch after punch, multiple shields appeared on the body of the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor. Although they were destroyed with a single punch from Ling Han, the damage still dropped to rock bottom.
This was naturally the use of the key element of creation, but to use it so proficiently, it required incredible understanding and mastery.

Though Ling Han was also using the element of creation to form a shield, in such a fast battle, if he wanted to form a defense at the parts that he should have defense in such a short period of time, he would need a strong ability of prediction.
Directly protect his entire body?

Firstly, in this way, he would not be able to attack. Secondly, with his battle prowess, only by shrinking his defenses to a point could he possibly block the attacks of his opponent. If he wanted to defend in all aspects, he would only become unable to withstand a single blow, and it would be completely ineffective.
Thus, Ling Han was repeatedly hit. After all, this was the first time he had come across a battle on this level.
Not long after, he was riddled with wounds.

However, this didn’t matter. The essence of life channeled by itself, instantly healing his injuries. If it weren’t for his tattered clothes, no one would believe that he had once been so severely injured.
When the large black dog and little azure dragon arrived, the battle between Ling Han and the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor had already reached its climax.
"This is the first time I’ve seen Little Han being suppressed by someone when their cultivation levels are equal," the large black dog said solemnly.

"It can’t be helped. He’s been immersed in this level for who knows how many years, so it’s normal that Little Han is no match." The little azure dragon wasn’t worried. "In any case, that guy already has an undying body."
The essence of life flowed through his body. To say nothing of the fact that others could not kill him, even if he wanted to commit suicide, he would not be able to.
At this point, he was truly undying and indestructible.
No wonder people would become lunatics as time passed.
For example, the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor had directly married a million wives, and given birth to tens of thousands of children.
However, as the battle continued, Ling Han received fewer and fewer wounds.
For him, battle was the best teacher.
In the intense battle, his experience was rapidly increasing, and his understanding and use of the four elements was also rapidly increasing.
Peng! Peng! Peng!

The Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor unleashed a three-hit combo, yet they were all blocked by Ling Han’s shield of earth. At the beginning, Ling Han had to sustain at least two attacks. Afterward, he would only sustain one out of the three strikes, and right until this moment, he had blocked all of them.
"Not bad, not bad. Your comprehension ability in battle is very strong. Perhaps, even I was inferior to you in the past," the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor said. However, his attacks didn’t stop.
He was no longer limited to using his fists, palm strikes, finger taps, or kicks. Every move was indescribably amazing, but its might was also indescribably great.
He was a Great Emperor, and he could summon clouds with a flip of his hand and rain with a wave of his hand.
The stronger his opponent was, the more astonishing Ling Han’s rebound would be.
He had already gotten used to the rhythm of the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor’s attacks. Not only had he blocked its attacks, but he had even begun to counterattack.
At this, the two Great Emperors started to suffer injuries.
After reaching their height, who would be weaker than the other?
Thus, if anyone retained a portion of their power for defense, that would definitely lead to insufficient attack power, and they would not be able to wound their opponent at all.
And if he defended with all his might, he would only be beaten.
With the pride of a Great Emperor, would he choose to defend passively?
Thus, the two Great Emperors chose to attack with all their might without hesitation.
You punch me, and I kick you. With their attacks that were strong to the extreme, they could easily tear through each other’s bodies, and cause great damage.
However, when the essence of life surged past, no matter how serious the injury, it would immediately recover.
In fact... even if their physical bodies were destroyed, the soul mark could still be revived with a single thought, and recover to their original state.
As for the soul mark, even heaven and earth wouldn’t be able to destroy it if it shrank back to a single point.
Thus, they truly had undying bodies.

The battle was incredibly intense, with Imperial Blood spraying everywhere. However, just as the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor had said before, the battle between them was meaningless. Since they were undying bodies, no matter how intense the battle was, it would only be a waste of time.
Of course, for them, time itself was meaningless. The only difference was that sometimes, they could move freely, but at other times, they would be trapped for a few Stacked Eras.
"Junior, do you still want to continue the battle?" the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor asked calmly. There was no emotion on his face.
After experiencing a long life, he had long since lost all emotion.
Sorrow, joy, delight, and anger had long since disappeared without a trace. His actions were all based on his will, and he did not care about good or evil.
Ling Han released a battle cry, and began to increase his power.
Boom, it was not just the four elements that came from the surroundings. He was also using the four elements of his own body, which was equivalent to the overlap of two heavens and earths.
Instantly, his battle prowess began to spike madly.
’Hmm?’
A hint of surprise appeared on the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor’s face.

This made him feel refreshed. Who knew how many years it had been? He had long since become numb, and had seen too many things. There was already nothing in this world that could attract his attention.
However, his interest was piqued now.
Interesting, this was really interesting.

When one had reached a height like they had, the four fundamental elements that they could sense and use were all the same. The difference lay in the method of use and the level of proficiency. This needed time.
However, the amount of four elements that Ling Han shot out far surpassed him.

chapters.title: Chapter 4899: Blinded
paragraphs: A strong sense of curiosity welled up in the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor’s heart. Although the amount of four elements that Ling Han could unleash wasn’t double his, it was at least 20% more than what he could unleash.
When one had reached a height like they had, they could no longer advance any further. Thus, even if it was only a 20% increase, this was still a massive advantage.
This was also inconceivable.
What granted you the ability to have this boost?
Peng!
The Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor received Ling Han’s punch head-on, yet he was still sent flying.
Ling Han caught up with him, and sent out his fists in a barrage of punches.
Peng, peng, peng! Each punch landed solidly, and it wasn’t long before the chest of the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor cracked open, revealing his white bones. Even his heart was exposed.
However, the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor only needed to think for a moment, and his injuries would immediately heal, leaving no trace behind.
Ling Han indeed had an advantage in terms of battle prowess, and it was a very great advantage at that. Yet, he was still unable to kill the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor.
He wanted to draw the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor into his own heaven and earth, but he was completely unable to do so.
The gap in battle prowess between the two of them had not reached the extent of overwhelming.

"You really are a strange junior!" the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor exclaimed ruefully. He then stroked his chin, and said, "I had initially thought that my power had already reached its limit. Who would’ve thought that there was still room for improvement?"
"I’m not going to play with you anymore. I’m going into seclusion to comprehend."
Seclusion, this was a term that was already incredibly unfamiliar to him. Ever since he had cultivated the four elements, he was invincible and undying, so what was the point of going into seclusion?
Even the destruction of heaven and earth couldn’t kill him.
But for those that could become a Great Emperor, which one of them did not have the heart to become invincible?

And now, there was actually someone whose battle prowess surpassed his. Even if he was still undying and indestructible, there was still a lot of displeasure in his heart, and he had gained an ambition.
Another could, but why couldn’t he?
They were the only four first tier Great Emperors in this universe.
The Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor was extremely decisive, and he immediately turned around to leave.
Ling Han didn’t pursue him. After all, so what if he caught up to him? He couldn’t draw him into the heaven and earth inside his body, so he couldn’t kill him.
And once a battle broke out in the outside world, just how great would the loss of life be?
The difference between Ling Han and the three invincible Great Emperors was that he still had a kind heart.

This was not soft-heartedness. If there came a day when Ling Han really had the strength to suppress the three Great Emperors, then even if they had to battle in the outside world, he would not hesitate to battle.

Without destruction, there would be no construction. Only by dealing with these three Great Emperors would the development of the world be able to conform to nature, and not, because of their interference, the world had become their toy.
Ling Han pondered deeply. When the four elements in his body reached the same level as this heaven and earth, would he be able to suppress those three?
He had no idea, because no one had reached this kind of battle prowess before, so he naturally could only fantasize.
The Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor went into seclusion just like that, ignoring all of his million wives and tens of thousands of children.
Without this Great Emperor standing guard, his territory was completely divided between Ling Han and the Boundless Great Emperor.
Ling Han was re-establishing order, while the Boundless Great Emperor continued to destroy order, advocating violence.
Tens of thousands of years later, the borders of the two great forces were already close, and it was inevitable that conflict would arise.
However, the Boundless Great Emperor never made a move..
As he saw it, any contest for supremacy was only a game. He was the one who was playing the game, so how could he personally participate in the battle?
It didn’t matter if he won or lost. It was just a game. Worse come to worst, he could enter the next Stacked Era and start a new game.
Ling Han was different.

Great Emperor Wu Ya and the others, added with Shou Ji and the other Great Emperors that he had created, had an absolute advantage in terms of numbers of Great Emperors. Naturally, they pushed forwards, and the number of planets they conquered ncreased.

Though the Boundless Great Emperor had also created Great Emperors, firstly, they were only in eighth tier, and secondly, there were only a mere nine of them. Naturally, they were powerless to stop them.
After a million years, the territory of the Boundless Great Emperor had already shrunk to one-tenth of its original size. Its share in the entire universe was already less than five percent.

All the Great Emperors were just about to continue their efforts, and conquer all the territory of the Boundless Great Emperor, but right at this moment, they encountered a powerful enemy, which was also an old enemy.
—The old Divine Beast.
Theoretically speaking, the old Divine Beast would only be able to die if it left the Imperial Island. However, who asked him to be taken away by the three invincible Great Emperors?
They could also freely obtain element of life, allowing the old Divine Beast to extend its lifespan, just like the Great Emperor Wu Ya and the others.
This character was in the second tier!
Who could block the attack of a second tier Great Emperor?
Even if the Great Emperor Wu Ya and the others had already advanced to the third tier, they were still no match in a one-on-one battle.
Moreover, they were also apprehensive, because if Great Emperors attacked with their full strength, the damage caused would be too great.
Just look at how the twelve Lords of Death battled Xuan Taiyu, causing the entire North Heavenly Realm’s fortune to decline for tens of millions of years.
Right now, not only were there more Great Emperors, but their battle prowess was also at the second tier or third tier. Thus, the damage caused by this was naturally even greater.
The biggest difference between the Boundless Great Emperor, the old Divine Beast, and Ling Han and the others was that they could ignore all life in the world and do as they liked.
When Ling Han received the news, he immediately moved out.
He stood in the galaxy, and there was a massive white star in front of him. The old Divine Beast was standing guard there.
Behind him was the empress, the large black dog, the Great Emperor Wu Ya, and so on.
Ling Han moved, grabbing out at the star in front of him.
Weng, immediately, an Imperial Might spread out, and the old Divine Beast took a step and arrived in the galaxy.

"What a joke, where did you guys get the courage to actually dare to invade this place!" The old Divine Beast sneered, while its eyes were fixed on Ling Han, "Junior, do you think that just because you have become a second tier, you can compete with those three?"
"Yi, the information of this old b@stard is so outdated. He still doesn’t know that Ling Han once battled with the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor," the large black dog said in surprise.
"True." The little azure dragon nodded. "He’s only a servant. The Boundless Great Emperor doesn’t need to report to him."
"Sigh, letting our Little Han battle with a servant is really demeaning!" The large black dog shook his head, "Just see how Grandpa Dog will deal with him!"
The large black dog turned around, and aimed his behind at the old Divine Beast.

"Junior, if you don’t want to die, scram quickly. Don’t wait— wu!" The old Divine Beast wanted to subdue Ling Han’s troops without fighting. After all, he had fought Ling Han before, and was already no match for the latter.
However, before he could finish speaking, he felt a strong light shine over, causing his eyes to hurt.
What was going on?

He focused his gaze and looked over. Shockingly, he saw that despicable dog shaking its behind at him, and what was shining brightly and causing his eyes to hurt was precisely the iron underwear that the other was wearing.
’Holy f*ck!’
Even with the strength of the old Divine Beast, it still couldn’t help but shed tears. This was naturally not something like grief, but purely because of the strong light.

It should be known that that was a Transcendent Weapon. It should have possessed the might of fifth tier, and its explosive power could reach fourth tier. Now, however, the large black dog had exploited all of its might, and it instantly lost all destructive power.
But because of this, how bright would this light be?
Even a second tier would be dazzled by the light, or even shed tears!

chapters.title: Chapter 4900: Annihilating the old Divine Beast
paragraphs: This, the old Divine Beast shed tears!

All the Great Emperors felt rueful. They had battled with the old Divine Beast for millions and millions of years, yet they had not even managed to wound the old Divine Beast. And as for the large black dog, with a shake of his behind, the old Divine Beast was blinded so badly that it was shedding tears.
Despicable indeed, but it could not be denied that this was their best battle merit against the old Divine Beast.
He was clearly despicable, so why had he succeeded instead?
All the Emperors were speechless. This kind of victory made them feel too embarrassed to celebrate.

"Hahaha!" Only the large black dog laughed proudly, and twisted his behind even more happily. Xiu, xiu, xiu! Blinding light flashed madly. Unless this was a first tier Great Emperor like Ling Han, anyone would feel annoyed.
"Despicable dog, I’m going to kill you!" The old Divine Beast was in a towering rage, and with a wave of its hand, delivered a palm strike at the large black dog.
What he hated the most now was not Ling Han, but rather the large black dog.
He was so despicable that he gritted his teeth.
Ling Han immediately lashed out. Pa! He easily blocked the strike.
The large black dog switched positions, and continued to dazzle the surroundings.
The old Divine Beast had no choice but to cover its face with its hands. Otherwise, nothing could block this kind of light.
After roaming the world for so long, when had he ever been in such a sorry state?
"Despicable dog! Despicable dog! Despicable dog!" he roared in exasperation.
The large black dog picked his ears, and said to Ling Han, "Grandpa Dog is feeling great now, so I’ll leave the matters afterwards to you."
This show-off acted like he was even more awesome than Ling Han.
Ling Han naturally did not take it to heart. He merely smiled, and asked the old Divine Beast, "Do you have any last words to say?"
"Haha!" The old Divine Beast turned to look at Ling Han, "Junior, do you think that just because you have killed a few Great Emperors, you can kill even me?"
"En." Ling Han nodded, and moved directly, grabbing out at the old Divine Beast.
The old Divine Beast was enraged, and brandished a palm strike at Ling Han.
However, when he delivered this strike, it was like mud sinking into the ocean, directly disappearing without a trace.
’What?’
He couldn’t help but gape in shock. Just how powerful was this attack of his? Why did it seem like it had not been delivered at all?
"You!" Realization suddenly dawned on him, and the gaze he directed at Ling Han was filled with envy and jealousy.
First tier!
Ling Han had already mastered all four elements, and had become an invincible Great Emperor.
How could this not make him jealous?
That was because this had always been his pursuit. Furthermore, just when it looked like he was about to succeed, he was stopped by Star Moon Empress and the others, and what was the result?
Now, Ling Han had become an invincible Great Emperor, while he was a lackey.
He was filled with hatred!
Boom, Ling Han’s attack landed, and instantly, only half of the old Divine Beast’s body was left. No matter how tough his physique was, it was still insufficient in front of Ling Han.
"You can’t possibly grasp the four elements," Ling Han said calmly. "You are created by the heaven and earth, so how can you possibly rival the heaven and earth?"
It had to be a Great Emperor that had cultivated to perfection in every cultivation level, and only then could he possibly become an invincible Great Emperor.

Hence, even if the old Divine Beast was an extraordinary breed like the Heaven Devouring Beast, grasping the three fundamental elements was the finishing line. If he wanted to forcefully comprehend the four fundamental elements, he would only be crushed by the power of the fundamental elements.

Throughout history, there had been at least 34 Stacked Eras. However, there were only a measly four Great Emperors of the first tier. From this, it could be seen just how difficult it was to reach this level.

"No, as long as I was given a little more time, I would definitely be able to reach this step as well!" the old Divine Beast said defiantly. He had once crushed this young man in front of him, but now, the latter had severed half of his body with a single move.
The gap in battle prowess was already indescribably wide.

Ling Han shook his head. The old Divine Beast that he had once viewed as a great enemy was completely unable to withstand a single blow from him now. It was not even qualified to make him take it seriously.

"Ling Han, what kind of expression is that!" The old Divine Beast was already in a terrible mood, yet Ling Han’s disdainful attitude still caused him to be completely battered. How could he endure this?
"Ah!"
He screamed again, because that despicable light shone over again, dazzling him to the point that his single eye was tearing up.
Thankfully, he was now missing one side of his body, and only had one eye. The damage caused by this was directly halved.
"Hehe, who asked you to be so arrogant!" the large black dog said, swaying his behind.
"Despicable dog, you’re using your powerful connections as an intimidation tactic!" the old Divine Beast roared.
"Wrong, wrong. Little Han is Grandpa Dog’s brother. How can this be called using powerful connections as an intimidation tactic?" The large black dog giggled.
Ling Han shook his head, and pressed down another hand.

"No—" the old Divine Beast called out in defiance. He was originally the strongest in this era, and had the highest chance of becoming an invincible and undying Great Emperor. In the end, he first became a lackey, and now, he couldn’t even save his life.
Boom, Ling Han’s attack swept over, and the old Divine Beast instantly disappeared into thin air.
When the element of destruction swept past, there would naturally be nothing left of him.
Ling Han waited for a while longer, yet he didn’t see the Boundless Great Emperor make a move.
He knew that it was not because he was afraid. He was already undying and indestructible, so what was there to be afraid of?
He was like the Mysterious Clouds Great Emperor, viewing all life as a toy. Meanwhile, he was high and mighty, looking down on the show that he had directed.
Since the Boundless Great Emperor didn’t attack, Ling Han didn’t engage in battle either. Instead, he turned around and left.
Another two thousand years later, order had been re-established in the entire universe.
And by this time, everyone could sense that the signs of becoming Emperor had appeared in the heaven and earth.
More than 10 million years had passed, and the shockwaves from the previous Great Emperor had already dispersed completely. The heaven and earth would allow a new Emperor to appear.
All the young prodigies were rubbing their fists, wanting to contend for this once in a thousand years opportunity.

Although there were hundreds of Great Emperors in the world at this moment, it couldn’t be denied that the level of Great Emperor was still the most powerful battle prowess in the world. Everyone wanted to squeeze into this group.
Ling Han also wanted his descendants to fight for this great opportunity.
Although they could also become Emperors in the Primitive Abyss, there would be limitations. Ultimately, they would not have been blessed by heaven and earth.
Of course, this was unless they obtained all four of the key elements. However, this was far too difficult. Out of the dozens of Stacked Eras, only four had appeared.
Jing Haoran and Shui Qingchang also came out of seclusion one after another. They could only reach second tier, and could not advance any further.
Consummate level of the four elements was really, really too difficult. Even if they were the masters of the Genesis World, they would not be able to accomplish this.
If two, or even more, invincible Great Emperors appeared from this Stacked Era, that would really be strange.

However, all the Great Emperors had long since reached the end of their lifespans. They could only travel the world by depending on the element of life provided by Ling Han. Otherwise, if they wanted to live, they could only stay on the Imperial Island.
The heaven and earth allowed a new Emperor to appear, and this also welcomed a heyday of cultivation. Outstanding talents appeared from all over the world.
Ling Han valued prodigies. He had the Nine Suns Holy Land recruit prodigies, and he would also personally guide them, wanting to take a gamble on the fortune of heaven and earth.
He sat cross-legged on a rock, while his disciples sat around him, listening quietly to his teachings.
These disciples all knew that this was an invincible Great Emperor. Even if any one of them became a Great Emperor, they would still have to be extremely respectful in front of Ling Han.
A Great Emperor who woudl attain Dao in this era would clearly be very depressed. He should have been invincible in this world, and suppressed an era, but what happened in the end?
There were many Great Emperors, and there were even invincible Great Emperors.
Hong long long, countless golden lotuses suddenly appeared out of thin air in the heaven and earth, blooming everywhere.
A new Emperor was about to be born!
However, how could it be so fast!
Everyone was astounded. No Pseudo-Emperors had appeared among them, so it was naturally impossible that one of them had attained Dao.
Meanwhile, Ling Han’s expression was filled with shock. This f, the one who had attained Dao was him!
